jobs.title: Compliance Officer - Fraud Risk (Temporary, 80-100%)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about fighting financial crime and building robust frameworks to protect a global organisation? Join our dynamic Compliance team at Swiss Re where you'll play a pivotal role in designing and implementing strategies to combat fraud risk across our worldwide operations. This is your opportunity to apply your expertise in a collaborative, international environment while making a meaningful impact on our organisation's integrity and resilience.

About the Role
 As our Compliance Officer - Fraud Risk Framework Owner, you'll be the driving force behind Swiss Re's global fraud risk management strategy. You'll design, oversee, and continuously enhance our fraud risk framework, leveraging your deep technical knowledge of anti-fraud controls and their application to industry to protect our organization against evolving fraud threats.
 Key Responsibilities

• Own and enhance the global Fraud Risk Framework, including policies, standards, and processes that form the foundation of our fraud risk management approach.

• Establish operational strategies to enable effective Compliance oversight of fraud risk.

• Provide ongoing oversight of the design and effectiveness of fraud control environment.

• Monitor and assess fraud-related regulatory developments, determining their impact and defining appropriate actions.

• Lead training and awareness by developing comprehensive global training content and awareness initiatives on the fraud risk for employees, and conducting trainings.

• Advise senior stakeholders on fraud risk management topics and provide expert guidance across business units.

• Support broader Compliance initiatives including policy development, regulatory monitoring, and risk assessments.

• Contribute to Compliance reporting and oversight, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.

About the Team
 The Compliance Financial Crime Risk Frameworks (FCR) team at Swiss Re is responsible for global Compliance frameworks covering four key financial crime risks: Fraud, Bribery and Corruption, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, and Economic Sanctions. Our diverse team based in New York, Bratislava, and London develops, maintains, and implements global policies, standards, processes, and supporting technology to manage these risks effectively. We deliver training programs to educate employees on their responsibilities and monitor emerging risks and regulatory developments across all jurisdictions where Swiss Re operates.

About You
 You're a seasoned compliance professional with deep expertise in fraud risk management. You combine technical knowledge with excellent communication skills, allowing you to influence stakeholders at all levels. You're detail-oriented yet strategic, and able to see both the big picture and the nuanced implementation requirements. You thrive in a collaborative environment but have the ability to work independently to drive fraud risk related matters.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• University degree or equivalent qualification (legal training beneficial).

• Solid compliance experience, including at least 3 years in anti-fraud roles, preferably within insurance or financial services.

• Proven experience in utilizing organizational risk management framework towards fraud risk management. A fraud-related certification would be a strong plus.

• Hands-on experience in developing and maintaining compliance risk frameworks, particularly drafting policies, standards, and processes.

• Strong experience in developing and delivering trainings.

• Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders across all seniority levels.

• Excellent organizational, analytical, and project management capabilities.
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Certified Anti-Fraud Specialist Certification (CAFS), or another professional anti-fraud certification.

• Knowledge of other financial crime risks (Bribery and Corruption, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, and Economic Sanctions).

• Additional languages beyond fluent English, especially German.

• Experience working in multinational organizations with diverse regulatory environment.
 This is a temporary position to provide maternity cover. The contract will be for a fixed term, subject to the return of the postholder.
 For Slovakia, the monthly base salary range for this position is between 2,900 EUR and 4,900 EUR for a full-time role.
 The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role
 • the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.
 We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.
 #LI-Hybrid
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. jobs.title: Claims Specialist Property E&C (hybrid, m/f/x, 80-100%)
jobs.description:
Locations:
Frankfurt, DE |
Hamburg, DE |
Munich, DE

Are you passionate about insurance and ready to grow your career in a supportive environment? Join our dynamic Property, Engineering & Construction Claims Team in DACH and develop your expertise in a role where you can make a real difference. We're looking for an enthusiastic professional who enjoys solving problems and is committed to delivering excellent service to our clients.
 About the Role
 As a Claims Specialist in our Property, Engineering & Construction team, you'll handle a portfolio of claims underwritten in the DACH region. You'll focus on Property and Engineering including International Programme Property losses, working alongside experienced colleagues to develop your technical skills and contribute to successful claim resolutions.
 Our objective is proactive investigation and evaluation, fair resolution, and the delivery of exceptional customer service in line with the Corporate Solutions Claims Commitment.
 Key Responsibilities

• Process and manage a portfolio of standard claims within defined technical authority from first advice through to settlement, including initial coverage review and fact investigation.

• Perform loss evaluation and contribute to appropriate claim resolution strategies under supervision.

• Coordinate with external experts and vendors while helping to monitor budgets.

• Support the handling of recovery claims and assist in identifying potential dubious/fraud cases.

• Prepare accurate reports for internal stakeholders and share claims insights with colleagues.

• Alert team leaders about potential loss developments consistent with company procedures.
 About the Team
 The DACH Property, Engineering and Construction claims team is based in Frankfurt, Hamburg, Munich and Zürich and comprises 10 claims professionals of different backgrounds, fields and languages, handling losses in these main lines of business. We believe that the way in which claims are handled, through the delivery of our Corporate Solutions Claims Commitment, can be a key differentiator and enables us to provide a unique and de-commoditised service to our customers.
 Put simply: we want exemplary claims service to be the reason customers buy insurance from Swiss Re Corporate Solutions.
 About You
 You're a collaborative, detail-oriented professional with a positive attitude and eagerness to learn. You communicate effectively, work well in teams, and approach challenges with enthusiasm. You're organized, adaptable, and ready to develop your skills in a dynamic insurance environment.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 3+ years Claims or Insurance Industry experience, preferably with some exposure to Property, Engineering or Construction claims

• Demonstrated ability to work with external experts and vendors

• Basic understanding of policy coverage, investigation processes, and claim evaluation

• Proficiency with computer systems including MS Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), MS Outlook, and internet-based research

• Understanding of insurance fundamentals and willingness to develop technical expertise

• Fluency in both German and English languages
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with international program business

• Knowledge of additional European languages

• Basic familiarity with construction and engineering concepts

• Experience handling standard claims independently

• Insurance-related coursework or initial certifications

• Interest in developing specialized expertise in Property, Engineering or Construction claims
 For Germany, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 70,000 and EUR 116,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers: ​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,​

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. jobs.title: Head RDS Insurance Sales, UK&I
jobs.description:
As Head RDS Insurance Sales UK & Ireland, you will play a critical role in driving the growth of our Solutions business in Insurance and Public Sector market segments. You’ll work with cross-functional teams to deepen relationships with existing clients and develop new revenue streams, particularly with non-clients and in adjacent segments. This role is key to expanding our fee-based income and supporting the growth of our core RDS Insurance Solutions offerings.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive sales of RDS Insurance Solutions products, consulting services and analytics projects for the United Kingdom & Ireland markets.

• Lead a team of sales and customer success professionals creating a high performing team to successfully achieve annual plan ambitions aligned to global standards

• Own the regional Market Unit relationships and partner with the MU heads to execute the RDS Insurance regional plan

• Establish annual business plan and derive individual sales targets for yourself and your team members

• Deliver regional and individual fee-based revenue targets in alignment with annual business planning

• Execute the implementation of the go-to-market strategy across United Kingdom & Ireland.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients.

• Conduct thorough clients' needs analysis to identify new opportunities and identify and prospect potential clients and leads through various channels.

• Manage a robust sales pipeline of qualified leads.

• Present compelling sales pitches and product demonstrations to articulate value propositions.

• Lead negotiations and close deals to meet/exceed sales objectives.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance outreach and business development strategies.

• Monitor industry trends and competitor activity to identify new opportunities.

• Maintain a solid understanding of Swiss Re's IP assets and technologies, products, and consulting capabilities.

• Provide structured feedback to product and delivery teams to inform development and commercial improvements.

• Keep accurate records in the CRM system and prepare regular sales reports and forecasts for senior management.

About Swiss Re Risk Data Solutions

RDS Insurance is a central pillar of our strategy, critical to the development of our core activities as well as developing new revenue streams for Swiss Re. We offer a comprehensive suite of services; from risk consulting and software solutions to data analytics and SaaS platforms, we help clients stay competitive in an evolving industry. Through our global expertise and specialist tools, clients gain agility and resilience in an ever-changing marketplace.

About you

• At least 15 years of experience in sales and leading teams, preferably within financial, consulting, or technology services

• Deep knowledge of the P&C insurance industry across underwriting, claims, risk management, and technology

• Strong existing network within the P&C sector and a proven track record of consistently achieving sales targets

• Exceptional prospecting and lead-generation skills

• Skilled communicator with a consultative, client-first approach and ability to translate customer needs into solutions that address them

• Experience influencing senior stakeholders and C-suite decision-makers

• Motivated, results-driven, and team-oriented

• Comfortable making independent decisions while aligning with broader business objectives

• Experience leading and building high performing sales teams

Key Attributes:

• Empathetic and attentive listener with a problem-solving mindset

• Persistent and resilient under pressure

• Agile, creative, and adaptable to a fast-paced environment

• Strong organizational and time management abilities

• Committed to exceptional client service

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office two to three days per week on average.
 The base salary range for this position is between £144,000 and £216,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibities of the role,
• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

 Payroll delivery and compliance

 Controls, reconciliations , and year-end

jobs.title: Insurance Partner Associate with Spanish

titleByLocale.it: Partner di assicurazione associato con lo spagnolo

jobs.description:
Are you ready to make a real impact in a truly international environment? Do you enjoy the freedom to work independently, while being part of a supportive, hard-working, and globally connected team? If you're looking for a role where your ideas matter and your work has global reach — we'd love to hear from you!

About the Role

At Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, we work with trusted Insurance Partners — external insurance companies — in countries where we don't have local servicing capabilities. These partners help us serve our global clients wherever they operate, issuing policies and managing claims.
 As an Insurance Partner Associate , you will play a key role in supporting the delivery of international insurance programs for large corporate clients. This is a dynamic, cross-functional role ideal for someone who thrives on communication, problem-solving, and operating in a fast-paced international environment — someone who is energised by variety and can confidently manage a high volume of tasks and requests while maintaining quality and accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage a high volume of requests across your portfolio, prioritising effectively to meet deadlines and client expectations

• Support policy issuance — quotations, policies, and invoices — ensuring accuracy and timeliness through quality checks

• Document partner and market insights to support a shared knowledge base and drive process improvements

• Drive process improvement by creating and updating clear guidelines and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

• Collaborate with LATAM colleagues , including occasional calls in the later afternoon hours (once or twice per week) to align across time zones

About the Team

Swiss Re's International Program Services Team plays a key role in delivering insurance solutions to global clients with operations across multiple countries. Our team is based in Bratislava, Kuala Lumpur, and Mexico City , ensuring closeness to our network partners and making sure everything runs smoothly — from policy quotation to premium collection. We are a collaborative, multicultural team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

About You

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented professional who brings strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to stay composed and effective when managing a high volume of work. You are goal-oriented, eager to learn, and comfortable navigating a multicultural, international environment. You take ownership of your work, build trusted relationships across borders, and bring a proactive approach to problem-solving.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Professional experience in Operations, Finance, or International Business

• Proficiency in Business English AND Spanish (written and spoken) — essential for supporting our LATAM partner network

• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage high volumes of tasks , balancing multiple priorities while delivering high-quality results under pressure

• Excellent communication skills , with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships in a multicultural environment

• Flexibility and availability to participate in occasional calls with LATAM colleagues during later afternoon hours (once or twice per week), in line with regional time zones

• Goal-oriented and self-driven approach , with a willingness to work both independently and as part of a team

These are additional nice to haves:

• Previous experience in the re/insurance industry

• Familiarity with international insurance programs or global client servicing

• Experience working with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) or process documentation

jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in Cloud Infrastructure Engineering ? Are you passionate about everything Azure Cloud? Then join us as a Senior QA & Reliability Engineer
 About the Role
 As a Senior QA & Reliability Engineer, you will be at the heart of Swiss Re's cloud transformationjourney — embedding quality and reliability into every layer of our Azure cloud platform. This isnot a siloed QA role. You will think holistically, connecting testing, monitoring, and observabilityas interconnected disciplines that drive real engineering excellence. You will work in a fast-paced,cross-functional environment, partnering with platform, product, and delivery teams to ensure ourcloud solutions are secure, compliant, and built to last.
 Your main responsibilities:
 This role requires curious, driven, and collaborative engineer who takes pride in building systems that are not only functional but truly dependable. You bring a holistic mindset to reliability - thinking about quality, monitoring, and testing as interconnected disciplines rather than silos. You communicate clearly, thrive in cross-functional environments, and are energized by solving complex technical challenges with real business impact.

• Define and execute test strategies (integration, performance, reliability testing)

• Build and maintain automated test frameworks and CI/CD quality

• Ensure end-to-end functional and non-functional validation (NFRs)

• Drive test coverage, defect analysis, and root cause resolution

• Establish quality metrics and reporting frameworks

• Proven experience with Microsoft Azure - including Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and related observability and reliability services

• Strong background in reliability or quality engineering - with hands-on experience designing and executing testing strategies (integration, performance, chaos/resilience testing) in cloud-native environments

• Solid expertise in monitoring and observability - including the design of logging frameworks, metrics pipelines, distributed tracing, and alerting systems at scale

• Embed quality and reliability practices into SDLC and DevOps pipelines

• Mentor engineers and uplift QA/SRE practices across teams

• Partner with product, platform, and delivery teams to align quality with business goals
 About the team
 The Public Cloud Platform Delivery Team is a unit in the Public Cloud Transformation department. The team focuses on platform operations that manage the overall Azure platform setup, security policies, and service operations. Enable application teams to deliver secure, compliant, and innovative solutions that increase business value. Partner with application delivery teams to innovate, deliver and operate solutions in a fast, secure and compliant way to enable and increase business value.
 The Public Cloud Platform Delivery's mission is to

• Design, build and operate secure and compliant cloud platforms and shared services and tools to enhance value-driven adoption.

• Provide an efficient engineering experience via platforms and services aligned with Cloud Technology Management steering & guidance.
 About You
 The following proven technical skills will be required:

• Deep hands‑on knowledge of Azure

• Hands-on expertise in designing app workload using Cloud Platform Services (SaaS, and PaaS).

• Hands-on expertise with chaos engineering tools (e.g., Azure Chaos Studio, Gremlin, or similar)

• Hands-on expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) such as Bicep and CI/CD Azure DevOps pipeline integration for automated quality and reliability checks

• Strong grounding in Platform engineering concepts: golden paths, paved road tooling, self‑service automation, and internal developer platforms (IDPs).

• Experience in one or more programming languages: PowerShell, Bash or Python.

• Experience in Azure landing zone design , platform automation design, DevSecOps tooling, network topology & connectivity, access management & privileged identity design, platform monitoring, security architecture, high availability architecture design.

• Experience in DevOps methodology (preferably DevSecOps), both technically and organisationally, including continuous deployment, delivery pipelines and test environments.

• Good stakeholder communication. Ability to work with Product Owners, Security Leads, Architects and engineering teams.

• At ease working in a transformational and complex environment at a fast-pace and getting things done.

• Proficiency in English is required.
 For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 60,000 and EUR 100,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

 About the Role
 As a Senior QA & Reliability Engineer, you will be at the heart of Swiss Re's cloud transformationjourney — embedding quality and reliability into every layer of our Azure cloud platform. This isnot a siloed QA role. You will think holistically, connecting testing, monitoring, and observabilityas interconnected disciplines that drive real engineering excellence. You will work in a fast-paced,cross-functional environment, partnering with platform, product, and delivery teams to ensure ourcloud solutions are secure, compliant, and built to last.
 Your main responsibilities:
 This role requires curious, driven, and collaborative engineer who takes pride in building systems that are not only functional but truly dependable. You bring a holistic mindset to reliability - thinking about quality, monitoring, and testing as interconnected disciplines rather than silos. You communicate clearly, thrive in cross-functional environments, and are energized by solving complex technical challenges with real business impact.

• Define and execute test strategies (integration, performance, reliability testing)

• Build and maintain automated test frameworks and CI/CD quality

• Ensure end-to-end functional and non-functional validation (NFRs)

• Drive test coverage, defect analysis, and root cause resolution

• Establish quality metrics and reporting frameworks

• Proven experience with Microsoft Azure - including Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and related observability and reliability services

• Strong background in reliability or quality engineering - with hands-on experience designing and executing testing strategies (integration, performance, chaos/resilience testing) in cloud-native environments

• Solid expertise in monitoring and observability - including the design of logging frameworks, metrics pipelines, distributed tracing, and alerting systems at scale

• Embed quality and reliability practices into SDLC and DevOps pipelines

• Mentor engineers and uplift QA/SRE practices across teams

• Partner with product, platform, and delivery teams to align quality with business goals
 About the team
 The Public Cloud Platform Delivery Team is a unit in the Public Cloud Transformation department. The team focuses on platform operations that manage the overall Azure platform setup, security policies, and service operations. Enable application teams to deliver secure, compliant, and innovative solutions that increase business value. Partner with application delivery teams to innovate, deliver and operate solutions in a fast, secure and compliant way to enable and increase business value.
 The Public Cloud Platform Delivery's mission is to

• Design, build and operate secure and compliant cloud platforms and shared services and tools to enhance value-driven adoption.

• Provide an efficient engineering experience via platforms and services aligned with Cloud Technology Management steering & guidance.
 About You
 The following proven technical skills will be required:

• Deep hands‑on knowledge of Azure

• Hands-on expertise in designing app workload using Cloud Platform Services (SaaS, and PaaS).

• Hands-on expertise with chaos engineering tools (e.g., Azure Chaos Studio, Gremlin, or similar)

• Hands-on expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) such as Bicep and CI/CD Azure DevOps pipeline integration for automated quality and reliability checks

• Strong grounding in Platform engineering concepts: golden paths, paved road tooling, self‑service automation, and internal developer platforms (IDPs).

• Experience in one or more programming languages: PowerShell, Bash or Python.

• Experience in Azure landing zone design , platform automation design, DevSecOps tooling, network topology & connectivity, access management & privileged identity design, platform monitoring, security architecture, high availability architecture design.

• Experience in DevOps methodology (preferably DevSecOps), both technically and organisationally, including continuous deployment, delivery pipelines and test environments.

• Good stakeholder communication. Ability to work with Product Owners, Security Leads, Architects and engineering teams.

• At ease working in a transformational and complex environment at a fast-pace and getting things done.

• Proficiency in English is required.
 For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 60,000 and EUR 100,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 #LI-Hybrid
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. jobs.title: Contracts Specialist - L&H Re/Insurance
jobs.description:
Locations:
Chicago, IL, US |
Kansas City, MO, US |
Armonk, NY, US |
Fort Wayne, IN, US

About the Role
 This is a high-ownership, individual contributor role where you'll lead end-to-end contract drafting for Life & Health reinsurance deals across the US, Canada, and English Caribbean markets. You'll work with autonomy, guided by clear frameworks, and collaborate closely with underwriters, client managers, pricing, legal, and operations to ensure every contract reflects deal intent with precision and commercial clarity. Reporting to the Head Contracts L&H North America, this role offers direct exposure to live transactions and meaningful influence over how traditional reinsurance deals are structured and executed.

Key Responsibilities

Draft and Review Reinsurance Contracts

• Own end-to-end drafting of Life & Health traditional reinsurance contracts and addenda with a high degree of independence

• Translate technical and commercial inputs into clear, accurate, and enforceable contractual language

• Ensure all contracts reflect deal structure, underwriting intent, and agreed commercial terms

• Deliver high-quality contracts within expected timelines , managing multiple assignments simultaneously
 Manage Contract Quality and Risk

• Identify and assess commercial, operational, and contractual risks embedded in deal structures and contract language

• Apply internal guidelines to determine appropriate positions and approval pathways

• Maintain consistency and deviation discipline across the contract portfolio

• Identify and resolve emerging issues and problematic clauses proactively

• Contribute to the development and refinement of standard wordings , helping to raise the bar across the team
 Partner with Stakeholders and Clients

• Collaborate with Client Managers and cross-functional partners to clarify deal requirements and resolve ambiguities

• Act as a trusted advisor on contract wording and risk trade-offs , providing clear analysis and recommended positions

• Participate in contract discussions and wording negotiations with clients where appropriate

• Engage Legal on non-standard, jurisdiction-specific, or dispute-related matters to ensure appropriate oversight
 About the Team
 The Life & Health Contracts function is a critical enabler of Swiss Re's reinsurance business across the US, Canada and English Caribbean markets. The team drafts, reviews, and advises on traditional reinsurance agreements between Swiss Re and its clients, working in close partnership with client managers, underwriting, pricing, claims, legal, and operations.
 The team's work spans three core areas:

• Structuring and documenting agreements aligned with underwriting intent

• Advising on wording implications and commercial risk trade-offs

• Supporting disciplined portfolio management through rigorous contract analysis
 Contracts plays a pivotal role in safeguarding Swiss Re's risk position while enabling sustainable, long-term client performance — making this team both a technical center of excellence and a strategic business partner.
 About You
 You bring a sharp legal or contracting mind combined with genuine curiosity about the commercial and risk dimensions of traditional reinsurance. You're comfortable working independently, navigating ambiguity, and engaging directly with senior stakeholders and clients. You take pride in producing work that is precise, well-reasoned, and fit for purpose — and you're energized by the complexity and variety that comes with working across diverse markets and deal structures.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Proven ability to independently draft and review complex reinsurance or insurance contracts , including treaty documentation or equivalent financial services agreements

• Experience in Life & Health reinsurance or broader insurance/reinsurance markets , with a solid understanding of reinsurance structures and underwriting concepts

• Sound commercial judgment and risk assessment capability , with the ability to identify contractual risk and apply appropriate positions within established frameworks

• Experience engaging directly with clients in contract discussions or wording negotiations

• Familiarity with workflow tools, contract management platforms, and comfort using technology including GenAI in daily work
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Background at a reinsurer, insurer, in-house legal team, or law firm with exposure to re/insurance or complex financial contracts

• Proficiency in French (an advantage given the Canadian market scope, but not required)

• Exposure to US, Canadian, or Caribbean insurance regulatory environments
 The estimated base salary range for this position for Fort Wayne, IN; Chicago, IL and Kansas City, MO is $80,000 to $120,000, and for Armonk, NY, the range is $88,000 to $132,000 . The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short- and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 Our company operates under a hybrid work model, with the expectation that employees work from the office three days per week . Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship/visa transfers/visa extension or relocation support.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.description:
Möchten Sie Ihre fachliche Expertise in der Leistungsprüfung der Lebensversicherung in einem internationalen Rückversicherungsumfeld einbringen und weiterentwickeln?
 Dann freuen wir uns, Sie in unserem Life & Health Team willkommen zu heißen. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir die Leistungsstrategie im deutschen Markt weiter, fördern Innovationen und bauen nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen auf.
 In dieser Position werden Sie Teil eines agilen Leistungsprüfungs- und Risikoprüfungs-Teams.
 Sie bringen Ihre Erfahrung aktiv ein, arbeiten fachübergreifend zusammen und tragen dazu bei, hochwertige und moderne Leistungen für unsere Kunden im Rückversicherungskontext zu erbringen.
 Der Standort ist München; Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt in der Betreuung des deutschen Marktes. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Sie das Team auch bei Anfragen aus anderen europäischen Märkten, wie z.B. Zentral- und Osteuropa oder Skandinavien.
 Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Fachliche Prüfung und eigenständige Bearbeitung von Leistungsfällen in der Berufsunfähigkeits-, Grundfähigkeits- und Lebensversicherung sowie bei schweren Krankheiten, einschließlich komplexer Fälle, im Rahmen der übertragenen Vollmachten

• Aufbau und Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen als kompetente/r Ansprechpartner/in für die Leistungsprüfer/in unserer Kunden

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Client Management, Risikoprüfung und Aktuariat zur kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Portfolios und Prozessen

• Mitwirkung bei der Weiterentwicklung von Strategien zur Leistungsprüfung, Produktkonzepten und neuen Geschäftsfeldern

• Teilnahme an Kundenaudits sowie Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung kosteneffizienter Schadenansätze

• Mitarbeit in strategischen Projekten, einschließlich der Weiterentwicklung von Leistungsprüfungssystemen

• Aktive Mitwirkung an Themen rund um Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI in der Leistungsprüfung

• Analyse von Markttrends und Kundenbedürfnissen als Grundlage für fachliche und strategische Entscheidungen

Über das Team
 Als Life & Health Hub in München sind wir Teil eines vernetzten kontinentaleuropäischen Life & Health Teams sowie einer globalen Life & Health Gemeinschaft. Das Team vereint Expertise aus Client Management, Aktuariat, Leistungs- und Risikoprüfung und Medizin.
 Wir arbeiten in einem dynamischen, anspruchsvollen und kollegialen Umfeld, das von fachlichem Austausch, analytischem Denken, gemeinsamer Verantwortung und einer guten Portion Freude an der Zusammenarbeit geprägt ist.
 Sie berichten an den Head of Claims and Underwriting für Deutschland, Nordics/Baltics, Österreich sowie Zentral- und Osteuropa.
 Über Sie
 Sie verbinden fundiertes Fachwissen in der Leistungsprüfung mit einer offenen, kooperativen Arbeitsweise und übernehmen gerne Verantwortung in Entscheidungsprozessen. Unterschiedliche Erfahrungsstände sind willkommen – wir unterstützen Ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung aktiv.
 Unsere Erwartungen

• Ausbildung oder beruflicher Hintergrund in der Lebensversicherung, in Finanzdienstleistungen, im Rechtsbereich oder in einem medizinischen Fachgebiet

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im deutschen Lebenserstversicherungs- und/oder Rückversicherungsmarkt, insbesondere in der Leistungsprüfung von Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherungen

• Freude am Aufbau und an der Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen

• Grundlegende Fähigkeiten in der Datenanalyse sowie in der strukturierten Problemlösung

• Interesse an Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und dem Einsatz moderner Technologien (z. B. KI-gestützte Analysen) in der Leistungsprüfung

• Hohe Sorgfalt im Detail bei gleichzeitigem Blick für übergeordnete Zusammenhänge

• Fließende und sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch

Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Anforderungen vollständig erfüllen, freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung. Entscheidend ist Ihre fachliche Motivation, Ihr Interesse an moderner Leistungsprüfung und die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden.
 Vergütung
 In Deutschland liegt das Grundgehalt für diese Position zwischen 95.000 EUR und 158.000 EUR (Vollzeitbeschäftigung).
 Die konkrete Vergütung richtet sich nach:

• Anforderungen, Umfang und Verantwortung der Position

• Ihrem persönlichen Profil, insbesondere Ausbildung, Qualifikation, Fachwissen und Erfahrung

Zusätzlich bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive, leistungsbezogene variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen anerkennt. Darüber hinaus profitieren Sie von einer Vielzahl globaler und standortspezifischer Leistungen. Die Anspruchsberechtigung kann je nach den Bedingungen der Swiss Re und Ihrem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.
 Über Swiss Re
 Swiss Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherung, Versicherung und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken – von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Dabei decken wir sowohl den Bereich Sach- & Haftpflicht als auch Leben & Kranken ab. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Chancen und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Möglich wird dies durch die Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit.
 Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine inklusive Unternehmenskultur zu fördern, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken unterstützt. In dieser Position werden Sie Teil eines agilen Leistungsprüfungs- und Risikoprüfungs-Teams.
Sie bringen Ihre Erfahrung aktiv ein, arbeiten fachübergreifend zusammen und tragen dazu bei, hochwertige und moderne Leistungen für unsere Kunden im Rückversicherungskontext zu erbringen.
Der Standort ist München; Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt in der Betreuung des deutschen Marktes. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Sie das Team auch bei Anfragen aus anderen europäischen Märkten, wie z.B. Zentral- und Osteuropa oder Skandinavien.
Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Fachliche Prüfung und eigenständige Bearbeitung von Leistungsfällen in der Berufsunfähigkeits-, Grundfähigkeits- und Lebensversicherung sowie bei schweren Krankheiten, einschließlich komplexer Fälle, im Rahmen der übertragenen Vollmachten

• Aufbau und Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen als kompetente/r Ansprechpartner/in für die Leistungsprüfer/in unserer Kunden

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Client Management, Risikoprüfung und Aktuariat zur kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Portfolios und Prozessen

• Mitwirkung bei der Weiterentwicklung von Strategien zur Leistungsprüfung, Produktkonzepten und neuen Geschäftsfeldern

• Teilnahme an Kundenaudits sowie Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung kosteneffizienter Schadenansätze

• Mitarbeit in strategischen Projekten, einschließlich der Weiterentwicklung von Leistungsprüfungssystemen

• Aktive Mitwirkung an Themen rund um Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI in der Leistungsprüfung

• Analyse von Markttrends und Kundenbedürfnissen als Grundlage für fachliche und strategische Entscheidungen

Über das Team
Als Life & Health Hub in München sind wir Teil eines vernetzten kontinentaleuropäischen Life & Health Teams sowie einer globalen Life & Health Gemeinschaft. Das Team vereint Expertise aus Client Management, Aktuariat, Leistungs- und Risikoprüfung und Medizin.
Wir arbeiten in einem dynamischen, anspruchsvollen und kollegialen Umfeld, das von fachlichem Austausch, analytischem Denken, gemeinsamer Verantwortung und einer guten Portion Freude an der Zusammenarbeit geprägt ist.
Sie berichten an den Head of Claims and Underwriting für Deutschland, Nordics/Baltics, Österreich sowie Zentral- und Osteuropa.
Über Sie
Sie verbinden fundiertes Fachwissen in der Leistungsprüfung mit einer offenen, kooperativen Arbeitsweise und übernehmen gerne Verantwortung in Entscheidungsprozessen. Unterschiedliche Erfahrungsstände sind willkommen – wir unterstützen Ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung aktiv.
Unsere Erwartungen

• Ausbildung oder beruflicher Hintergrund in der Lebensversicherung, in Finanzdienstleistungen, im Rechtsbereich oder in einem medizinischen Fachgebiet

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im deutschen Lebenserstversicherungs- und/oder Rückversicherungsmarkt, insbesondere in der Leistungsprüfung von Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherungen

• Freude am Aufbau und an der Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen

• Grundlegende Fähigkeiten in der Datenanalyse sowie in der strukturierten Problemlösung

• Interesse an Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und dem Einsatz moderner Technologien (z. B. KI-gestützte Analysen) in der Leistungsprüfung

• Hohe Sorgfalt im Detail bei gleichzeitigem Blick für übergeordnete Zusammenhänge

• Fließende und sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch

Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Anforderungen vollständig erfüllen, freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung. Entscheidend ist Ihre fachliche Motivation, Ihr Interesse an moderner Leistungsprüfung und die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden.

• Ausbildung oder beruflicher Hintergrund in der Lebensversicherung, in Finanzdienstleistungen, im Rechtsbereich oder in einem medizinischen Fachgebiet

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im deutschen Lebenserstversicherungs- und/oder Rückversicherungsmarkt, insbesondere in der Leistungsprüfung von Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherungen

• Freude am Aufbau und an der Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen

• Grundlegende Fähigkeiten in der Datenanalyse sowie in der strukturierten Problemlösung

• Interesse an Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und dem Einsatz moderner Technologien (z. B. KI-gestützte Analysen) in der Leistungsprüfung

• Hohe Sorgfalt im Detail bei gleichzeitigem Blick für übergeordnete Zusammenhänge

• Fließende und sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch

Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Anforderungen vollständig erfüllen, freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung. Entscheidend ist Ihre fachliche Motivation, Ihr Interesse an moderner Leistungsprüfung und die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden.
 Vergütung
 In Deutschland liegt das Grundgehalt für diese Position zwischen 95.000 EUR und 158.000 EUR (Vollzeitbeschäftigung).
 Die konkrete Vergütung richtet sich nach:

• Anforderungen, Umfang und Verantwortung der Position

• Ihrem persönlichen Profil, insbesondere Ausbildung, Qualifikation, Fachwissen und Erfahrung

Zusätzlich bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive, leistungsbezogene variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen anerkennt. Darüber hinaus profitieren Sie von einer Vielzahl globaler und standortspezifischer Leistungen. Die Anspruchsberechtigung kann je nach den Bedingungen der Swiss Re und Ihrem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.
 Über Swiss Re
 Swiss Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherung, Versicherung und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken – von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Dabei decken wir sowohl den Bereich Sach- & Haftpflicht als auch Leben & Kranken ab. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Chancen und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Möglich wird dies durch die Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit.
 Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine inklusive Unternehmenskultur zu fördern, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken unterstützt. Wir leben ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle die gleichen Chancen haben, sich zu entfalten und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlechtsidentität und/oder -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlichen oder geistigen Fähigkeiten, Qualifikationen, Denkweisen oder anderen Merkmalen. In unserem inklusiven und flexiblen Umfeld kann jede*r das authentische Selbst zur Arbeit mitbringen und die eigene Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit einbringen.
 Wenn Sie eine erfahrene Fachkraft sind, die nach einer beruflichen Pause in den Arbeitsmarkt zurückkehrt, ermutigen wir Sie, sich auf offene Positionen zu bewerben, die zu Ihren Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen passen.
 Wir können KI-gestützte Tools einsetzen, um die Prüfung und Bewertung von Bewerbungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. jobs.title: Senior Property Treaty Underwriter, US Globals

titleByLocale.it: Trattato di proprietà senior Underwriter, US Globals
titleByLocale.en: Senior Property Treaty Underwriter, US Globals
titleByLocale.de: Senior Property Treaty Underwriter, US Globals
titleByLocale.fr: Underwriter senior du Traité de propriété, US Globals

jobs.description:
Locations:
New York, NY, US |
Schaumburg, IL, US |
Armonk, NY, US

We are looking for a Senior Property Treaty Underwriter who will be responsible for underwriting, costing, and strategically developing a portfolio of U.S.-based global property treaty business with our largest clients.
 This is a unique opportunity to influence high‑impact reinsurance strategies, contribute thought leadership, and collaborate across a dynamic, cross‑functional environment!
 About the Role
 The role combines technical treaty underwriting expertise, actuarial analysis, portfolio steering, and market-facing leadership, with a strong focus on risk quality, capital efficiency, and long-term profitability across the reinsurance cycle.
 You will collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders - including clients, brokers, actuaries, client managers, reserving teams, and senior leadership - to evaluate individual treaties, steer client portfolios, and negotiate price and terms while shaping the market dynamics.
 Key responsibilities include :

• Underwrite U.S. Global Property Treaty business across catastrophe and non catastrophe structures, including quota share, excess of loss, and aggregate covers, applying sound underwriting judgment and technical analysis.

• Analyze treaty submissions using exposure data, catastrophe modeling outputs, pricing frameworks, and qualitative risk assessment to ensure alignment with risk appetite and develop robust loss picks.

• Assess cedant performance, portfolio composition, underwriting philosophy, and risk controls, and structure treaties (limits, attachments, reinstatements, and T&Cs) to appropriately balance risk and return.

• Review contract and policy language to ensure compliance with underwriting guidelines and consistency with intended risk transfer.

• Act as a trusted underwriting partner and visible market representative, fostering strong relationships, disciplined risk selection, and a collaborative, solution‑oriented team culture.

• Mentor and coach junior underwriters to build necessary skills to support our clients and manage market cycles
 About the Team
 The US Globals and Canada Property CUO desk plays a pivotal role in evaluating some of Swiss Re’s most complex and strategically important property treaties, both in terms of underlying exposures and innovative deal structures. Our US Globals clients include some of the largest and most sophisticated carriers worldwide, and our remit spans US commercial and personal lines, as well as international exposures.
 Bringing diverse and deep expertise to every challenge, our team integrates seasoned underwriters and actuaries who collaborate to deliver highly tailored, data driven solutions for clients. We embrace complexity, champion innovation, and consistently set high standards for excellence within the Property CUO organization.
 About You
 You are a seasoned, strategic, and analytically driven professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You bring deep intellectual curiosity and the ability to translate complex quantitative insights into actionable recommendations. You demonstrate mature judgment, proactively address challenges, and build strong partnerships across teams and stakeholders.
 Qualifications and Skills :

• Experience : Minimum 7+ years of experience in a reinsurance or primary underwriting, portfolio management or pricing

jobs.title: Senior QA & Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior QA & Reliability Engineer
Are you passionate about building systems that are not only functional but truly dependable? Do you thrive at the intersection of quality, reliability, and cloud innovation? If you're energized bysolving complex technical challenges with real business impact — this is your moment. Join Swiss Re's Public Cloud Platform Delivery Team in Hyderabad and help shape the future ofsecure, scalable, and resilient cloud platforms.
About the Role
As a Senior QA & Reliability Engineer, you will be at the heart of Swiss Re's cloud transformationjourney — embedding quality and reliability into every layer of our Azure cloud platform. This isnot a siloed QA role. You will think holistically, connecting testing, monitoring, and observabilityas interconnected disciplines that drive real engineering excellence. You will work in a fast-paced,cross-functional environment, partnering with platform, product, and delivery teams to ensure ourcloud solutions are secure, compliant, and built to last.
 Key 
• Responsibilities
Define and execute comprehensive test strategies — including integration, performance,chaos, and resilience testing — tailored for cloud-native environments
Build and maintain automated test frameworks and embed quality gates across CI/CDpipelines to enable continuous compliance and consistent delivery standards
Ensure end-to-end functional and non-functional validation (NFRs) across platform servicesand application workloads
Drive test coverage, defect analysis, and root cause resolution to continuously improveplatform reliability
Establish quality metrics and reporting frameworks that provide actionable insights toengineering and leadership teams
Design and maintain logging frameworks, metrics pipelines, distributed tracing, and alertingsystems at scale using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics
Implement and maintain unit testing for PowerShell using Pester, ensuring high testcoverage and reliability across platform automation
Enforce coding and configuration standards through linting tools across PowerShell, YAML,Bicep, and JSON
Embed quality and reliability practices into the SDLC and DevOps/DevSecOps pipelines, championing a shift-left approach to quality
Apply chaos engineering principles using tools such as Azure Chaos Studio or Gremlin toproactively identify and address reliability risks
Mentor engineers and uplift QA and SRE practices across teams, fostering a culture ofengineering excellence
Partner with Product Owners, Security Leads, Architects, and delivery teams to align qualityoutcomes with business goals and platform strategy
 About the Team
The Public Cloud Platform Delivery Team is a core unit within Swiss Re's Public CloudTransformation department. The team is responsible for managing the overall Azure platformsetup, security policies, and service operations — enabling application teams to deliver secure,compliant, and innovative solutions that drive business value. Working closely with applicationdelivery teams, the team partners to innovate, deliver, and operate solutions in a fast, secure,and compliant way.
The team's mission is to: Design, build, and operate secure and compliant cloud platforms, shared services, andtools that enhance value-driven adoption
Provide an efficient engineering experience via platforms and services aligned with CloudTechnology Management steering and guidance
This is a team of curious, driven, and collaborative engineers who take pride in building platformsthat others can rely on — and who are constantly raising the bar on what great cloud engineeringlooks like.
 About You
You are a holistic thinker who sees quality, monitoring, and testing as deeply interconnected —not isolated disciplines. You bring clarity and confidence when communicating across technicaland non-technical stakeholders, and you are energized by complexity, not intimidated by it. Youtake ownership, mentor those around you, and are committed to building systems that are notjust functional, but truly dependable.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:
Deep hands-on expertise with Microsoft Azure — including Azure Monitor, ApplicationInsights, Log Analytics, Azure Chaos Studio, and related observability, reliability, andplatform services
Strong background in reliability or quality engineering — with proven experience designingand executing testing strategies (integration, performance, chaos/resilience testing) incloud-native environments, including unit testing for PowerShell using Pester
Solid expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — particularly Bicep — and hands-onexperience integrating testing and validation processes into CI/CD Azure DevOps pipelines
for automated quality and reliability checks
Proven experience with DevOps/DevSecOps methodology — including continuousdeployment, delivery pipelines, test environments, and enforcing coding and configurationstandards through linting across PowerShell, YAML, Bicep, and JSON
Hands-on experience with platform engineering concepts — including golden paths, pavedroad tooling, self-service automation, and internal developer platforms (IDPs), combinedwith experience in Azure landing zone design, platform automation, network topology,access management, and security architecture
 Experience with chaos engineering tools such as Gremlin or similar platforms beyond AzureChaos Studio
Proficiency in one or more scripting/programming languages: PowerShell, Bash, or Python
Experience designing application workloads using Cloud Platform Services (IaaS and PaaS)
Familiarity with privileged identity design, high availability architecture, and security architecture in enterprise cloud environments
Strong stakeholder communication skills — comfortable working with Product Owners,Security Leads, Architects, and cross-functional engineering teams
Ability to thrive in a transformational, fast-paced, and complex environment and deliverresults with pragmatism and focus
Proficiency in English (required)
 For India, the base salary range for this position will be shared during the recruitment process fora full-time role.
The specific salary offered considers: the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation,skills and experience
In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, theoffered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, youmay be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-basedannual bonus.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office atleast three days per week.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about the intricate world of insurance contracts and have a keen eye for detail? Join our dynamic EMEA Contracts & Wording team where your expertise will directly impact our business success through crafting precise insurance wordings and providing critical contract guidance across our organization.
 About the Role

As an Insurance Contracts Specialist, you'll be at the intersection of contractual precision and insurance expertise, ensuring our contracts are robust, compliant, and aligned with the French business unit goals. You'll collaborate with underwriters and stakeholders to develop tailored solutions that protect our interests while meeting client needs.
 Key Responsibilities

• Draft and develop French Swiss Re CorSo forms and ad hoc clauses and wordings with precision and accuracy.

• Review and analyze third party manuscript wordings to identify risks and breach of internal guidelines.

• Collaborate with Underwriters and internal stakeholders on complex wording topics.

• Conduct audits through comprehensive contracts reviews to ensure compliance and quality.

• Monitor market developments to proactively ringfence contracts and identify emerging trends.

• Analyse competitors' wordings to gain insights into prevailing market standards and enhance understanding of the operational practices within the French market.

• Deliver training and awareness sessions to enhance stakeholder knowledge of policy wordings and contracts principles.

• Provide expert guidance on contractual matters to support business goals and risk management.

About the Team

The EMEA Contracts & Wording team is responsible for drafting large-risks insurance policy wordings and clauses, reviewing third-party wordings, and providing expert consultation on contractual matters. We work closely with underwriters to ensure robust contract development while monitoring market trends to protect the company's interests. Our team also delivers specialized training to enhance organizational understanding of insurance contract principles.
 About You

You're a detail-oriented professional who is passionate about underwriting and contractual precision. You thrive in collaborative environments where you can apply your analytical mindset to solve complex problems. Your communication skills allow you to explain intricate contractual concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders, and you're committed to continuous learning in an evolving insurance landscape.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Fluent in French with native-level proficiency.

• Minimum 7 years of experience in underwriting or claims, with a solid understanding of insurance principles.

• Comprehensive knowledge of policy wordings across the primary CorSo lines of business including E&C, Property, GL or FinPro, as well as their practical implementation.

• Legal aptitude and exceptional attention to detail with ability to analyze complex contractual language.

• Track record of building strong relationships with underwriters and functioning as an integrated team member.

• Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and negotiate contract changes effectively.

• Strong ability to communicate effectively.

These are additional nice to have:

• Insurance education or Legal qualification.

• Engineering and Construction industry expertise.

• Experience working in international insurance markets.

• Proficiency in additional European languages.

For France the annual base salary range for this position is between EUR 74 000 and EUR 110 000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

At Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, we support businesses to thrive by providing innovative risk transfer solutions. As part of our Engineering & Construction (E&C) and Renewable Energy (RE) team, you will contribute to building a resilient and profitable portfolio across Latin America, working closely with experienced underwriters and cross-functional partners.
 This role is a great opportunity to start and grow your career in underwriting, gaining exposure to complex risks and the renewable energy sector while collaborating across a diverse, international environment.
 About the Role
 In this role, you will support the underwriting of Engineering & Construction and Renewable Energy risks across Latin America, contributing to high-quality decision-making and portfolio performance.
 You will:
 • Support underwriting activities for E&C + RE risks, including risk assessment, pricing and documentation
 • Collaborate with underwriting, operations and claims teams to ensure efficient deal execution
 • Ensure compliance with local regulatory and internal requirements across LatAm markets
 • Maintain accurate underwriting data and documentation in systems, ensuring high data quality
 • Monitor post-bind activities such as premium collection, claims data and portfolio follow-up
 • Contribute to process improvements and operational excellence initiatives
 About the Team
 You will join the CorSo Wholesale Engineering & Construction team covering Latin America, part of the broader Ibero-America, Middle East & Africa division.
 Our team combines strong technical expertise with a collaborative and client-focused mindset. We work closely with brokers and clients across the region, supporting complex infrastructure and energy projects—including renewable energy—while driving sustainable and profitable growth.
 About You
 We are looking for a motivated early-career professional who is eager to learn, grow and build a career in underwriting.
 You bring:
 • A degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial or related field) or equivalent experience
 • Relevant experience in (re)insurance, underwriting, or a related technical/analytical role (preferred, not mandatory)

 • High attention to detail and ability to manage data, documentation and processes effectively

titleByLocale.de: IT Business Analyst - SAP General Ledger
titleByLocale.fr: IT Business Analyste - SAP General Ledger

jobs.description:
About the role
 Are you interested in how technology supports financial reporting at one of the world's leading reinsurers?
 Join our Subledger & Group Integration squad within the SAP General Ledger product area and help shape SAP solutions supporting critical financial closing processes across Swiss Re. Working with SAP S/4HANA , you will translate business needs into scalable solutions that help ensure financial data quality and accuracy.
 As an IT Business Analyst, you will work at the intersection of Finance and Technology , collaborating with business experts, SAP consultants, developers, and engineers to improve systems supporting Swiss Re's financial reporting landscape.
 This role gives you exposure to the Subledger & Group Integration domain, where financial data is integrated from multiple subledger systems into SAP General Ledger and further distributed to Group reporting systems, supporting reliable financial closing and reporting processes.
 You will have the opportunity to grow into an end-to-end SAP Finance and business systems expert within a collaborative environment.
 Your key responsibilities
 Translate business needs into solutions

• Collaborate with stakeholders to analyse and refine requirements for new functionalities and process improvements.

• Translate business requirements into functional designs , user stories, and system specifications for implementation and testing.

• Bridge Finance and IT by making complex business and technical topics clear and actionable.
 Drive SAP General Ledger enhancements

• Support solution design and implementation within SAP General Ledger and related subledger and group integration areas.

• Perform SAP customizing and system parametrization activities.

• Work with application engineers and ABAP developers to ensure solutions are implemented as intended.
 Ensure quality and operational excellence

• Support testing activities and deployment of new functionalities.

• Investigate production issues and coordinate resolution with relevant stakeholders.

• Contribute to stable and reliable critical financial closing processes, including quarter-end support activities.
 Continuously improve our product

• Identify opportunities to improve processes, integrations, and system capabilities.

• Support the evolution of our SAP Finance landscape and adoption of modern SAP technologies.

About the team
 The Subledger & Group Integration team is part of Swiss Re's broader SAP General Ledger product area, operating as an agile DevOps squad with end-to-end ownership across the product lifecycle - from idea and implementation to operations and continuous improvement.
 Our solutions are a key part of Swiss Re's financial reporting ecosystem, enabling accurate reporting through SAP General Ledger capabilities and integrations with multiple source systems.
 We believe in leadership from every seat, collaboration, and shared accountability. You will join a team that values knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and close partnership with business and engineering colleagues.

About you
 We are looking for a curious and solution-oriented professional who enjoys turning complex business processes into effective technology solutions.
 You bring:

• Experience in a IT Business Analyst, IT Specialist, Functional Analyst, Product Analyst , or similar role.

• Relevant experience in product development , including translating requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria .

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

• SQL or SAP HANA querying skills.

• Knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel .

• Experience with system integrations and interfaces .

• Excellent communication skills with both business and technical stakeholders .

• A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership from analysis through delivery.

• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a team.
 Nice to have

• Experience with SAP General Ledger, or SAP S/4HANA.

• Knowledge of SAP system customization and configuration.

• Familiarity with Agile practices and tools such as Azure DevOps and Confluence.

• Background in Finance, Accounting, Insurance, or Reinsurance.

• Understanding of financial closing and reporting processes.

Why join us?
 You will work on systems at the heart of Swiss Re's finance landscape, gain exposure to modern SAP technologies , and contribute to solutions with real business impact .
 We foster continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and ownership. Whether you want to deepen your SAP expertise or broaden your business analysis experience, this role offers a strong platform for professional development.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,200 and EUR 3,700 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

jobs.description:
About the Role
 Swiss Re is building a next-generation Risk Data & Services (RDS) platform for corporates—combining proprietary risk data, advanced analytics, and deep risk expertise to deliver actionable insights at scale.
 We are now looking for a high-performing sales hunter to lead new business acquisition across APAC. This is a rare opportunity to take an emerging, high-value proposition to market and win strategic, first-of-their-kind deals with large corporates. You will operate in a greenfield environment, shaping the go-to-market, opening new logos, and helping scale a business at the intersection of risk, data, and technology.
 Key Responsibilities
 - Own new logo acquisition across APAC, targeting large corporates and risk leaders (CROs, CFOs, Heads of Risk)
 - Build and execute a territory and account penetration strategy to exceed revenue targets
 - Originate, develop, and close complex enterprise deals
 - Establish and manage senior C-level relationships
 - Lead cross-functional deal teams across product, underwriting, engineering, and partners
 - Shape compelling commercial propositions and business cases
 - Bring market feedback into product development
 - Define and scale repeatable go-to-market approaches
 What makes this role different
 - Greenfield builder role – not account management
 - Opportunity to land flagship clients
 - Backed by Swiss Re’s brand and data capabilities
 - Exposure to climate, supply chain, and property risk topics
 About you
 - Proven track record of winning new logos
 - Experience selling enterprise SaaS, data, AI, or cloud platforms
 - Success closing early-stage deals
 - Strong C-level engagement skills
 - Ability to lead complex deal teams
 - Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
 Additional requirements
 - 5–10+ years in enterprise new business sales
 - Consistent quota overachievement
 - APAC sales experience preferred
 - Fluent business English
 Nice to have
 - Additional APAC language proficiency
 - Understanding of commercial risk or insurance markets
 - Exposure to climate, supply chain, or property risks
 Working model
 - Singapore-based, covering APAC
 - Travel up to 30% in region
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.
