titleByLocale.fr: Compliance Officer - Fraud Risk (12‑month fixed-term contract, 80-100%)

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about fighting financial crime and building robust frameworks to protect a global organisation? Join our dynamic Compliance team at Swiss Re where you'll play a pivotal role in designing and implementing strategies to combat fraud risk across our worldwide operations. This is your opportunity to apply your expertise in a collaborative, international environment while making a meaningful impact on our organisation's integrity and resilience.

About the Role
 As our Compliance Officer - Fraud Risk Framework Owner, you'll be the driving force behind Swiss Re's global fraud risk management strategy. You'll design, oversee, and continuously enhance our fraud risk framework, leveraging your deep technical knowledge of anti-fraud controls and their application to industry to protect our organization against evolving fraud threats.
 This is a 12‑month fixed-term position with the possibility of extension.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and enhance the global Fraud Risk Framework, including policies, standards, and processes that form the foundation of our fraud risk management approach.

• Establish operational strategies to enable effective Compliance oversight of fraud risk.

• Provide ongoing oversight of the design and effectiveness of fraud control environment.

• Monitor and assess fraud-related regulatory developments, determining their impact and defining appropriate actions.

• Lead training and awareness by developing comprehensive global training content and awareness initiatives on the fraud risk for employees, and conducting trainings.

• Advise senior stakeholders on fraud risk management topics and provide expert guidance across business units.

• Support broader Compliance initiatives including policy development, regulatory monitoring, and risk assessments.

• Contribute to Compliance reporting and oversight, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.

About the Team
 The Compliance Financial Crime Risk Frameworks (FCR) team at Swiss Re is responsible for global Compliance frameworks covering four key financial crime risks: Fraud, Bribery and Corruption, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, and Economic Sanctions. Our diverse team based in New York, Bratislava, and London develops, maintains, and implements global policies, standards, processes, and supporting technology to manage these risks effectively. We deliver training programs to educate employees on their responsibilities and monitor emerging risks and regulatory developments across all jurisdictions where Swiss Re operates.

About You
 You're a seasoned compliance professional with deep expertise in fraud risk management. You combine technical knowledge with excellent communication skills, allowing you to influence stakeholders at all levels. You're detail-oriented yet strategic, and able to see both the big picture and the nuanced implementation requirements. You thrive in a collaborative environment but have the ability to work independently to drive fraud risk related matters.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• University degree or equivalent qualification (legal training beneficial).

• Solid compliance experience, including at least 3 years in anti-fraud roles, preferably within insurance or financial services.

• Proven experience in utilizing organizational risk management framework towards fraud risk management. A fraud-related certification would be a strong plus.

• Hands-on experience in developing and maintaining compliance risk frameworks, particularly drafting policies, standards, and processes.

• Strong experience in developing and delivering trainings.

• Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders across all seniority levels.

• Excellent organizational, analytical, and project management capabilities.
 These would be a plus:

• Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Certified Anti-Fraud Specialist Certification (CAFS), or another professional anti-fraud certification.

• Knowledge of other financial crime risks (Bribery and Corruption, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, and Economic Sanctions).

• Additional languages beyond fluent English, especially German.

• Experience working in multinational organizations with diverse regulatory environments
 For London, the annual base salary range for this position is between 76,000 EUR and 114,000 EUR for a full-time role.
 The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role
 • the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.
 We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week

jobs.description:
Are you a University student with a strong desire to learn and grow in a dynamic environment? If you are proficient in English and Spanish/ Italian we have the perfect opportunity for you!
 About the role
 As a valued member of a dynamic and multinational team, you will have the opportunity to work in a diverse environment, collaborate with colleagues all around the world and contribute to important projects that impact our global business.
 Key responsibilities

• Coordination of your own business portfolio of reinsurance treaties, contract administration and data entry

• Monitoring the End to End processes, coordination of pending tasks, scheduling of meetings and ad hoc tasks

• Composition of various kind of outcomes (Power point – for client visits or conferences, Excel Spreadsheets, etc.) and possible participation in projects and initiatives

• Communication and collaboration within the team and other departments globally, acting as the main point of contact for our Stakeholders

• Daily use of Swiss Re tools, applications and the MS office package
 About the team
 You will be an important part of a friendly team within a company with strong global presence and good reputation . The team consists of young professionals willing to learn and drive the business, improve efficiency and quickly react to the needs of the changing reinsurance environment. Our overall responsibility is coordinating the heart of Reinsurance business run by European Branches, as Business Services are the port of call for our internal clients and for all administrative tasks.
 About you
 We are looking for a reliable , self-driven and open-minded student, able to focus on details and prioritize , with a bilingual proficiency and, most importantly, a great teammate .

• University student – day study

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Agentic Engineering
jobs.description:
P&C Re Engineering is looking for a Software Engineer to help build and evolve the AI and agentic systems behind our reinsurance business. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys shipping production software, is fluent — or eager to become fluent — with agentic coding tools, and wants to work at the frontier of applied AI. It is a contract engagement within one of our business-line squads.
 Agentic Engineering builds and runs AI and agentic systems for reinsurance — across Claims, Treaty and Facultative lines — on the platforms the firm already runs. While this is a hands-on engineering role, it rewards a strong product and quality mindset: you will own the software behind a line's AI systems and lead its development toward genuinely agentic systems.
 What you will do
 As a Software Engineer in the team, you will build, evolve and run the software behind a line's AI systems — the services and workflows that LLM-based agents use. You will work day-to-day with agentic coding harnesses (e.g. Claude Code): breaking work into well-scoped tasks, directing AI agents to build and modify code, and reviewing their output with calibrated scrutiny — spec-first, tested, and accountable for what your agents produce. You will work closely with the Product, Architecture and Domain Delivery organisations.
 If you join us, you will for example:

• Maintain, refactor and extend the line's AI applications and services in production

• Build agentic-friendly software: the tools, services and workflows that LLM-based agents call

• Design AI workflows that combine models, prompts, tools, enterprise data, and business logic

• Validate model behavior, outputs, and assumptions from a production and business-use perspective

• Design and maintain evaluation frameworks for AI/LLM systems, including test suites and human evaluation workflows

• Write evaluations and quality checks for agent behavior, and build in grounding and assurance

 This role is for an experienced professional who can work independently, handle ambiguity, solve problems with discipline and help stakeholders do business with third parties in a controlled and efficient way.
 ABOUT THE ROLE
 As Third-Party Operations and Delivery Manager — DORA, you will coordinate TPM execution across the third-party lifecycle and support DORA-related deliverables, including data validation, legal entity coordination, reporting readiness and responses to audit or regulatory requests. You will translate requirements into clear actions, escalate issues early and help maintain high-quality data, controls and evidence.
 This is a two-year fixed-term maternity cover role. Future opportunities within Swiss Re may be considered, subject to individual performance and business needs. We encourage applications from motivated professionals with relevant experience in third-party management, regulatory delivery, operational risk, compliance, procurement, audit or service delivery. The role is not designed as an entry-level position. It requires ownership, good judgement, stakeholder confidence and the ability to deliver results in a global environment.
 ABOUT YOU
 Must-have

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in third-party management, operational risk, compliance, procurement, outsourcing, audit, regulatory change or service delivery, ideally within a regulated environment (insurance, reinsurance or banking).

• Hands-on experience with third-party lifecycle processes (onboarding, due diligence, monitoring, issue tracking, reporting and offboarding).

• Strong understanding of risk, controls, data quality and audit requirements, including maintaining clear documentation and evidence.

• Proven ability to manage stakeholders and coordinate complex deliverables across global teams, legal entities and control functions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach.

• Ability to work independently, demonstrate ownership and sound judgement, and deliver results with limited supervision.

• Confident communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and challenge constructively.

• Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as DORA, outsourcing guidelines, operational resilience, EIOPA, FINMA, PRA, MAS or Solvency II.

• Experience with TPM, workflow, reporting or GRC tools.
 Nice-to-have

• Relevant certifications in risk management, audit, compliance or third-party risk.

• Master’s degree in business, finance, economics, risk management or a related field.

• Additional language skills.
 This is maternity cover role with temporary contract.

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

Are you passionate about governance, compliance, and creating frameworks that help organizations operate effectively? Join our dynamic team at Swiss Re as we shape the future of policy governance across our global organization. This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact on our governance structure while working with stakeholders across all levels of the business.
 Please note, this is a 12‑month fixed-term position.
 About the Role
 As our Policy and Standards Governance specialist, you'll be the driving force behind Swiss Re's Policy Governance Framework, ensuring consistency, compliance, and usability across the organization. You'll combine governance expertise with stakeholder influence to maintain and enhance our approach to policy management.

Key Responsibilities:

• Framework Strategy and Design : Own and evolve the end-to-end Policy Governance Framework, developing governance models, taxonomies, templates, and quality assurance standards

• Continuous Improvement : Define and implement enhancements to streamline processes, improve user experience, and ensure effective lifecycle management

• Stakeholder Management : Advise policy and standard owners on framework application and best practices for drafting and implementation

• Community Building : Build and lead a community of Standard Owners to promote collaboration and knowledge sharing to support consistency and best practices

• Compliance Support : Contribute to the development and implementation of Compliance policies, standards, processes, and tools

• Risk Framework Enhancement : Monitor regulatory developments to identify new requirements and potential improvements to risk frameworks

• Training and Awareness : Prepare and deliver training, guidance, and awareness materials to build Compliance capability
 About the Team
 The Compliance Programme, Policies & Awareness (PPA) team is responsible for the global Compliance framework at Swiss Re. We develop, maintain and implement the policies, standards and training programs that educate employees on their responsibilities and behaviours in identifying and managing Compliance Risks. We support the business and our Compliance colleagues by monitoring for new risks and regulations in the jurisdictions in which we operate, and we oversee the operation and implementation of the overall Policy Governance framework across Swiss Re.

About You
 You're a governance professional who thrives on creating order and structure within complex organizations. You have excellent communication skills and can influence stakeholders at all levels. You're detail-oriented yet can see the big picture, allowing you to develop frameworks that are both robust and practical.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• University or equivalent qualification with minimum 8 years of experience in governance, compliance, risk management, program management or other risk and control framework roles

• Sound experience with policies, standards and governance frameworks, particularly in relation to drafting policies and standards

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills with the ability to interact effectively and accurately across all seniority levels

• Excellent organizational, process, project management, and analytical skills

• Fluency in English (written and spoken)
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in an international financial services environment

• Working knowledge of compliance risks, particularly in fraud, conduct risk and bribery and corruption.

• Additional languages beyond English

• Experience with digital policy management systems or tools

jobs.title: Senior Structurer, Property & Casualty
jobs.description:
Locations:
Schaumburg, IL, US |
Armonk, NY, US

We are looking for a Senior Structurer, who leads a Deal Team for Transactions, to be an integral member of the cross-functional team that facilitates the execution of Property & Casualty (P&C) structured reinsurance solutions (PCSS). Our Structurers actively contribute to the identification and origination of P&C transaction opportunities in the Americas!
 About the Role
 In collaboration with Client Markets and the wider team, we show the value of P&C structured solutions to our clients, through compelling analytics and presentation materials. We work to ensure that best practice underwriting and actuarial resources are utilized and compliance with regulatory, accounting, tax and legal requirements (mitigate reputational risk) are met.
 Key Responsibilities include:

• Meet regularly with clients and brokers to understand client challenges. Collaborate to design strategic and appropriate solutions tailored to meet client needs.

• Develop strong professional relationships with key external and internal clients.

• Represent PCSS as an innovator and structural thought leader internally and externally.

• Manage transaction process and ensure an inclusive deal team approach with underwriters, actuarial, legal, accounting, finance and risk professionals within Swiss Re.

• Develop and promote innovation.

• Leverage Underwriting experts for local market and custom practices while promoting best practice and address governance matters. Drive efficiency using an inclusive approach with cross-functional teams.
 Leadership :

• Prioritize (triage) market opportunities and realize synergies among PCSS and other units of Swiss Re.

• Assist with internal initiatives to advance the transactions topic with key internal stakeholders and across the broader organization.
 About the Team
 We are a highly experienced, diverse, and energetic team of structurers. At PCSS, we understand that we have a unique place within Swiss Re that adds significant value through the origination, structuring and deal team leadership of our largest and most sophisticated programs. We have high visibility in the organization and many opportunities to influence our Senior Leaders to support needle moving transactions.
 Our hunger, drive, persistence, and collaboration set us apart from our competition. We are technical. We are pragmatic. We are problem solvers. We are courageous. We have fun. The successful candidate will possess all of these traits and will enjoy being part of a selfless team who works together and supports one another without hesitation!
 About You
 The successful candidate possesses a high level of integrity, transparency and analytical capabilities along with excellent communication, negotiation and facilitation skills. In addition, they will have strong networking and influencing skills and experience in organizing and motivating cross-functional teams.
 Additional requirements include :

• College degree required.

• Minimum 3 years' experience in the financial/insurance industry.

• Actuarial or corporate finance qualifications a plus.

• Reinsurance experience either in Underwriting, Risk Management or Marketing; ideally complemented by practical experience in executing tailored P&C reinsurance transactions.

• Thorough understanding of reinsurance products, markets and risk, and actuarial principles.

jobs.title: Engineering & Construction (E&C) Underwriter
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about the construction industry and have a keen eye for risk assessment? Join our team at Swiss Re Corporate Solutions as an Engineering & Construction Underwriter in Toronto where you'll play a pivotal role in expanding our footprint in the Canadian construction insurance market. This exciting opportunity combines technical expertise with relationship building to deliver innovative insurance solutions for complex engineering and construction projects across Canada.
 About the Role
 As an E&C Underwriter based in Toronto, you'll be at the forefront of risk assessment and business development for construction projects spanning power generation, manufacturing, infrastructure, building construction, and heavy civil works. You'll leverage your technical knowledge and market insights to craft tailored insurance solutions that meet client needs while maintaining profitability.
 Key Responsibilities

• Generate and underwrite new business in the engineering and construction sector with brokers and clients throughout Canada

• Extend Swiss Re's market presence by assessing, proposing, and negotiating insurance conditions for large and mid-sized construction projects

• Collaborate closely with Canadian and Global teams to ensure consistent client and broker relationships

• Assess risks, coverage, terms and conditions while driving underwriting processes within appropriate risk management frameworks

• Efficiently triage new submissions to maximize productivity and response times

• Serve as a technical reference within the global Engineering & Construction community, tracking new technologies and market trends

• Support cross-selling opportunities and contribute to solution and marketing strategy development tailored to client needs
 About the Team
 Supporting the Engineering & Construction business in the Corporate Solutions, Canada Region, you will be part of a small but dynamic team of experienced underwriters, focused on profit-oriented underwriting of new and existing accounts and on building relationships with key partners in the large corporate and middle-market risk segments.
 About You
 We're looking for a detail-oriented, collaborative professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate combines technical underwriting expertise with strong relationship-building skills and a passion for the construction industry. Your entrepreneurial mindset and client-centric approach will help us expand our presence in this specialized market in the Greater Toronto Area.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• In-depth knowledge of insurance, engineering and construction underwriting, and the Canadian insurance market

• Minimum 2–5 years of underwriting experience or equivalent

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex risks and determine appropriate coverage solutions

• Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Established broker and client network in the Canadian construction insurance market

• French language proficiency

• Experience with cross-selling insurance products

• Knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in construction

• Experience working in global or matrix organizations

• Professional designations in insurance or engineering fields

• Client-centric, forward-thinking approach anticipating future customer needs

• Ability to collaborate across teams and multiple offices

• Demonstrated ability to work under pressure and manage high workloads
 The base salary hiring range for this existing position located in Toronto is CAD $95,000 to $124,000. jobs.title: Head Contracts L&H North America
jobs.description:
Locations:
Armonk, NY, US |
Fort Wayne, IN, US

The Opportunity
 The North America (US, Canada, English Caribbean) portfolio represents the largest and most complex region within Swiss Re’s L&H reinsurance portfolio.
 The L&H Contracts Team Lead – North America is a senior leadership role with full regional accountability for the Contracts function across traditional reinsurance agreements. This role leads contract drafting discipline, governance rigor, and in-force contractual risk review within a high-volume, performance-driven underwriting environment.
 You will serve as a business partner to Swiss Re L&H's North America Market Units and translate underwriting intent and legal advice into disciplined, repeatable contract execution that protects performance and long-term value. The role owns deviation discipline, negotiation consistency, contractual integrity, and contractual analysis across the region, while driving modernization through workflow tools and GenAI-enabled practices.
 While strong legal and drafting expertise is essential, this role sits within the L&H Pricing & Portfolio Performance (PPP) function and partners closely with legal, underwriting, pricing, claims, portfolio management and risk functions to support Swiss Re's North America business. It is accountable for ensuring contracts reflect disciplined risk-taking and align with underwriting performance objectives.
 Reporting to the Global Head of L&H Contracts, this role is a member of the global L&H Contracts Leadership Team and plays a visible role in shaping the evolution of the Contracts function.
 About the Life & Health Contracts Function
 The L&H Contracts function at Swiss Re drafts, reviews and advises on reinsurance agreements between Swiss Re and its clients. In close partnership with underwriting, pricing, claims, legal, and risk, the team:

• Structures and documents traditional reinsurance agreements

• Ensures contractual terms reflect underwriting intent

• Provides clear advice on wording implications and risk trade-offs

• Supports disciplined portfolio management through contracts analysis
 Contracts plays a critical role in safeguarding Swiss Re’s risk position while enabling sustainable long-term profitability.
 Your Mandate
 1. Strengthen Commercial Discipline

• Ensure contracts reflect underwriting intent and disciplined risk-taking

• Act as a trusted partner to Client Markets and cross-functional stakeholders (Underwriting, Pricing, Claims, Legal), shaping deal structure and contract outcomes on key accounts

• Provide clear, decisive recommendations on wording and structural trade-offs, including hands-on involvement of key client accounts

• Lead interpretation, analysis, and restructuring of existing agreements
 2. Strengthen Governance & Standardization

• Ensure consistent application of global contracting standards

• Own deviation governance, tracking, and transparency across the region

• Strengthen documentation rigor and decision traceability
 3. Talent Management & Leadership

• Lead, mentor, and develop team of Contracts Specialists across the US and Canada

• Define clear roles, accountability, and career pathways for Contracts Specialists

• Represent North America within the global L&H Contracts Leadership Team
 4. Accelerate Digital Workflow & GenAI Adoption

• Lead regional adoption of contracting workflow tools and GenAI-enabled practices, embedding AI into standard drafting and review workflows

• Ensure responsible use of GenAI is operationally embedded and scalable across the region
 What Success Looks Like
 Within 18–24 months:

• Contracts is recognized as a disciplined commercial and risk partner across North America

• Strong governance and deviation discipline across markets

• Broad adoption of digital workflow and GenAI tools
 Your Profile

• 12–15+ years’ experience in Life & Health reinsurance or insurance contracting - must have

• Law degree

• Strong legal foundation or substantial experience drafting and negotiating reinsurance agreements

• Demonstrated commercial judgment and ability to articulate risk trade-offs

• Experience operating in a regulated, high-complexity reinsurance environment

• Experience leading multi-location teams

• Experience driving workflow modernization and technology-enabled change
 You are:

• A high-accountability leader who drives performance and sets clear standards

• Decisive and comfortable owning difficult calls

• Commercially pragmatic while uncompromising on risk discipline

• Confident challenging stakeholders constructively

• Committed to developing talent and strengthening capabilities
 Why This Role Is Compelling

• Full regional accountability across Swiss Re’s largest L&H portfolio

• Direct partnership with the North America leadership and the Global Head of L&H Contracts

• Mandate to strengthen commercial discipline and governance at scale

• Opportunity to shape the evolution of the Contracts function, including integration of workflow and GenAI
 The estimated base salary range for this position for Fort Wayne, IN, is between $156,000 to $234,000, and for Armonk, NY, the range is between $160,000 to $240,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office three days per week.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. • Experience driving workflow modernization and technology-enabled change

titleByLocale.fr: Conseiller juridique - Crédit et caution - Hybride

jobs.description:
Locations:
Kansas City, MO, US |
Chicago, IL, US

We are looking for a Legal Counsel to join our Corporate Solutions (CorSo) Legal Team to provide transactional, regulatory and legal support to our North America (NA) Credit & Surety business unit, which underwrites insurance primarily in surety, as well as in trade finance, project & infrastructure finance, commodity finance and political risk.
 In this role, you will work closely with Credit & Surety business stakeholders, including the Head Commercial Surety NA and the Head Contract Surety NA, to help the Credit & Surety business grow, move fast and manage risk intelligently. You will be part of a collaborative, high-performing global legal team that values pragmatism, sound judgement, and strong relationships. You will report to the Head of Credit & Surety Legal.

About the Role
 In this role you will act as the principal legal advisor to the CorSo Credit & Surety business in the US and Canada and will:

• Provide pragmatic legal advice designed to enable and support Credit & Surety business growth in NA in compliance with applicable state and insurance laws and regulations, while clearly articulating legal risks and opportunities.

• Be a subject-matter expert in NA Contract and Commercial Surety, including drafting and negotiating bond forms, indemnity agreements, co-surety agreements and agency agreements.

• Support underwriters at every stage of the transaction life cycle, facilitate the closing of transactions, and also advise on any restructuring and unwinding of transactions.

• Advise on relevant licensing and regulatory issues in relation to Credit & Surety transactions and work closely with other internal experts in the management of regulatory relationships .

• Provide legal support for internal group projects and strategic initiatives with key constituencies (Finance, Tax, Operations, Underwriting, Sales).

• Support legal entity management and corporate governance related issues, working closely with other regional legal team members

• Partner and collaborate with various regional and functional stakeholders within the company (such as other Legal teams, Compliance, Actuarial, Compliance, Contracts and Wordings, Finance, Internal Audit, Operations, Risk and Underwriting) to ensure holistic assessment and mitigation of risks

• Apply legal practices and controls that comply with Group guidelines, local corporate governance practice, statutory requirements and applicable regulatory agencies for CorSo regional entities

About the Team
 In this position, you will be a part of the CorSo Credit & Surety Legal team, which consists of eight lawyers located across North America, Europe, and Asia. This is a largely transactional role providing legal support to underwriters, product managers, risk managers, and claims specialists in a highly commercial way. The legal team works closely with the C&S business unit as trusted advisors; balancing growth ambitions with regulatory discipline and reputational protection. You will be close to decision makers and directly see the results of your work. As an NA based Credit & Surety counsel, you will also work closely with the CorSo NA Legal team, which consists of ten lawyers.

About You
 You're a proactive legal professional with an ability to meet competing deadlines and work effectively in a demanding, fast-paced environment. You combine technical excellence with commercial awareness, enabling you to provide pragmatic solutions that balance legal risk with business objectives. Your strong communication skills allow you to explain complex legal concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders, and develop strong relationships with clients, stakeholders and colleagues.
 You bring :

• Admitted to the bar of at least one state in the United States, preferably Illinois, Kansas, or Missouri, depending on hiring office

• Minimum of 6 years' legal experience in a large law firm setting or financial services, organization; specific experience with credit insurance, surety bonds/guarantees or banking/finance is highly preferred

• Ability to identify, research and analyze difficult issues in ambiguous circumstances and to concisely summarize complex issues for senior leaders is a key requirement

• Experience in advising on insurance or financial services licensing and regulatory aspects

• An understanding of direct and excess lines domestic and international insurance, as well as distribution networks, broker and agency relationships

• Experience in negotiating, drafting, and amending contractual agreements, specifically bond forms, indemnity agreements, co-surety agreements agency and distribution

• High personal integrity, with ability to apply highest ethical standards and maintain independence as a lawyer

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• "Can-do" mindset with dedication to continuous learning and development

• Comfort working independently while collaborating with a global team
 Why Join Us?
 Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of Swiss Re Group. Our Legal team plays a critical role in enabling innovation, supporting growth, and safeguarding the franchise.

We offer:

• A highly collaborative, international working environment

• Exposure to complex Surety transactions and commercial contracting models

• Flexibility and a hybrid working approach

• The opportunity to shape how legal support is delivered in a modern insurance business
 The estimated base salary range for this position in Chicago, IL and in Kansas City, MO, is $156,000 to $210,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office three days per week .
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. jobs.description:
Senior Application Engineer
 Corporate band : D
 About Swiss Re
 The Swiss Re Group is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. It anticipates and manages risk – from natural catastrophes to climate change, from ageing populations to cybercrime. The aim of the Swiss Re Group is to enable society to thrive and progress, creating new opportunities and solutions for its clients. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, where it was founded in 1863, the Swiss Re Group operates through a network of around 80 offices globally. It is organized into three Business Units, each with a distinct strategy and set of objectives contributing to the Group’s overall mission.
 About the role
 The primary responsibility of an Application Engineer is the overall technology delivery of the Product and Manage Application(s) lifecycle of applications. Together with other team-members like Engineering leads, Product Owners, plan the project timeline, assess risk, prioritize technical tasks and plan milestones and delivery of project.
 The responsibility could span multiple products and would require collaboration across various global teams with a mix of both internal and external members.
 We’re looking for potential team members who …

• Have strong fundamentals with in-depth knowledge of core technologies and platforms.

• Have strong understanding of software development process.

• Have extensive experience working in agile cross-functional and continuous delivery teams.

• Are data driven and a pragmatic problem solver with an eye for business who loves creating order out of uncertainty and thinks strategically about tough trade-offs.

• Have a resilient personality, comfortable with change and able to get over setbacks and motivate peers to do the same.

• Can listen, comprehend the vision, challenge requirements and work out a realistic design.
 About the Team
 Our team is the global L&H Reinsurance Engineering team, responsible for the technical Architecture and Engineering of IT solutions for Reinsurance business unit. The team members are passionate about technology with deep understanding of reinsurance business. We closely collaborate with other teams and colleagues around the globe to share knowledge and engineer solutions.
 Growing experience will, over time, give you a broad view on Architecture & Engineering of a global reinsurer and enable you to have a comprehensive understanding, people and systems involved and how these systems shape business outcomes. This will allow you to build up an excellent foundation for a next career step in a role closer to the operational business activities in our global organization.
 About You
 To succeed in this role, you will possess …

• Demonstrated strong expertise in Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, MSSQL, TSQL and database engineering with 12+ years experience delivering enterprise-scale database solutions.

• Responsible for leading the design, development, and implementation of complex Oracle database applications, procedures, functions, triggers, packages, and database APIs.

• Provide technical leadership in database architecture, data modelling, normalization, and solution design to support business-critical applications and data platforms.

• Drive database performance improvements through advanced query tuning, index optimization, execution plan analysis, capacity planning, and database health monitoring. .

• Lead the development and management of ETL processes, data pipelines, and data integration solutions to support reporting, analytics, and operational systems.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, data engineers, and application teams to translate business requirements into scalable and resilient database solutions.

• Establish and enforce database development standards, coding best practices, governance controls, secure coding guidelines, and data protection policies.

• Leverage AI-powered tools and automation solutions to improve database development productivity, optimize performance analysis, accelerate issue resolution, and enhance operational efficiency.

• Evaluate and implement emerging AI, machine learning, and data-driven technologies to support intelligent automation, predictive analytics, database modernization, and continuous innovation initiatives

jobs.description:
Are you energised by transforming complexity into clarity? Do you thrive on building high-performing teams, driving accountability, and delivering outcomes that genuinely move the needle? If you are ready to shape the future of Life & Health Operations at a global scale, this is the role for you.

About the Role

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity at the heart of Swiss Re's L&H Operations. As Head Business Architecture L&H Operations, you will set the standard for how we execute across the full treaty life cycle — from onboarding through to claims payments. You will drive operational excellence with pace and discipline, strengthen governance and quality, and build the capabilities, mindset, and execution muscle that enable our global Operations teams to consistently deliver for clients, stakeholders, and the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Set the bar for operational rigor and accountability — create a sustainable, trusted, and resilient Operations function that is built to perform at the highest level

• Drive process alignment, simplification, and continuous improvement — maintain a relentless focus on execution, measurable outcomes, and delivery against Operations KPIs

• Identify, prioritise, and execute operational excellence opportunities — remove friction, accelerate delivery, and make it easier for teams to do their best work

• Define standard Operations processes — lead the design, testing, execution, and rollout of end-to-end process and system enhancements

• Own the Operations governance and quality assurance framework — embed consistent risk appetite, strong controls, and a proactive risk culture across global Operations teams

• Build frameworks and operational discipline — ensure portfolio data is trusted, usable, and actionable for analytics and decision-making

• Turn standardisation and automation opportunities into delivered improvements — enable scalable growth and stronger business performance

• Build and energise a global community of Operations experts — establish clear roles, responsibilities, deliverables, and shared standards of excellence

• Create compelling expert career paths — attract, develop, and retain outstanding Operations talent across the globe

• Lead and deliver strategic projects and initiatives — drive clear ownership, strong stakeholder engagement, and close collaboration with regional teams, Market Units, COO, CUO, and other key partners

About the Team

You will lead a global team of 20+ talented colleagues across key Swiss Re locations, working at the very heart of L&H Operations. This team operates in close partnership with Market Units, Operational Excellence, Risk Management, COO, CUO, and wider Operations teams worldwide. Far from being a support function, this team is expected to be a genuine catalyst — driving sharper execution, stronger standards, and practical transformation that turns strategy into progress and progress into measurable business impact. If you are looking for a team where your leadership truly matters and your work leaves a visible mark on the business, this is it.

About You

You are an inspirational, hands-on leader who combines strategic thinking with a bias for action. You bring the courage to challenge constructively, the judgement to make pragmatic trade-offs, and the resilience to push important work through to completion. You communicate with impact, build credibility through delivery, and motivate diverse global teams to move with purpose, confidence, and urgency.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Proven track record of leading large, diverse global teams — with a demonstrated ability to create clarity, energy, and accountability that drives consistently strong outcomes

• Strong project and change management expertise — with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans, decisive action, and delivering results that land with impact

• Demonstrated success in operational excellence and process improvement — a consistent record of simplifying complexity, raising operational standards, and delivering tangible, measurable improvements at pace

• Deep experience in governance and quality assurance frameworks — including risk management, controls design, and embedding a proactive risk culture across large, distributed teams

• Excellent communication and senior stakeholder influencing skills — with the ability to build followership through transparency, credibility, and delivery across complex, matrixed organisations

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in Life & Health reinsurance or insurance operations, with familiarity of the treaty life cycle from onboarding through to claims

• Exposure to data strategy, portfolio data management, or analytics enablement within an operations context

• Experience designing and executing automation or digitalisation initiatives within an operations environment

• Familiarity with COO/CUO operating models and working across Market Units in a global reinsurance or financial services setting

• A college degree or equivalent professional qualification in a relevant discipline

• Multilingual capabilities — excellent spoken and written English is essential; additional languages are a plus

• A track record of building expert communities and creating career development frameworks that attract and retain top talent

For Folkestone, the base salary range for this position is between GBP 108'000 and GBP 162'000 for a full-time role.

The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity at the heart of Swiss Re's L&H Operations. As Head Business Architecture L&H Operations, you will set the standard for how we execute across the full treaty life cycle — from onboarding through to claims payments. You will drive operational excellence with pace and discipline, strengthen governance and quality, and build the capabilities, mindset, and execution muscle that enable our global Operations teams to consistently deliver for clients, stakeholders, and the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Set the bar for operational rigor and accountability — create a sustainable, trusted, and resilient Operations function that is built to perform at the highest level

• Drive process alignment, simplification, and continuous improvement — maintain a relentless focus on execution, measurable outcomes, and delivery against Operations KPIs

• Identify, prioritise, and execute operational excellence opportunities — remove friction, accelerate delivery, and make it easier for teams to do their best work

• Define standard Operations processes — lead the design, testing, execution, and rollout of end-to-end process and system enhancements

• Own the Operations governance and quality assurance framework — embed consistent risk appetite, strong controls, and a proactive risk culture across global Operations teams

• Build frameworks and operational discipline — ensure portfolio data is trusted, usable, and actionable for analytics and decision-making

• Turn standardisation and automation opportunities into delivered improvements — enable scalable growth and stronger business performance

• Build and energise a global community of Operations experts — establish clear roles, responsibilities, deliverables, and shared standards of excellence

• Excellent communication and senior stakeholder influencing skills — with the ability to build followership through transparency, credibility, and delivery across complex, matrixed organisations

jobs.description:
Envision working in an unusual accounting role where you get a front-row seat into how a global reinsurance business operates. You will own an end-to-end process for tailor-made reinsurance solutions — recording treaty details, calculating cash flows, and managing client statements including invoicing and more. Your reinsurance knowledge will grow over time; what we need is your curiosity and open mind!
 About the Role
 As a Junior Finance Specialist, you will primarily support Non-Traditional business activities while gaining broad exposure across accounting and reporting functions. You'll collaborate with diverse teams — from Pricing and Actuaries to Group Accounting — building a deep understanding of complex reinsurance transactions and contributing to a robust financial control environment.
 Key responsibilities:
 • Gain a thorough understanding of transactions by reviewing contracts and engaging with Pricing, Portfolio Management, Actuarial, and Group Accounting teams
 • Ensure accurate financial ledger entries in accordance with deal structures, IFRS 17, and Statutory Accounting requirements as part of quarterly closing activities
 • Process outgoing payments and receipts for assigned deals, including payment instructions, bookings, and follow-up on overdue items
 • Provide clear transaction information to various stakeholders including Claims, Actuaries, IFRS 17, and Statutory Accounting teams
 • Uphold and adhere to the control environment, ensuring compliance and accuracy across all activities
 • Contribute to ad-hoc initiatives such as project work, system improvements, reporting, and analysis
 About the Team
 We are a dynamic, international team with colleagues spanning two countries — Slovakia and Switzerland. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do: while each team member works with a high degree of independence and ownership, we are united by a shared commitment to achieving our goals together. We are a high-performance team that values trust, open communication, and continuous learning.
 About You
 You are detail-oriented and thrive in complex, fast-paced environments. You have a natural ability to prioritise effectively, meet deadlines, and adapt quickly to new systems and workflows. You communicate confidently — both in writing and in person — and bring a genuine willingness to learn and grow within a global organisation.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:
 • Academic or professional foundation in Finance and Accounting — a Master's degree in Finance and Accounting, or relevant experience in an Accounting or Financial Reporting role
 • Strong understanding of financial statements, including Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet
 • Fluent English communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across diverse groups and seniority levels
 • Strong analytical and data management skills, with the ability to interpret and work with complex financial data
 • Ability to understand and adapt quickly to complex workflows and systems, with a proven capacity to set priorities and meet deadlines
 These are additional nice to haves:
 • Knowledge or understanding of IFRS 17 or US-GAAP
 • Proficiency in additional languages beyond English
 • Experience working in an international or cross-functional team environment
 • Familiarity with reinsurance or insurance industry concepts
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1,400 and EUR 2,400 per month (for a full-time role).
 The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits.

jobs.description:
About the Role
 As Global Insurance Network Manager, you will help shape and sustain Swiss Re Corporate Solutions’ partner ecosystem supporting International Programs across markets where Corporate Solutions does not maintain a local insurance presence or license. The role combines strategic partner development, disciplined governance and service oversight to ensure clients receive consistent, compliant and high-quality execution through a strong network of local insurance carrier partners. This position is a key enabler of our international business model and of our ambition to deliver a distinctive client experience globally.
 The role has the following key responsibilities:

• Shape, develop and maintain a strong global network of partner insurers that can support International Programs in markets where Corporate Solutions does not operate through an owned entity or local license.

• Own and deepen senior relationships with network partners, fostering long-term collaboration, mutual accountability and a clear focus on client outcomes, especially when acting as escalation point for the global IP colleague community.

• Identify, assess and onboard new partners where required, including due diligence, commercial evaluation, contractual implementation and readiness for operational delivery.

• Steer service performance across the partner network through clear standards, performance monitoring, issue resolution and continuous improvement measures.

• Anticipate strategic, operational and market developments affecting network partners, and define mitigation or contingency actions to protect continuity, resilience and service quality.

• Maintain a strong view of local market requirements, including insurance, regulatory, and tax considerations, and ensure relevant insights are reflected in internal guidance, decision-making and network data.

• Ensure partner interactions and network processes are executed in line with Swiss Re standards, governance expectations, compliance requirements and applicable local regulations.

• Partner closely with underwriting, operations, legal, compliance, finance, claims as well as third parties (e.g. brokers, as appropriate) and other relevant functions to resolve complex issues and support effective delivery of International Programs. Support sales efforts and advertise Swiss Re Corporate Solutions' network capabilities to potential brokers and clients.

• Contribute to the evolution of the International Programs value proposition by supporting new partner capabilities, product roll-outs and targeted capability-building initiatives for both partners and internal stakeholders.
 About the Team
 You will join the team responsible for global network and partner management within International Program Operations at Corporate Solutions.
 Our team plays a central role in enabling Corporate Solutions’ International Programs business. We define network strategy, shape partner propositions and help ensure consistent top-level service delivery to multinational clients around the world. Our success is built on close collaboration across functions, strong partner connectivity, a client-centric mindset and the disciplined use of data, systems and expertise to deliver at scale.
 Our Network Management function has a business enabler role. We drive our network strategy and our partner propositions centrally and are ultimately responsible for top-level service delivery to international program clients across the globe. Our coordinated customer centric approach, our state-of-the-art systems and tech platforms and our strong team of dedicated specialists located around the globe are key assets for CorSo's continued success in International Program business.
 About You
 You are an experienced insurance professional with strong commercial judgement, a relationship- and service-oriented mindset, and the ability to navigate complexity across markets, partners and internal stakeholders. jobs.description:
Are you energised by transforming complexity into clarity? Do you thrive on building high-performing teams, driving accountability, and delivering outcomes that genuinely move the needle? If you are ready to shape the future of Life & Health Operations at a global scale, this is the role for you.

About the Role

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity at the heart of Swiss Re's L&H Operations. As Head Business Architecture L&H Operations, you will set the standard for how we execute across the full treaty life cycle — from onboarding through to claims payments. You will drive operational excellence with pace and discipline, strengthen governance and quality, and build the capabilities, mindset, and execution muscle that enable our global Operations teams to consistently deliver for clients, stakeholders, and the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Set the bar for operational rigor and accountability — create a sustainable, trusted, and resilient Operations function that is built to perform at the highest level

• Drive process alignment, simplification, and continuous improvement — maintain a relentless focus on execution, measurable outcomes, and delivery against Operations KPIs

• Identify, prioritise, and execute operational excellence opportunities — remove friction, accelerate delivery, and make it easier for teams to do their best work

• Define standard Operations processes — lead the design, testing, execution, and rollout of end-to-end process and system enhancements

• Own the Operations governance and quality assurance framework — embed consistent risk appetite, strong controls, and a proactive risk culture across global Operations teams

• Build frameworks and operational discipline — ensure portfolio data is trusted, usable, and actionable for analytics and decision-making

• Turn standardisation and automation opportunities into delivered improvements — enable scalable growth and stronger business performance

• Build and energise a global community of Operations experts — establish clear roles, responsibilities, deliverables, and shared standards of excellence

• Create compelling expert career paths — attract, develop, and retain outstanding Operations talent across the globe

• Lead and deliver strategic projects and initiatives — drive clear ownership, strong stakeholder engagement, and close collaboration with regional teams, Market Units, COO, CUO, and other key partners

About the Team

You will lead a global team of 20+ talented colleagues across key Swiss Re locations, working at the very heart of L&H Operations. This team operates in close partnership with Market Units, Operational Excellence, Risk Management, COO, CUO, and wider Operations teams worldwide. Far from being a support function, this team is expected to be a genuine catalyst — driving sharper execution, stronger standards, and practical transformation that turns strategy into progress and progress into measurable business impact. If you are looking for a team where your leadership truly matters and your work leaves a visible mark on the business, this is it.

About You

You are an inspirational, hands-on leader who combines strategic thinking with a bias for action. You bring the courage to challenge constructively, the judgement to make pragmatic trade-offs, and the resilience to push important work through to completion. You communicate with impact, build credibility through delivery, and motivate diverse global teams to move with purpose, confidence, and urgency.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Proven track record of leading large, diverse global teams — with a demonstrated ability to create clarity, energy, and accountability that drives consistently strong outcomes

• Strong project and change management expertise — with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans, decisive action, and delivering results that land with impact

• Demonstrated success in operational excellence and process improvement — a consistent record of simplifying complexity, raising operational standards, and delivering tangible, measurable improvements at pace

• Deep experience in governance and quality assurance frameworks — including risk management, controls design, and embedding a proactive risk culture across large, distributed teams

• Excellent communication and senior stakeholder influencing skills — with the ability to build followership through transparency, credibility, and delivery across complex, matrixed organisations

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in Life & Health reinsurance or insurance operations, with familiarity of the treaty life cycle from onboarding through to claims

• Exposure to data strategy, portfolio data management, or analytics enablement within an operations context

• Experience designing and executing automation or digitalisation initiatives within an operations environment

• Familiarity with COO/CUO operating models and working across Market Units in a global reinsurance or financial services setting

• A college degree or equivalent professional qualification in a relevant discipline

• Multilingual capabilities — excellent spoken and written English is essential; additional languages are a plus

• A track record of building expert communities and creating career development frameworks that attract and retain top talent

For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between 164'000 CHF and 24'000 CHF for a full-time role.

The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. jobs.title: Natural Catastrophe Specialist, Earthquake
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about using cutting-edge science to better understand natural catastrophe risk? Join our team and help advance Swiss Re’s understanding of earthquakes and related geological hazards! This is your opportunity to apply your skills and experience to drive confident natural catastrophe decision-making.
 About the Role
 As a Natural Catastrophe (Nat Cat) Specialist you will develop and improve models for quantifying risk associated with earthquakes and related geological hazards (landslides, tsunamis, volcanoes, etc). In this role you will collaborate with other business functions like underwriting, portfolio steering and risk management to translate catastrophe modeling insights into actionable decisions.
 Additional responsibilities include :

• Leverage novel technologies and advanced statistical methods to evaluate exposure to geological hazards.

• Review and assess vulnerability to geological hazards based on analytical and empirical methods.

• Establish yourself as an expert in natural catastrophe risk and modeling within Swiss Re and effectively communicate these risk views internally and externally.
 About the Team
 The catastrophe perils (Cat Perils) department develops and advances Swiss Re’s global Nat Cat risk assessment framework, models, and tools. Our team of ~70 scientists and engineers combine cutting-edge science with Swiss Re’s underwriting expertise to support confident catastrophe risk decisions across the business.
 Come be a part of a team who brings significant value to the company, increasing Swiss Re's edge in Nat Cat re/insurance!
 About You
 You are passionate about applying science in the insurance industry and improving society's resilience to natural catastrophes. You are a problem-solver who excels in applying advanced scientific methods to complex challenges in natural catastrophe modeling. Highly motivated, detailed-oriented and well organized, you thrive in a fast-paced business setting. You work well independently, collaborate efficiently, and communicate technical concepts with outstanding clarity.
 Additional requirements include :

• Master's degree or Ph.D. in natural sciences, engineering or a related technical field

• Sound understanding of seismology, geologic hazards and/or seismic vulnerability

• Strong analytical and programming skills (e.g., Python, Matlab, R), and experience using statistical tools and methods to solve applied problems.

• Highly motivated with an ability to effectively manage own time and priorities in a collaborative environment

• Strong communication and presentation skills and ability to explain complex problems with clarity and effectiveness

Nice-to-haves:

• Catastrophe modeling experience in a (re)insurance context.

• Proficiency with GIS software and structured databases
 Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework or visa sponsorship.
 The estimated base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $180,000. The specific salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

jobs.description:
Are you a transformation-driven professional with a passion for reimagining how organisations operate at scale? Do you thrive at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and execution? If so, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact at a global level.
 About the Role
 As an Operational Excellence Lead , you will be a key driver of business transformation within a high-impact, globally connected team. At the core of this role is the opportunity to design and shape new operating models for the Credit line of business — reimagining how this value chain functions end-to-end and how it can be improved to improve productivity, risk selection and time to market.
 This role places you at the heart of evolving underwriting operating models, enabling the organisation to operate smarter, faster, and more effectively. You will lead strategic change initiatives, challenge the status quo, and work collaboratively across Functions and Platforms to design fit-for-purpose operating models that balance specific market needs with global consistency. You will also champion digital innovation — including GenAI — to unlock new levels of productivity and deliver measurable, sustainable business impact.
 This is not a back-office role — it is a high-visibility, high-influence position for someone who is energised by complexity, motivated by outcomes, and committed to shaping the future of how a global organisation operates.
 Key Responsibilities

• Champion digital innovation and adoption , including the integration of GenAI and emerging technologies to enhance productivity and deliver measurable business impact.

• Lead end-to-end transformation initiatives , designing and implementing operating models that balance global consistency with specific market needs.

• Drive operational rigor and efficiency by identifying process gaps, designing solutions, and embedding best practices across the organisation.

• Manage and execute complex projects from inception through to delivery, ensuring milestones, timelines, and quality standards are consistently met.

• Engage and align senior stakeholders across Lines of Business, Platforms, and Functions to build consensus and drive change.

• Analyse and optimise underwriting operating models , identifying opportunities to enhance service differentiation, compliance, and user experience.

• Monitor and report on transformation outcomes , using data-driven insights to track progress, demonstrate value, and inform strategic decisions.

• Collaborate across geographies and functions to ensure initiatives are inclusive of diverse business needs and deliver consistent global impact.
 About the Team
 The Operational Model Excellence Credit & Surety (OMEX C&S) team is a global transformation function dedicated to evolving end-to-end operational models across the C&S Lines of Business (LoBs), Platforms, and Functions. With a mission rooted in driving operational rigor, user relief, and capability building, the team works at the intersection of people, processes, systems, and data — all within a unified framework.
 Joining OMEX means becoming part of a forward-thinking, collaborative, and globally connected team that is actively shaping the future of how the organisation operates. Here, your ideas matter, your expertise is valued, and your work creates real, visible impact.
 About You
 You are a strategic thinker and a pragmatic doer — someone who can navigate complexity with confidence, inspire teams and stakeholders, and translate ambitious transformation goals into tangible results. You bring deep domain expertise, a collaborative mindset, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. You demonstrate strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. You are curious about innovation, comfortable with ambiguity, and energised by the opportunity to drive meaningful change in a dynamic, global environment.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Good understanding of the Credit & Surety line of business , including its product and business model, with the ability to apply this knowledge to drive relevant and impactful operational change.

• Proven ability to lead and execute projects end-to-end, managing scope, stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables in complex, cross-functional environments.

• Comprehensive knowledge of end-to-end underwriting operating models , with experience identifying inefficiencies and designing solutions that enhance performance and compliance.

• Strong expertise in digital innovation and transformation , including familiarity with emerging technologies and the application of tools such as GenAI to drive productivity and business value.

• Demonstrated ability to motivate, engage, and align diverse stakeholders , building trust and consensus across functions, geographies, and seniority levels.
 These are additional nice to haves:

• A strong background in business and service design and/or business consulting, bringing structured problem-solving and human-centred design thinking to operational challenges.

• Familiarity with Lean or other operational excellence methodologies.

• Exposure to data analytics and the use of data-driven insights to support transformation decisions

• Experience in capability building, including the development of training materials, frameworks, or knowledge-sharing tools

• A track record of delivering change in regulated industries, with an understanding of compliance and risk considerations
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 For Spain the annual base salary range for this position is between EUR 42,000 and EUR 70,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

• Python / PySpark Proficiency: Strong programming skills in Python and PySpark for data processing, transformation, and analysis across large datasets

• Analytical Mindset: A natural ability to see the bigger picture in data — understanding not just how to move data, but how to make it genuinely valuable and insightful for end users

• Curiosity & Adaptability: A growth mindset and enthusiasm for picking up new tools, platforms, and methodologies as the data landscape continues to evolve

• AI & Agentic Programming: Experience working with AI agentic frameworks and/or building intelligent, automated data workflows

• Data Visualisation: Ability to translate data into compelling visual stories through dashboards or applications built on Palantir Workshop, Power BI, or similar tools

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de clientèle et de distribution

jobs.description:
About the Role
 Reporting directly to the Head Customer and Distribution Manager SEA, you will drive Swiss Re Corporate Solutions’ strategy with distribution partners and key customers.
 The primary responsibilities of the role are:
 Distribution Management
 Strategy & Planning

• Align with brokers on local strategic priorities

• Execute go-to-market plans with managed brokers to achieve top and bottom line goals

• Understand brokers' country and regional strategies and communicate insights internally

• Implement local and regional distribution campaigns
 Engagement & Execution

• Define and manage regular engagement models (e.g., quarterly reviews)

• Build and manage deal pipelines in coordination with underwriters

• Support portfolio priorities (OBR) with managed brokers
 Data & Insights

• Analyze broker performance data to identify opportunities and trends

• Use Swiss Re's thought leadership to strengthen broker relationships

• Gather and share market intelligence with internal teams
 Escalation & Governance

• Act as primary contact for broker issues requiring escalation

• Support internal deal escalations for complex cases

• Contribute to planning and executing Broker Service Agreements
 Customer Management
 Strategy & Planning

• Develop go-to-market plans for key customers aligned with financial and strategic goals.

• Build and deepen relationships with key external stakeholders.

• Ensure consistent knowledge sharing with underwriting, claims, and other internal teams.

• Support regional initiatives to enhance key customer relationships.
 Engagement & Business Development

• Understand client needs and act as a trusted advisor.

• Generate new business opportunities and optimize product offerings.

• Lead all business transactions, renewals, and strategic relationship activities.

• Drive client negotiations and coordinate cross-functional teams for delivery.

• Prepare and contribute to executive-level meetings.
 Knowledge & Innovation

• Promote thought leadership with customers via events, webinars, and publications (e.g., SIGMA).

• Facilitate forums, learning sessions, and speaking opportunities.
 Compliance & Performance

• Ensure adherence to Swiss Re’s business guidelines and Code of Conduct.

• Model Swiss Re’s values and key behaviors.

• Meet all relevant internal and external deadlines.
 Performance Criteria

• Financial metrics (e.g., GWP, CoR, retention, number of opportunities).

• Contribution to strategic and cultural objectives.

• Progress against agreed strategic initiatives.
 About You
 Education

• University degree or equivalent professional experience.
 Professional Experience

• 7-10 years of insurance industry experience in client, distribution, underwriting, risk management

• Strong network across brokers, corporate risk managers, and insurance professionals.

• Proven success in sales, relationship management, and complex deal execution.

• Experience with CRM systems
 Competencies & Other attributes

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and results focus.

• Excellent communicator and negotiator with conflict resolution skills.
