jobs.title: Head Business Architecture L&H Operations
jobs.description:
Are you energised by transforming complexity into clarity? Do you thrive on building high-performing teams, driving accountability, and delivering outcomes that genuinely move the needle? If you are ready to shape the future of Life & Health Operations at a global scale, this is the role for you.

About the Role

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity at the heart of Swiss Re's L&H Operations. As Head Business Architecture L&H Operations, you will set the standard for how we execute across the full treaty life cycle — from onboarding through to claims payments. You will drive operational excellence with pace and discipline, strengthen governance and quality, and build the capabilities, mindset, and execution muscle that enable our global Operations teams to consistently deliver for clients, stakeholders, and the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Set the bar for operational rigor and accountability — create a sustainable, trusted, and resilient Operations function that is built to perform at the highest level

• Drive process alignment, simplification, and continuous improvement — maintain a relentless focus on execution, measurable outcomes, and delivery against Operations KPIs

• Identify, prioritise, and execute operational excellence opportunities — remove friction, accelerate delivery, and make it easier for teams to do their best work

• Define standard Operations processes — lead the design, testing, execution, and rollout of end-to-end process and system enhancements

• Own the Operations governance and quality assurance framework — embed consistent risk appetite, strong controls, and a proactive risk culture across global Operations teams

• Build frameworks and operational discipline — ensure portfolio data is trusted, usable, and actionable for analytics and decision-making

• Turn standardisation and automation opportunities into delivered improvements — enable scalable growth and stronger business performance

• Build and energise a global community of Operations experts — establish clear roles, responsibilities, deliverables, and shared standards of excellence

• Create compelling expert career paths — attract, develop, and retain outstanding Operations talent across the globe

• Lead and deliver strategic projects and initiatives — drive clear ownership, strong stakeholder engagement, and close collaboration with regional teams, Market Units, COO, CUO, and other key partners

About the Team

You will lead a global team of 20+ talented colleagues across key Swiss Re locations, working at the very heart of L&H Operations. This team operates in close partnership with Market Units, Operational Excellence, Risk Management, COO, CUO, and wider Operations teams worldwide. Far from being a support function, this team is expected to be a genuine catalyst — driving sharper execution, stronger standards, and practical transformation that turns strategy into progress and progress into measurable business impact. If you are looking for a team where your leadership truly matters and your work leaves a visible mark on the business, this is it.

About You

You are an inspirational, hands-on leader who combines strategic thinking with a bias for action. You bring the courage to challenge constructively, the judgement to make pragmatic trade-offs, and the resilience to push important work through to completion. You communicate with impact, build credibility through delivery, and motivate diverse global teams to move with purpose, confidence, and urgency.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Proven track record of leading large, diverse global teams — with a demonstrated ability to create clarity, energy, and accountability that drives consistently strong outcomes

• Strong project and change management expertise — with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans, decisive action, and delivering results that land with impact

• Demonstrated success in operational excellence and process improvement — a consistent record of simplifying complexity, raising operational standards, and delivering tangible, measurable improvements at pace

• Deep experience in governance and quality assurance frameworks — including risk management, controls design, and embedding a proactive risk culture across large, distributed teams

• Excellent communication and senior stakeholder influencing skills — with the ability to build followership through transparency, credibility, and delivery across complex, matrixed organisations

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in Life & Health reinsurance or insurance operations, with familiarity of the treaty life cycle from onboarding through to claims

• Exposure to data strategy, portfolio data management, or analytics enablement within an operations context

• Experience designing and executing automation or digitalisation initiatives within an operations environment

• Familiarity with COO/CUO operating models and working across Market Units in a global reinsurance or financial services setting

• A college degree or equivalent professional qualification in a relevant discipline

• Multilingual capabilities — excellent spoken and written English is essential; additional languages are a plus

• A track record of building expert communities and creating career development frameworks that attract and retain top talent

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity at the heart of Swiss Re's L&H Operations. jobs.description:
Are you a detail-oriented finance professional with a passion for improving processes and a genuine excitement for the possibilities that AI and automation bring? Join our dynamic team in Zurich where you'll play a hands-on role in driving AI-powered process automation and supporting the continuous improvement of global carrier finance operations — working closely with senior stakeholders and teams across the globe.
 About the Role
 As our Carrier Operations & Process Analyst, you will support the operational execution and enhancement of Global Carrier finance processes — with a strong focus on identifying automation opportunities and driving AI-driven process improvement initiatives. Working closely with the Carrier Operations & Process Managers and the Regional Heads of Carrier Management, you'll contribute to transformation initiatives, help ensure process consistency, and play an active role in shaping smarter, more efficient ways of working. This is a role for someone who doesn't just follow processes — but actively questions, improves, and automates them.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Analyse existing carrier finance processes to identify automation opportunities and actively support the design and implementation of AI-driven, more efficient and standardised solutions

• Drive and contribute to AI-powered process automation initiatives, translating identified opportunities into practical, scalable improvements that reduce manual effort and increase operational efficiency

• Contribute to GFO&T strategic initiatives by performing analysis, supporting implementation activities, and helping track progress against key milestones

• Collaborate with senior stakeholders and the GFO&T Strategy team to prepare clear, datadriven materials that support informed decision-making

• Coordinate regional (EMEA) and global Carrier Management activities, including preparation of materials, facilitation of meetings, and support of training and knowledge sharing
 About the Team
 Global Finance Operations & Transformation (GFO&T) is the division responsible for the accounting and reporting of accurate, consistent financial information for Swiss Re globally - supporting both external reporting and internal strategic analysis. The team's scope spans IFRS
reporting at the global level, as well as statutory financial information for all Swiss Re legal entities, including SST and Solvency II compliance. GFO&T is at the forefront of transforming Global Finance, steering the organisation toward a simpler, more effective, and forward-looking operating model. When you join GFO&T, you become part of a team that doesn't just keep the lights on — it drives meaningful change.
 About You
 You're a proactive and structured finance professional who enjoys working in international environments. You have strong attention to detail and a collaborative mindset, and you're genuinely curious about how AI and automation can transform the way finance operations work. Whether you've already had hands-on experience with automation tools or you're eager to dive in and develop these skills, you bring the energy, initiative, and analytical mindset to make a real difference. You communicate clearly, work well across teams and regions, and are always looking for smarter ways to get things done.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field — we welcome applications from both finance and engineering backgrounds

• 5+ years of experience in finance, consulting, finance operations, or a related engineering or technology discipline

• Experience in the (re)insurance or financial services industry — a solid understanding of this sector is essential for success in this role

• Good understanding of financial processes and data handling, with the ability to work confidently with data and systems

• Demonstrated hands-on experience contributing to or leading automation initiatives, including identifying process automation opportunities and supporting or driving their implementation

• Strong analytical and organisational skills, with a sharp attention to detail and a structured approach to problem-solving

• Solid communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across teams and regions

• Fluency in English (required) — as the primary language of business across our global teams

• German language skills strongly recommended — given the Zurich-based working environment and local stakeholder interactions
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Knowledge of IFRS standards or relevant regulatory frameworks

• Experience or strong interest in AI or digital transformation initiatives within a finance or operations context — including experience with tools such as RPA, Power Automate, or similar

• Experience with financial systems or data tools

• Additional European languages are a plus
 Salary Information
 For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between 98,000 CHF and 146,000 CHF for a full-time role. The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

jobs.description:
Are you energised by transforming complexity into clarity? Do you thrive on building high-performing teams, driving accountability, and delivering outcomes that genuinely move the needle? If you are ready to shape the future of Life & Health Operations at a global scale, this is the role for you.

About the Role

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity at the heart of Swiss Re's L&H Operations. As Head Business Architecture L&H Operations, you will set the standard for how we execute across the full treaty life cycle — from onboarding through to claims payments. You will drive operational excellence with pace and discipline, strengthen governance and quality, and build the capabilities, mindset, and execution muscle that enable our global Operations teams to consistently deliver for clients, stakeholders, and the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Set the bar for operational rigor and accountability — create a sustainable, trusted, and resilient Operations function that is built to perform at the highest level

• Drive process alignment, simplification, and continuous improvement — maintain a relentless focus on execution, measurable outcomes, and delivery against Operations KPIs

• Identify, prioritise, and execute operational excellence opportunities — remove friction, accelerate delivery, and make it easier for teams to do their best work

• Define standard Operations processes — lead the design, testing, execution, and rollout of end-to-end process and system enhancements

• Own the Operations governance and quality assurance framework — embed consistent risk appetite, strong controls, and a proactive risk culture across global Operations teams

• Build frameworks and operational discipline — ensure portfolio data is trusted, usable, and actionable for analytics and decision-making

• Turn standardisation and automation opportunities into delivered improvements — enable scalable growth and stronger business performance

• Build and energise a global community of Operations experts — establish clear roles, responsibilities, deliverables, and shared standards of excellence

• Create compelling expert career paths — attract, develop, and retain outstanding Operations talent across the globe

• Lead and deliver strategic projects and initiatives — drive clear ownership, strong stakeholder engagement, and close collaboration with regional teams, Market Units, COO, CUO, and other key partners

About the Team

You will lead a global team of 20+ talented colleagues across key Swiss Re locations, working at the very heart of L&H Operations. This team operates in close partnership with Market Units, Operational Excellence, Risk Management, COO, CUO, and wider Operations teams worldwide. Far from being a support function, this team is expected to be a genuine catalyst — driving sharper execution, stronger standards, and practical transformation that turns strategy into progress and progress into measurable business impact. If you are looking for a team where your leadership truly matters and your work leaves a visible mark on the business, this is it.

About You

You are an inspirational, hands-on leader who combines strategic thinking with a bias for action. You bring the courage to challenge constructively, the judgement to make pragmatic trade-offs, and the resilience to push important work through to completion. You communicate with impact, build credibility through delivery, and motivate diverse global teams to move with purpose, confidence, and urgency.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Proven track record of leading large, diverse global teams — with a demonstrated ability to create clarity, energy, and accountability that drives consistently strong outcomes

• Strong project and change management expertise — with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans, decisive action, and delivering results that land with impact

• Demonstrated success in operational excellence and process improvement — a consistent record of simplifying complexity, raising operational standards, and delivering tangible, measurable improvements at pace

• Deep experience in governance and quality assurance frameworks — including risk management, controls design, and embedding a proactive risk culture across large, distributed teams

• Excellent communication and senior stakeholder influencing skills — with the ability to build followership through transparency, credibility, and delivery across complex, matrixed organisations

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in Life & Health reinsurance or insurance operations, with familiarity of the treaty life cycle from onboarding through to claims

• Exposure to data strategy, portfolio data management, or analytics enablement within an operations context

• Experience designing and executing automation or digitalisation initiatives within an operations environment

• Familiarity with COO/CUO operating models and working across Market Units in a global reinsurance or financial services setting

• A college degree or equivalent professional qualification in a relevant discipline

• Multilingual capabilities — excellent spoken and written English is essential; additional languages are a plus

• A track record of building expert communities and creating career development frameworks that attract and retain top talent

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. jobs.description:
Are you a qualified actuary ready to step into a role where technical excellence meets commercial strategy? Do you thrive at the intersection of pricing leadership, portfolio performance and senior stakeholder influence — in one of the world's most international reinsurance environments? If this sounds like you, Swiss Re wants to hear from you.
 About the Role
 As a Senior Actuary in the Continental Europe Market Unit, you will be at the heart of Swiss Re's Life & Health business — shaping strategy, driving portfolio performance and acting as a trusted actuarial voice across markets. This is a role that blends deep technical expertise with real commercial impact, offering you the opportunity to lead, influence and make a difference at scale.
 Key Responsibilities:
 • Act as Chief Actuary for one or more Continental European markets, providing technical leadership and oversight of pricing decisions, referrals and key actuarial assumptions
 • Monitor portfolio performance continuously — identifying emerging opportunities and risks, and supporting the design and execution of value-enhancing management actions
 • Partner cross-functionally with Client Management, Underwriting, Valuation and Portfolio Management teams to identify and unlock opportunities to enhance portfolio value
 • Influence strategic decisions by acting as a trusted counterpart to Inforce Optimisation and Portfolio Management teams — bringing constructive challenge and sharp actuarial insight
 • Lead actuarial assessments supporting repricing initiatives, recaptures, in-force transactions and other high-impact strategic projects
 • Contribute to client discussions, transaction structuring and negotiations, bringing both actuarial rigour and commercial perspective to the table
 • Support governance processes through referral reviews and independent actuarial challenge, ensuring robust decision-making frameworks
 • Connect the dots across the actuarial control cycle — building an end-to-end understanding of the business and feeding consistent insights back to the relevant teams
 • Represent your markets and contribute to selected Continental Europe cross-functional initiatives, broadening your impact beyond your core portfolio
 • Coach and support less experienced actuaries, actively contributing to a culture of technical excellence and continuous development across the organisation
 About the Team
 You will join a vibrant and highly collaborative Continental Europe actuarial community, working closely with colleagues across Client Management, Underwriting, Valuation, Pricing and Portfolio Management. The team is deeply embedded in Swiss Re's Life & Health business and plays a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of one of the most diverse and dynamic reinsurance portfolios in the region.
 This role offers broad exposure to strategic initiatives, senior stakeholders and a rich variety of Life & Health products and markets — making it an exceptional opportunity for an actuary who is ready to grow their leadership footprint in a truly international setting.
 About You
 We are looking for a commercially minded, technically strong actuary who brings both depth of expertise and the confidence to challenge and influence at the most senior levels. You are someone who can translate complex actuarial insights into clear business recommendations, build trusted relationships across functions, and lead initiatives independently in a fast-paced, international environment.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:
 • Qualified actuary (SAV, DAV, FIA, FSA or equivalent) with significant actuarial experience in life insurance, health insurance or reinsurance
 • Strong technical grounding in pricing, valuation, portfolio management or related actuarial disciplines, with a demonstrated ability to assess portfolio performance and translate findings into actionable business recommendations
 • Proven stakeholder influence — a track record of constructively challenging and engaging senior stakeholders, driving outcomes across organisational boundaries
 • Commercial acumen — a solid understanding of reinsurance value drivers and the ability to bring commercial judgement to actuarial work
 • Excellent communication skills — the ability to present complex actuarial topics clearly and compellingly to both technical and non-technical audiences, combined with fluency in English
 These are additional nice to haves:
 • Experience in portfolio management, in-force management or portfolio steering
 • Background in supporting client negotiations and transaction structuring
 • Proven leadership qualities including the ability to inspire, engage and empower a team with diverse professional backgrounds and experience, with a passion for developing others
 • Strong understanding of various valuation methods including IFRS17
 • Additional European language skills — particularly German, French, Italian or Spanish
 Salary Information
 For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between 132,000 CHF and 198,000 CHF for a full-time role.
 The specific salary offered considers:
 • The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role
 • The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
 In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

 As a Senior Actuary in the Continental Europe Market Unit, you will be at the heart of Swiss Re's Life & Health business — shaping strategy, driving portfolio performance and acting as a trusted actuarial voice across markets. This is a role that blends deep technical expertise with real commercial impact, offering you the opportunity to lead, influence and make a difference at scale.
 Key Responsibilities:
 • Act as Chief Actuary for one or more Continental European markets, providing technical leadership and oversight of pricing decisions, referrals and key actuarial assumptions
 • Monitor portfolio performance continuously — identifying emerging opportunities and risks, and supporting the design and execution of value-enhancing management actions
 • Partner cross-functionally with Client Management, Underwriting, Valuation and Portfolio Management teams to identify and unlock opportunities to enhance portfolio value
 • Influence strategic decisions by acting as a trusted counterpart to Inforce Optimisation and Portfolio Management teams — bringing constructive challenge and sharp actuarial insight
 • Lead actuarial assessments supporting repricing initiatives, recaptures, in-force transactions and other high-impact strategic projects
 • Contribute to client discussions, transaction structuring and negotiations, bringing both actuarial rigour and commercial perspective to the table
 • Support governance processes through referral reviews and independent actuarial challenge, ensuring robust decision-making frameworks
 • Connect the dots across the actuarial control cycle — building an end-to-end understanding of the business and feeding consistent insights back to the relevant teams
 • Represent your markets and contribute to selected Continental Europe cross-functional initiatives, broadening your impact beyond your core portfolio
 • Coach and support less experienced actuaries, actively contributing to a culture of technical excellence and continuous development across the organisation
 About the Team
 You will join a vibrant and highly collaborative Continental Europe actuarial community, working closely with colleagues across Client Management, Underwriting, Valuation, Pricing and Portfolio Management. The team is deeply embedded in Swiss Re's Life & Health business and plays a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of one of the most diverse and dynamic reinsurance portfolios in the region.
 This role offers broad exposure to strategic initiatives, senior stakeholders and a rich variety of Life & Health products and markets — making it an exceptional opportunity for an actuary who is ready to grow their leadership footprint in a truly international setting.
 About You
 We are looking for a commercially minded, technically strong actuary who brings both depth of expertise and the confidence to challenge and influence at the most senior levels. You are someone who can translate complex actuarial insights into clear business recommendations, build trusted relationships across functions, and lead initiatives independently in a fast-paced, international environment.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:
 • Qualified actuary (SAV, DAV, FIA, FSA or equivalent) with significant actuarial experience in life insurance, health insurance or reinsurance
 • Strong technical grounding in pricing, valuation, portfolio management or related actuarial disciplines, with a demonstrated ability to assess portfolio performance and translate findings into actionable business recommendations
 • Proven stakeholder influence — a track record of constructively challenging and engaging senior stakeholders, driving outcomes across organisational boundaries
 • Commercial acumen — a solid understanding of reinsurance value drivers and the ability to bring commercial judgement to actuarial work
 • Excellent communication skills — the ability to present complex actuarial topics clearly and compellingly to both technical and non-technical audiences, combined with fluency in English
 These are additional nice to haves:
 • Experience in portfolio management, in-force management or portfolio steering
 • Background in supporting client negotiations and transaction structuring
 • Proven leadership qualities including the ability to inspire, engage and empower a team with diverse professional backgrounds and experience, with a passion for developing others
 • Strong understanding of various valuation methods including IFRS17
 • Additional European language skills — particularly German, French, Italian or Spanish
 Salary Information
 For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between 132,000 CHF and 198,000 CHF for a full-time role.

• Drive pricing and profitability analysis: Work cross-functionally and directly with clients to price and analyse the profitability of life reinsurance treaties, supporting the development and pricing of new life insurance products

• Monitor portfolio performance: Analyse emerging claims experience and steer portfolio outcomes through data-driven insights and proactive management

• Build trusted, long-term client relationships: Position Swiss Re as the leading and preferred reinsurance partner in the Italian market through strategic engagement and professional credibility

• Represent Swiss Re externally: Act as a credible technical ambassador at client meetings, industry events, conferences, and professional forums

You bring a collaborative mindset, a proactive approach, and the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder environments with confidence.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Minimum 10 years of experience in the Italian L&H (re-) insurance industry

• Strong actuarial background with relevant qualifications (e.g., Ordine Nazionale degli Attuari or equivalent actuarial certification), including hands-on experience in pricing and product development

• Fluent Italian and English communication skills, both written and verbal

• Proven ability to work in client-facing or commercially accountable roles within the insurance or reinsurance sector

• Solid understanding of local GAAP / IFRS and regulatory frameworks, including Solvency II and the IVASS context

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a matrix or cross-functional environment

• Established and active professional network within the Italian Life & Health insurance industry

• Experience structuring or evaluating reinsurance transactions and solutions beyond traditional treaty business

jobs.description:
Werden Sie Teil eines weltweit führenden Unternehmens im Risikomanagement und helfen Sie mit, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen! Als Mitglied unseres Teams bei Swiss Re Corporate Solutions in München übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Verwaltung von Versicherungsprogrammen, die Unternehmen weltweit schützen. Diese Position bietet eine ideale Kombination aus Kundenkontakt, fachlicher Expertise und teamorientierter Zusammenarbeit in einem sich stetig weiterentwickelnden internationalen Umfeld.
 Über die Rolle
 In dieser Position stehen Sie im Zentrum unserer Versicherungsaktivitäten. Sie betreuen nationale und internationale Versicherungsprogramme und unterstützen unsere Underwriter in Deutschland maßgeblich. Mit Ihrer ausgeprägten Detailgenauigkeit und Ihren organisatorischen Fähigkeiten sorgen Sie für eine reibungslose Bearbeitung der Kundendokumentation und stellen höchste Datenqualitätsstandards sicher.
 Ihre Aufgaben

• Verwaltung und Betreuung nationaler und multinationaler Versicherungsprogramme im Führungs- und Mitversicherungsgeschäft

• Unterstützung der Underwriter im Tagesgeschäft

• Sorgfältige Bearbeitung und Organisation eingehender Kundendokumente

• Sicherstellung der Datenintegrität durch präzise Dateneingabe, Dokumentenerstellung und -ablage in unseren IT-Systemen

• Regelmäßige Kommunikation mit Kunden und Geschäftspartnern zur Klärung von Anfragen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Serviceeinheiten innerhalb des Unternehmens

• Unterstützung bei finanzbezogenen Prozessen, z. B. versicherungstechnischen Abrechnungen, Mahnverfahren und Kontenabstimmungen

• Sicherstellung der Datenqualität durch regelmäßige Prüfungen und Kontrollen

• Mitwirkung an Prozessoptimierungen und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen

• Mitarbeit in Projekten auf nationaler und europäischer Ebene

• Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen der Versicherungsbranche
 Über das Team
 Swiss Re Corporate Solutions ist der Industrieversicherungsbereich der Swiss Re Group, einem der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherung, Versicherung und weiteren Formen des Risikotransfers. Mit rund 50 Standorten weltweit bieten wir innovative Versicherungslösungen für große und mittelständische internationale Unternehmen. Unser Team unterstützt Kunden dabei, ihre Risiken zu reduzieren, und bietet gleichzeitig einen erstklassigen Schadenservice für zusätzliche Sicherheit. Wir fördern ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld, das ideal für neugierige und anpassungsfähige Fachkräfte ist.
 Ihr Profil
 Sie sind eine detailorientierte Fachkraft mit Versicherungserfahrung und fühlen sich in einem dynamischen, internationalen Umfeld wohl. Sie verbinden fachliches Know-how mit ausgeprägten organisatorischen Fähigkeiten und einer hohen Kundenorientierung. Ihre Anpassungsfähigkeit und Ihre Fähigkeit zur bereichsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit machen Sie zu einer idealen Ergänzung für unser wachsendes Unternehmen.

jobs.description:
Shape the future of cybersecurity, join our team of cybersecurity professionals in Bratislava and help Swiss Re fulfill its mission in making the world more resilient. As a Senior Security Engineer in our Applications Identity and Access Management team, you'll be at the forefront of securing critical application-to-application interactions across our global operations.
 About the Role

In this pivotal security position, you'll tackle complex authentication and authorization challenges while working in a flexible hybrid setup that perfectly balances remote work with collaboration at our Bratislava office.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and assess authentication and authorization risks in application-to-application use cases across the organization.
- Design and prototype innovative solutions to mitigate security risks and strengthen our cybersecurity posture.
- Drive group-wide risk mitigation by clearly structuring, explaining, and presenting risks and solutions, supporting teams in implementing effective security measures, and coordinating execution across cross-functional teams.
 About the team

The Applications IAM team specializes in securing access and secrets management of technical identities across Swiss Re's global IT ecosystems, including public cloud environments. We are part of the CSO's Product and Engineering Unit, responsible for cybersecurity engineering and operations, governance, risk, and compliance. Our team defines and advances the company's information security strategy, working at the cutting edge of cybersecurity innovation.

About You
 You're a creative security expert who thrives on solving complex challenges and collaborating with specialized teams. You combine technical expertise with excellent communication skills, allowing you to translate complex security concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:
 Engineering skills
 - Strong background in IT security and deep technical expertise in Identity and Access Management.
- Solid hands-on engineering skills, with the ability to write scripts, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, write service-to-service integration prototypes, design systems on public clouds (e.g. Azure), combined with a confident command of authentication and authorization protocols such as OIDC and OAuth.
- Degree in computer science or a closely related field
 Seniority and ways of working
 - Experience driving the deployment or adoption of technologies at scale.
- Strong practical command of agile ways of working, including breaking down complex work, aligning with stakeholders, and delivering reliably.
- Strong ability to engage senior technical stakeholders, defend design decisions convincingly, and challenge assumptions with well-founded arguments.
- Strong ability to engage senior management by structuring, and presenting risks and solutions clearly.
 These are additional nice to haves:
 - Cybersecurity and public cloud certifications
- Experience with security audits
- Experience as pen-tester
- In-depth knowledge of secret vault technologies

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 3,800 and EUR 6,300 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation,skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

jobs.description:
About the job

Are you an Actuarial Developer interested in programming? If yes - then we have an outstanding opportunity for YOU!
Buckle up and read on.

About The Role

Be ready to join our engineering team and work side by side with software engineers and business colleagues to transfer insurance solutions into the digital world for our focus markets Germany, Netherlands, Switzerland and UK.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Analyse calculation requirements for life&health products
• Transform product specifications into digital product models
• Configure, test, and document new life&health digital insurance product models
• Work side-by-side with engineers, architects, project leaders, and management to resolve problems and suggest alternatives

About The Team

Our tech team works with the latest enterprise technology and tools, pushing the boundaries with every new project. We’re the software engineering engine behind a fast-growing risk-tech start-up that helps millions of end users access affordable and easy to buy life insurance.
You will join the team that is responsible for the policy management and quote calculation for digital insurance policy. It is an international team distributed between Switzerland, Spain and Slovakia. The team members are friendly, high-skilled professionals with a strong team-player culture.

About You

You are an actuary with strong coding skill or a deep passion to learn programming and you want to explore the world of insurance digitalization. As member of a team with a tight-knit collaboration culture, you are a team-player professional and a confident communicator who can engage with colleagues in person, in writing and online meetings.

Also, you have…

• Relevant education as an actuary with added knowledge about life and pension, or similar
• With a minimum of relevant coding experience in any relevant coding language (Java, C#, Python)
• Good understanding of Life and Health products
• A passion for understanding complex requirements and finding simple solutions
• A genuine interest in coding to be able to learn and effectively use tools and software development techniques as practiced, acquired, or adopted within the team
• Willingness to work in a team. Our joint success is what counts
• Enthusiasm for driving improvement by finding and implementing solutions to new challenges

What We Offer

We’re a scale-up embedded within an organization known for its high-caliber talent and excellent benefits. So, you get the best of both worlds – a fast paced, bold environment with a genuine work-life balance and more. You’ll contribute to complex, ambitious projects across Europe.

 At iptiQ, we partner with established brands around the world to create impactful digital insurance solutions. We make it easier for consumers to buy the insurance they need from the brands they trust. We provide life and non-life insurance through our end-to-end digital platform and build multi-channel customer experiences.

What we offer our employees is outstanding. Hybrid working in offices across the world, phenomenal learning & career opportunities and a culture that encourages new perspectives to challenge conventions and come up with innovative solutions. We believe in the power of inclusion. Drawing on our employees' broad range of perspectives, life experiences and backgrounds stimulates creativity and gives us a competitive edge. iptiQ embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive regardless of their age, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, physical or mental ability, or other characteristic and can be their authentic self. Ignite your curiosity to shape digital insurance.

About the job

Are you an Actuarial Developer interested in programming? If yes - then we have an outstanding opportunity for YOU!
Buckle up and read on.

About The Role

Be ready to join our engineering team and work side by side with software engineers and business colleagues to transfer insurance solutions into the digital world for our focus markets Germany, Netherlands, Switzerland and UK.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Analyse calculation requirements for life&health products
• Transform product specifications into digital product models
• Configure, test, and document new life&health digital insurance product models
• Work side-by-side with engineers, architects, project leaders, and management to resolve problems and suggest alternatives

About The Team

Our tech team works with the latest enterprise technology and tools, pushing the boundaries with every new project. We’re the software engineering engine behind a fast-growing risk-tech start-up that helps millions of end users access affordable and easy to buy life insurance.
You will join the team that is responsible for the policy management and quote calculation for digital insurance policy. It is an international team distributed between Switzerland, Spain and Slovakia. The team members are friendly, high-skilled professionals with a strong team-player culture.

About You

You are an actuary with strong coding skill or a deep passion to learn programming and you want to explore the world of insurance digitalization. As member of a team with a tight-knit collaboration culture, you are a team-player professional and a confident communicator who can engage with colleagues in person, in writing and online meetings.

Also, you have…

• Relevant education as an actuary with added knowledge about life and pension, or similar
• With a minimum of relevant coding experience in any relevant coding language (Java, C#, Python)
• Good understanding of Life and Health products
• A passion for understanding complex requirements and finding simple solutions
• A genuine interest in coding to be able to learn and effectively use tools and software development techniques as practiced, acquired, or adopted within the team
• Willingness to work in a team. Our joint success is what counts
• Enthusiasm for driving improvement by finding and implementing solutions to new challenges

What We Offer

We’re a scale-up embedded within an organization known for its high-caliber talent and excellent benefits. So, you get the best of both worlds – a fast paced, bold environment with a genuine work-life balance and more. You’ll contribute to complex, ambitious projects across Europe.

For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 42,000 and EUR 70,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:
the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.
Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
About iptiQ
At iptiQ, we partner with established brands around the world to create impactful digital insurance solutions. We make it easier for consumers to buy the insurance they need from the brands they trust. We provide life and non-life insurance through our end-to-end digital platform and build multi-channel customer experiences.

What we offer our employees is outstanding. Hybrid working in offices across the world, phenomenal learning & career opportunities and a culture that encourages new perspectives to challenge conventions and come up with innovative solutions. We believe in the power of inclusion. Drawing on our employees' broad range of perspectives, life experiences and backgrounds stimulates creativity and gives us a competitive edge. iptiQ embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive regardless of their age, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, physical or mental ability, or other characteristic and can be their authentic self. Ignite your curiosity to shape digital insurance.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

iptiQ is part of Swiss Re, one of the world’s leading providers of re/insurance and risk transfer solutions. This means we’re backed by Swiss Re’s capital strength and more than 150 years of risk knowledge. Through our partnerships, we contribute to Swiss Re’s vision to make the world more resilient.

jobs.title: Property Facultative Underwriter
jobs.description:
Are you an ambitious underwriting professional ready to make your mark in one of the world's most dynamic reinsurance markets? At Swiss Re, we're looking for a driven and commercially minded Property Facultative Underwriter to join our Hong Kong team — someone who thrives on building relationships, making smart underwriting decisions, and shaping a profitable portfolio across Greater China and beyond.
 About the Role
 This is a high-impact opportunity to be at the heart of Swiss Re's Asia Pacific Facultative business. You'll take ownership of a growing Property Facultative book across Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, while also contributing to peak renewals and peer reviews across the broader Asia Pacific region. From originating and pricing complex property risks to driving the adoption of SwiftRe® — Swiss Re's cutting-edge digital underwriting platform — you'll be a key player in delivering sustainable, profitable growth. Your performance will be measured on the bottom line, and your contributions will be visible and valued.
 Key Responsibilities
 Underwriting & Business Development

• Grow a profitable and balanced Property Facultative book across Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan; cross-sell, engage, and service brokers and clients with excellence

• Serve as the primary underwriting contact for Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan Property Fac business, delivering high-quality, timely service while adhering to underwriting authority and guidelines

• Support the development and execution of the Property Go-To-Market strategy, delivering planned portfolio targets and articulating risk appetites clearly to clients and brokers

• Proactively manage the portfolio for sustainable profitable growth — monitor external risk trends, steer the portfolio toward profitability targets and Target Liability Profile

• Drive business origination and strengthen broker and client relationships; build robust new business pipelines and improve renewal retention to maximize Swiss Re Fac's commercial position

• Mitigate volatility and manage line size, exploring alternative approaches to write business profitably while meeting client needs

• Ensure disciplined use of pricing and modelling tools , maintaining robust reflection of pricing to exposure and risk quality; proactively improve data transparency and accuracy

• Support underwriting peer reviews and audits , and implement audit recommendations diligently

• Proactively manage operational risks to ensure ORM compliance; contribute to internal risk reviews and the ORM process

• Provide underwriting support to China and other Swiss Re offices and handle ad hoc tasks as required
 SwiftRe® Digital Platform

• Develop a profitable, diversified, and highly automated SwiftRe® portfolio , improving efficiency and automation within the underwriting control framework

• Support the Senior Property Fac Underwriter in steering portfolios for profitable growth; contribute to underwriting parameter setting and optimization of automation and response times

• Enhance SwiftRe® functionality , underwriting control, and user-friendliness in close collaboration with the SwiftRe® Product Team

• Support product set-up and adapt generic products to local market needs

• Ensure timely responses to clients and brokers; handle daily submissions, special acceptances, client queries, and support SwiftRe® client onboarding
 Collaboration & Market Presence

• Contribute to Swiss Re's market presence by working closely with Treaty Underwriters, Key Account Managers, and cross-functional teams

• Provide technical training and advice to Swiss Re clients and internal functions

• Liaise proactively with the Claims Team to stay informed on claims trends and client profitability issues

• Streamline underwriting processes and workflows and lead or participate in projects as required
 About the Team
 Join the Swiss Re Hong Kong Property Facultative Team — a growing, energetic, and collaborative group that is part of the fast-expanding Asia Pacific P&C Facultative Underwriting community. Together, the team shares a common vision to grow Swiss Re's Facultative business across Asia Pacific, spanning markets from Japan and Korea to Greater China, Southeast Asia, India, and Australia & New Zealand.
 This team thrives on entrepreneurial spirit, deep underwriting expertise, and resilience, while fostering an environment that supports both personal and professional development. You'll be joining a community that values collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to excellence — where your contributions genuinely matter.
 About You

• University degree; completed ACII or CPCU qualification an advantage

• At least 10 years industrial experience, 5 years or more of relevant underwriting experience in Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan and a good understanding of these markets and products

• Good knowledge of all aspects of industrial and commercial property underwriting; experienced in heavy property occupancies and general property underwriting

• Experience in writing multi-national programs / automated underwriting platform business, are added advantages

• Comfortable working in a highly collaborative, multi-cultural matrix organization

• Taking ownership, accountability; going the extra mile to get things done

• Strong teammate and effective communicator, both written and verbally

• Team player and willingness to positively engage with colleagues

• Efficient and pragmatic, gets things done

• Provide superior service to our clients / brokers

• Ability to learn and deliver under pressure and at ease with going outside of comfort zone

• Proven track record as a successful business origination person and deal maker

• Innovative and comfortable with data analytics and leveraging technology for SwiftRe® underwriting and business development ad added advantage

• Excellent English and Mandarin skills, Cantonese language is beneficial

• Willing to make occasional business travels
 The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Are you an ambitious underwriting professional ready to make your mark in one of the world's most dynamic reinsurance markets? At Swiss Re, we're looking for a driven and commercially minded Property Facultative Underwriter to join our Hong Kong team — someone who thrives on building relationships, making smart underwriting decisions, and shaping a profitable portfolio across Greater China and beyond.
 About the Role
 This is a high-impact opportunity to be at the heart of Swiss Re's Asia Pacific Facultative business. You'll take ownership of a growing Property Facultative book across Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, while also contributing to peak renewals and peer reviews across the broader Asia Pacific region. From originating and pricing complex property risks to driving the adoption of SwiftRe® — Swiss Re's cutting-edge digital underwriting platform — you'll be a key player in delivering sustainable, profitable growth. Your performance will be measured on the bottom line, and your contributions will be visible and valued.
 Key Responsibilities
 Underwriting & Business Development

• Grow a profitable and balanced Property Facultative book across Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan; cross-sell, engage, and service brokers and clients with excellence

• Serve as the primary underwriting contact for Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan Property Fac business, delivering high-quality, timely service while adhering to underwriting authority and guidelines

• Support the development and execution of the Property Go-To-Market strategy, delivering planned portfolio targets and articulating risk appetites clearly to clients and brokers

• Proactively manage the portfolio for sustainable profitable growth — monitor external risk trends, steer the portfolio toward profitability targets and Target Liability Profile

• Drive business origination and strengthen broker and client relationships; build robust new business pipelines and improve renewal retention to maximize Swiss Re Fac's commercial position

• Mitigate volatility and manage line size, exploring alternative approaches to write business profitably while meeting client needs

• Ensure disciplined use of pricing and modelling tools , maintaining robust reflection of pricing to exposure and risk quality; proactively improve data transparency and accuracy

• Support underwriting peer reviews and audits , and implement audit recommendations diligently

• Proactively manage operational risks to ensure ORM compliance; contribute to internal risk reviews and the ORM process

• Provide underwriting support to China and other Swiss Re offices and handle ad hoc tasks as required
 SwiftRe® Digital Platform

• Develop a profitable, diversified, and highly automated SwiftRe® portfolio , improving efficiency and automation within the underwriting control framework

• Support the Senior Property Fac Underwriter in steering portfolios for profitable growth; contribute to underwriting parameter setting and optimization of automation and response times

• Enhance SwiftRe® functionality , underwriting control, and user-friendliness in close collaboration with the SwiftRe® Product Team

• Support product set-up and adapt generic products to local market needs

• Ensure timely responses to clients and brokers; handle daily submissions, special acceptances, client queries, and support SwiftRe® client onboarding
 Collaboration & Market Presence

• Contribute to Swiss Re's market presence by working closely with Treaty Underwriters, Key Account Managers, and cross-functional teams

• Provide technical training and advice to Swiss Re clients and internal functions

• Liaise proactively with the Claims Team to stay informed on claims trends and client profitability issues

• Streamline underwriting processes and workflows and lead or participate in projects as required
 About the Team
 Join the Swiss Re Hong Kong Property Facultative Team — a growing, energetic, and collaborative group that is part of the fast-expanding Asia Pacific P&C Facultative Underwriting community. Together, the team shares a common vision to grow Swiss Re's Facultative business across Asia Pacific, spanning markets from Japan and Korea to Greater China, Southeast Asia, India, and Australia & New Zealand.
 This team thrives on entrepreneurial spirit, deep underwriting expertise, and resilience, while fostering an environment that supports both personal and professional development. You'll be joining a community that values collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to excellence — where your contributions genuinely matter.
 About You

• University degree; completed ACII or CPCU qualification an advantage

• At least 10 years industrial experience, 5 years or more of relevant underwriting experience in Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan and a good understanding of these markets and products

• Good knowledge of all aspects of industrial and commercial property underwriting; experienced in heavy property occupancies and general property underwriting

• Experience in writing multi-national programs / automated underwriting platform business, are added advantages

• Comfortable working in a highly collaborative, multi-cultural matrix organization

• Taking ownership, accountability; going the extra mile to get things done

• Strong teammate and effective communicator, both written and verbally

• Team player and willingness to positively engage with colleagues

• Efficient and pragmatic, gets things done

• Provide superior service to our clients / brokers

• Ability to learn and deliver under pressure and at ease with going outside of comfort zone

• Proven track record as a successful business origination person and deal maker

• Innovative and comfortable with data analytics and leveraging technology for SwiftRe® underwriting and business development ad added advantage

• Excellent English and Mandarin skills, Cantonese language is beneficial

• Willing to make occasional business travels
 The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. jobs.description:
Ready to build and run full stack, cloud-native digital services that power our Alternative Capital Partners organisation?
 About the Role & team
 The Asset Management Digital and Tech Transformation unit has the mission to enable AM to become an AI powered, data centric organization . We foster a data-centric culture and ensure a state-of-the-art tech and data landscape, smartly using public cloud and SaaS solutions to provide innovative, secure and cost aware technology services.
 If you join us, as a member of the ACP (Alternative Capital Partners) IT team, you will be able to participate in a variety of interesting initiatives . For example, you will:

• Further develop internal and client facing, cloud native full stack applications

• Provide a resilient and secure tech operating platform through continuous improvement and operational support

• Co-create advanced tech and data enabled services in global, cross functional teams

• Support many other exciting projects in a collaborative environment with colleagues from Swiss Re Asset Management's international offices
 We work in a scaled agile model with a shared leadership team and broadly aligned autonomy for our squads. We are located across the globe but share the same values of passion, openness, respect, humility, and curiosity in our team. We are a highly skilled and diverse global team. We love to learn new skills and will support you to do the same! We strive to improve the quality of our work for our customers every day. As a matter of trust, we give you a high degree of flexibility which matches your independent working style. Is this for you? Then we want to get to know you!
 Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain end-to-end web applications using Java (Spring Boot) for the backend and Angular for the frontend

• Implement RESTful APIs and integrate them with front-end components

• Manage cloud infrastructure and deploy applications using Azure services (App Services, Azure DevOps, Azure SQL, Key Vaults, etc.)

• Optimize application performance and ensure secure, scalable deployments in the Azure environment

• Maintain code quality and automated testing using CI/CD pipelines

• Provide operational support and troubleshooting of the production issues
 About You
 You are a hands-on software engineer with a strong track record of delivering sustainable, cloud-based solutions. You take ownership for reliable operations, approach new challenges with a solution-oriented mindset, and enjoy partnering with business SMEs in cross-functional teams. You care about security, quality, user experience, documentation, testing, and the bigger picture.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:
 • Degree in Computer Science (Master's preferred) or a comparable engineering discipline
 • 5+ years' experience building and operating full-stack applications
 • Hands-on experience with public cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP), preferably Azure
 • Proficiency in core engineering skills including:
 -Backend: Java (alternatively Python), Spring Boot, REST APIs
 -Frontend: Angular (alternatively React), TypeScript, HTML5/CSS3
 -Databases: Azure SQL / SQL Server , or equivalent
 • Hands-on experience with Cloud delivery practices and tooling, including IaC, CI/CD, and Containerization
 • Strong analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving skills
 • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across global teams
 • Proficiency in English (written & verbal)
 These are additional nice to haves:
 • Experience with Node.js/Kotlin for backend development
 • Knowledge of React as an alternative frontend framework
 • Experience with Kubernetes
 • Expertise in automated testing tools like Cypress/k6
 • Comfortable working in agile delivery environments (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira)
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between [EUR 2,800] and [EUR 4,600] per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​

 About the Team
 As a new student you will be an important part of the Operations team collaborating with skilled professional from the field. In Technical Accounting we process invoicing documentation from our clients, performing a high-level data quality check according to the contract signed and ensuring the payments based on the documents received are timely completed.
 About the Role
 As our new colleague you will take care of the official communication with our clients, providing support and expertise where needed and helping them resolve potential issues. You will oversee a portfolio of insurance business partners (brokers and direct clients) - including communication via multiple channels.
 Key responsibilities:
 • Checking and analysis of data based on contract requisitions
 • Daily use of modern reporting tools, dedicated business applications, and MS office package
 • Collaboration and partnership across as well different departments
 • Prioritization and self-organization of work
 About You
 You can bring your knowledge from accounting, finance or economics background and will have the opportunity to gain experience, develop and uncover your potential – discover your professional interest. You have effective communication and presentation skills with passion to learn and take on new challenges.
 Essentials:
 • We are looking for university student (preferably in economics /management/business administration)
 • English language – proficient written and spoken (any other language is advantageous)
 • Knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
 • Analytical and critical thinking are among your strengths

 Basic training provided for every new joiner, including real life cases.

jobs.title: Senior Java Engineer - DBaaS Platform
jobs.description:
About the Role
 Join our Database as a Service (DBaaS) team and help evolve a core platform used across Swiss Re. We provide secure, stable, and easy-to-use database services with a strong focus on automation and self-service, supporting both private and public cloud environments.
 We are looking for a hands-on Senior Java Engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, improving existing systems, and contributing to the evolution of our platform.
 This role is primarily focused on software engineering and delivery. You will spend most of your time designing, building, reviewing, and improving code while contributing to technical decisions and modernization efforts across the platform.
 You will have the opportunity to work on both new capabilities and the gradual modernization of a large existing codebase, helping shape the future evolution of the platform.
 What you will do
 Engineering & Delivery

• Work with and improve a large existing Java codebase

• Drive incremental refactoring and modernization of legacy components

• Contribute to migration towards Spring Boot-based services

• Design, develop, and maintain services forming the DBaaS platform

• Design and implement new capabilities while modernizing existing components

• Participate in code reviews and maintain high standards of code quality

• Troubleshoot issues and contribute to the team's production support rotation

• Collaborate closely with database engineers and other teams
 Technical Ownership & Delivery

•
• Take ownership of selected features and initiatives from design through delivery

• Drive pragmatic improvements in system design, reliability, and maintainability

• Contribute to technical design discussions with a focus on practical and maintainable solutions

• Support end-to-end delivery — design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operation

• Collaborate with product owners and engineers to refine requirements and priorities

• Apply agile practices to deliver incremental improvements

• Stay actively involved in implementation to keep decisions grounded in reality

About You
 We are looking for a strong engineer who enjoys building and improving systems in a practical, hands-on way.
 Minimum Qualifications

•
• Strong experience with Java backend development

• Experience designing and building RESTful services

• Experience working with large, complex codebases

• Proven ability to perform incremental refactoring and modernization

• Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals and clean code practices

• Experience with CI/CD, Git, and Docker

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate across teams

• Professional proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications

•
• Experience with Spring Boot or modernizing legacy Java applications

• Experience with PostgreSQL and/or Oracle databases

• Familiarity with resiliency, retries, asynchronous processing, and related backend patterns

• Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred)

• Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and production troubleshooting

• Experience with messaging or event-driven architectures

What We Are Looking For

•
• Someone comfortable improving existing systems step by step

• Ability to balance technical quality with business needs

• A pragmatic mindset — choosing the right solution, not the most complex one

• Ownership and accountability for delivered work

• A collaborative engineer who enjoys working closely with teammates and stakeholders

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 3,800 and EUR 6,300 per month (for a full-time role).
 The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role
 • the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

jobs.description:
You will be part of the Solution Client Delivery EMEA team within the Life and Health Reinsurance division. This role involves supporting the implementation of our automated underwriting solutions with client companies across the EMEA region. Automated solutions form a key part of our risk management strategy, enabling our clients to benefit from optimized operational processes and to provide the foundation for future growth opportunities. This is an exciting time for automated solutions as we are experiencing significantly new client activity and developing and commercializing new and innovative UW solutions.
 Reporting to the EMEA Lead Project Manager, you will be part of a team dedicated to delivering Magnum and associated UW solutions, as well as individual client teams' delivering on BAU activities. You will have a key role in oversight and management of implementation and BAU projects. You will work closely with the center of competence for Client Delivery to coordinate best practice and resource planning.
 About The Role
 The main responsibilities include:

• Managing the overall implementation of client projects, ensuring the system or change to the system is delivered according to the agreed specifications, deadlines and cost

• Coordinating the BAU activities within the Client teams', creating a transparent plan of action with the client team members and delivering against plan

• Working with clients to coordinate the development of requirements and business specifications, underwriting rule analysis, development and testing

• Adhering to Client Delivery project management processes, procedures and use of tools and systems

• Drive coordination across multiple teams involved in the implementations and BAU

• Effective and transparent communication of progress including commercials and risks and issues to all stakeholders including senior management and the client

• Maintaining clear auditable project documentation
 The role will involve some periods of on-site work in client offices and travel within the EMEA region.
 About You

• Strong project and change management skills focused on execution and delivery

• Experience with business transformation and business analysis

• Strong communication and presentation skills

• Effective scheduling and time management with ability to anticipate challenges

• Desire to strive for excellent customer satisfaction

• Ability to learn about the Underwriting solution suite and have a drive for professional development

• Proficient IT skills including the ability to use some of the advanced features of Word/Excel/Access

• German language required (written and spoken form)

• Flexible where travel is required
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2 100 and EUR 3 400 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
 You can look forward to extra rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.
 We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.

• Coordinating the BAU activities within the Client teams', creating a transparent plan of action with the client team members and delivering against plan

• Working with clients to coordinate the development of requirements and business specifications, underwriting rule analysis, development and testing

• Adhering to Client Delivery project management processes, procedures and use of tools and systems

• Drive coordination across multiple teams involved in the implementations and BAU

• Effective and transparent communication of progress including commercials and risks and issues to all stakeholders including senior management and the client

• Maintaining clear auditable project documentation
 The role will involve some periods of on-site work in client offices and travel within the EMEA region.
 About You

• Strong project and change management skills focused on execution and delivery

• Experience with business transformation and business analysis

• Strong communication and presentation skills

• Effective scheduling and time management with ability to anticipate challenges

• Desire to strive for excellent customer satisfaction

• Ability to learn about the Underwriting solution suite and have a drive for professional development

• Proficient IT skills including the ability to use some of the advanced features of Word/Excel/Access

• German language required (written and spoken form)

• Flexible where travel is required
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
