jobs.description:
About the Role
 Join our Database as a Service (DBaaS) team and help build, operate, and improve a core platform used across Swiss Re. We provide secure, stable, and easy-to-use database services with a strong focus on automation and self-service capabilities, supporting both private and public cloud environments.
 We are looking for a hands-on Database Engineer who enjoys working with enterprise database platforms and is interested in automation, reliability, and continuous improvement.
 You will work as part of an experienced and collaborative engineering team responsible for Oracle and PostgreSQL database platforms. The role combines database engineering, operations, automation, and modernization activities, contributing to reliable and scalable services used across the organization.
 Operational on-call coverage is limited (approximately once every two months and decreasing as the team grows) and applies only to high-priority incidents. The team follows a "you build it, you run it" philosophy and continuously strives to automate operational activities wherever possible.

What You Will Do

Database Engineering & Operations

• Support and improve enterprise Oracle and PostgreSQL database platforms

• Perform database administration, troubleshooting, and operational activities

• Contribute to platform reliability, availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery capabilities

• Investigate and resolve performance issues across database environments

• Participate in production support and incident resolution activities

• Create and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures
 Automation & Platform Improvement

• Contribute to automation initiatives across database platforms

• Develop and maintain scripts, tools, and Infrastructure as Code solutions

• Support modernization efforts across Oracle, PostgreSQL, and cloud-based database services

• Help improve self-service capabilities used by internal engineering teams

• Participate in platform improvements focused on reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence
 Collaboration & Delivery

• Work closely with database engineers, application teams, and cloud platform teams

• Participate in agile ceremonies and backlog refinement activities

• Share knowledge, ideas, and best practices within the team

• Contribute to technical discussions and solution design activities

• Help identify opportunities for continuous improvement
 About You
 Nobody meets 100% of the requirements — and that's perfectly fine. If you meet most of the qualifications below and are interested in enterprise database platforms, cloud technologies, and automation, we'd be happy to meet you.
 You will join a highly skilled, dedicated, and cross-functional database team located between Bratislava and Zürich within Global Technology Services.
 Minimum Qualifications

• Experience with Oracle and/or PostgreSQL database administration

• Experience supporting database platforms in enterprise environments

• Good understanding of database performance analysis and SQL tuning

• Experience with high availability, backup, recovery, and operational support activities

• Experience with scripting and automation (Shell/Bash, PL/SQL, Python, or similar)

• Experience working with Linux-based environments

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Attention to detail and quality-oriented mindset

• Hands-on attitude and willingness to continuously learn and improve

• Professional proficiency in English
 Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Oracle RAC, Exadata, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure

• Experience with PostgreSQL administration and operations

• Experience with public cloud platforms (Azure, OCI, AWS)

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tooling

• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

• Experience with monitoring and observability platforms

• One or more Oracle or cloud-related certifications

• Interest in AIOps, machine learning, or statistical modelling
 What We Are Looking For

• Someone comfortable working with existing systems and improving them step by step

• A pragmatic mindset focused on practical and sustainable solutions

• Ability to balance technical quality with business needs

• Strong ownership and accountability for delivered work

• A collaborative team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and solving problems together

• Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and approaches
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,800 and EUR 4,600 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.​

jobs.title: Structurer, Insurance Linked Securities
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in an empowering, fast-paced and international environment? Able to build your expertise and grow your responsibilities rapidly in the right setting? We are seeking a motivated, entrepreneurial and energetic professional to join Swiss Re Capital Markets (SRCM) Insurance-Linked Securities (ILS) Structuring team as an ILS Structurer at the Assistant Vice President Level, where you'll help bridge the gap between global capital markets and the (re)insurance industry.
 About the Role
 This role is pivotal in supporting the origination, pricing, structuring, and execution of ILS transactions—including catastrophe bonds—for Swiss Re Capital Markets’ diverse portfolio of clients. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including competing investment banks, risk modelers, rating agencies and legal firms on the placement of new issue securities. You will also actively contribute to the research and innovation related to transferring emerging perils and new structural solutions to the capital markets.
 Your main responsibilities will also include :

• Develop client materials for new transaction opportunities, prepare presentations for investor discussions, and interact directly with the C-suite of prospective clients

• Analyze and research the exposures of SRCM clients (sovereign nations, corporations, re/insurers and asset managers), and review transaction documentation such as Offering Circulars, Private Placement Memorandums and other similar documents

• Perform financial analyses using Monte Carlo simulation techniques and cash flow models

• Travel to client and investor meetings and actively engage in the discussion
 About the Team
 Swiss Re Capital Markets New York-based ILS structuring team is composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds across investment banking, capital markets, reinsurance and catastrophe modeling. This position will be based in New York, NY and report directly to the Head of ILS Structuring, Americas.
 About You
 You bring entrepreneurial spirit with high energy and passion and flourish working in a team environment! You have a successful track record managing multiple simultaneous projects and deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Your professionalism when interacting with C-suite-level clients leaves an excellent impression of you and the company.
 Key requirements also include :

• Bachelor's degree required, with significant emphasis in Mathematics, Finance, Economics or similar analytical background with a strong record of achievement

• Minimum 3-5 years' re/insurance, catastrophe modeling, actuarial or investment banking experience required

• Exposure to the catastrophe bond, ILS market or reinsurance placement process required

• Outstanding written and verbal English required, including excellent grammar, spelling and attention to detail in presentation materials

• Existing securities industry licensing (i.e. FINRA SIE, 7, 63, 79) preferred, or capable of acquiring licenses within 60-days of employment
 About Swiss Re Capital Markets
 Swiss Re Capital Markets (SRCM) is a leading boutique investment bank, acting as broker-dealer in the structuring, placement and secondary trading of ILS in the capital markets. ILS includes catastrophe bonds, sidecars, synthetic solutions and many other securitization and derivative products. New York, NY, US

Are you looking for a strategy & operations role that offers exposure to the topics most relevant to the US Property & Casualty (P&C) reinsurance market and direct interaction with senior executives? Our Operations Officer role in US P&C Reinsurance provides a strong platform to further develop strategic problem solving, executive communication, business analytics, and execution skills with one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance.
 About the Role
 The Operations Officer role will support the US P&C Reinsurance CEO, extended leadership team and global stakeholders as an analyst on strategic and operational engagements across the organization, working jointly with the Senior Operations Officer and the Head Market Operations & Performance Americas.
 The role is focused on analysis, executive reporting, business performance monitoring, operational execution, and coordination across internal stakeholders. The successful candidate will work closely with senior leaders and functional teams across Client Underwriting, Product, Business Management, Finance, Risk Management, and other areas.
 Responsibilities include :

• Support the US P&C Reinsurance CEO and extended leadership team with projects and activities that deliver on the Market Unit’s strategic objectives.

• Prepare presentations and briefing materials for internal management meetings, including Board meetings, Business Performance Reviews, townhalls, and offsites.

• Support materials for external engagements, including rating agency discussions, regulatory updates, conferences, and other senior stakeholder meetings.

• Provide quantitative and qualitative analysis on critical business topics, including market share analysis, client satisfaction, renewal updates, interaction analysis, and KPI reporting.

• Support the Senior Operations Officer in enabling strategic execution by gathering and analyzing internal and external data, developing recommendations, and supporting execution of key initiatives.

• Act as an ambassador for the US P&C Market Unit by connecting business functions, including Client Underwriting, Product, Business Management, Finance, and Risk Management, in support of business unit and group priorities.
 About the Team

The Market Operations & Performance Americas team works closely with senior leaders across P&C Reinsurance to support strategic direction, business performance management, and operational excellence. The team helps connect strategy, governance, analytics, and execution across the business.
 About You
 Curious, open-minded, and a fast learner, you bring strategic thought and strong analytical skills. You thrive working in a challenging, complex, and global environment while bringing people together across functions, levels, and regions. You are innovative, detail-oriented and self-motivated.
 Additional requirements include :

• University degree with strong academic and professional track record.

• 3 to 4 years of experience in financial markets, reinsurance, insurance, strategy, business management, or management consulting.

• Familiarity with reinsurance a plus

• Reliable and accountable, with a consistent track record of high-quality work.

• Agile and flexible in response to changing circumstances.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel required; Power BI knowledge is a plus.

jobs.description:
Launch your actuarial career with an exciting winter internship at our Canadian office in Toronto! This is your chance to gain hands-on experience in the P&C (Property & Casualty) sector while working alongside industry professionals who are passionate about mentoring the next generation of actuarial talent. You'll develop valuable skills, build your professional network, and apply your academic knowledge to real-world challenges.
 About the Role
 As an Actuarial Intern reporting directly to our P&C Appointed Actuary, you'll be immersed in meaningful work that contributes to our company's success while developing your technical and professional capabilities in a supportive environment.
 Key Responsibilities

• Support Canadian statutory reserving and reporting under IFRS 17, gaining exposure to industry standards

• Assist with financial forecast modelling , Financial Condition Testing (FCT) and the ORSA process

• Contribute to the transition and stabilization of IFRS 17, collaborating with local and global project teams across functions including Finance and IT

• Work on diverse projects and provide support to team members as needed

• Apply analytical skills to solve real business problems while receiving mentorship from experienced actuaries
 About the Team
 You'll join our dynamic P&C Actuarial team based in Toronto, working in a collaborative environment where innovation and analytical thinking are valued. Our team plays a crucial role in the company's financial reporting, risk assessment, and strategic planning, providing you with exposure to various aspects of the actuarial profession while supporting your professional development.
 About You
 You're a motivated student with a passion for numbers, problem-solving, and learning. You thrive when facing complex challenges and are eager to apply your academic knowledge in a professional setting. You're detail-oriented yet can see the big picture, and you're excited about building a career in the actuarial field.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field

• Excellent working knowledge of MS Excel, with Visual Basic Programming capabilities

• Demonstrated progress in actuarial exams

• Strong analytical skills with meticulous attention to detail

• Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams

• Experience with MS Access, R, Oracle or other database management tools

• Previous internship experience in insurance, finance, or related fields

• Knowledge of IFRS 17 concepts

• Proactive learning style with intellectual curiosity

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager- US & Canada
jobs.description:
Locations:
Armonk, NY, US |
Fort Wayne, IN, US

Are you a people-first leader who thrives at the intersection of operational excellence and business impact? Do you get energized by building high-performing teams, solving complex problems, and driving meaningful process improvements? If so, this is your opportunity to lead a critical function at the heart of a global reinsurance powerhouse.

About the Role
 As Sales Operations Manager , you will lead the North America Sales Operations team, a function that sits at the very center of how the business operates and grows. You will be accountable for ensuring the seamless execution of treaty onboarding, data quality management, operational controls, and continuous improvement initiatives across the region. This is a high-visibility leadership role where you will partner with stakeholders across Client Markets, Treaty Administration, Finance, Valuation, and global Operations to deliver operational excellence at scale.
 This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain the status quo, it's for someone who wants to shape it.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Sales Operations team, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and exceptional client service

• Drive cross-training initiatives to build team resilience and ensure business continuity across shifting priorities

• Oversee end-to-end customer onboarding and operational support activities, ensuring service levels, quality standards, and operational objectives are consistently met

• Manage team workload and capacity effectively, adapting to volume fluctuations and evolving business priorities with agility

• Maintain robust operational controls and data quality standards , monitoring KPIs and operational metrics to ensure accuracy, integrity, and compliance

jobs.description:
About the Role
 We are looking for an enthusiastic individual to join the London-based US Lawyers' underwriting team within Swiss Re Corporate Solutions. This role offers an opportunity to join a dynamic team and offers development potential.
 You will be responsible for underwriting complex Lawyers Professional Liability (LPL) risks for top‑tier law firms, with a strong focus on attention to detail, broker engagement, and strategic risk selection.
 The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting a sophisticated Large Lawyers portfolio, partnering closely with claims, risk management, and actuarial colleagues.
 Key Responsibilities

• Analyze submissions to assess insurability, coverage, structure, and risk quality for large, often international, law firms.

• Review claims history and work on pricing with actuarial teams.

• Negotiate proposals and prepare quotations.

• Serve as an underwriting contact for key global brokers and major law firm clients.

• Lead or participate in underwriting meetings, renewals, and strategic discussions with insurers and brokers.

• Support relationship management and contribute to long‑term client and broker partnerships.

• Contribute market insights on trends affecting large law firms, including emerging practice risks, jurisdictional trends, and claim developments.
 About the Team
 You will be joining the London-based US Lawyers' underwriting team within Swiss Re Corporate Solutions — a dynamic, collaborative group dedicated to delivering exceptional underwriting on some of the most complex and high-profile legal professional liability risks in the market. The team offers strong technical support, a global perspective, and real opportunities for professional development and growth.
 About You
 You are a motivated, detail-oriented underwriting professional who thrives in a fast-paced, intellectually challenging environment. You bring strong analytical capabilities, excellent interpersonal skills, and the confidence to engage with senior stakeholders and global brokers. You are equally comfortable working independently and collaborating within a diverse, global team.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Experience in Lawyers Professional Liability , ideally with exposure to excess or layered programs

• Strong understanding of large law firm risk profiles , claims drivers, and broker market dynamics

• Proven ability to evaluate complex risks and articulate underwriting rationale clearly and confidently
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Strong negotiation and analytical skills , with confidence engaging at senior levels

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills , with experience managing multiple stakeholders in a team environment

• High level of self-motivation and ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative, global team

• Willingness to travel as required to support broker and client relationships
 Why Join Us

• Opportunity to step into a well‑established, high‑profile Large Lawyers portfolio .

• Meaningful underwriting on complex and intellectually challenging risks.

• Collaborative, global team environment with strong technical support.
 Compensation & Work Model
 For the United Kingdom, the base salary range for this position is between £63,000 and £95,000 for a full-time role.
 The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role
 • the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
 In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 #Li-Hybrid

 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. Are you searching for a new challenge in a stable company? Would you like to build your career, learn more about insurance/reinsurance and be a part of an amazing team?
 We are looking for a new colleague who has analytical thinking and will enjoy working with Excel. If you found yourself in the description, send us your CV!
 About the Team
 As a new team member you will be a significant part of the L&H Reinsurance Operations team working with skilled professionals from the field. You will have the opportunity to learn, develop and uncover your potential - find yourself in the work you like.

About the role
 Your main responsibilities will be administration of clients' accounts in your portfolio, which comprises of our clients who are primarily insurance companies and brokers. You will be responsible for your own portfolio of insurance companies.

Key responsibilities:
 • Verification of client data based on reinsurance treaties
 • Clarification of discrepancies and business communication with internal departments and clients
 • Data analysis, booking and cash flow management
 • Proactive investigation and interpretation of accounting data

The position is a maternity cover contract.
 About you
 You are a communicative, diligent and analytical person who is detail-oriented and thrives in a team.
 Essentials:
 • Flair for numbers, analytical skills and good knowledge of MS Excel
 • Engaged and proactive work ethic
 • Proficiency in English is a must, proficiency in French is advantageous - written and spoken
 WE HIRE FOR ATTITUDE, AND TRAIN FOR SKILLS.

Ready to play an important role and own the way you work? This is your opportunity to demonstrate and improve your strengths, talents and skills!
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1300 and EUR 2200 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​

As a Financial Transactions Modeler, you'll be at the intersection of financial markets and insurance, helping managing sophisticated portfolios that are key to Swiss Re L&H growth strategy. You'll apply your quantitative expertise to model, analyze, and optimize our financial market transformation portfolios.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain stochastic cashflows models for bespoke insurance transactions exposed to Financial Market risks, with focus on Variable Annuities, GMxB, and Index-Linked portfolios

• Standardize and automate transaction reporting processes for hedging, valuation and risk management purposes

• Analyze biometric and policyholder behavior experience to support assumption updates

• Support the onboarding of new transactions with technical precision and attention to details

• Perform regular ad-hoc investigations into existing processes and data (policy data, P&L attribution, reserving, etc.)

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Swiss Re to improve management of financial and biometric exposures

You'll be joining the Financial Market Portfolios team within Life & Health Transactions. Our team plays a crucial role in supporting the portfolio growth of Financial Solutions as part of Swiss Re L&H growth strategy. We work closely with multiple stakeholders including L&H Structured Solutions, L&H Pricing & Structuring, Quantitative Analytics, Risk Management, Finance, Treasury, and Asset Management to deliver innovative financial solutions that drive business growth and manage risk effectively.

You're a curious, analytical thinker with strong technical abilities and a drive to understand underlying patterns in complex data. You thrive in collaborative environments where you can apply your quantitative skills to solve real business challenges. You're results-oriented and excited about contributing to business growth through data-driven insights.

• Academic background in STEM with hands-on quantitative programming experience, preferably in Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Physics, or Computer Science

• 4+ years of programming and debugging experience in quantitative modelling or analytics (preferably in C, C++, Java, Python)

• Experience with stochastic modelling, preferably of financial market risks and insurance cashflows

The following experience would be particularly valuable:

• Relevant life insurance / reinsurance experience

• Variable Annuities, GMxB or Index-Linked products

• Working knowledge of financial markets and financial mathematics

• Data engineering

• Biometric experience studies, preferably using R or Python

• Insurance structuring and pricing

• L&H insurance portfolio management

• Collaboration with Valuation, Treasury, Risk Management, Asset Management

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze biometric and policyholder behavior experience to support assumption updates

• Support the onboarding of new transactions with technical precision and attention to details

• Perform regular ad-hoc investigations into existing processes and data (policy data, P&L attribution, reserving, etc.)

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Swiss Re to improve management of financial and biometric exposures

jobs.description:
Are you a strategic thinker with exceptional content production skills?
 Join our Marketing Services & Operations EMEA team on a 1-year temporary contract and become the force behind sales enablement that drives business success! In this role, you'll blend sales enablement expertise with operational excellence to produce high-quality assets that enhance client engagement.
 About the Role
 As our Sales Enablement Content Producer & Manager, you'll be the vital link between enablement strategy and execution. You'll transform complex information into compelling, brand-aligned content that equips our sales teams with the tools they need to succeed in the competitive re/insurance landscape.
 Key Responsibilities

• Develop and design market-specific sales enablement strategies aligned with marketing objectives to drive targeted client engagement in coordination with marketing managers and business stakeholders.

• Produce high-quality content across various formats (slides, PDFs, visuals, infographics) based on structured briefs

• Format and finalize content using brand-approved templates and layout standards

• Maintain and evolve branded templates ensuring proper structure, tagging, and accessibility

• Track production progress and ensure timely delivery of assets meeting quality specifications

• Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to manage production timelines

• Support intake workflows and contribute to improving content delivery processes

• Maintain understanding of Business Unit services and marketing priorities for contextually aligned content

• Identify opportunities for content reuse and support quality control across assets

• Manage structure and version control of marketing and sales enablement asset library

• Monitor adoption and effectiveness of enablement tools, gathering feedback to continuously refine practices
 About the Team
 You'll be joining the EMEA Marketing Services & Operations department within the Branding and Marketing Division. Our team is responsible for delivering marketing strategies and plans that support business growth, with a focus on events, digital marketing and impactful content that enables Swiss Re to communicate our value proposition to clients.
 About You
 You're a detail-oriented marketing professional who thrives in collaborative environments. You have a keen eye for copywriting, design and formatting while understanding the strategic importance of sales enablement in driving business results. You're comfortable managing multiple requests simultaneously and delivering high-quality assets under pressure.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Marketing, Communications, or related field

• 3+ years of experience in B2B marketing content production or sales enablement, preferably within re/insurance/finance industry

• Strong knowledge of content marketing principles and asset lifecycle management

• Experience in sales enablement function

• Proficiency in formatting, visual layout, and working with templates and brand guidelines

• Experience working with internal marketing teams and external content vendors

• Excellent written and oral English
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with content asset libraries and sales enablement platforms such as Seismic

• Understanding of best practices for tagging, storage, and taxonomy

• High attention to detail and consistency in formatting and file organization

• Collaborative, delivery-focused team player who thrives in a matrixed environment

• Additional European languages such as German, French, Spanish, Italian or other

• Global experience in marketing or content production
 This is a 1-year temporary contract.
 Salary Information
 For London, the base salary range for this position is between 52 000 GBP and 78 000 GBP for a full-time role.
 The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
 In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits.

• Experience working with internal marketing teams and external content vendors

jobs.description:
Our Business Services Team provides strategic support with business-processing and technical support to the underwriting team (Latin America –Specialties, Engineering, Property and Casualty).
 We are a dynamic and diverse team, with a high level of collaboration, challenged by constant interaction and coordination with internal and external customers.
 We are accountable to organize and work with detailed source documents following procedures and focusing on the assurance of data entry and quality in systems and tools used for risk clearance, create submissions, and control costing.
 About the role:

• Modify, update, and process changes in applicable tools, systems (Manhattan), and documents, as needed.

• Follow established performance standards and metrics applicable to the business unit supported.

• High competency with process guidelines and applicable tools and systems.

• Collaborate on the development and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures, system and tool enhancements, and testing/piloting changes.

• Generate reports and documents, verifying information in predefined business reports for customers.

• Audit compliance, compile, review, and verify data accuracy using source documents.

• Interact with on-shore/off-shore contractors, as appropriate, to answer questions or give instructions.

• Ability to accurately and efficiently analyze data to determine and communicate recommendations to customers.

• High interaction and coordination with underwriters and other internal /external departments related.
 About You:
 We are looking forward to meeting you! Are you keen on applying accurate logic and common sense in decision making? Are you looking forward to acquire new knowledge and be part of a multicultural work environment?
 You will be ideal for the role if your profile includes:

• 4 year degree in a technical field (Actuarial, Engineering, Economics etc.)

• (Re)Insurance knowledge, with minimum 1 year relevant experience in P&C lines of business.

• Being proficient in English and Spanish (Other languages may be essential based on the Market / Team being supported)
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst Partner Management
jobs.description:
About the role:

This is your opportunity to join the exciting world of the global business intelligence team of Reinsurance Client Governance, Business Operations. The team acts as centralized facilitator for the global Reinsurance community and Group Functions in organizing, managing and maintaining core data and KYC information of Swiss Re's external business partners.
 This position is part of Partner Management & Analytics Team under Reinsurance Client Governance team for Reinsurance, will have responsibility to support the Partner Management activities including Partner data governance. Maintaining continuous attention to partner data quality involves identifying and executing tasks to preserve the data within the Partner data management system for Business Partners. The position includes evaluating and streamlining different risk management standards for Partner Data Management activities, as well as ensuring that necessary corrective measures are implemented.

Principal Responsibilities :

• Primary responsibilities are centered on partner data governance.

• Advise and support various stakeholders from business community on partner data requisites and maintenance.

• Responsible for managing the Know Your Customer (KYC) process for partners.

• Perform checks and execute risk control standards for Partner Management.

• Manage International Trade Control (ITC) risk control mechanism in close collaboration with Compliance & Governance functions.

• Recommend, manage, and execute data improvement actions in collaboration with business stakeholders.

• Leading improvement projects & implementing lean principles / methodologies.

• Enhancing services and abilities for handling partner data along with spearheading different data cleansing projects.

• Establish and maintain Partner and Contact data KPI framework.

• Find ways to improve, standardize, and simplify the process reports.

About the team:

The Partner Management & Analytics Team is part of the Reinsurance Client Governance, Business Operations division — a centralized and dynamic hub that serves as the backbone of Swiss Re's global Reinsurance community and Group Functions. The team specializes in organizing, managing, and maintaining core data and KYC information for Swiss Re's extensive network of external business partners. With a global reach and a collaborative spirit, the team plays a critical role in upholding data integrity, compliance standards, and governance excellence across the reinsurance landscape. Joining this team means becoming part of a group that is passionate about data quality, continuous improvement, and making a meaningful difference in how Swiss Re manages its partner relationships worldwide.

About you:

The successful candidate should have or be able to build strong relevant content knowledge and a proficient understanding in managing, maintaining, and promoting data management & adherence to Compliance guidelines for strong governance. A strong team player and have a good sense for priorities and experience in assessing and addressing business needs.

Job requirements:

• Graduate / Post-graduate in Business Management or similar.

• 3-4 years' experience as a Research Analyst; especially in Business research, KYC & Analysis.

• Expertise in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word & MS Teams.

• Good understanding of Governance and Risk Control framework for CRM tools.

• Must be a self-starter, highly organized and able to handle multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and able to deliver results in time.

• Must be capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a team.

• Working experience with various countries and cultures would be a plus.

• Insurance Certification/ experience would be a plus.

• Knowledge of Data Warehouse and Visualization tools would be a plus.

jobs.title: Operational Resilience Manager (Hybrid set up)
jobs.description:
Are you a resilience professional who thrives at the intersection of strategy and hands-on delivery? Do you want to shape how a leading global reinsurer prepares for, responds to, and recovers from disruptions? If so, this is your opportunity to make a real and lasting impact.
 About the Role
 As a Lead Operational Resilience Manager based in Madrid, you will be at the heart of evolving and embedding Swiss Re's Operational Resilience and Crisis Management capabilities across the organisation. This is a high-impact, senior role where strategic thinking meets practical execution — you'll partner with business leaders, challenge the status quo, and drive meaningful outcomes in a fast-moving, globally connected environment.
 You won't just be maintaining frameworks — you'll be shaping them, testing them, and making them stronger.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead framework development: Own and continuously evolve the Operational Resilience & Crisis Management frameworks , ensuring alignment with organisational standards, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices

• Shape strategic direction: Contribute to the resilience roadmap , incorporating emerging risks, external trends, and regulatory developments to keep Swiss Re ahead of the curve

• Integrate protective intelligence: Leverage threat, geopolitical, security, and environmental indicators to inform scenario design , location and third-party risk considerations, and senior stakeholder briefings

• Partner with the business: Collaborate with business units and functions to strengthen resilience capabilities — including business services, dependencies, recovery strategies, and scenario planning

• Drive resilience testing: Own the end-to-end design, facilitation, and follow-through of resilience testing and scenario exercises, including accountability for remediation actions

• Challenge impact tolerances: Support and constructively challenge the business in defining and practically applying resilience-related impact tolerances in planning and decision-making

• Lead reporting and insights: Develop and maintain resilience dashboards and senior management updates that enable informed, timely decision-making

• Coordinate regulatory engagement: Ensure high-quality responses, clear narratives, and robust supporting evidence for regulatory reviews and internal assessments

• Strengthen third-party resilience: Support critical supplier considerations, concentration risk management , and ongoing monitoring of third-party resilience

• Align with technology teams: Collaborate closely with IT and cyber teams to ensure resilience priorities and dependencies are well-integrated

• Support incident management: Contribute actively during disruptive events — supporting triage, escalation, coordination, situational awareness , communications, and lessons learned

• Embed resilience cross-functionally: Drive collaboration across risk, compliance, operations, and technology to make resilience part of everyday practice

• Mentor and develop others: Provide direction, structure, and guidance to more junior colleagues, fostering a culture of learning and ownership
 About the Team
 The Operational Resilience team is a truly global function, with talented colleagues based across Zurich, Hyderabad, Bangalore, New York, Madrid, Bratislava, and London. Together, we lead the implementation and continuous evolution of Operational Resilience at Swiss Re — ensuring the organisation can remain effective and meet its commitments even during disruptions or crises.
 We are a collaborative, forward-thinking team that combines deep expertise with a pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset. As part of the Madrid team, you'll be embedded in a vibrant local hub while contributing to a global agenda that matters. We're looking for an experienced and driven professional to play a key role in shaping and advancing this work across the organisation.
 About You
 You are a seasoned resilience professional who brings both the strategic perspective to shape frameworks and the hands-on drive to deliver results. You communicate with clarity and confidence, influence without authority, and take genuine ownership of outcomes. You're comfortable navigating complexity, engaging senior stakeholders, and working across cultures and functions in a fast-paced international environment.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 6+ years of relevant experience in operational resilience, business continuity, and/or crisis management within complex organisations

• Demonstrated expertise in developing, enhancing, and challenging policies, standards, procedures, and guidance — with the ability to translate complex concepts into practical, actionable steps for diverse stakeholders

• Strong understanding of operational resilience frameworks , including critical business services, impact tolerances, and scenario testing methodologies

• Proven experience in designing and facilitating scenario testing or exercises, and driving remediation activities through to completion

• Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders , providing both strategic support and constructive challenge
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in financial services or similarly regulated industries

• Familiarity with European regulatory expectations , including DORA

• Experience with third-party risk management or supplier resilience programmes

• Knowledge of IT or cyber resilience concepts and their intersection with operational resilience

• Experience with data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI

• Experience working in Agile or transformation environments

• Experience mentoring colleagues or coordinating small, cross-functional teams

• Advanced proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

• Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken
 For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between 60,000 EUR and 100,000 EUR for a full-time role.

About the Role
As a Lead Operational Resilience Manager based in Madrid, you will be at the heart of evolving and embedding Swiss Re's Operational Resilience and Crisis Management capabilities across the organisation. This is a high-impact, senior role where strategic thinking meets practical execution — you'll partner with business leaders, challenge the status quo, and drive meaningful outcomes in a fast-moving, globally connected environment.
You won't just be maintaining frameworks — you'll be shaping them, testing them, and making them stronger.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead framework development: Own and continuously evolve the Operational Resilience & Crisis Management frameworks , ensuring alignment with organisational standards, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices

• Shape strategic direction: Contribute to the resilience roadmap , incorporating emerging risks, external trends, and regulatory developments to keep Swiss Re ahead of the curve

• Integrate protective intelligence: Leverage threat, geopolitical, security, and environmental indicators to inform scenario design , location and third-party risk considerations, and senior stakeholder briefings

• Partner with the business: Collaborate with business units and functions to strengthen resilience capabilities — including business services, dependencies, recovery strategies, and scenario planning

• Drive resilience testing: Own the end-to-end design, facilitation, and follow-through of resilience testing and scenario exercises, including accountability for remediation actions

• Challenge impact tolerances: Support and constructively challenge the business in defining and practically applying resilience-related impact tolerances in planning and decision-making

• Lead reporting and insights: Develop and maintain resilience dashboards and senior management updates that enable informed, timely decision-making

• Coordinate regulatory engagement: Ensure high-quality responses, clear narratives, and robust supporting evidence for regulatory reviews and internal assessments

• Strengthen third-party resilience: Support critical supplier considerations, concentration risk management , and ongoing monitoring of third-party resilience

• Align with technology teams: Collaborate closely with IT and cyber teams to ensure resilience priorities and dependencies are well-integrated

• Support incident management: Contribute actively during disruptive events — supporting triage, escalation, coordination, situational awareness , communications, and lessons learned

• Embed resilience cross-functionally: Drive collaboration across risk, compliance, operations, and technology to make resilience part of everyday practice

• Mentor and develop others: Provide direction, structure, and guidance to more junior colleagues, fostering a culture of learning and ownership

We're looking for an experienced and driven professional to play a key role in shaping and advancing this work across the organisation.

You are a seasoned resilience professional who brings both the strategic perspective to shape frameworks and the hands-on drive to deliver results. You communicate with clarity and confidence, influence without authority, and take genuine ownership of outcomes. • 6+ years of relevant experience in operational resilience, business continuity, and/or crisis management within complex organisations

• Demonstrated expertise in developing, enhancing, and challenging policies, standards, procedures, and guidance — with the ability to translate complex concepts into practical, actionable steps for diverse stakeholders

• Strong understanding of operational resilience frameworks , including critical business services, impact tolerances, and scenario testing methodologies

• Proven experience in designing and facilitating scenario testing or exercises, and driving remediation activities through to completion

• Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders , providing both strategic support and constructive challenge
These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in financial services or similarly regulated industries

• Familiarity with European regulatory expectations , including DORA

• Experience with third-party risk management or supplier resilience programmes

About the Role
 As an Application Engineer specializing in Frontend development, you'll be at the heart of developing and maintaining our sophisticated in-house insurance products built primarily with Angular. You'll join one of our product teams and contribute to functionality that generates real business impact while upholding our commitment to engineering excellence.
 Key Responsibilities

• Develop and review code that meets our high standards for quality and maintainability

• Collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams including requirements engineers, QA specialists, and other application engineers

• Shape architecture by contributing to key decisions and documentation that guide our technical direction Integrate services and shared platforms including messaging systems, BPMN workflows, logging frameworks, and telemetry solutions

• Stay current with emerging technologies and Generative AI developments to continuously improve our solutions
 About the Team
 We are a team that believes in engineering excellence and that our leaders should also be engineers themselves. We build applications that are carefully designed, thoughtfully implemented, and surpass the expectations of our users by working together with product owners. Quality and stability are first-class deliverables in everything we do, and we lead by example by embedding high standards into our processes.
 About You
 You're a naturally curious and thoughtful professional who thrives in a high-performance engineering environment. Your passion for coding is matched by your commitment to delivering business value. You believe in continuous learning through self-improvement or by absorbing knowledge from those around you, and you're excited to contribute to a team that values technical excellence
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Proficiency in software development across the entire software delivery lifecycle, with strong Angular, HTML & CSS expertise

• Experience building/packing modules with module bundlers like Webpack, Node, or Browserify

• Previous public cloud experience, particularly with Microsoft Azure Strong understanding of Restful APIs, Open API specification & Swagger

• Comfort spending most of your time in the IDE and working with large and established codebases

• Experience with other JavaScript frameworks beyond Angular Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

• A track record of delivering change in regulated industries, with an understanding of compliance and risk considerations

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced professional in guarantees and surety operations with a passion for client servicing? Do you thrive in an international environment where strong interpersonal skills and attention to detail make a real impact? If so, this could be your next career opportunity.

 As an Operations Surety Specialist , you will play a key role in delivering exceptional service to our global corporate clients and brokers. You will be responsible for the timely and accurate handling of surety bond and guarantee requests while ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
 You will work closely with internal stakeholders, clients, and brokers to support business growth and deliver an outstanding client experience.

• Review and coordinate the issuance of surety bonds and guarantees, ensuring compliance with regional jurisdictional and regulatory requirements.

• Provide guidance on guarantee and bond wordings, particularly under English Law and URDG758 frameworks.

• Structure and support complex surety transactions while minimizing operational and regulatory risks.

• Deliver high-quality client servicing by handling requests, inquiries, amendments, and new transactions in a timely and accurate manner.

• Maintain and strengthen relationships with clients and brokers, contributing actively to business growth and client satisfaction.

• Analyze incoming emails and documentation, assess the nature of requests, and allocate tasks efficiently to the appropriate teams.

• Process and allocate client payments accurately, support reconciliations and premium bookings, and resolve discrepancies when necessary.

• Support clients with account statements and payment-related inquiries while ensuring high service standards and responsiveness.

About the Team
 The Surety Europe Team is a growing and dynamic international team closely collaborating with Surety business unit. Driven by strong customer orientation and service excellence, we support profitable business growth while maintaining high levels of client satisfaction.
 Our team operates across multiple European locations, including Germany and Spain, fostering a collaborative and multicultural working environment.
 About You
 You are client-focused, proactive, and highly organized person. You enjoy working in an international environment, taking ownership of your responsibilities, and collaborating with different stakeholders. You bring strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You are able to prioritize effectively, work independently, and build strong working relationships both internally and externally. You are also a strong team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and supporting the growth of colleagues.
 Essential Skills & Experience

• Completed commercial education, preferably as a banking specialist, or bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration or Law. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

• Previous experience in a client-facing role, ideally within banking, insurance, or financial services.

• Solid experience in guarantees and surety bond issuance.

• Strong understanding of direct issuance guarantee business and guarantee frameworks, particularly under English Law and URDG758.

• Fluency in English is mandatory.

Nice to Have

• 5–7 years of professional experience within banking, insurance, or financial operations.

• Knowledge of sanctions screening, AML procedures, commercial law and company law.

• Certified Specialist in Demand Guarantees (CSDG) or similar certification is considered an asset.

• Knowledge of Italian Law is considered a strong advantage.

• Italian language skills (written and spoken) are considered a strong advantage, while knowledge of German would be an additional asset.

• Experience working in an international and cross-functional environment.

Take the next step in your career and do not hesitate to apply! We are looking forward to reviewing your application.
 As this role requires regular communication in English, please make sure to submit your application and CV in English language.

jobs.description:
Join our dynamic team in Toronto where you'll develop your analytical expertise, solve complex risk management challenges, and gain invaluable industry experience in a global reinsurance leader.
 About the Role
 As an Actuarial Intern on an 8-month program starting in May 2026, you'll gain hands-on experience supporting our Life & Health Actuarial Reserving operations with meaningful work that contributes directly to our business outcomes while developing your professional skills.
 Key Responsibilities

• Learn and assist with model construction and validation for actuarial analysis and risk assessment

• Develop your analytic skills by participating in experience studies to analyze performance and identify trends

• Support financial reporting processes, including US STAT, Swiss STAT and IFRS17 reporting
 About the Team
 Our results-oriented team focuses on actuarial reserving on America's Group and Health businesses. We're passionate about actuarial data analysis and provide accurate financial reporting for our block of business. Working with us means joining a collaborative environment where you'll receive mentorship and your contributions will have meaningful impact across multiple business areas.
 About You
 You're a motivated, enthusiastic, and goal-driven actuarial student who thrives in a learning environment. Your passion for problem-solving and innovation enables you to think outside the box and develop creative solutions with tangible results.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, or related fields

• Exceptional academic performance (GPA of 3.0 and above)

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Completion of 2 or more actuarial exams (preferred)
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with AXIS, SQL, R and VBA

• Previous internship experience in insurance, sales, or business

• Quick learning ability with enthusiasm for developing new skills

• Strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects

• Collaborative approach with ability to work effectively in teams

• Innovative thinking and curiosity about the reinsurance industry

jobs.title: Investment Analyst, Private Debt
jobs.description:
Have you thought about kick-starting your investment career in Private Markets?
 We are looking for a motivated and ambitious professional who is ready to contribute and grow through a hands-on role in the exciting and expanding world of private debt.
 This role requires prior experience analyzing structured credit transactions (public or private) and a strong interest in credit investing, portfolio construction, and financial markets.
 About the Role
 As a Private Debt Investment Analyst at Swiss Re, you will play a key role in supporting and shaping the Private Debt asset class. The role offers primary exposure to public and private securitized products, specialty finance, and asset-backed lending structures, as well as broader private asset classes including infrastructure lending, commercial mortgages, and private credit.
 Your responsibilities will span both strategic and operational dimensions, including the development and oversight of the long-term investment strategy and operating model. You will be actively involved in the day-to-day management of the portfolio, contributing to investment selection, portfolio steering, performance monitoring, and risk assessment. This role offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative, team-oriented environment with a strong emphasis on disciplined risk management and continuous improvement.
 Key responsibilities also include :

• Analyze and evaluate investment opportunities across structured credit, asset-based finance, and other private markets opportunities originated via external asset managers' relationships

• Help oversee Private Debt asset managers including ongoing assessment of investment strategy as well as operational aspects

• Develop and maintain a high standard portfolio monitoring framework capturing key portfolio characteristics as well as developments in terms of returns and risk

• Drive and coordinate with key stakeholders customized reporting frameworks and presentations to relevant business units and internal committees

• Track market developments across ABS, RMBS, CMBS, consumer finance, specialty lending and other private market sectors
 About You
 You bring strong analytical and quantitative skills, coupled with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, international environment. In addition, your effective interpersonal and communication skills support successful collaboration across diverse teams and stakeholders.
 Additional requirements include :

• College/university degree or equivalent in finance, economics, or a related field. CFA or similar qualifications are a plus

• 2-5 years of relevant experience in structured credit, securitized products or asset-based finance

• Understanding of structured finance concepts, credit analysis and securitization structures

• Advanced/Expert Microsoft Office (including Excel and PowerPoint) skills required

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Self-motivated and driven; ability to balance multiple tasks and work effectively in a collaborative, fast moving, demanding, and dynamic environment

• Ability and willingness to travel, when required
 About the Team
 The Private Debt team is a diverse and global team of investment professionals located in New York, Zurich, and London part of the Private Investments unit in Swiss Re Group Asset Management. We are a core function within Swiss Re Asset Management, responsible for managing private debt portfolios for Swiss Re's own balance sheet. The team consists of dedicated specialists overseeing and transacting in Infrastructure, Commercial Mortgage, Mid-Market Loans, and Private Asset-Backed Finance across a global portfolio.
 Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework or visa sponsorship.
 The estimated base salary range for this position is $112,000 to $168,000. The specific salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. jobs.title: Risk Consultant- P&C Insurance
jobs.description:
Locations:
New York, NY, US |
Chicago, IL, US

Are you a P&C professional with a real passion for predictive modeling and analytics? Are you a consultant or actuary who leads analytical projects that require you to understand and analyse client's needs, challenges, and deliver effective business solutions? Do you have experience in product development, pricing, underwriting, go-to market efforts, in-force management, claims? If so, here is where your journey begins!
 We are currently expanding our Risk Consulting & Analytics team within the Swiss Re Risk Data Solutions division by searching for a dedicated professional to deliver analytics and consulting services across the insurance value chain to our clients. Do not hesitate to apply to join our highly skilled team!
 About the role

As a main contributor , you will be responsible for executing and supporting delivery on our client consulting offerings. This is a key role within the Americas consulting team with ownership of client delivery and evolving and growing the overall consulting value proposition. Our clients include some of the largest global insurance carriers as well as regional insurers, MGAs, and public sector organizations in the Americas. Being client-centric and commercially minded, you will help drive our collective success.
 Your key responsibilities will involve:

• Contributing to delivery of P&C analytics and risk consulting engagements, creating and leading technical analyses, and interpreting results and communicating them to clients

• Working collaboratively within multi-disciplined project teams to drive effective delivery

• Acting as a primary contributor for Property and Casualty analytical projects, using a combination of internal and external data sources to help clients navigate changes

• Developing, maintaining, and improving pricing models across P&C lines

• Collaborating closely with stakeholders across Swiss Re to develop new capabilities and data assets
 About Risk Consulting & Analytics (RCA)
 'Solutions' is a central pillar of the reinsurance strategy, critical both to development of our core activities as well as developing new revenue streams for Swiss Re. The Risk Consulting & Analytics team within the Risk Data Solutions division is globally responsible for delivering consulting services to our clients. We unlock the power of data by providing insights and advice to our clients along the entire insurance value chain and partner to realize their strategic ambitions of growth, profitability, and efficiency. Our typical client work centres on profitable growth, product development, pricing, underwriting, risk scoring and selection and claims. Combining Swiss Re’s unparalleled industry expertise, wealth of data and groundbreaking data analytics capabilities, we offer trusted, impactful, and commercially valued insights at the forefront of innovation and grounded on Swiss Re’s core values. Providing such services to our clients leads to new, more, or better business profit generation for Swiss Re that would not happen through core or transaction business. These earnings will be manifested primarily through a fee income model.
 About you:
 You have strong technical underwriting/pricing analytics and problem-solving skills, business mindset, can-do attitude, and ability to assimilate complex information. You also have a desire to work in a dynamic, high-impact client-facing role.

Essentials:

• 2-3 + years primary Property & Casualty underwriting, predictive modeling, actuarial, or analytics experience

• Expertise in statistical tools, programming languages, and visualization tools (e.g. Python, R, SQL, MS PowerBI)

• Comfort with data analysis and manipulation in at least one programming language in the P&C insurance space

• Excellent knowledge of the primary insurance market for Property and Casualty lines of business, having worked for an insurer, broker, consulting firm or analytics company

• Ability to interpret complex analysis and turn it into actionable insights through impactful analysis

• Experience with interacting & communicating with senior management and diverse client stakeholders

• Flexibility to travel occasionally
 Nice to have:

• Experience building predictive models in a variety of forms (GLMs, tree-based models, etc.) Experience within the context of pricing models highly preferred.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about bridging the gap between cutting-edge risk analytics and real-world client success? Join our dynamic Risk Data Solutions team where you'll lead insurance and reinsurance clients to unlock the full potential of our property and natural catastrophe solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend commercial acumen with technical expertise while making a tangible impact on how clients navigate complex risk landscapes.
 About the role
 As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will own the client journey – from initial sales through implementation, design, adoption, and long-term growth. You will be the orchestrator of client value, working at the intersection of analytics, underwriting expertise, and business strategy.
 Key Responsibilities:
 • Drive strategic sales across the EMEA market, leveraging Swiss Re's comprehensive portfolio of risk data products and services
• Lead end-to-end customer success initiatives, with particular focus on property and NatCat related use cases, ensuring strong adoption, retention, and expansion
• Foster collaboration with Reinsurance Underwriting and Key Account management colleagues to align our solutions with client priorities and strategic objectives
• Deliver structured onboarding and training programs, translating complex NatCat and property analytics into practical client workflows and decision frameworks
• Spearhead renewals and expansion in partnership with Sales and Reinsurance account teams, contributing directly to Net Revenue Retention and long-term profitability
• Develop comprehensive Success Plans and lead Executive/Quarterly Business Reviews, connecting solution usage to measurable business outcomes.
• Advocate for client needs within RDS, channeling customer insights into product development, delivery improvements, and roadmap prioritization.
• Implement data-driven approaches to customer health monitoring, leverage usage metrics, engagement indicators, and risk signals to proactively manage relationships
 About Swiss Re Risk Data Solutions
 RDS Insurance is a central pillar of our strategy, critical to the development of our core activities as well as developing new revenue streams for Swiss Re. We offer a comprehensive suite of services; from risk consulting and software solutions to data analytics and SaaS platforms, we help clients stay competitive in an evolving industry. Through our global expertise and specialist tools, clients gain agility and resilience in an ever-changing marketplace.

About You
 You thrive at the intersection of client relationships, technical solutions, and business outcomes. Your approach combines commercial instinct with analytical thinking, allowing you to translate complex risk concepts into tangible value for clients.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements;
 • Proven experience in Customer Success, Client Delivery, Consulting or Solutions Sales in data-driven or insurance-related environments
• Strong exposure to property and/or natural catastrophe risk, underwriting, analytics, or related client use cases
• Demonstrated ability to work effectively with Underwriting and Key Account Management teams in a reinsurance context
• Experience managing senior client stakeholders and leading outcome-focused discussions
 Additional desirable qualifications:
 • Experience with catastrophe modelling tools or risk analytics platforms
• Background in property underwriting, portfolio management, or related disciplines
• Experience in solution-oriented sales or consultative client engagement models
• Ability to navigate matrix organizations and influence without direct authority
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office two to three days per week on average.

 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role
 • the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
 In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about leveraging data analytics to drive smarter risk management? If youthrive at the intersection of technology and business, and love turning complex data intomeaningful insights — this could be the role for you. Join a forward-thinking global organizationwhere your analytical expertise will directly shape how we identify, assess, and mitigateoperational risks. Based in Bangalore, India, this is your opportunity to make a real impact usingcutting-edge technology and innovative thinking.
 About the Role:
 As an Operational Risk Data Analyst, you'll sit at the exciting crossroads of risk management andtechnology. You'll be translating complex business requirements into practical, data-drivensolutions that enhance our operational risk framework. From designing powerful dashboards tooptimizing workflows in Palantir Foundry, your work will be visible, valued, and impactful — withstakeholders across the globe relying on the solutions you build.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Design and develop impactful dashboards and data visualizations that transform complexrisk data into clear, actionable insights

• Implement and optimize workflows within the Palantir Foundry application suite tostreamline operational risk processes

• Translate business requirements into end-to-end technical solutions using existingOperational Risk Management (ORM) applications

• Leverage SQL, Python, and data visualization tools to create efficient and scalable reportingmechanisms

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand diverse needs and deliver tailored,high-quality solutions

• Automate routine processes using robotic process automation to drive efficiency andreduce manual effort

• Maintain and enhance existing applications and solutions to ensure continuedeffectiveness and relevance

• Analyze operational risk data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvementacross the organization
 About the Team:
 You'll be joining the Operational Risk Management Governance team within Group Functions RiskManagement (GFRM) — a collaborative, innovative, and purpose-driven team dedicated toexcellence in risk management. The team is focused on advancing operational risk activities inline with a clearly defined vision, applying technology and analytics expertise to enhance both theeffectiveness and efficiency of operational risk management across the organization. Together,the team develops forward-looking solutions that strengthen the risk management framework anddrive meaningful change at a global scale. If you enjoy working in an environment that valuescuriosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement, you'll feel right at home here.
 About You:
 You're a tech-savvy problem solver who thrives on turning complex business challenges intoelegant technical solutions. You have a natural curiosity about data and a talent for uncoveringpatterns and insights that others might miss. Your strong communication skills allow you tobridge the gap between technical concepts and business needs, making you a trusted andeffective collaborator across departments and cultures. You bring both attention to detail and big-picture thinking — and you're energized by working in a fast-paced, global environment.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

• 5+ years of relevant work experience in data analytics, risk management, or a relateddiscipline

• Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and delivering dashboards and/ordeveloping workflows within the Palantir Foundry application suite (including CodeWorkbook, Code Repositories, Workshop, and Ontology Manager)

• Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (e.g., Python)

• Experience with reporting and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau)

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with robotic process automation (RPA)

• Understanding of enterprise risk management concepts and frameworks

• Experience working in the financial services or insurance industry

• Knowledge of data governance and data quality principles

• Ability to prioritize multiple topics simultaneously and switch fluidly between detailedanalytics and big-picture thinking

• Experience working in multicultural, global environments
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office atleast three days per week.
