jobs.description:
Are you a people-first leader who thrives at the intersection of operational excellence and business impact? Do you get energized by building high-performing teams, solving complex problems, and driving meaningful process improvements? If so, this is your opportunity to lead a critical function at the heart of a global reinsurance powerhouse.

About the Role
 As Sales Operations Manager , you will lead the North America Sales Operations team, a function that sits at the very center of how the business operates and grows. You will be accountable for ensuring the seamless execution of treaty onboarding, data quality management, operational controls, and continuous improvement initiatives across the region. This is a high-visibility leadership role where you will partner with stakeholders across Client Markets, Treaty Administration, Finance, Valuation, and global Operations to deliver operational excellence at scale.
 This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain the status quo, it's for someone who wants to shape it.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Sales Operations team, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and exceptional client service

• Drive cross-training initiatives to build team resilience and ensure business continuity across shifting priorities

• Oversee end-to-end customer onboarding and operational support activities, ensuring service levels, quality standards, and operational objectives are consistently met

• Manage team workload and capacity effectively, adapting to volume fluctuations and evolving business priorities with agility

• Maintain robust operational controls and data quality standards , monitoring KPIs and operational metrics to ensure accuracy, integrity, and compliance

• Support audit, compliance, and governance requirements , serving as a key operational point of contact for escalations and risk management

• Identify and lead process improvement initiatives that simplify, standardize, and automate workflows — improving efficiency, scalability, and the overall stakeholder experience

• Partner with technology and business teams to implement operational enhancements and drive digital transformation within the function

• Build and sustain strong relationships with internal business partners and leadership, communicating operational performance, priorities, and risks with clarity and confidence

About the Team
 Sales Operations sits at the center of the business, enabling client markets to focus on winning and growing client relationships while we ensure the operational foundation is accurate, efficient, and compliant. We support the full deal lifecycle, from origination through execution, by partnering closely with cross-functional teams to manage processes, systems, data quality, KPIs, and controls.
 Our culture is collaborative, detail-driven, and service-oriented: we value accountability, continuous improvement, and strong partnerships. We take pride in bringing clarity, structure, and reliability to a fast-moving commercial environment and we're always looking for ways to do it better. Team members play a meaningful role in shaping how the business operates, making this a place where your contributions are visible and your impact is real.

About You
 You are a seasoned operations leader who brings both strategic thinking and hands-on execution to everything you do. You know how to inspire a team, navigate complexity, and build the kind of operational infrastructure that lets a business scale with confidence. You communicate with clarity, lead with empathy, and never lose sight of the details that matter.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 7+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Operations, Financial Services, Insurance, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of operational excellence

• 3+ years of people leadership experience , with proven success building, coaching, and developing high-performing teams

• Strong expertise in data quality management and operational controls , including experience supporting audit, compliance, and governance requirements

• Demonstrated ability to lead process improvement initiatives , including simplification, standardization, and automation of complex operational workflows

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant discipline
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in the reinsurance or life & health insurance industry, with familiarity of treaty administration and deal lifecycle management

• Exposure to operational technology platforms and digital transformation initiatives within a financial services or insurance context

• Experience working in a multi-country or global operating model , navigating cross-functional and cross-cultural stakeholder environments

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills , with the ability to translate data and metrics into actionable operational insights

• Excellent communication and influencing skills , with a track record of building trusted relationships with senior business partners and leadership teams

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with multiple competing priorities and a strong bias for action

This role will be located in our Toronto office. Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework, relocation assistance or visa sponsorship.

The base salary hiring range for this existing position located in Toronto is CAD $136,000 to $166,000. The specific base salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

jobs.description:
Locations:
Hamburg, DE |
Munich, DE |
Frankfurt, DE

Sie möchten komplexe industrielle Risiken nicht nur bewerten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten? Sie suchen eine Rolle mit echtem Einfluss, internationalem Umfeld und direktem Kundenkontakt? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig – werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und treiben Sie gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Industrieversicherung voran.
 Über die Rolle
 In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position verbinden Sie fundierte Underwriting-Expertise mit aktiver Marktbearbeitung. Sie arbeiten eng mit Kunden und Maklern zusammen, entwickeln individuelle Versicherungslösungen und tragen maßgeblich zur Profitabilität und strategischen Weiterentwicklung unseres Portfolios bei. Diese Rolle bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, eigenverantwortlich zu handeln, Ihre Netzwerke auszubauen und in einem dynamischen, internationalen Umfeld echten Mehrwert zu schaffen.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Eigenverantwortliches Underwriting für Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft im Rahmen definierter Zeichnungsrichtlinien und Vollmachten

• Analyse und Bewertung von Sach- und Ertragsausfallrisiken sowie Erstellung von Angeboten und Strukturierung komplexer Versicherungsprogramme

• Aktive Portfolioentwicklung durch Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen und Identifikation neuer Geschäftspotenziale

• Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger, langfristiger Beziehungen zu Kunden und Maklern

• Mitwirkung an Markt- und Portfoliostrategien unter Berücksichtigung aktueller Trends und Entwicklungen

• Enge Teamzusammenarbeit im Team sowie bereichsübergreifender Wissensaustausch

• Mitarbeit in Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte, Prozesse und Services
 Über das Team
 Unser Team steht für konsequent ergebnisorientiertes Underwriting, kombiniert mit einer ausgeprägten Kunden- und Marktorientierung. Langfristige Partnerschaften mit Kunden und Maklern in Deutschland und Österreich sowie unsere etablierte Marke bilden die Grundlage unseres Erfolgs. Wir setzen auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit – und liefern unseren Kunden dabei schnelle, klare und wirkungsvolle Versicherungslösungen. In unserem Team finden Sie ein offenes, kollegiales Umfeld, in dem Fachwissen geteilt und Eigeninitiative geschätzt wird.
 Über Sie
 Sie verbinden analytische Stärke mit unternehmerischem Denken und haben Freude daran, komplexe Risiken zu verstehen, zu strukturieren und daraus überzeugende Lösungen zu entwickeln. Sie treten sicher auf, verhandeln überzeugend und bauen tragfähige, langfristige Beziehungen auf. Dabei arbeiten Sie sowohl eigenständig als auch gerne im Team – strukturiert, leistungsbereit und mit einem klaren Blick für das Wesentliche.

Folgende Qualifikationen und Erfahrungen bringen Sie mit:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft) oder eine versicherungsspezifische Ausbildung (z. B. Versicherungskaufmann/-frau, Fachwirt/-in) bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mindestens 5–10 Jahre) im deutschen Industrieversicherungsmarkt, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt im Property-Underwriting sowie Erfahrung in der Führung von internationalen Versicherungsprogrammen

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Analyse und Bewertung von Sach- und Ertragsausfallrisiken

• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Naturgefahren sowie Man-Made-Risiken und Schadenmanagement

Das wäre zusätzlich von Vorteil:

• Erfahrung in den Segmenten Real Estate und/oder Onshore Energy

• Etabliertes Netzwerk im deutschen Versicherungsmarkt

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten

• Teamorientierte, strukturierte und leistungsbereite Arbeitsweise

• Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Geschäftsreisen
 Für Deutschland liegt das Grundgehalt für diese Position zwischen 101.000 EUR und 169.000 EUR für eine Vollzeitbeschäftigung.
 Das konkrete Gehaltsangebot berücksichtigt:

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Verantwortung der Position

• Das Profil der Bewerberin bzw. des Bewerbers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung
 Sollten Sie nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen oder diese deutlich übertreffen, kann das angebotene Gehalt unter oder über dem ausgeschriebenen Bereich liegen. Zusätzlich zum Grundgehalt können Sie Anspruch auf weitere Vergütungsbestandteile und Benefits haben, darunter eine attraktive leistungsbezogene Jahresprämie.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.description:
About the Role
 We are looking for an ambitious individual who thrives working in a dynamically changing international environment to join us as a Compliance Officer for our P&C and L&H reinsurance business across EMEA, with a specific focus on the United Kingdom. The role includes acting as SMF 16 ensuring adherence to applicable UK regulatory requirements and industry standards.
 The role reflects a broad and hands-on compliance remit, with responsibilities spanning regulatory oversight, advisory, governance, and project work. Typical activities include:

• Acting as the FCA-approved SMF16 Compliance Officer for the UK entity, with accountability under the SMCR framework, including Fitness & Propriety, Conduct Rules, and senior manager engagement

• Leading and continuously enhancing the compliance framework aligned with relevant external and internal requirements and manage

• Providing trusted advisory support on key compliance risks including conduct risk, financial crime, and data protection across Reinsurance within EMEA

• Monitoring and assessing regulatory developments in the UK and EMEA and managing regulatory relationships, including regulatory consultations, filings, and supervisory interactions

• Provide assurance to management regarding the business' implementation of Compliance Risk Frameworks through oversight of business activities and support of assurance activities.

• Delivering compliance reporting, including contributing to the Group Board reporting and local committee engagement and supporting governance and senior leadership

• Performing Compliance Risk Assessments and delivering training

• Collaborating with global compliance teams and contributing to broader EMEA and global compliance strategy and transformation initiatives
 About the Team
 This is an exciting opportunity to be a crucial member of the P&C & L&H Reinsurance EMEA Compliance team, as part of a global team. You will report to the Head Compliance P&C & L&H Reinsurance EMEA. The team is internal business client facing with an international footprint and diversity of team members. We provide end-to-end guidance on key Compliance Risks including Anti-Money Laundering, International Trade Sanctions, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Data Protection, Conduct Risk, and others. Our clients are diverse and are committed to delivering value and innovative services and products in a compliant manner. We are a diverse team based in Zurich, Munich, Cape Town, Luxemburg, Bratislava and London.
 About You
 You are an experienced Legal, Compliance or Risk professional with experience in carrying out regulatory monitoring activities. You believe in leadership from every seat and will be able to demonstrate that in your day-to-day endeavors. Attention to detail is key, and your ability to prioritize tasks and work collaboratively with stakeholders at all levels is critical to success in this role.
 We would like you to have:

• University degree or equivalent qualification

• Solid experience in compliance, risk or governance related roles with experience in the UK market

• Good understanding of (re)-insurance regulatory requirements

• Solid understanding of compliance risks, particularly anti-money laundering, international trade controls, conduct and data protection

• Ability to take ownership and prioritise and work in a dynamic and changing matrix environment

• Strong communication, interpersonal and presentation skills

• Fluent in English, other languages a plus.
 Behaviours
 We expect that you always act with integrity, regardless of the situation. We are looking for a great teammate that collaborates well but still takes ownership for your own work by effectively prioritising and executing your tasks. This is a fast-paced role where pragmatic thinking, effective time management and the ability to multi-task are key. By demonstrating innovation and the drive for continuous improvement, there are many opportunities to add value to our team!
 Compensation & Work Model
 The base salary range for this position is between 76,000 GBP and 114,000 GBP (full time equivalent). The specific salary offered considers:

•
• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

Hybrid working model with a minimum of three days per week in the office
 #Li-Hybrid
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.description:
Are you a skilled lawyer with a passion for complex, innovative reinsurance and alternative capital transactions? Do you thrive in a collaborative, international environment where your legal expertise shapes real commercial outcomes? If so, this could be the role for you.
 About the Role
 This is a rare opportunity to join Swiss Re's Global Transactions & Legal Governance Team in a truly global legal role. As Legal Counsel, you will be at the heart of structuring, negotiating, and executing some of the most complex and strategically important reinsurance and alternative capital transactions in the market — from insurance-linked securities and collateralised solutions to legacy portfolio transactions and capital management structures.
 You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with structurers, underwriters, actuaries, and client managers, bringing your legal expertise to bear on transactions that matter — while ensuring robust governance, compliance, and risk management standards are upheld.
 Key Responsibilities:
 • Provide expert legal advice on complex reinsurance and alternative capital transactions, including insurance-linked securities, structured reinsurance, retrocession, collateralised solutions, and legacy portfolio transactions
 • Review, draft, and negotiate contracts and legal documents across all phases of the transaction lifecycle — from structuring through to execution and implementation
 • Conduct legal and regulatory due diligence, analysing and advising on legal and regulatory matters as they apply to Swiss Re's transaction activities across global markets
 • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across Legal, Tax, Accounting, Finance, Risk, and Compliance to support seamless transaction execution
 • Contribute to the development of Swiss Re's transaction frameworks, legal templates, negotiation strategies, and best practices across business units
 • Support transaction governance processes, including preparation of approval materials, identification of legal and regulatory risks, and escalation of material issues to senior management
 • Monitor legal and regulatory trends affecting relevant business areas and proactively advise internal stakeholders on emerging developments
 • Instruct and manage outside counsel as needed, ensuring quality and cost-effectiveness
 • Facilitate international coordination of legal and regulatory issues, helping to maintain and adapt Swiss Re's legal and regulatory frameworks
 • Deliver internal presentations and training on legal topics with a focus on transactions, sharing knowledge across the organisation
 • Act as a trusted advisor to structurers, underwriters, and other business stakeholders throughout the full transaction lifecycle
 • Provide timely and concise reporting on legal matters, including progress, risks, and outcomes, to senior management
 About the Team
 This role sits within the P&C & L&H Transactions Legal Team, which forms part of the broader Global Transactions & Legal Governance Team at Swiss Re. The team provides specialist legal support on complex Property & Casualty, Life & Health, and retrocession transactions across Swiss Re's global business.
 Working at the intersection of legal expertise and commercial strategy, the team partners closely with structurers, underwriters, capital partners, and a wide range of internal stakeholders to deliver innovative risk transfer solutions — while maintaining the highest standards of governance and risk management. The team plays a central role in supporting Swiss Re's capital management activities and alternative capital initiatives.
 This is a genuinely collaborative, international team that operates across jurisdictions and functions, bringing together diverse perspectives and deep specialist knowledge. The team is committed to fostering an inclusive environment that reflects Swiss Re's broader values — embracing diversity of age, background, nationality, gender identity, experience, and perspective at every level.
 About You
 You are a commercially minded, solutions-oriented lawyer who combines strong technical legal skills with the ability to build trusted relationships across a complex, international organisation. You bring intellectual curiosity, sound judgement, and a genuine enthusiasm for working on sophisticated, high-impact transactions. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and contributing to a team that values collaboration, integrity, and continuous learning.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:
 • Fully qualified lawyer (bar exam) in the UK or Switzerland (preferred), or equivalent qualification in another relevant jurisdiction
 • Minimum five years of post-qualification experience, ideally gained in a law firm or in-house in the (re)insurance industry, with demonstrable expertise in (re)insurance law, transactions, regulations, and a working understanding of structured finance and collateral structures
 • Experience with regulatory and licensing topics in cross-border scenarios, with the ability to analyse and advise on complex multi-jurisdictional legal and regulatory matters
 • Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to convey legal and compliance concepts clearly and concisely to a range of stakeholders
 • Fluency in English (written and spoken); additional language skills are a plus
 These are additional nice to haves:
 • Experience with insurance-linked securities, alternative capital structures, or legacy portfolio transactions
 • Familiarity with collateralised reinsurance structures and capital management transactions
 • Exposure to international coordination of legal and regulatory matters across multiple jurisdictions
 • Experience instructing and managing external counsel
 • A track record of contributing to the development of legal frameworks, templates, or best practices in a complex organisation
 • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across diverse, cross-functional, and international teams
 • A proactive, self-reflective approach — someone who openly shares their thinking, is receptive to constructive challenge, and is committed to continuous professional development
 • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple matters and deadlines independently, with a measured appetite for risk and a focus on delivering workable, pragmatic solutions
 Salary Information
 For London, the base salary range for this position is between GBP 94,000 and GBP 140,000 for a full-time role. The specific salary offered considers:
 • The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role
 • The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. jobs.description:
Locations:
New York, NY, US |
Kansas City, MO, US |
Alpharetta, GA, US

Casualty, Property & Directors and Officers Liability
 Locations: Alpharetta, GA | NYC, NY | Kansas City, MO

Are you a technically skilled commercial underwriter who thrives on complexity, loves diving deep into policy language, and wants to make a real global impact? If you have a passion for multinational insurance programs and a sharp eye for coverage analysis, this could be the role you've been looking for. At Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, we're solving some of the most complex risk challenges in the world — and we want you to be part of it.

About the Role
 Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is seeking an experienced Underwriter to join our International Programs team. In this role, you will be at the heart of multinational insurance operations — providing critical underwriting expertise, policy wording guidance, and regulatory oversight for U.S. local placements that service business produced outside North America. As a reverse-flow underwriter , you'll collaborate with underwriting teams across the globe to evaluate coverage structures, review policy forms and endorsements, assess underwriting exceptions, and deliver technical guidance that directly shapes the quality and consistency of multinational insurance solutions for our clients. This is a high-impact position that blends deep technical expertise with meaningful cross-border collaboration.
 Key responsibilities include:
 Technical Underwriting

• Review and support U.S. local policies, endorsements, and coverage structures for multinational insurance programs

• Evaluate pre-bind exception requests and provide well-reasoned technical underwriting recommendations

• Ensure compliance of local placements with underwriting guidelines, regulatory requirements, and approved program structures

• Provide technical underwriting guidance across a broad range of lines including:

• Commercial General Liability

• Construction Liability

• Automobile Liability

• Employers Liability

• Employee Benefits Liability

• Umbrella and Excess Liability

• Commercial Property

• Directors & Officers Liability (D&O)

• Long-tail and runoff liabilities, where applicable

• Review policy wording and endorsements to ensure alignment with coverage intent and underwriting strategy

• Support multinational placements involving large corporate and middle-market accounts
 International Program Support

• Act as a technical resource for underwriting teams and producing offices outside North America

• Support multinational insurance programs, captive structures, fronting arrangements, and alternative risk transfer solutions

• Utilize Swiss Re systems and tools to monitor and oversee local servicing policies

• Maintain awareness of market developments, regulatory requirements, and emerging risks
 Collaboration and Leadership

• Partner with internal stakeholders across underwriting, operations, claims, legal, compliance, and finance functions

• Participate in broker and client discussions requiring technical underwriting expertise

• Provide training and guidance to underwriting colleagues and producing offices

• Contribute to process improvements, system enhancements, and knowledge management initiatives

About the Team
 The International Programs team is a cornerstone of Swiss Re Corporate Solutions' continued growth and global success. We are a collaborative, high-performing group that sits at the intersection of technology, underwriting expertise, and global servicing — helping multinational clients navigate complexity and manage risk across jurisdictions with confidence. Through our integrated technology platform , expansive global servicing network, and deep underwriting knowledge, we deliver seamless multinational insurance solutions that make a tangible difference for clients worldwide. You'll work closely with colleagues across Underwriting, Operations, Claims, Compliance, Finance, Legal, Contracts & Wording, Product Management, and Integrated Risk Solutions — making every day dynamic and collaborative. This is a team that values curiosity, technical excellence, and a genuine commitment to finding the best solutions for our clients — no matter how complex the challenge.

About You
 You are a detail-oriented, technically strong underwriting professional who brings both analytical rigor and collaborative energy to everything you do. You're comfortable navigating complex coverage structures, engaging confidently with brokers and global colleagues, and making sound underwriting decisions in a fast-paced, multinational environment. You take pride in your technical expertise and are always looking for opportunities to share knowledge and elevate those around you.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3–7 years of commercial underwriting experience

• Successfully passed CPCU 551 (Managing Commercial Property Risk) and CPCU 552 (Managing Commercial Liability Risk)

• Strong technical knowledge of commercial insurance coverages, policy forms, and underwriting principles, with demonstrated ability to:

• Interpret ISO and Swiss Re proprietary policy forms, endorsements, exclusions, and coverage triggers

• Evaluate coverage intent and identify potential gaps or unintended exposures

• Assess how primary, excess, umbrella, and specialty coverages interact within a multinational insurance program

• Evaluate the impact of limits, aggregates, exclusions, attachment points, and coverage triggers on overall program structure

• Hands-on experience reviewing policy wording, endorsements, and complex coverage structures

• Working knowledge across multiple lines: General Liability, Umbrella, Excess Liability, Automobile Liability, Employers Liability, Commercial Property, Directors & Officers Liability, and Construction Liability
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience working with multinational insurance programs, captive structures, or fronting arrangements

• Familiarity with alternative risk transfer solutions and global regulatory environments

• Ability to respond confidently to broker and producing office inquiries regarding policy wording, coverage applicability, and endorsement usage

• Experience providing training, mentoring, or technical guidance to underwriting colleagues

• Proficiency with underwriting systems, tools, and digital platforms

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across global time zones

• Exposure to large corporate and middle-market account underwriting

*** Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 The estimated base salary range for this position is $108,000 to $162,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short- and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

Casualty, Property & Directors and Officers Liability
Locations: Alpharetta, GA | NYC, NY | Kansas City, MO

Are you a technically skilled commercial underwriter who thrives on complexity, loves diving deep into policy language, and wants to make a real global impact? If you have a passion for multinational insurance programs and a sharp eye for coverage analysis, this could be the role you've been looking for. At Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, we're solving some of the most complex risk challenges in the world — and we want you to be part of it.

About the Role
Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is seeking an experienced Underwriter to join our International Programs team. In this role, you will be at the heart of multinational insurance operations — providing critical underwriting expertise, policy wording guidance, and regulatory oversight for U.S. local placements that service business produced outside North America. As a reverse-flow underwriter , you'll collaborate with underwriting teams across the globe to evaluate coverage structures, review policy forms and endorsements, assess underwriting exceptions, and deliver technical guidance that directly shapes the quality and consistency of multinational insurance solutions for our clients. This is a high-impact position that blends deep technical expertise with meaningful cross-border collaboration.
Key responsibilities include:
Technical Underwriting

• Review and support U.S. local policies, endorsements, and coverage structures for multinational insurance programs

• Evaluate pre-bind exception requests and provide well-reasoned technical underwriting recommendations

• Ensure compliance of local placements with underwriting guidelines, regulatory requirements, and approved program structures

• Provide technical underwriting guidance across a broad range of lines including:

• Commercial General Liability

• Construction Liability

• Automobile Liability

• Employers Liability

• Employee Benefits Liability

• Umbrella and Excess Liability

• Commercial Property

• Directors & Officers Liability (D&O)

• Long-tail and runoff liabilities, where applicable

• Review policy wording and endorsements to ensure alignment with coverage intent and underwriting strategy

• Support multinational placements involving large corporate and middle-market accounts
International Program Support

• Act as a technical resource for underwriting teams and producing offices outside North America

• Support multinational insurance programs, captive structures, fronting arrangements, and alternative risk transfer solutions

• Utilize Swiss Re systems and tools to monitor and oversee local servicing policies

• Maintain awareness of market developments, regulatory requirements, and emerging risks
Collaboration and Leadership

• Partner with internal stakeholders across underwriting, operations, claims, legal, compliance, and finance functions

• Participate in broker and client discussions requiring technical underwriting expertise

• Provide training and guidance to underwriting colleagues and producing offices

• Contribute to process improvements, system enhancements, and knowledge management initiatives

About the Team
The International Programs team is a cornerstone of Swiss Re Corporate Solutions' continued growth and global success. We are a collaborative, high-performing group that sits at the intersection of technology, underwriting expertise, and global servicing — helping multinational clients navigate complexity and manage risk across jurisdictions with confidence. Through our integrated technology platform , expansive global servicing network, and deep underwriting knowledge, we deliver seamless multinational insurance solutions that make a tangible difference for clients worldwide. You'll work closely with colleagues across Underwriting, Operations, Claims, Compliance, Finance, Legal, Contracts & Wording, Product Management, and Integrated Risk Solutions — making every day dynamic and collaborative. This is a team that values curiosity, technical excellence, and a genuine commitment to finding the best solutions for our clients — no matter how complex the challenge.

About You
You are a detail-oriented, technically strong underwriting professional who brings both analytical rigor and collaborative energy to everything you do. You're comfortable navigating complex coverage structures, engaging confidently with brokers and global colleagues, and making sound underwriting decisions in a fast-paced, multinational environment. You take pride in your technical expertise and are always looking for opportunities to share knowledge and elevate those around you.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3–7 years of commercial underwriting experience

• Successfully passed CPCU 551 (Managing Commercial Property Risk) and CPCU 552 (Managing Commercial Liability Risk)

• Strong technical knowledge of commercial insurance coverages, policy forms, and underwriting principles, with demonstrated ability to:

• Interpret ISO and Swiss Re proprietary policy forms, endorsements, exclusions, and coverage triggers

• Evaluate coverage intent and identify potential gaps or unintended exposures

• Assess how primary, excess, umbrella, and specialty coverages interact within a multinational insurance program

• Evaluate the impact of limits, aggregates, exclusions, attachment points, and coverage triggers on overall program structure

• Hands-on experience reviewing policy wording, endorsements, and complex coverage structures

• Working knowledge across multiple lines: General Liability, Umbrella, Excess Liability, Automobile Liability, Employers Liability, Commercial Property, Directors & Officers Liability, and Construction Liability
These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience working with multinational insurance programs, captive structures, or fronting arrangements

• Familiarity with alternative risk transfer solutions and global regulatory environments

• Ability to respond confidently to broker and producing office inquiries regarding policy wording, coverage applicability, and endorsement usage

• Experience providing training, mentoring, or technical guidance to underwriting colleagues

• Proficiency with underwriting systems, tools, and digital platforms

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across global time zones

• Exposure to large corporate and middle-market account underwriting

*** Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
The estimated base salary range for this position is $108,000 to $162,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. jobs.description:
Join a team of security and technology professionals and help Swiss Re to fulfil its mission in making the world more resilient. As the Security Awareness Process Manager, you'll support the development of Swiss Re's information security & risk awareness programme, establish a communication plan to get across security awareness topics, and coordinate proprietary trainings to educate employees on the importance of staying safe in the digital world. What's more, you'll be working in a hybrid setup, perfectly balancing work from home and the office premises.

About the team

Group Security & Technology Platforms (GSTP) brings together security, technology platforms and operational resilience to provide secure, reliable and scalable foundations for Swiss Re's business. The function ensures that security, resilience and engineering quality are embedded by design into how technology is built, operated and evolved across the organisation.

The Strategy & Operations team – which you will be a direct part of – drives GSTP's overall strategy and operations, acting as a hub for its continuous improvement with a strong focus on culture, ambition and mandate.

We're looking for a resourceful individual skilled in communications and reporting, preferably with an information security background – one who will embody the value of security culture and awareness as a whole.

In your role, you will…

• Support the development of Swiss Re's security & risk awareness programme

• Coordinate, prepare, and roll out campaigns, trainings and awareness-related activities in close coordination with other departments to increase security awareness for all Swiss Re employees

• Establish annual change and communication plan for security awareness topics and support the rollout of communication posts and promotions

• Support the execution of the Phishing Awareness programme, evaluate the results and publish articles on the results and/or awareness measures of the simulated phishing attack simulations

• Assist in periodic updating of all Security trainings and regularly review all targeted security trainings in coordination with subject-matter experts

• Support the rollouts and communications surrounding targeted security trainings for specific staff and further develop the security training programme with business authorities

• Manage and ensure regular monitoring and metrics reporting on awareness topics

• Support your team with ad-hoc operational tasks

• Be someone who believes in continuous innovation, is curious and steadfast in finding a better way every day

Your qualifications

Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of our requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are curious about the world of teaching employees about cyber security's importance and raising their awareness, we'll be more than happy to meet you!

• What we need from you

• 2-4 years of experience in cyber security or related fields

• Passion, drive, and a belief in the value of security culture as an enabler of business performance

• Understanding and basic knowledge of cyber security concepts and practices

• Experience with Microsoft Office and the ability to build spreadsheets and reports

• Experience in Marketing/Communication or related fields – preferably with a strong focus on IT security or equivalent background

• Must have experience with different methods of communications, such as social media, blogging, videos, online messaging, printed materials, hosted & virtual events, etc.

• Keeping the oversight and monitoring of the different cyber security related projects, campaigns and initiatives

• Project management experience and the ability to plan and manage an organisation-wide security & risk awareness programme

• Ability to take the initiative, get in touch, and coordinate with stakeholders across different departments in the company – collaboration and partnering with others are a key factor to success!

• Nice-to-have

• Experience in developing and handling eLearning courses via LMS (learning management system) and handling phishing simulation platforms

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,800 and EUR 4,600 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

jobs.description:
Are you a skilled lawyer with a passion for complex, innovative reinsurance and alternative capital transactions? Do you thrive in a collaborative, international environment where your legal expertise shapes real commercial outcomes? If so, this could be the role for you.
 About the Role
 This is a rare opportunity to join Swiss Re's Global Transactions & Legal Governance Team in a truly global legal role. As Legal Counsel, you will be at the heart of structuring, negotiating, and executing some of the most complex and strategically important reinsurance and alternative capital transactions in the market — from insurance-linked securities and collateralised solutions to legacy portfolio transactions and capital management structures.
 You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with structurers, underwriters, actuaries, and client managers, bringing your legal expertise to bear on transactions that matter — while ensuring robust governance, compliance, and risk management standards are upheld.
 Key Responsibilities:
 • Provide expert legal advice on complex reinsurance and alternative capital transactions, including insurance-linked securities, structured reinsurance, retrocession, collateralised solutions, and legacy portfolio transactions
 • Review, draft, and negotiate contracts and legal documents across all phases of the transaction lifecycle — from structuring through to execution and implementation
 • Conduct legal and regulatory due diligence, analysing and advising on legal and regulatory matters as they apply to Swiss Re's transaction activities across global markets
 • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across Legal, Tax, Accounting, Finance, Risk, and Compliance to support seamless transaction execution
 • Contribute to the development of Swiss Re's transaction frameworks, legal templates, negotiation strategies, and best practices across business units
 • Support transaction governance processes, including preparation of approval materials, identification of legal and regulatory risks, and escalation of material issues to senior management
 • Monitor legal and regulatory trends affecting relevant business areas and proactively advise internal stakeholders on emerging developments
 • Instruct and manage outside counsel as needed, ensuring quality and cost-effectiveness
 • Facilitate international coordination of legal and regulatory issues, helping to maintain and adapt Swiss Re's legal and regulatory frameworks
 • Deliver internal presentations and training on legal topics with a focus on transactions, sharing knowledge across the organisation
 • Act as a trusted advisor to structurers, underwriters, and other business stakeholders throughout the full transaction lifecycle
 • Provide timely and concise reporting on legal matters, including progress, risks, and outcomes, to senior management
 About the Team
 This role sits within the P&C & L&H Transactions Legal Team, which forms part of the broader Global Transactions & Legal Governance Team at Swiss Re. The team provides specialist legal support on complex Property & Casualty, Life & Health, and retrocession transactions across Swiss Re's global business.
 Working at the intersection of legal expertise and commercial strategy, the team partners closely with structurers, underwriters, capital partners, and a wide range of internal stakeholders to deliver innovative risk transfer solutions — while maintaining the highest standards of governance and risk management. The team plays a central role in supporting Swiss Re's capital management activities and alternative capital initiatives.
 This is a genuinely collaborative, international team that operates across jurisdictions and functions, bringing together diverse perspectives and deep specialist knowledge. Our team thrives on intellectual curiosity, cross-functional collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence — and we're growing.

You are as comfortable presenting to C-suite partners as you are diving into the technical details of a multi-jurisdictional fronting arrangement. You bring a collaborative spirit, a broad industry network, and an entrepreneurial mindset that drives you to challenge the status quo and pursue new business opportunities with energy and purpose.

 • Significant and varied experience in the direct insurance market, whether in Underwriting, Risk Management, or Insurance Marketing, complemented by hands-on experience in structuring and executing non-standard risk transfer solutions
 • Proven ability to engage and do business at the C-suite level, with strong communication and negotiation skills across diverse, multicultural, and cross-functional environments

 • Curiosity and an open, innovative mindset — you question current paradigms, generate new insights, and are passionate about exploring and pursuing business ideas
 • Outstanding interpersonal and networking skills, with the ability to build meaningful professional relationships at all levels of an organization and across functional areas
 • Experience working in a multi-cultural, international environment across multiple time zones and regulatory frameworks
 • Familiarity with captive insurance structures, including rent-a-captive, pure captive, and protected cell arrangements

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer (Hybrid setup)
jobs.description:
Our engineering team is growing, and we are looking for a Full-stack Software Engineer who will play a pivotal role in the development of our product and in speeding up the IT delivery growth in iptiQ. We promise you the freedom and space you need to be creative, show off your skills, and grow your expertise. This is an outstanding chance to become part of our growing team and deliver solutions in large scaling distributed event driven system .
 Our Technology Stack
 Our cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS platform runs on AWS. We use Kotlin, Java, SpringBoot, Docker, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL on the backend, and ReactJS and TypeScript on the frontend. Our continuous delivery pipeline leverages GitLab. We are using Prometheus, ElasticSearch, Kibana and Grafana as our logging and monitoring stack.
 Our mission
 iptiQ is not just an insurance company; we are at the forefront of integrating technology into the life and health insurance space. We employ people with diverse technical backgrounds who are eager to solve some of the industry's most complex problems and make a lasting impact on our customers globally. At iptiQ, you'll not only be a part of transforming the insurance industry but also work on large-scale applications and new platforms that redefine how insurance products are developed and delivered. From revolutionizing underwriting processes to creating user-centric digital health tools, our engineers are at the heart of iptiQ's mission to transform the world of insurance.
 About the Role
 In your role as a software engineer, you will participate in the development of different technical areas like frontend orchestration of iptiQ web solutions - using modern web technologies (ReactJS, Redux, MaterialUI, JSS, GraphQL) and highly scalable microservices written in Java and Kotlin, owning the code-base and following best coding practices. You will actively engage in driving application quality along with test automation engineers, continuously building, inspecting and shaping up the product throughout the entire lifecycle. Last but not least, you will use your mentoring skills, supporting junior software engineers and sharing your knowhow with other tech-savvy team members. You'll have the flexibility to move between teams and projects, growing with our dynamic industry and contributing to an ecosystem that's constantly evolving. We value versatility and leadership, and we rely on our engineers to be proactive and enthusiastic in tackling new challenges across the tech spectrum.
 About the Team
 Our tech team works with the latest enterprise technology and tools, pushing the boundaries with every new project. We’re the software engineering engine behind a fast-growing risk-tech start-up that helps millions of end users access affordable and easy to buy life insurance.
 You will join the team that is responsible for the company Web, Public API and Document rendering solutions, an international team distributed between Netherlands, Spain and Slovakia. The team member are friendly, high-skilled professionals with a strong team-player culture.
 About You

• As member of a team with a strong collaboration culture, you are a team-player professional and a confident communicator who can engage with colleagues in person, in writing and online meetings

• Entrepreneurial mindsets

• Highly motivated to learn and adapt in different areas of software engineering

• Passionate about improving developer experience and software quality

• Eager to take on responsibility and result oriented

• Role model who values mutual support and success

• Demonstrated track record of proficiency in several elements of our technology stack (Kotlin, Java, SpringBoot, Docker, Kubernetes, Apache, Kafka, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Optional: ReactJS and TypeScript) is expected.
 You will

• Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code

• Participate in designing and developing new features and products that align with user needs and business goals.

• Work closely with team members, including product managers, designers, and other engineers, to ensure a cohesive development process and product outcome.

• Identify system problems, debug issues, and implement fixes promptly to ensure continuous product functionality

• Mentor junior team members
 Essentials:

• Bachelor´s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equicalent is a must

• Experience in ReactJS and JavaScript front-end frameworks

• Solid understanding wand proficiency with backend microservice development in JAVA/Kotlin

• Experience in node.js

• Good sense of styling principles and experience with either CSS/SCSS, JSS, HTML or styled components.

• High coding standards, comfortable with using unit testing frameworks such as: React Testing Library, Jest).

• Understanding of user interface, client / server integrations concepts
 N ice to h ave:

• Docker and Kubernetes experience

• Experience with authentication principles such as OAuth2

• Experience with test-driven-development

• Familiarity with microservice architecture, API, solution design, and overall development process

• Familiarity with GraphQL and Back-end for Front-end (BFF) technology/concepts

• Experience with GitLab, Cloudflare, CI/CD pipeline
 What we offer

• A supportive and collaborative team environment

• Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies

• Professional growth and learning opportunities

• Flexible working time
 We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.

For Spain the base salary range for this position is between EUR 42,000 and EUR 70,000 per year (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
 In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.
 About iptiQ
 At iptiQ, we partner with established brands around the world to create impactful digital insurance solutions. We make it easier for consumers to buy the insurance they need from the brands they trust. We provide life and non-life insurance through our end-to-end digital platform and build multi-channel customer experiences.

What we offer our employees is outstanding. Hybrid working in offices across the world, phenomenal learning & career opportunities and a culture that encourages new perspectives to challenge conventions and come up with innovative solutions. We believe in the power of inclusion. Drawing on our employees' broad range of perspectives, life experiences and backgrounds stimulates creativity and gives us a competitive edge. iptiQ embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive regardless of their age, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, physical or mental ability, or other characteristic and can be their authentic self. Ignite your curiosity to shape digital insurance.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

iptiQ is part of Swiss Re, one of the world’s leading providers of re/insurance and risk transfer solutions. This means we’re backed by Swiss Re’s capital strength and more than 150 years of risk knowledge. Through our partnerships, we contribute to Swiss Re’s vision to make the world more resilient.

 Our Technology Stack

We use Kotlin, Java, SpringBoot, Docker, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL on the backend, and ReactJS and TypeScript on the frontend. Our continuous delivery pipeline leverages GitLab. We are using Prometheus, ElasticSearch, Kibana and Grafana as our logging and monitoring stack.
 Our mission

We employ people with diverse technical backgrounds who are eager to solve some of the industry's most complex problems and make a lasting impact on our customers globally. At iptiQ, you'll not only be a part of transforming the insurance industry but also work on large-scale applications and new platforms that redefine how insurance products are developed and delivered. From revolutionizing underwriting processes to creating user-centric digital health tools, our engineers are at the heart of iptiQ's mission to transform the world of insurance.

Last but not least, you will use your mentoring skills, supporting junior software engineers and sharing your knowhow with other tech-savvy team members. You'll have the flexibility to move between teams and projects, growing with our dynamic industry and contributing to an ecosystem that's constantly evolving. We value versatility and leadership, and we rely on our engineers to be proactive and enthusiastic in tackling new challenges across the tech spectrum.

titleByLocale.de: Head Mortality Pricing and Portfolio Management - L&H UK & Ireland (Hybrid, 80-100% FTE)
titleByLocale.fr: Prix de la mortalité en tête et gestion de portefeuille - L&H UK & Ireland (Hybrid, 80-100% ETP)

jobs.description:
About the Role
 In this high-impact, client-facing role, you will play a leading role in shaping reinsurance solutions across the UK & Ireland protection market. You will apply your technical actuarial and modelling expertise across new business pricing, portfolio monitoring, and strategic initiatives in the UK&I market as well as working closely with clients and senior colleagues across Swiss Re’s global network.
 The role offers significant commercial exposure, alongside direct engagement with senior stakeholders across the business, providing a platform to influence pricing decisions, portfolio performance, and market strategy. You will also represent Swiss Re externally, contributing to the firm’s market presence through client interactions and industry events.
 This is a line management role with three direct reports.
 Main activities:

• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients’ pricing and reinsurance teams, acting as a trusted partner across new business and portfolio monitoring matters.

• Lead the development and management of Terms of Trade for UK & Ireland, Life & Health protection products, primarily across individual and group mortality.

• Own the development of pricing assumptions, ensuring they are robust, evidence-based, and aligned with portfolio experience and market strategy.

• Lead pricing of traditional reinsurance tenders across new and established products, taking ownership of recommendations and associated sign-off within agreed authority.

• Work with clients on pricing and product development opportunities, providing commercial insight and solutions.

• Shared accountability for the U.K.&I in-force portfolio, including rate reviews, recaptures, benefit changes, and broader optimisation actions.

• Monitor mortality portfolio performance and deliver clear management reporting to senior stakeholders, highlighting key risks and opportunities.

• Represent the Market Unit as local mortality portfolio owner within Swiss Re's global forum, contributing to pricing, portfolio, and market strategy.

• Lead and develop a small team, ensuring high-quality delivery and a strong performance culture.
 About the Team
 Our London-based Life & Health pricing team delivers reinsurance pricing across a wide range of products in the UK & Ireland insurance markets, alongside in-force portfolio management and performance monitoring activities. We work closely with colleagues across client management, underwriting, claims and reporting teams, ensuring a collaborative and integrated approach.
 Our team is diverse, driven, and characterised by a strong sense of community. We tackle complex and challenging work with a shared commitment to high standards, maintaining a culture that is curious, supportive, and encourages continuous learning.
 About You

• Qualified actuary (FIA/FFA/FSA or equivalent) with several years’ post-qualification experience.

• Strong understanding of Life & Health (re)insurance markets, products, and trends, with proven mortality pricing experience (experience across other lines is advantageous).

• In-depth knowledge of mortality risk, modelling and analysis, including mortality improvement concepts and frameworks.

• Excellent grounding in relevant statistical and actuarial modelling techniques.

jobs.description:
About the Role
 The Technical Accounting Analyst I is an entry-level role designed for colleagues who are early in their accounting career and ready to build expertise in reinsurance accounting. You will focus on mastering key accounting processes, ensuring high data quality, supporting portfolio handling, and developing independence in daily tasks as your experience grows.
 Key Responsibilities
 Core Technical Responsibilities:

• Perform exception-based handling of accounts with strong focus on data quality and value creation.

• Execute technical verification of accounts within the company’s validation framework and contract wording.

• Conduct account processing according to established guidelines and processes, including handling escalations as needed.

• Manage balance settlement with external clients according to reinsurance terms and agreements.

• Handle cash flow management including timely collection of Accounts Receivable and monitoring of portfolio financials.

• Ensure all financial transactions/payments adhere to processes, the quality management framework and key internal controls.

• Perform regular checks and analysis of client policy and financial files, identifying discrepancies and proactively resolving issues.

• Handle internal/external client communication for assigned accounts.

• Guide peers on reinsurance accounting matters when required.

• Support portfolio work, provide authorizations/escalations of financial transactions and payments according to authority matrix.
 About You

• Post-secondary degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and comfort working with numbers.

• Good verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Proactive and agile team player with a willingness to learn and grow.

• Ability to manage assigned workload and deliver high-quality results on time.

• Solid MS Excel proficiency; Power BI is an advantage.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.

• Proactive, adaptable, and curious mindset with the ability to learn new tools and processes quickly.
 Nice to Have

• Experience in (re)insurance, finance operations, accounting, or technical accounting.

• Understanding of treaty structures, cedent/broker workflows, and reinsurance data processes.

• Second language is an advantage to have.
 This is temporary maternity cover role.

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​

jobs.description:
About the Role
 We are looking for a candidate with a strong academic record and industry experience in natural catastrophe and man-made risk modelling and knowledge in (Re)insurance for our Underwriting advisory Team at Bangalore.
 You will support costing of Facultative cessions. You are expected to be proficient in Man-made and Nat-cat modeling and hold good knowledge of re/insurance market. We are also looking for someone who has a commercial mindset and strong collaboration skills with dedication and eagerness to learn.
 About Team
 The Bangalore (BLR) Facultative Team is a strategic offshore advisory hub responsible for providing facultative underwriting support to Property line of business. The team will be working closely with the overseas facultative desk underwriters to provide modeling and costing support on North America property risks.
 You get in-depth exposure to Swiss Re’s modelling and costing practices, proprietary risk model platforms, costing tools as well as an opportunity to work with Swiss Re's overseas underwriters. In addition to your regular responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to contribute to various projects of strategic importance to Swiss Re Group specifically for North America region.
 Provide high quality modelling and costing support to Swiss Re North America underwriting desks which will include but not limited to

• You will support Facultative renewals and new business. This includes the reviewing of submission data including risk engineering reports, providing data analysis & risk modelling of Nat Cat and Man-made loss scenarios making best use of SR's costing techniques to model / forecast and quantify the impact of contract features relevant to costing.

• Support in product & process innovation using the learnings from underwriting support and suggest improvements to Nat cat models, tools, and systems

• Advising underwriters in understanding model results, model differences and limitations

• Continuously developing and applying best modeling and costing practices

• Collaborating with the underwriting community abroad and other business partners on various projects to generate new value-added services for Swiss Re

• Establish & maintain positive relationship with internal partners

About You

• Competent in Property re/insurance underwriting, single-risk assessment, risk modelling and contract preparation, with 2-5 years of relevant Underwriting/risk modelling experience

• An advanced degree in the field of natural science or a quantitative field (e.g., engineering, statistics, Mathematics, Econometrics) which is closely related to these subject areas

• Professional qualification in insurance e.g., CII, CPCU an added advantage

• Experience in facility / portfolio underwriting analytics an added advantage

• Strong understanding of underwriting techniques, methods, tools, and processes

• Ability to analyze large data sets, investigate complex connections and draw meaningful conclusions.

• Expertise in Advance Excel (VBA), SQL and Power BI and inclination towards learning new technologies will be an added advantage.

• Strong motivation to learn about re/insurance and overseas markets

• Strong team-player with proven ability to collaborate with teams in other locations and cultures, along with strong sense of accountability and execution

• Excellent command of English (written and spoken).

• Above all: scientific and technological curiosity with the ability to bring new ideas to constructively challenge the status quo.

Join our team and help shape the future of risk data governance through innovative engineering solutions. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies while contributing to a platform that serves as the backbone for risk management across our organization.
 About the Role
 As a Software Engineer on our Data Directory platform, you'll be at the intersection of data governance, security, and backend development. You'll craft elegant solutions that empower risk professionals to access and manage critical data with confidence, while ensuring the highest standards of security and data integrity.
 Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop backend services using Java and Python that power our data governance platform

• Create and maintain API-based interfaces that expose metadata and governance information

• Engineer database solutions with focus on schema design, data models, and maintaining data integrity

• Build and operate cloud services on Microsoft Azure following enterprise standards

• Implement security measures when handling sensitive risk-related metadata

• Enhance existing code to increase clarity, maintainability, and overall robustness

• Collaborate across teams with development, DevOps, and business analytics professionals

• Apply secure-by-design principles throughout the development lifecycle

• Implement authentication systems using OAuth2 for API security

• Develop comprehensive testing including unit and integration tests to ensure quality
 About the Team
 The Risk Management Data Pools application team is responsible for maintaining and evolving Data Directory, the central platform that manages metadata and governance for Risk Management data feeds. Our team ensures that critical risk data is transparent, accessible, and secure across the organization, enabling informed decision-making and regulatory compliance.
 About You
 You're a collaborative problem-solver who takes pride in writing clean, maintainable code. You communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders and understand the importance of balancing delivery speed with security and long-term maintainability. You're comfortable improving existing solutions, not just building new ones, and you take ownership of your code and its quality.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Solid experience with Java and working knowledge of Python

• Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs

• Strong understanding of database schemas, data modelling, and relational concepts

• Experience with Microsoft Azure or a comparable cloud platform

• Familiarity with OAuth2 and API security mechanisms

• Experience with unit and integration testing

• Comfortable working in a globally distributed team
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with metadata-driven systems or data governance platforms

• Familiarity with AI coding agents and responsible use in software development

• Exposure to regulated or risk-related environments

• Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps collaboration models

• Experience working in financial services or risk management domains
