jobs.title: L&H RE Records Management Manager
jobs.description:
This newly created role will drive key elements of L&H Re Records Management and represent L&H in the Group Records Management Enhancement Program. The role combines regional accountability with global programme involvement and plays a critical part in embedding the future Records Management Target Operating Model (TOM) within L&H Re.
 The successful candidate will help transition L&H Re from legacy remediation towards a sustainable, business-integrated Records Management capability.
 Key focus areas include:

• Planning, preparing and driving remediation of high-priority Records Management issues in the region and as part of the global team. This includes reducing physical records backlog, reviewing and triaging unindexed boxes, and addressing legacy issues in electronic records.

• Acting as a gatekeeper between local business teams, Group Records Management, and CRES to ensure efficient coordination, clear accountability, and optimal use of resources.

• Conducting structured analysis of physical and electronic records data, documenting issues, and tracking remediation and quality improvement initiatives.

• Actively sharing lessons learned within L&H Re and across Group Records Management and other BUs, ensuring insights are embedded into future TOM design and improvements.

• Implementing the future Records Management TOM within L&H Re, fully aligned with the Group TOM, and acting as a strong advocate for Records Management across the business.
 This role leads initiatives across the L&H Re landscape, covering most of the end-to-end value chain. Success requires understanding the broader strategic context while remaining closely connected to functional and MU stakeholder needs. Sustainable global solutions require strong stakeholder engagement, transparent communication, and decisive execution.
 About the role

In this role, you will:

• Take a regional lead role within the programme to ensure professional, pragmatic, and end-to-end project execution.

• Act as regional topic owner for Records Management in L&H Re, ensuring quality assurance activities are conducted and local mandates are clearly defined and executed.

• Collect and assess regional requirements, connect with local stakeholders, and promote adherence to DRM processes and guidelines.

• Support the integration of Group deliverables into regional business processes and ensure local adoption and operationalisation.

• Contribute to planning, issue triage, risk identification, and structured execution across remediation and governance topics.
 About the Team

Records Management is a new team as part of L&H Business Operations. We work with stakeholders across the entire L&H value chain, IT, as well as GDTO. Key focus of this new team will be on solving the three following priority tasks for L&H Re:

• Addressing potential legacy issues on physical and digital records

• Implement future Records Management TOM design for L&H Re, aligned to the future Group Records Management TOM

• Actively participate and represent L&H Re in the Group Records Management Enhancement Program

You will report to the Senior L&H Records Management Project Leader.
 About you
 Education & Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.

• Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, preferably within the Life & Health (L&H) reinsurance domain, business operations, or related functions.

Know-how and experience:

• Ability to quickly grasp complex issues, engage constructively, and develop pragmatic solutions within defined governance frameworks.

• Solid understanding of the L&H business, including Swiss Re’s L&H Re system landscape and end-to-end business processes.

• Ability to translate business requirements into high-level process improvements or system/tool change requests.

• Prior experience or exposure to Records Management is advantageous.
 Soft skills:

• Strong ability to conceptualise and structure complex topics into actionable plans.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to different stakeholder groups.

• Capability to work across regions, divisions, and functions to develop accepted and sustainable solutions.

• Comfort operating in a complex environment and breaking down ambiguity into manageable components.
 Personal Attributes:

• Natural problem-solver and critical thinker with strong ownership and delivery mindset.

• Integrative personality with respect for cross-functional expertise and the resilience to drive outcomes.

• Structured, analytical approach with the ability to learn quickly.

• Ability to thrive in a global, matrixed environment and take on a broad range of responsibilities.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager Japan & Korea

titleByLocale.it: Senior Marketing Manager Giappone e Corea

jobs.description:
About the Role

As Senior Marketing Manager for Japan & Korea, you will be at the heart of Swiss Re's commercial growth strategy in the APAX region. You will own and drive end-to-end marketing campaigns - from awareness to conversion - that deepen client relationships, elevate our brand presence, and empower origination teams to close deals with confidence. Reporting to the Head of Marketing L&H Re, you will be a key connector between global strategy and local execution, ensuring that every marketing activity resonates with the cultural nuances and business dynamics of Japan and Korea.

Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Planning: Proactively collaborate with Japan & Korea Market Heads and their broader teams to develop, align, and execute local marketing strategies that integrate seamlessly with global plans across three Business Units (BUs) – L&H, P&C and Corporate Solutions.

• Audience Targeting: Partner with the global marketing team and regional marketing services hub to define precise customer segments, profiles, and compelling messaging tailored to local markets.

• Marketing Activation: Design, manage, and execute full-funnel marketing and sales enablement activities for Japan & Korea, selecting the optimal channel mix while ensuring cultural sensitivity and local nuances are embedded throughout.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with local leadership teams, client underwriting teams, claims, sales, and cross-functional teams (XFTs) to align and amplify local marketing efforts across all three BUs.

• Sales Enablement & Client Research: Consult with Japan & Korea leadership to identify sales enablement needs, support the implementation of global sales excellence initiatives locally, and ensure origination teams are equipped with the right materials, tools, and resources to convert leads and close deals effectively.

• PR & Media: Collaborate closely with the media relations team to ensure message consistency, amplify campaign coverage, and effectively position Swiss Re's leaders and solutions in the marketplace — including sourcing local stories and coordinating content creation and promotional plans.

• Budget & Performance Reporting: Own the local marketing budget, respond to global performance reporting requests, and present impactful results to local leadership to continuously optimise the marketing planning cycle.

About the Team

L&H Marketing team sits within Swiss Re's Branding & Marketing division and is dedicated to driving commercial impact through innovative, insight-led marketing across the Life & Health Reinsurance business. We work closely with Business Unit Marketing Heads and local market teams to develop and execute integrated marketing strategies that span awareness, engagement, and conversion. With a collaborative, global mindset and a strong focus on local relevance, the team plays a pivotal role in strengthening Swiss Re's market presence and supporting business growth across key regions worldwide.

About You

You are a seasoned marketing professional who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You bring a deep understanding of complex, matrixed environments and have a natural ability to build trusted relationships across cultures and seniority levels. You are a confident communicator, a creative problem-solver, and someone who takes ownership — bringing energy, curiosity, and a results-driven mindset to everything you do. You are equally comfortable presenting to senior leadership as you are rolling up your sleeves to deliver impactful marketing initiatives on the ground.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 10+ years of experience in marketing and communications roles with a proven track record of delivering measurable commercial impact.

• Exceptional communication skills — strong written and verbal abilities in both Japanese and English (fluency in both languages is essential), with the outstanding ability to convey complex ideas clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.

• Proven project management and organisational skills — demonstrated ability to manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously, delivering results on time and within budget

• Ability to designs integrated marketing strategies across channels and markets, aligning stakeholders and coordinating complex campaigns across the customer journey.

• Ensuring consistency in messaging, timing, and execution across initiatives, with timely reporting.

• Industry knowledge - familiarity with the (re)insurance sector in a B2B marketing role or a related financial services environment is strongly preferred

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Management, Communications, or Economics.

These are additional nice to haves:

• Creativity: A flair for developing innovative, culturally resonant marketing ideas that cut through in competitive markets.

• Networking: Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with key industry influencers, networks, and event organisers across Japan and Korea.

• Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed, and dynamic global environment where priorities can shift and agility is key.

• Korean language skills — proficiency in Korean is a valuable plus for engaging effectively with the Korea market.

• Digital marketing acumen — experience with digital channels, marketing automation, and data-driven campaign optimisation.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week. Limited travel expected.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

jobs.title: Senior Incident Coordinator (Hybrid option)
jobs.description:
Join a team of cybersecurity professionals and help Swiss Re to fulfil its mission in making the world more resilient. As the Senior Incident Coordinator, you'll play a crucial role in our cyber defense strategy, coordinating response activities, facilitating preparedness exercises, and driving important through thorough post-incident analysis and documentation.
 What's more, you'll be working in a hybrid setup, perfectly balancing work from home and the office premises.
 About the team
 The Cyber Incident Management team serves as the frontliner defense against cybersecurity threats across Swiss Re. We provide critical incident leadership and coordination, overseeing the triage, investigation, and containment of security events to minimize business impact. Our team excels in stakeholders' communication and management during incidents, conduct through post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement, and develops preparedness and resilience strategies. We also establish and monitor KPIs and metrics to enhance our security posture and response capabilities.
 We're looking a detailed-oriented professional who excels at coordinating security activities and facilitating effective incident response. Join our team where your organizational expertise will strengthen our security posture through thoughtful planning, clear communication, and continuous improvement initiatives.
 In your role, you will…

• Exercise Planning & Facilitation: Design, organize, and facilitate regular tabletop exercises and simulations to test and enhance the organization's incident response capabilities

• Response Coordination : Support incident response efforts by coordinating resources, scheduling meetings, and ensuring proper communication channels are maintained

• Documentation Management : Create and maintain comprehensive incident response documentation, playbooks, and procedures

• Post-Incident Reporting : Compile detailed incident reports capturing timeline, actions taken, and impact assessments

• Metrics & Analysis : Collect, analyse, and report on key incident metrics to identify trends and improvement opportunities

• Lessons Learned : Facilitate post-incident review sessions and document findings to enhance future response efforts

• Stakeholder Communication : Coordinate communications between technical teams and business stakeholders during and after incidents

• Training Coordination : Organize and track participation in incident response training programs

• Process Improvement : Identify and implement refinements to incident management processes based on lessons learned

• Tool Administration : Support the maintenance and optimization of incident management platforms and documentation repositories
 Your qualifications
 Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of our requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are curious about the world of cyber defense, we'll be more than happy to meet you!
 What we need from you

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience

• Experience in incident management, business continuity, or security operations

• Demonstrated experience planning and facilitating tabletop exercises or simulations

• Strong documentation skills with experience creating reports, playbooks, or procedural documentation

• Excellent organizational and coordination abilities with attention to detail

• Strong communication skills in English
 Nice-to-have

• Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, MITRE ATT&CK)

• Experience with incident management or ticketing systems

• Background in metrics collection, analysis, and reporting

• Project or program management experience or certifications

• Facilitation or training certification/experience

• Experience in process improvement methodologies

• Knowledge of security operations and incident response procedures
 For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 62,000 and EUR 94,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers: ​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,​

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.​
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

jobs.description:
About the Role
 The Technical Accounting Analyst I is an entry-level role designed for colleagues who are early in their accounting career and ready to build expertise in reinsurance accounting. You will focus on mastering key accounting processes, ensuring high data quality, supporting portfolio handling, and developing independence in daily tasks as your experience grows.
 Key Responsibilities
 Core Technical Responsibilities:

• Perform exception-based handling of accounts with strong focus on data quality and value creation.

• Execute technical verification of accounts within the company’s validation framework and contract wording.

• Conduct account processing according to established guidelines and processes, including handling escalations as needed.

• Manage balance settlement with external clients according to reinsurance terms and agreements.

• Handle cash flow management including timely collection of Accounts Receivable and monitoring of portfolio financials.

• Ensure all financial transactions/payments adhere to processes, the quality management framework and key internal controls.

• Perform regular checks and analysis of client policy and financial files, identifying discrepancies and proactively resolving issues.

• Handle internal/external client communication for assigned accounts.

• Guide peers on reinsurance accounting matters when required.

• Support portfolio work, provide authorizations/escalations of financial transactions and payments according to authority matrix.
 About You

• Post-secondary degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and comfort working with numbers.

• Good verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Proactive and agile team player with a willingness to learn and grow.

• Ability to manage assigned workload and deliver high-quality results on time.

• Solid MS Excel proficiency; Power BI is an advantage.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.

• Proactive, adaptable, and curious mindset with the ability to learn new tools and processes quickly.
 Nice to Have

• Experience in (re)insurance, finance operations, accounting, or technical accounting.

• Understanding of treaty structures, cedent/broker workflows, and reinsurance data processes.

• Second language is an advantage to have.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between 1 300 EUR and 2 200 EUR per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

descriptionByLocale.de:
About the Role
 The Technical Accounting Analyst I is an entry-level role designed for colleagues who are early in their accounting career and ready to build expertise in reinsurance accounting. You will focus on mastering key accounting processes, ensuring high data quality, supporting portfolio handling, and developing independence in daily tasks as your experience grows.
 Key Responsibilities
 Core Technical Responsibilities:

• Perform exception-based handling of accounts with strong focus on data quality and value creation.

• Execute technical verification of accounts within the company’s validation framework and contract wording.

• Conduct account processing according to established guidelines and processes, including handling escalations as needed.

• Manage balance settlement with external clients according to reinsurance terms and agreements.

• Handle cash flow management including timely collection of Accounts Receivable and monitoring of portfolio financials.

• Ensure all financial transactions/payments adhere to processes, the quality management framework and key internal controls.

• Perform regular checks and analysis of client policy and financial files, identifying discrepancies and proactively resolving issues.

• Handle internal/external client communication for assigned accounts.

• Guide peers on reinsurance accounting matters when required.

• Support portfolio work, provide authorizations/escalations of financial transactions and payments according to authority matrix.
 About You

• Post-secondary degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and comfort working with numbers.

• Good verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Proactive and agile team player with a willingness to learn and grow.

• Ability to manage assigned workload and deliver high-quality results on time.

• Solid MS Excel proficiency; Power BI is an advantage.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.

• Proactive, adaptable, and curious mindset with the ability to learn new tools and processes quickly.
 Nice to Have

• Experience in (re)insurance, finance operations, accounting, or technical accounting.

• Understanding of treaty structures, cedent/broker workflows, and reinsurance data processes.

• Second language is an advantage to have.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between 1 300 EUR and 2 200 EUR per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. Would you like to become part of Knowledge Company with global presence and strong reputation? To be in the heart of reinsurance business and thus become a part of team of dynamic professionals? If YES, we are looking forward to your application!
 About the Team
 We are a multinational, dynamic and engaged team of more than 60 Business Coordinators, divided into smaller teams according to EMEA markets. Our team is the backbone for our underwriters, who originate and renew the business with clients. We are also the only reinsurance department that oversees the end-to-end process.
 About the Role
 Key responsibilities:
 - Acting as a point of contact and partner for Client Underwriters or Key Account Managers (client facing staff)
 - Handling of your own portfolio – including contract management, data gathering, analysis of portfolio and reporting
 - Collaborating and coordinating tasks across cross-functional teams (Technical Accounting, Claims, Underwriting, Contracts, etc.)
 - Preparing presentations for client visits, client events and conferences
 - Possible participation in projects and initiatives
 About You
 We are looking for a reliable self-driven, constructive and open-minded team player with attention to detail, prioritization, effective communication and interpersonal skills, strong customer focus and service orientation.
 Essentials:
 - Position is also suitable for graduates however previous working experience in administration or Insurance/Reinsurance is an advantage
 - Language skills: fluent English and other European language is plus
 - MS office package (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
 - Data literacy - ability to read and interpret data is an advantage
 We are looking forward to your application!
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1400 and EUR 2300 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

jobs.description:
About the Role
 As an Accounts Payable Analyst, you will be an important part of our finance operations, ensuring that supplier invoices are processed accurately and paid on time. You will work with colleagues across the company, handle day-to-day operational tasks, and gradually build a deeper understanding of finance processes end-to-end.
You’ll join a supportive team that values learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement — a perfect environment to grow your skills and confidence.
 Key Responsibilities
• Perform four-eyes review of supplier invoices and verify accuracy before payment
• Handle internal and external queries related to invoice status, payment dates, and discrepancies
• Support period-end and quarter-end closing activities
• Reconcile assigned balance sheet and control accounts on a regular basis
• Share knowledge within the team and support training of new colleagues
• Contribute to team goals and perform other role-related tasks assigned by the Team Leader
 About the Team
 We are a global team consisting of three closely connected teams. You will be part of a country‑focused sub-team. We are a collaborative, open, and knowledge-sharing group of professionals who support Swiss Re entities across the globe.

Our mission is simple but critical: to ensure invoices are paid correctly and on time while continuously improving our processes. Thanks to Swiss Re’s flat structure, you’ll have real ownership of your work and direct exposure to senior stakeholders across the organization.

About You
 • Secondary school or university degree in Finance (or similar) — suitable for fresh graduates
• English at a good business level (B2), written and spoken
• A team player with a proactive attitude and willingness to learn
• Detail-oriented, curious, and open to new ideas
• Strong communication skills with a problem-solving mindset
• Basic accounting knowledge (e.g. debit / credit) is an advantage
• Intermediate MS Excel skills are a plus
 This is a maternity cover with a strong possibility of contract extension.

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1300 and EUR 2200 per month (for a full-time role).

• Reconcile assigned balance sheet and control accounts on a regular basis
• Share knowledge within the team and support training of new colleagues
• Contribute to team goals and perform other role-related tasks assigned by the Team Leader
 About the Team

Our mission is simple but critical: to ensure invoices are paid correctly and on time while continuously improving our processes. Thanks to Swiss Re’s flat structure, you’ll have real ownership of your work and direct exposure to senior stakeholders across the organization.

About You
 • Secondary school or university degree in Finance (or similar) — suitable for fresh graduates
• English at a good business level (B2), written and spoken
• A team player with a proactive attitude and willingness to learn
• Detail-oriented, curious, and open to new ideas
• Strong communication skills with a problem-solving mindset
• Basic accounting knowledge (e.g. debit / credit) is an advantage
• Intermediate MS Excel skills are a plus
 This is a maternity cover with a strong possibility of contract extension.

jobs.description:
Möchten Sie die Zukunft der Lebensrückversicherung in Deutschland mitgestalten? Werden Sie Teil von Swiss Re als (Senior) Aktuar/in & Client Manager/in L&H für Deutschland – und verstärken Sie ein engagiertes, kollaboratives Team, das Innovation und nachhaltiges Wachstum in diesem einzigartigen Marktumfeld vorantreibt.
 Über die Rolle
 In Ihrer Rolle als (Senior) Aktuar/in & Client Manager/in L&H für Deutschland fungieren Sie als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Swiss Re und ihren Rückversicherungskunden. Ihre ausgeprägte aktuarielle Expertise bildet die Grundlage für eine strategisch wichtige Rolle beim Ausbau der Marktpräsenz von Swiss Re sowie bei der Entwicklung datenbasierter, kundenorientierter Lösungen. Der Standort ist München und Sie berichten an den Head Client Management Germany & Nordics.
 Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Sie sind die zentrale Ansprechperson für L&H Kunden von Swiss Re in Deutschland und stellen eine nahtlose Kommunikation sowie eine qualitativ hochwertige Serviceerbringung sicher.

• Sie bauen langfristige, vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen auf und pflegen diese, indem Sie Swiss Re als technisch führenden und bevorzugten Rückversicherungspartner im deutschen Markt positionieren.

• Sie entwickeln und implementieren Wachstumsstrategien für bestehende und potenzielle Kunden, gestützt auf aktuariellem Know-how in den Bereichen Pricing, Produktdesign und Portfoliosteuerung, und treiben so nachhaltiges Geschäftswachstum und Innovation voran.

• Sie verantworten und steuern Kundenbeziehungen ganzheitlich, einschließlich der finanziellen Performance von Bestandsportfolios sowie der Bewertung und Strukturierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten aus aktuarieller und kommerzieller Perspektive.

• Sie etablieren und pflegen ein starkes professionelles Netzwerk im deutschen Versicherungsmarkt, um Chancen entlang der strategischen Säulen von Swiss Re – Core, Solutions und Transactions – zu identifizieren und umzusetzen, insbesondere bei komplexen, aktuariell geprägten Fragestellungen.

• Sie vertreten Swiss Re bei Kundenterminen, Branchenveranstaltungen, Konferenzen und in relevanten Fachgremien und agieren dabei als glaubwürdige:r Markenbotschafter:in mit starker technischer Kompetenz.

Über das Team
 Sie werden Teil eines dynamischen und hochmotivierten Teams von Fachleuten, die alles daran setzen, hervorragende Ergebnisse zu erzielen und die Zukunft des Geschäfts von Swiss Re mitzugestalten. Als L&H-Hub in München sind wir Teil eines vernetzten kontinentaleuropäischen L&H-Teams sowie einer globalen L&H-Gemeinschaft. Das Team ist äußerst divers und umfasst verschiedene Funktionen, die für die Betreuung unserer Kunden relevant sind, darunter Client Mangement, Aktuariat, Underwriting, Leistungsregulierung und Medizin. Das Arbeitsumfeld ist schnelllebig, hochgradig kollaborativ und intellektuell anspruchsvoll, geprägt von analytischer Exzellenz, fachlichem Austausch und einer guten Portion Freude an der gemeinsamen Arbeit.
 Über Sie
 Sie sind eine dynamische und strategisch denkende Persönlichkeit mit einer ausgeprägten aktuariellen Expertise und fundierter Erfahrung in der L&H‑Versicherungs‑ oder Rückversicherungsbranche. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf Pricing, Portfoliosteuerung und der wirtschaftlichen Bewertung von Risiken. In der direkten Kundeninteraktion fühlen Sie sich wohl, bauen langfristige Partnerschaften auf und nutzen Ihre analytischen Fähigkeiten, um profitables Wachstum zu steuern und nachhaltige, messbare Ergebnisse in einem schnelllebigen, kollaborativen Umfeld zu erzielen.
 Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im deutschen Lebenserstversicherungs- und/oder Rückversicherungsmarkt

• Starker aktuarieller Hintergrund mit relevanten Qualifikationen (z.B. DAV, Aktuar DAV oder gleichwertig)

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe aktuarielle Konzepte in Geschäftslösungen zu übersetzen – Erfahrung in Preisgestaltung und Produktenwicklung für biometrische Lösungen sind ein Plus

• Fundiertes Verständnis von HGB Rechnungslegung sowie anderen internationalen Regularien (Solvency II, IFRS)

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten zum Verständnis von Marktmustern und zur Erkennung aufkommender Trends

• Erfahrung in kundenorientierten Rollen innerhalb des Versicherungs- oder Rückversicherungssektors

• Fließende und sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch.

In Deutschland, liegt das Grundgehalt für diese Position zwischen 72.000 EUR und 120.000 EUR (Vollzeitbeschäftigung) und für die Senior Position zwischen 101.000 EUR und 169.000 EUR (Vollzeitbeschäftigung). Das konkrete Gehaltsangebot berücksichtigt:

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Verantwortung der Position

• Das Profil des Bewerbers/der Bewerberin, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung.

Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive, leistungsbezogene variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen anerkennt. Darüber hinaus profitieren Sie von einer Vielzahl globaler und standortspezifischer Leistungen.
 Die Anspruchsberechtigung kann je nach den Bedingungen der Swiss Re und Ihrem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.

We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. jobs.title: Service Assistant*in (m/f/x/d, 50%)
jobs.description:
Zur Unterstützung unseres Serviceteams, suchen wir, eine/-n versierte/-n Service Assistant*in, welche/r gerne in einem internationalen Umfeld aktiv ist und mit Freude in den Bereichen Mitarbeiterrestaurant, Take away und in den Pausenzonen die folgenden Aufgaben übernimmt. Ihr Arbeitsort ist Zürich Mythenquai und der Eintritt wäre per 1. Juli 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung

Ihre Hauptaufgaben

• Durchführen von Vorbereitungsarbeiten um ein professionelles Anrichten der Speisen sowie das Auffüllen während der Servicezeiten zu gewährleisten.

• Sicherstellen eines reibungslosen und professionellen Ablaufs an den Ausgabestationen im Mittagsservice und erteilen von wichtigen Auskünften bezüglich Produkte, Inhalten und Allergenen.

• Selbständiges Durchführen von Reinigungsarbeiten nach dem Mittagsservice und vorbereiten der Stationen für den nächsten Tag.

• Beim Einsatz im Take away Bereich sicherstellen einer ansprechenden Präsentation des Angebots und bedienen des Kassensystems Gastronovi inklusive abschliessender Reinigungsarbeiten.

• Unterstützung des Pausenzonen Teams beim Vorbereiten, Auffüllen und Betreuen der Pausenzonen in den verschiedenen Gebäuden bei Abwesenheiten.
 Anforderungen für alle Einsatzbereiche

• Sie verstehen es, mit einem hohen Mass an Qualitätsbewusstsein unsere anspruchsvollen Gäste auf Deutsch und Englisch zu betreuen.

• Sie arbeiten gerne im Team, sind lernfreudig, offen für neue Aufgaben und zeichnen sich durch Einsatzfreude und Teamgeist aus.

• Ihr Arbeitspensum beträgt 50% und wird von Montag bis Freitag zwischen 10.00-15.30 Uhr absolviert.

• Gelegentliche Einsätze bei Abendanlässen.
 Swiss Re Gastronomie – Ihr Arbeitsumfeld
 Unsere gastronomischen Schauplätze mit den zwei Mitarbeiterrestaurants und den anderen gastronomischen Outlets befinden sich in Zürich und Adliswil und decken ein breites Spektrum an Dienstleistungen ab. Unser Konferenzzentrum mit Hotelbetrieb, Swiss Re Centre for Global Dialogue, befindet sich in Rüschlikon und erfreut sich mit seinen 50 Hotelzimmer sowie 3 Suiten auch internationaler Beliebtheit. Sie sind in Zürich aktiv und unterstützen das Buffet Team im Klubhaus, das sich in Zürich am Mythenquai befindet.
 Was bringen Sie mit:

• Erfahrung beim Bedienen der Gäste am Selbstwahlbuffet und bei Banketten

• Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Kassensystemen von Vorteil

• Hoher Qualitätsanspruch und ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung

• Teamplayer mit Freude am Gästekontakt

• Flexibel bezüglich Einsatzzeiten

• Gepflegtes Auftreten und gute Umgangsformen

• Gute mündliche Deutschkenntnisse (Niveau B2); schriftlich von Vorteil

• Gute mündliche Englischkenntnisse erforderlich (Niveau B1)
 Was wir bieten

• Swiss Re, in jeder Hinsicht ein moderner und renommierter Arbeitgeber

• Überdurchschnittliche Pensionskasse, Vorsorge- und Versicherungsleistungen

• Stark vergünstigte Abonnements für den öffentlichen Verkehr und die Freizeit

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

• Und noch vieles mehr
 Für die Schweiz liegt die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position zwischen 50'000 CHF und 76'000 CHF (bei einer Vollzeitstelle). Das konkret angebotene Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• die Anforderungen, den Umfang, die Komplexität und die Verantwortlichkeiten der Rolle,

• das Profil der Bewerberin bzw. des Bewerbers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung.
 Zusätzlich zum Grundgehalt bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive, leistungsabhängige variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen anerkennt. Darüber hinaus profitieren Sie von einer Vielzahl globaler und standortspezifischer Zusatzleistungen.
 Die Anspruchsberechtigung kann je nach den Richtlinien von Swiss Re und dem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.
 Swiss Re – Ihr Arbeitgeber
 Dies ist Ihre Chance, bei der Swiss Re Group einzusteigen - einem der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen innovativen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers. Bei Swiss Re geht es darum, die grossen Risiken, die die Welt betreffen, zu verstehen und zu analysieren - von Naturkatastrophen bis zum Klimawandel, von der Überalterung der Bevölkerung bis zur Cyberkriminalität. Wir kombinieren Erfahrung mit Fachwissen und innovativem Denken, um neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Dies ist nur möglich mit rund 15'000 aussergewöhnlichen Mitarbeitenden der Swiss Re Gruppe weltweit.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

jobs.title: SwiftRe Operations Analyst III 1
jobs.description:
About the Role
 SwiftRe is an efficient web-based platform providing mid-market and facultative business to our clients. It is an easy to use and efficient online risk placement, claims and accounting channel for clients. This position includes handling a client portfolio with detailed operational focus, steering parameters from post-bind experience and contributing in process and system development.
 Key Responsibilities

• Core portfolio management comprises of Single Fac risks via SwiftRe Platform and Fac Facilities via Fac Portal

• Managing own portfolio of clients who are insurance companies/brokers from several different geographies with keen focus on operational KPI excellence

• End to end process management - Monitoring of outstanding statements, overall cash flow management and escalations needed towards delivering business-sensitive operational results – with undiluted focus on Ease of Doing Business

• Ensuring data quality - clients submit timely and quality data as per contractually agreements, subsequent analysis & uploading of insurance data into the system

• Client support - On exceptional need basis, supporting our clients in administering their contracts and processing statements on behalf of clients in SwiftRe portal

• Coordination of technical and financial accounting issues with diverse market accounting teams in various Swiss Re Units and regions

• Providing client administration and support regarding tools, processes and record management

• Training the clients on a regular basis to update their knowledge on SwiftRe's accounting and payments processes

• Cross-functional collaboration with internal and Underwriting teams (via email, phone and in-person visits)

• Process improvement - Identify opportunities for simplification, support process improvements and system enhancement. Collaborate with Business Expert Networks on regular basis for sustainable implementation of client processes

• Testing participation in User Acceptance Testing and reporting out of user summary as required

About the Team
 The makeup of the team includes 11-12 niche Operations Experts fully responsible for all back-office processes and some front-end processes of SwiftRe suite landscape. In line with our strategy, the team is expanding its efforts onto newer Solutions and is expected to rise in volume and complexity. Main scope of your intervention will be US and Canada markets, but as per business need also other markets to generate full benefit of our wider team structure in Operations. Our responsibilities require regular interactions with peers and experts from other global locations. We have a strong link to the other Business Management teams and collaborate on a daily basis to deliver best service and most value to our clients.
 About You

• Minimum Bachelor/Master's in Finance, Accounting or related fields. Outstanding performer with minimum 4-5 years of work experience.

• Strong Analytical skills (flair for figures), including Advanced Excel and Microsoft Power BI skills. Proven capabilities in data handling and portfolio steering in previous work experience. SQL skills would be an added advantage.

• Excellent verbal and written business communication skills. Proficient knowledge of other European or Asian languages would be an advantage.

• Strong understanding of re-insurance concepts, Accounting and Finance principles.

• Being an agile team player with the ability to manage own workload and demonstrate a sense of Accountability, Responsibility and Commitment.

• Ability to work together collaboratively, flexibly and constructively in a team/group environment including in virtual set-ups.

• Ability to challenge the status quo and manage multiple stakeholders (multi-cultural and cross functional teams in a virtual set-up).

• Solid understanding of interfaces and functions. Prior experience with digital applications, automation, solutions and big data would be an advantage.

• Insurance/Finance related certifications will be an added advantage.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

jobs.description:
Are you a technology fan impressed by aircrafts and ships, or fascinated by nature and agriculture? Do you want to be part of the energy transition to renewables, or see yourself as a cyber guardian? If your answer is yes, we invite you to explore this exciting opportunity! We're working across all these innovative domains, and our dynamic team is growing!
 About the Role
 In this pivotal position, you'll drive requirement engineering and quality assurance for our sophisticated data tools and platforms. We're looking for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit, pragmatic hands-on mindset, and an intellectually curious approach to problem-solving.
 Key Responsibilities

• Collaborate with Product Managers to collect, maintain, and understand business requirements

• Translate complex business terminology into technical language and vice versa

• Create clear, concise requirements and acceptance criteria that are unambiguous, complete, consistent, and verifiable

• Master data models and their business context through deep understanding

• Own the end-to-end data cycle process with accountability and precision

• Transform raw data into actionable reports and visualizations that meet business goals

• Analyze data proactively to identify problems, answer key questions, and develop quantitative and qualitative insights
 About the Team
 If tackling complex challenges across diverse industries excites you, then our innovative team is the perfect fit. We stand at the forefront of creating ingenious solutions through collaborative approaches.
 Our team serves as an empowered tech counterpart for business units, responsible for designing and implementing inventive data projects. We develop cutting-edge analytics capabilities and enhance Swiss Re's risk assessment frameworks.
 Joining us means learning not just how insurance premiums are modelled and how data analytics enriches business operations, but also improving your stakeholder management skills, agile development practices, and proficiency with tools that drive impactful projects.
 About You
 We're seeking enthusiastic professionals who can be effective leaders with strong functional and operational expertise. You should be an excellent communicator capable of building trust-based relationships within your squad and among partners.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements

• Proven experience with business analysis and requirements engineering

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail

• Knowledge of tools and techniques needed for data analysis and management

• Ability to validate data accuracy and troubleshoot reporting issues

• Experience analyzing large datasets and identifying actionable insights

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical issues to non-technical audiences

• Ability to work with tight deadlines, prioritize effectively, and adapt to changing organizational objectives

• Confidence in presenting applications/demos to internal and external stakeholders

• Exposure to agile development approaches (e.g., Scrum) and familiarity with tools like Azure DevOps or Confluence

• Business fluency in English
 These are additional nice to haves

• Experience in the Re-/Insurance industry

• Ability to identify strengths and weaknesses in business processes and suggest areas for improvement

• Knowledge of data visualization tools and techniques

• Experience with data governance and quality management

• Background in stakeholder management across different organizational levels

• Leadership /people management experience

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

• Fluent Spanish and English language skills (both written and spoken)

• Basic understanding of office administration and support functions

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel

• Strong attention to detail and comfort working with data

• Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively

• Basic understanding of insurance concepts

• Experience working in international or multicultural teams

jobs.title: Actuarial Portfolio Management Intern
jobs.description:
Are you an actuarial university student eager to gain hands-on experience in the insurance world? This is your opportunity to dive into real actuarial work, sharpen your analytical skills, and contribute to meaningful projects that shape how we understand and manage risk across Latin America. If you are curious, driven, and ready to learn, we want to hear from you!

About the Role
 As an Actuarial Portfolio Management Intern within Corporate Solutions, you will be embedded in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your contributions truly matter. From day one, you will support global pricing and portfolio management activities focused on Latin America, working alongside experienced actuaries and business partners. This is a unique chance to apply your academic knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for your actuarial career.
 Key Responsibilities

• Develop queries and reports to analyze data from our pricing tools, providing deeper insights into portfolio performance and monitoring changes over time

• Build analytical templates to assess the profitability of key portfolios and support our quarterly profitability review process

• Analyze external data for benchmarking purposes and to identify emerging trends that impact our business across Latin America

• Assist in updating parameters used in our actuarial tools and models to ensure accuracy and relevance of actuarial indications

• Contribute to actuarial projects as needed, gaining broad exposure to different areas of the actuarial function within a global reinsurance environment

About the Team
 We are the Global Pricing and Portfolio Management team within the Underwriting Center at Corporate Solutions, dedicated to supporting Latin America business. Our team plays a critical role in delivering actuarial expertise across multiple lines of business, with core responsibilities spanning loss ratio projections, rating plan development, and parameter updates . We collaborate closely with partners across Underwriting, Product, Finance, Claims, Reserving, and Data Science — making us a central hub of analytical insight within the organization.

About You
 You are an intellectually curious and proactive student who enjoys working with data and solving complex problems. You communicate clearly, take initiative, and are comfortable working in a multicultural, fast-paced environment. You are eager to learn, open to feedback, and motivated to build a career in actuarial science or a related quantitative field.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Currently studying Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or another quantitative field , with graduation expected in the second semester of 2027 or later

• Advanced English proficiency — you will regularly collaborate with teams across different regions and geographies

• Intermediate to advanced Excel skills , with the ability to build and work with analytical models and templates
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Spanish language skills — desirable for engagement with Latin America stakeholders, though not required

• Knowledge of VBA for automating tasks and enhancing Excel-based tools

• SQL skills for querying and managing large datasets

• Experience with R or Python for statistical analysis and data manipulation

• Strong communication skills — ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

• A genuine interest in the insurance and reinsurance industry and enthusiasm for building an actuarial career

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

jobs.description:
Are you a sharp, commercially minded legal professional with deep expertise in financial markets and collateral? This is your opportunity to take on a high-impact role at the heart of Swiss Re's Capital Markets Legal function — advising on complex, multi-jurisdictional matters and shaping the legal framework for one of the world's leading reinsurance groups.
 About the Role
 As Legal Counsel for Securities Finance and Collateral, you will be a trusted legal advisor embedded in a dynamic and internationally connected team. You will provide expert legal counsel to Swiss Re Group and its various Business Units, translating complex business requirements into clear legal processes and actionable guidance. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of law, finance, and regulation — with real visibility at senior levels of the organisation.
 Key Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day legal matters related to collateral trading and management, including the drafting and negotiation of master agreements for Securities Financing Transactions (SFTs), triparty collateral agreements, trade confirmations, security agreements, and bespoke collateral arrangements

• Advise on financial markets regulations , with a particular focus on the Swiss regulatory landscape, ensuring Swiss Re remains compliant with evolving legal and regulatory requirements

• Conduct legal and regulatory risk gap assessments and provide timely, well-reasoned legal opinions on operational and legal risks

• Draft and review legal policies and guidelines , ensuring they reflect current regulatory requirements and best practices

• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Credit Risk, Finance, and Asset Management stakeholders to deliver integrated, commercially sound legal solutions

• Engage with market associations such as ICMA and ISLA, representing Swiss Re's interests and staying ahead of industry developments

• Provide periodic updates to Senior Management, Internal Audit, and relevant Committees on legal developments and risk matters

• Coordinate with the governance team for regulatory filings and reporting obligations

• Escalate material issues appropriately to the Head of Global Collateral and the Head of Capital Markets, Finance – Legal

• Lead and support group-wide internal projects and contribute to broader Legal & Compliance initiatives

• Liaise and collaborate with peers across other branches of the legal department, fostering knowledge sharing and consistency

About the Team
 Based in Zurich, you will report to the Head of Capital Markets Finance Legal and join a team of seven talented legal professionals. The team is truly international in character, with members based across Zurich and London, bringing a rich diversity of qualifications, backgrounds, and legal expertise. The team operates in a collaborative and intellectually stimulating environment, advising on some of the most complex and high-profile matters within Swiss Re's legal function. You will have regular interactions with the General Counsel Corporate Center & Group Functions, the Group Treasurer, the Head of Risk & Short-Term Funding, and Swiss Re Senior Management.
 About You
 You are a confident, intellectually curious legal professional who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment. You bring sound legal judgement that goes beyond the letter of the law — you understand the business context, communicate complex concepts with clarity, and build trusted relationships across all levels of an organisation. You are open, collaborative, and willing to share your knowledge and perspective, while remaining receptive to challenge and committed to continuous learning.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Law degree with honours and admission to practice , with a Swiss legal qualification required ; an additional US or UK qualification is strongly preferred

• Minimum 8 years of significant international legal experience in securities lending, repo, and ideally derivatives businesses, gained at a renowned financial services institution and/or a top-tier law firm

• Strong experience in complex, multi-jurisdictional legal matters , with demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality legal advice under pressure

• Fluency in English and German (written and spoken), enabling effective communication with internal and external stakeholders across jurisdictions

• Proven expertise in drafting and negotiating financial market agreements, including GMRA, GMSLA, CSA, and related documentation

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience interacting with or representing organisations at market associations such as ICMA or ISLA

• Familiarity with Swiss Re's business model or the broader reinsurance/insurance industry

• Experience advising on regulatory filings and liaising with financial regulators

• Demonstrated ability to lead internal legal projects and drive cross-functional initiatives

• Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and governance committees

• A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a measured appetite for risk and a track record of delivering workable outcomes

• Professional references available upon request

For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between CHF 132 000 and CHF 198 000 for a full-time role.
 The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 About Swiss Re

• Manage day-to-day legal matters related to collateral trading and management, including the drafting and negotiation of master agreements for Securities Financing Transactions (SFTs), triparty collateral agreements, trade confirmations, security agreements, and bespoke collateral arrangements

• Advise on financial markets regulations , with a particular focus on the Swiss regulatory landscape, ensuring Swiss Re remains compliant with evolving legal and regulatory requirements

• Conduct legal and regulatory risk gap assessments and provide timely, well-reasoned legal opinions on operational and legal risks

• Draft and review legal policies and guidelines , ensuring they reflect current regulatory requirements and best practices

• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Credit Risk, Finance, and Asset Management stakeholders to deliver integrated, commercially sound legal solutions

• Engage with market associations such as ICMA and ISLA, representing Swiss Re's interests and staying ahead of industry developments

• Provide periodic updates to Senior Management, Internal Audit, and relevant Committees on legal developments and risk matters

• Coordinate with the governance team for regulatory filings and reporting obligations

• Escalate material issues appropriately to the Head of Global Collateral and the Head of Capital Markets, Finance – Legal

• Lead and support group-wide internal projects and contribute to broader Legal & Compliance initiatives

• Liaise and collaborate with peers across other branches of the legal department, fostering knowledge sharing and consistency

 Based in Zurich, you will report to the Head of Capital Markets Finance Legal and join a team of seven talented legal professionals. The team operates in a collaborative and intellectually stimulating environment, advising on some of the most complex and high-profile matters within Swiss Re's legal function. You will have regular interactions with the General Counsel Corporate Center & Group Functions, the Group Treasurer, the Head of Risk & Short-Term Funding, and Swiss Re Senior Management.
 About You
 You are a confident, intellectually curious legal professional who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment. You bring sound legal judgement that goes beyond the letter of the law — you understand the business context, communicate complex concepts with clarity, and build trusted relationships across all levels of an organisation. You are open, collaborative, and willing to share your knowledge and perspective, while remaining receptive to challenge and committed to continuous learning.

• Law degree with honours and admission to practice , with a Swiss legal qualification required ; an additional US or UK qualification is strongly preferred

• Minimum 8 years of significant international legal experience in securities lending, repo, and ideally derivatives businesses, gained at a renowned financial services institution and/or a top-tier law firm

• Strong experience in complex, multi-jurisdictional legal matters , with demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality legal advice under pressure

• Fluency in English and German (written and spoken), enabling effective communication with internal and external stakeholders across jurisdictions

• Proven expertise in drafting and negotiating financial market agreements, including GMRA, GMSLA, CSA, and related documentation

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience interacting with or representing organisations at market associations such as ICMA or ISLA

• Familiarity with Swiss Re's business model or the broader reinsurance/insurance industry

• Experience advising on regulatory filings and liaising with financial regulators

• Demonstrated ability to lead internal legal projects and drive cross-functional initiatives

• Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and governance committees

• A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a measured appetite for risk and a track record of delivering workable outcomes

• Professional references available upon request

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about finance and eager to build a career at the intersection of project finance and insurance? This is your opportunity to join a pioneering team, develop deep expertise in credit analysis and underwriting, and make a real impact on some of the world's most complex infrastructure transactions. If you thrive in a collaborative environment and are hungry to learn, we want to hear from you!
 About the Role
 As an Underwriting Analyst within our Project and Infrastructure Finance team, you will contribute to the analysis and evaluation of infrastructure and project finance transactions while developing your underwriting and credit risk expertise. Working side by side with Senior Underwriters, you will gain hands-on experience across the full lifecycle of project finance deals — from initial credit analysis through to transaction execution and ongoing portfolio management. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to grow their career in a dynamic environment with a truly global reach.
 Key responsibilities

• Assessment of project finance transactions and preparation of credit underwriting memoranda. This would include:
• Analysis of market, business profile, and technical aspects;

• Review of cash flow models including scenario analysis;

• Review of financing agreements;

• Review and execution of transaction documentation.

• Portfolio management tasks, including:
• Updating deal information;

• Analysis of the existing portfolio;

• Analysis of industry trends;

• Reviewing performance of existing transactions.

You will be expected to contribute to business-related projects on a case-by-case basis.
 About the Team
 The Project and Infrastructure Finance team is part of the Credit and Surety division within Corporate Solutions. Established over 18 years ago, we hold the distinction of being the first credit underwriting team in the insurance market to specialise in Project and Infrastructure Finance. Our team combines deep technical expertise with a collaborative culture, working on some of the most complex and rewarding transactions in the market. We are a close-knit group that values curiosity, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to excellence. Joining us means becoming part of a team that has shaped the industry — and continues to push its boundaries.
 About You
 You are curious, financially minded, and eager to develop your expertise in one of the most specialised areas of credit underwriting. You bring a collaborative spirit, a proactive attitude, and a genuine enthusiasm for learning. You are comfortable working with complex information, can communicate your analysis clearly and confidently, and thrive in a fast-paced, detail-oriented environment. Whether you are early in your career or bringing some relevant experience, what matters most is your drive, your curiosity, and your commitment to growing within the role.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Interest in project and infrastructure finance — understanding of how project finance transactions are structured, including familiarity with key financing documentation and contractual frameworks

• Experience or academic exposure to infrastructure sectors such as energy, telecom, transport, utilities, or social infrastructure

• Familiarity with insurance markets , particularly credit products

• Strong written and verbal communication skills , with the ability to present complex analysis in a clear and concise manner to senior stakeholders

• Experience working in a cross-functional or international environment , demonstrating adaptability and cultural awareness
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week. #LI-Hybrid

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

jobs.description:
Are you a detail-driven, operationally minded professional who thrives in a dynamic, multi-faceted environment? Do you enjoy connecting the dots across complex platforms and making things run smoothly behind the scenes? If so, this could be the perfect next step in your career.
 About the Role
 This is a unique opportunity to sit at the heart of Swiss Re's investment management operations, supporting both SRILIAC — Swiss Re's U.S.-based investment manager — and the broader ACP Operations platform. You'll play a meaningful role in keeping a sophisticated fund platform running efficiently, contributing to everything from day-to-day operational oversight to governance coordination and cross-functional business management. No two days will look the same, and your contributions will be felt across the organisation.
 Key Responsibilities

• Support end-to-end fund operations , including reporting, reconciliations, cash management, trade life-cycle oversight, NAV production support and fund launches

• Coordinate with internal teams, external administrators, custodians and service providers to ensure key operational activities are executed accurately, on time and within a strong control environment

• Draft, update and maintain procedures and documentation , ensuring records are well-organised, current and accessible across the platform

• Support governance and risk & control activities across the ACP Operations remit, including issue follow-up, reporting coordination and policy management

• Act as a connector between ACP business units and the wider Asset Management organisation, helping ensure activities are delivered in a well-controlled and structured manner

• Respond to ad hoc requests and contribute flexibly across a wide range of operational and business management priorities as business needs evolve

• Interpret and synthesise complex information from varied sources to support decision-making and operational oversight

• Maintain record retention and documentation management standards , supporting the ongoing oversight and integrity of the SRILIAC platform

About the Team
 ACP Business Management is a dedicated division within Group Asset Management, providing specialised transaction and business support to the ILS, Retro, LHSS and Investment Management businesses. SRILIAC, Swiss Re's U.S.-based investment manager, sits within this environment and is responsible for overseeing a range of investment and fund-related activities.
 The team works closely with internal stakeholders, external administrators, custodians and a broad network of business partners to support effective fund operations, oversight and coordination across the platform. This role offers genuine exposure to a wide operational landscape — from fund-level activities through to broader governance and cross-functional business management — making it an excellent environment for someone looking to build deep expertise across a complex, high-quality asset management platform.
 About You
 You are a proactive, organised and intellectually curious professional who is energised by variety and complexity. You communicate clearly, build relationships with ease and take pride in producing high-quality work. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities and rolling up your sleeves to get things done — whether that means drafting a procedure, following up on an operational issue or supporting a fund launch.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g. Finance, Business, Economics, Law or related discipline)

• 1+ years of experience in Operations, Finance, Legal, Audit or Consulting, with exposure to financial services or investment management environments preferred

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills , with a proven ability to interpret complex and varied information and translate it into clear, actionable outputs

• Excellent written communication skills , with the ability to draft and refine documentation — including procedures, reports and governance materials — for different audiences and purposes

• Solid understanding of end-to-end operating models , with the ability to look beyond individual processes and appreciate the broader operational landscape

These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with fund operations concepts such as NAV production, reconciliations, cash management or trade life-cycle processes

• Experience supporting governance, risk & control or compliance-related activities

• Exposure to working with external service providers such as fund administrators or custodians

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced, evolving environment

• A self-starter mindset with a strong work ethic and a high level of attention to detail

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week. #LI-Hybrid
 For London, the annual base salary range for this position is between GBP 34 000 and GBP 50 000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health.
