jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned payroll leader ready to make a global impact? At Swiss Re, we are looking for a bold, forward-thinking professional to lead our Global Payroll function - driving excellence, transformation, and innovation across a complex, multi-country environment. If you thrive at the intersection of people, technology, and compliance, this is your opportunity to shape the future of payroll at one of the world's leading reinsurance companies.
 About the Role

As Global Head of Payroll , you will be at the helm of Swiss Re's end-to-end global payroll operations, accountable for delivering accurate, compliant, and timely payroll across multiple countries and regions. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will drive payroll transformation - leveraging automation, AI, and technology - while maintaining the strongest standards of governance, controls, and employee experience.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop a high-performing global payroll team, setting clear expectations, building capability through coaching and feedback in order to effectively deliver end-to-end payroll operations across multiple countries and regions — including complex scenarios such as international assignments, expatriate payroll, and cross-border payments

• Drive payroll transformation and innovation, including process standardisation, system enhancements and integrations, and automation/AI initiatives to continuously improve efficiency, accuracy, and the overall employee payroll experience

• Own the payroll governance, controls and compliance framework, ensuring audit readiness, data security, and adherence to regulatory requirements across all jurisdictions, in close partnership with Finance, Risk, and Audit

• Manage vendor relationships and performance, leading strategy, procurement, and contract negotiations for payroll outsourcing services, and overseeing contractual outcomes with the global payroll provider, including assurance reviews (SOC 1/SOC 2) and IT security alignment

• Oversee financial management and year-end activities, including budget forecasting, cost transparency, tax reporting, annual statements, and statutory filings across all jurisdictions

• Ensure robust payroll systems and data integrity, working closely with HR and Finance to accurately reflect payroll requirements in systems architecture, including upstream/downstream interfaces and data quality controls

• Leverage analytics and market insights to provide reporting on payroll costs, trends, service performance, and risks, while staying current on emerging best practices, regulatory developments, and technology innovations in global payroll
 About the Team

The Global Payroll team at Swiss Re plays a key role in delivering accurate, timely, and compliant payroll services for employees around the world. Operating in a highly collaborative and international environment, the team partners closely with HR, Finance, and external providers to manage end-to-end payroll operations, statutory reporting, and governance across multiple countries. Driven by a mission to ensure a seamless payroll experience, the team upholds the highest compliance standards while continuously enhancing global payroll processes through automation, standardisation, and innovation.
 About You
 You are a seasoned executive and inspiring payroll leader who brings deep technical mastery combined with a bold strategic vision. You have built your career leading large-scale, complex, multi-country payroll functions and have a proven track record of driving transformation at an enterprise level. You operate with confidence at the C-suite level, influencing senior stakeholders and shaping organisational strategy. You are deeply committed to operational excellence, continuous improvement, and delivering an exceptional employee experience.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Extensive senior leadership experience in global payroll , with a demonstrable track record of operating at or near executive/C-band level, leading large, geographically dispersed payroll teams across multiple regions

• Deep expertise in multi-country payroll regulations, tax, social security and controls, with the ability to navigate highly complex compliance scenarios across jurisdictions at a strategic level

• Proven experience owning and transforming multi-country payroll operations (in-house and/or outsourced), including full accountability for service delivery, vendor governance, and strategic roadmap execution

• Experience working with global payroll providers at a senior governance level, including strategic vendor management, service performance oversight, and executive-level issue escalation

• Strong executive stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate at C-suite and board level across HR, Finance, Risk, IT, and external partners

• Good understanding of the payroll IT landscape and data flows (HR/finance/time/benefits), with hands-on payroll systems experience including processing, reconciliations, and exception handling

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills , including the ability to diagnose root causes, manage risk, and drive sustainable corrective actions with a high attention to detail

• Strong understanding of data protection and confidentiality requirements when handling employee and payroll information

• Adaptable, continuous learning mindset to stay current on regulatory changes, technology enablement, and best practices in global payroll

These are additional nice to haves:

• Additional languages (beyond English) relevant to key payroll locations

• Prior experience working for a payroll provider and/or in a payroll BPO environment
 For Slovakia, the monthly base salary range for this position is between 5,300 EUR and 8,800 EUR for a full-time role. The specific salary offered considers:
 - the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 - the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

As Global Head of Payroll , you will be at the helm of Swiss Re's end-to-end global payroll operations, accountable for delivering accurate, compliant, and timely payroll across multiple countries and regions. jobs.description:
Für unser Regional Pricing Team Life & Health Continental Europe suchen wir eine engagierte Aktuarin oder einen engagierten Aktuar mit Erfahrung im Pricing von Lebens- und Krankenversicherungsrisiken.

Wenn Du Freude daran hast, aktuarielle Expertise mit Kundenkontakt, strategischen Fragestellungen und kommerziellen Aspekten zu verbinden und dabei in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Über die Rolle

Als Pricing Actuary übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Kalkulation von Lebens- und Krankenrückversicherungsgeschäft in unseren europäischen Märkten mit besonderem Fokus auf Deutschland.

Du bringst hochwertige aktuarielle Expertise in funktionsübergreifende Teams und Kundenprojekte ein und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag sowohl zur Entwicklung von Neugeschäft als auch zur Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Portfolios.

Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus den Bereichen Underwriting , Client Management, Reporting und Produktentwicklung zusammen und entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für den Lebens- und Krankenrückversicherungsmarkt.

Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

• Entwicklung und Überprüfung von Kalkulationsgrundlagen sowie Rückversicherungskonditionen für Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft
 • Durchführung und Interpretation von Datenanalysen zur Schadenentwicklung und Portfolio-Performance
 • Sicherstellung der Profitabilität und Nachhaltigkeit bestehender Portfolios in Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams für Reporting und Experience Studies
 • Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden sowie internen Stakeholdern bei Pricing- und Produktentwicklungsinitiativen
 • Bereitstellung fundierter aktuarieller Expertise bei der Strukturierung und Umsetzung von Rückversicherungslösungen
 • Mitwirkung bei Best Practices sowie Unterstützung von Praktikantinnen, Praktikanten und Werkstudierenden bei fachlichen Fragestellungen
 • Eigenverantwortliche Mitarbeit an Projekten sowie aktive Mitgestaltung von Team- und Regionalinitiativen

Über das Team

Unser Regional Pricing Team ist Teil von Life & Health Continental Europe und verantwortlich für das Pricing von Rückversicherungsgeschäft über eine breite Palette von Produkten in verschiedenen Märkten, einschließlich Deutschland.

Wir arbeiten in einem stark vernetzten und funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld und kooperieren eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus den Bereichen Pricing, Client Management, Business Management, Underwriting , Claims und Reporting.

Wir arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Team, das von gegenseitiger Unterstützung und offener Zusammenarbeit geprägt ist. Neugier, Eigeninitiative und der gemeinsame Anspruch, hochwertige Lösungen zu entwickeln, stehen bei uns im Mittelpunkt.

Die Aufgaben sind anspruchsvoll und abwechslungsreich und bieten die Möglichkeit, unterschiedliche Märkte, Produkte und Rückversicherungslösungen kennenzulernen. Dabei kannst Du Dein aktuarielles Fachwissen weiter vertiefen, neue Perspektiven gewinnen und Dich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln.

Über dich

Du bist qualifizierte/r Aktuar/in (DAV, FSA, FIA oder vergleichbare Qualifikation) oder befindest Dich in der Endphase Deiner aktuariellen Ausbildung und verfügst über relevante Berufserfahrung, idealerweise im Pricing oder in der Rückversicherung.

Darüber hinaus bringst Du folgende Qualifikationen mit:

• Fundiertes Verständnis von Rückversicherungsstrukturen und/oder biometrischen Versicherungsprodukten
 • Sehr gute Kenntnisse aktuarieller und statistischer Modellierungsmethoden; Erfahrung mit R, Python oder vergleichbaren Tools ist von Vorteil
 • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie starke Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeit
 • Fähigkeit, Projekte eigenständig voranzutreiben und auch unter Zeitdruck qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu liefern
 • Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, effektiv mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten
 • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
 • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie die Fähigkeit, kommerzielle Diskussionen aktiv zu unterstützen

Idealerweise verfügst Du zusätzlich über:

• Erfahrung im deutschen Versicherungs- oder Rückversicherungsmarkt
 • Erfahrung in der fachlichen Begleitung oder Unterstützung von Praktikantinnen, Praktikanten oder Werkstudierenden
 • Kenntnisse einer weiteren europäischen Sprache
 Fühlst Du Dich angesprochen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

Für Deutschland liegt das Grundgehalt für diese Position bei einer Vollzeitstelle zwischen 69.000 EUR und 115.000 EUR. Das spezifisch angebotene Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• die Anforderungen, den Umfang, die Komplexität und die Verantwortung der Rolle

• das Profil des Bewerbers einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung

In dem Fall, dass Sie nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen oder diese deutlich übertreffen, kann das angebotene Gehalt unter oder über der ausgeschriebenen Spanne liegen. Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt können Sie Anspruch auf weitere Vergütungen und Leistungen haben, einschließlich eines attraktiven leistungsabhängigen Jahresbonus.

 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to take on a new challenge in a company that combines stability with genuine opportunity for growth? Do you want to build your expertise in the world of insurance and reinsurance, sharpen your skills, and be part of a collaborative, supportive team? If so, keep reading - this could be exactly what you've been looking for!
 About the Role

As a Back Office Administrator with French/German , you'll be at the heart of our Corporate Solutions operations, supporting underwriting units with their end-to-end business processes. This is a role where precision meets collaboration - you'll help ensure that our underwriting contracts are accurately reflected in our systems, that our processes run smoothly, and that our colleagues across EMEA have a reliable partner they can count on. If you enjoy working with data, communicating across cultures, and making a real operational impact, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

• Review and validate insurance documents to ensure accuracy and completeness, identifying and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner

• Update and maintain internal systems to accurately reflect underwriting contracts, ensuring data integrity at every step

• Work with data and Excel spreadsheets to support reporting, tracking, and operational tasks across the underwriting lifecycle

• Follow established guidelines and processes while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and sharing ideas with the team

• Collaborate and communicate effectively in French OR German with colleagues across multiple EMEA locations, building strong cross-functional working relationships

• Support policy administration by managing insurance policies covering both local and international clients

• Contribute to smooth operations during peak periods by prioritising tasks effectively and maintaining high-quality output even under pressure
 About the Team

Our team works closely with the underwriting community, and our mission is clear: ensure the correctness of data entered into our systems and keep operational processes running smoothly to resolve any issues related to policy administration. We manage insurance policies that span both local and international clients, making our work both varied and impactful. We are a diverse, collaborative group spread across EMEA, and we genuinely care about each other's growth and success. Here, you'll have the opportunity to learn, develop, and uncover your potential -finding real meaning and satisfaction in the work you do every day.
 About You

We're not looking for perfection - we're looking for curiosity, dedication, and a genuine desire to contribute. You bring a positive attitude to your work, take pride in getting the details right, and feel comfortable navigating a multicultural, fast-paced environment. You're someone who speaks up when you see a better way of doing things, and you know how to balance independent work with great teamwork. Whether you're early in your career or bringing some years of experience, what matters most is your mindset and your drive to grow.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Experience in a back office, administrative, or operations role, ideally within a corporate environment

• Proficiency in English and French OR German (both spoken and written) -essential for day-to-day communication with colleagues and stakeholders across EMEA

• Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools , particularly Excel and Outlook , for data management, reporting, and professional communication

• Strong attention to detail and numerical confidence - you're comfortable working with data, spotting inconsistencies, and ensuring accuracy in everything you produce

• Strong time management and organisational skills , especially the ability to prioritise effectively when workloads increase

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in financial services, insurance, or reinsurance

• A proactive, problem-solving mindset - you don't just flag issues, you come with ideas and solutions
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1,400 and EUR 2,300 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.
 #LI-Hybrid
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. jobs.title: Senior International Property Underwriter - Chicago
jobs.description:
Are you a highly motivated individual looking for an exciting opportunity to join our Commercial Property underwriting team in Chicago, Illinois? If you are looking for a prominent role where you can utilize your expertise and market knowledge in INTERNATIONAL PROPERTY UNDERWRITING, we want to hear from you!

About the Role :
 Our Property Team is looking for an international property underwriter with recognized experience and visibility in the Chicago Commercial Property insurance market and a successful track record in underwriting both global and domestic large, enterprise-sized corporations.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Manage a portfolio of accounts including fronted global property programs

• Analyze and underwrite exposures including Natural Catastrophe hazards

• Assess technical insurability regarding exposures and coverages on new offer and renewal submissions

• Prepare quotations, structure programs, and offer proposals in accordance with guidelines

• Use Swiss Re tools and systems for the development of terms and conditions

• Enter and maintain risk information into the various information systems and administer the accounts

• Establish and maintain a book of business as well as marketing and originating prospects

• Coach less experienced underwriters when necessary

• Lead internal (technical/organizational) and/or external (market/client development) projects

• Represent Swiss Re in meetings with clients, brokers, and other Swiss Re Group entities

• Build and maintain strong relationships with brokers, clients and team members

• Technical analysis of manmade and Nat Cat property exposures as well as policy terms and pricing metrics

• Structuring capacity deployment and negotiating key terms that align with our underwriting strategy
 About the Team :
 We are a diverse and inclusive team that works well in a collaborative environment while fostering and developing independent thought. Our team works with brokers situated in the Central Region of the United States. North American Retail Property is a foundational line of business for SwissRe Corporate Solutions that is at the core of our strong brand. Risk transfer solutions offered through this channel vary from ground up quota share, shared and layered, and single carrier placements. This team also works with our alternative risk transfer group to structure innovative and unique solutions for our clients and brokers.
 About You :
 You are a strong communicator, able to build partnerships with external customers and internal co-workers. You are an initiative-taker, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, team-focused environment, and deliver on tight deadlines. You are a strong negotiator, results oriented, and take responsibility for your decisions. We expect you to have the following business experience and skills:

• Minimum of 4-10 years' experience as an underwriter (of medium to large corporate accounts)

• Experience in the structuring and fronting of global programs preferred.

• Experience working with Captives a plus

• Knowledge of complex shared and layered program structures as well as 100% Single Carrier business

• Skills working across diverse occupancies including heavy manufacturing preferred

• In depth knowledge of insurance and commercial property underwriting in the central region

• Proficiency in the use of underwriting tools, applications, and guidelines

• Strong broker and client network in the local region

• Solid experience and understanding of Nat Cat and man-made risk management and loss prevention

• Negotiating skills and the ability to handle multiple deals in parallel
 Some travel within the region, including air travel, for client/broker meetings will be required. The role is located in our Chicago, IL office. Swiss Re has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office three days per week. The estimated base salary range for the Senior Underwriter level is $156,000 to $234,000. The specific salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity, specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

jobs.description:
Join our product team and be the bridge between business and technology in this exciting role! Are you passionate about transforming business requirements into impactful digital solutions? Join our dynamic team in Mexico City where you'll be at the heart of developing and maintaining our sophisticated in-house commercial insurance products, driving real business impact through innovative functionality!
 About the Role
 In this pivotal role, you'll bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation, ensuring our insurance products deliver exceptional value. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate complex requirements into clear specifications that guide our development process.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze and clarify business requirements and translate them into functional and technical specifications including business architecture, process maps, wireframes and data models

• Ensure comprehensive specification of User Stories with all required data and background analysis available to the entire team

• Design and define related test cases and support the Product Owner in creating effective acceptance criteria

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Platform Product Owners, Technology Leads, Business Process Managers, Business Architecture and the Data Office to maintain end-to-end consistency of system, process and information architecture

• Anticipate and analyze customer needs to develop effective problem-solving solutions

• Organize and prioritize the Product Backlog based on Product Owner guidance

• Own production support for one or more business applications, addressing user requests directly or triaging more complex cases to the development team

• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation on the corporate Wiki
 About the Team
 Our team is responsible for building products and solutions for the Corporate Solutions business unit. We work in a collaborative, innovative environment where your ideas will have real impact. We partner closely with colleagues around the globe, fostering a diverse and inclusive atmosphere where different perspectives help shape exceptional insurance products. As part of our team, you'll contribute to meaningful projects while developing your skills in a supportive, growth-oriented culture.
 About You
 You're a detail-oriented problem solver who thrives in collaborative environments. You have excellent analytical skills and can effectively translate between business and technical domains. You're proactive, customer-focused, and committed to delivering high-quality solutions that drive business value.
 We need you to bring in the following must haves:

• 5+ years of experience as a Requirements Engineer or in similar roles

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills

• Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and experience working in cross-functional product teams

• Proficiency in tools like Jira or similar Agile management platforms like Azure DevOps

• Proficient in Visio or other process mapping tools, with good knowledge of BPMN
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with Commercial Insurance products and processes

• Knowledge of insurance industry standards and regulations

• Experience with data modeling and database concepts

• Familiarity with API design principles

• Background in software development or technical implementation

jobs.description:
Are you a product-minded professional who thrives at the intersection of business strategy and digital delivery? Do you want to shape how underwriting governance comes to life across a global reinsurance leader? This is your opportunity to own a platform that touches underwriters across Swiss Re's entire organization — and make governance something people actually want to use.

About the Role

As the Underwriting Handbook Product Owner, you will be the driving force behind one of Swiss Re's most strategically important digital governance platforms. The Underwriting Handbook is a digital, user-centric tool that makes underwriting governance easier to find, understand, apply, and maintain — across Swiss Re's global underwriting teams.

You will own the product vision and roadmap, bridge the gap between business and technology, and champion adoption across underwriting communities and Business Units worldwide. This role sits at a fascinating crossroads: part strategist, part translator, part delivery lead — and entirely focused on making a real difference to how underwriters work every day.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Ownership & Roadmap

• Own the business product vision, priorities, and roadmap for the Underwriting Handbook, ensuring it remains aligned with Swiss Re's strategic underwriting governance objectives

• Proactively identify and resolve inconsistencies or implementation challenges across the Group, acting as the go-to person for product direction

• Translate underwriting governance needs, user feedback, and business priorities into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria

• Prioritize enhancements and fixes based on business impact and delivery feasibility, maintaining a well-groomed and outcome-focused backlog

Business–IT Translation

• Act as the key interface between Underwriting Governance, Business Units, and IT delivery teams, ensuring nothing gets lost in translation

• Ensure technology solutions accurately reflect underwriting workflows, governance needs, and user expectations

• Facilitate alignment on priorities, trade-offs, and design decisions — bringing the business perspective and constructively challenging unnecessary complexity

• Coordinate testing, validation, release readiness, and business sign-off for new capabilities, ensuring smooth and confident launches

Handbook Delivery & Adoption

• Drive delivery of the Underwriting Handbook as a practical, intuitive, and trusted source of underwriting governance content

• Collaborate with governance owners and subject-matter experts to structure content in a user-centric, accessible way

• Champion user adoption through targeted communication, training materials, feedback loops, and a culture of continuous improvement

• Support migration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of handbook content, keeping the platform current and reliable

About the Team

You will join the Underwriting Governance and Transformation team within Group Underwriting — a team at the heart of Swiss Re's ambition to continuously improve underwriting discipline, outcomes, and productivity across both P&C and L&H.

The team plays a critical role in shaping underwriting governance modernization, enabling AI-powered underwriting capabilities, and setting enterprise underwriting standards across Swiss Re's global organization. Working closely with underwriting governance and transformation leadership, this is a team where your contributions will have visible, lasting impact at scale.

About You

You are a pragmatic, product-minded professional who genuinely enjoys working where business strategy meets digital delivery. You have enough underwriting and governance fluency to earn credibility with subject-matter experts, and enough technology savvy to work confidently with agile delivery teams. You are structured and delivery-focused, but also curious and adaptable — comfortable navigating ambiguity and aligning diverse stakeholders around a shared vision.

You communicate with clarity and confidence: able to explain business needs to technical teams, and technology constraints to business stakeholders — without losing either audience.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 8+ years of experience in a product ownership, digital transformation, underwriting, or governance-related role, with a demonstrable track record of delivering digital products or platforms

• Proven ability to translate business needs into requirements, user stories, prioritized backlogs, and acceptance criteria in an agile or hybrid delivery environment

• Good understanding of underwriting workflows and the day-to-day needs of underwriters, sufficient to engage credibly with underwriting stakeholders and governance owners

• Hands-on experience working with IT / Data & Technology teams, ideally in a Product Owner, Business Owner, Business Analyst, or transformation delivery capacity

• Strong stakeholder management skills across business, governance, and technology functions — including the ability to facilitate alignment and navigate competing priorities

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with underwriting governance frameworks, including standards, referral processes, or authority frameworks

• Exposure to AI-enabled underwriting or digital transformation initiatives within financial services or reinsurance

• Formal agile or product management certification (e.g., CSPO, SAFe, or equivalent)

For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between 125'000 CHF and 188'000 CHF for a full-time role.

The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.description:
Dein Einstieg in die Welt der Life & Health Rückversicherung – mit echtem Impact!
 Du möchtest bereits während deines Studiums Einblicke in ein internationales Versicherungsumfeld gewinnen und aktiv an spannenden Projekten mitwirken? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenstelle genau die richtige Chance für dich: Bei uns lernst du nicht nur das Life & Health‑Geschäft aus nächster Nähe kennen, sondern trägst mit deinen Ideen und Analysen unmittelbar dazu bei, unseren Kunden und Swiss Re echten Mehrwert zu liefern.
 Über deine Aufgaben
 Zur Verstärkung unseres deutschen Markt-Teams im Life & Health Bereich suchen wir am Standort München einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d):

• Unterstützung bei der technischen Überarbeitung und Aktualisierung unseres Risikoprüfungs-Manuals

• Planung, Durchführung und Optimierung definierter Prozesse in unserem Kundensupport‑Tool

• Recherche- und Analyseaufgaben zu fachspezifischen Themen aus den Bereichen: Lebensversicherung, Public Health, Rückversicherung
 Dies ist eine hervorragende Gelegenheit, tief in das L&H‑Versicherungsgeschäft einzutauchen und direkte Einblicke zu erhalten, wie dein Beitrag die Arbeit unserer Kunden und unseres Unternehmens unterstützt.
 Über dein Team
 Du wirst in einem hoch motivierten, funktionsübergreifenden Team arbeiten. Wir verfolgen das Ziel, sehr ergebnisorientiert zu arbeiten. Die positive Beziehung zu unseren Kunden und Maklern in Deutschland und Österreich sowie unsere starke Marke sind die Grundlage für unseren Erfolg. Mit unserer Einstellung zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung wollen wir unseren externen Kunden und internen Kollegen schnelle, einfache und effektive Möglichkeiten zur Abwicklung von Geschäften in einem Umfeld bieten, in dem die Risiken aufgrund eines evidenzbasierten Arbeitsansatzes verstanden werden.
 Damit du dein Team gut kennenlernen und aktiv mit uns zusammenarbeiten kannst, wünschen wir uns eine regelmäßige Anwesenheit im Münchner Office.
 Über Dich

• Du hast Interesse daran, die Welt der Versicherungen und Rückversicherungen kennenzulernen.

• Du arbeitest gerne in multidisziplinären Teams, scheust keine Herausforderungen und bringst eigene Ideen aktiv ein.

• Du bist motiviert, lernbereit und arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig.

• Du hast Spaß an neuen digitalen Tools und bist technisch affin.

• Analytisches Denken und Organisationstalent zählen zu deinen Stärken.

• Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office (Excel und PowerPoint) sind Voraussetzung.
 Dauer : 6 Monate mit der Option auf Verlängerung, Beginn zeitnah
 Arbeitszeit : 20 Stunden / Woche (als Werkstudent)
 Die Position eignet sich auch als Praktikum von 3 - 6 Monaten bei einer 38-Stundenwoche.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about risk management and compliance? Do you have a keen eye for detail and strong analytical skills? We're looking for a motivated Compliance Officer to join our dynamic and global Assurance Team and help strengthen our compliance framework!
 About the Role
 As a Compliance Officer, you'll play a vital role in our second line of defense, helping to identify, assess, and monitor compliance risks across the organization. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your expertise in compliance while contributing to the integrity of our business operations.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Lead, design and execute compliance monitoring programmes and reviews

• Support the identification and analysis of compliance risks across the organization

• Identify and evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of existing controls mitigating compliance risks

• Monitor and track the timely resolution of identified compliance issues

• Prepare reports on monitoring results and compliance findings for senior management

• Support investigations, ad-hoc risk reviews and special projects as needed

• Provide compliance monitoring results for internal and external reporting

• Collaborate with team members and stakeholders across different business units and group functions
 About the Team
 Compliance Assurance is a global team responsible for providing assurance oversight of Code of Conduct, Global Compliance Frameworks and material local regulatory requirements across the Swiss Re Group on a risk-based basis. The team serves as the primary liaison with Group Internal Audit (GIA), Operational Risk Management (ORM), and other governance functions, facilitating coordination among risk and control functions and Compliance units in relation to Compliance Assurance activities.
 About You
 You bring sound judgement, professional scepticism, and the confidence to challenge constructively where needed. You are able to build trusted relationships with stakeholders while maintaining independence and objectivity in your assurance work.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent (qualification in Law, Business or Finance is a plus)

• 5+ years of experience in compliance, risk management, or audit in the financial services industry

• Understanding of compliance principles, monitoring and/or audit methodologies, and risk and control frameworks

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to work independently on monitoring exercises and projects

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in the (re)insurance industry, with exposure to global compliance, risk, or assurance teams

• Knowledge of conduct risks and/or financial crime risks

• Knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications (Excel and PowerPoint for data manipulation and analysis), data analytics tools (Power BI and Stargate) and interest in applying AI-enabled tools to enhance compliance monitoring activities

• Project coordination experience

• Additional language skills
 For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 58,000 and EUR 96,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In situations where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.

Are you ready to launch your career at one of the most respected reinsurance companies in the world? Do you have a passion for Life & Health insurance and a drive to make a real impact from day one? If you thrive in dynamic environments and love learning, this is the opportunity for you!
 About the Role
 This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience within a high-performing Life & Health Claims and Underwriting environment. As an intern, you will play a meaningful role in supporting our experts, contributing to the smooth running of day-to-day operations while developing a solid foundation in reinsurance. You will be exposed to a wide variety of tasks that will sharpen your analytical, administrative, and interpersonal skills.
 Key Responsibilities

• Accurate data capturing and case induction to ensure records are complete and compliant with internal standards

• Liaising with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure processes are followed and to deliver excellent, responsive client service

• Underwriting and claims case allocation, tracking, and reporting to support efficient workflow management across the team

• Maintaining set standards and targets, contributing to a culture of quality and accountability

• Life Guide and Claims Guide role allocation and password management, ensuring smooth system access for team members

• SharePoint updates and UCR administration duties

• Assisting with the preparation of presentations, client resource materials, and handouts that support client engagement and internal communications

• Seminar and event coordination, helping to plan and execute team and client-facing events

• Supporting ad-hoc duties as assigned, demonstrating flexibility and a proactive approach to team needs
 About the Team
 The Claims and Underwriting team is a dedicated and collaborative group operating within the Life & Health (L&H) division. The team is responsible for managing and processing Life & Health claims and underwriting cases, ensuring that clients receive accurate, timely, and high-quality service.
 About You
 We are looking for an enthusiastic and proactive individual who is eager to learn and grow within a fast-paced, professional environment. jobs.description:
About the Team and our Scope
 You will join the Data and Technology Finance area at Swiss Re, a team at the heart of a significant transformation in how finance data is sourced, managed, transformed, and consumed across the organisation.
 The role sits within Finance Data Foundation, the product area responsible for providing the data ingestion and transformation backbone that underpins finance. Our solutions enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed data flows that support critical finance processes, reporting, analytics, and decision-making.
 We believe that effective architecture is only possible with a strong understanding of the business processes, data, and people it supports. This role requires technical expertise, and you will work directly with other architects and engineering teams, but it is not a purely technical role. We are looking for someone who can connect technology solutions to real business needs, work closely with stakeholders, and design end-to-end solutions that are robust, pragmatic, and fit for purpose.
 About the Role
 We are looking for a Solutions Architect who combines technical depth with business curiosity. You will understand how finance works, translate complex needs into clear architectural direction, and partner with engineers, product owners, data specialists, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that are sustainable, scalable, and genuinely useful.
 As a Solutions Architect, you will develop a deep understanding of the end-to-end Finance data landscape. This includes how data flows into Finance from technical accounting and actuarial systems, how it is validated and transformed, and how calculations are performed to support reporting, analytics, and decision-making. You will build a sound understanding of the business processes, data products, platforms, controls, and people involved, enabling you to design solutions that are both technically robust and fit for real-world use.
 In the era of AI, we believe architecture must be grounded in evidence, not assumptions. You will validate solution designs with real data points, explore opportunities to use modern tooling and automation, and work directly with engineering teams to ensure solutions come to life as envisioned.
 This is not a role for a hands-off architect. We are looking for someone who stays close to delivery, engages actively with engineers and stakeholders, and is willing to go deep enough into the detail to make good architectural decisions.
 Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing and maintaining an end-to-end architectural understanding of how data flows into, through, and out of the entire Finance landscape including actuarial and risk systems.

• Proactively recognising optimisation opportunities across the Finance data landscape, including data flows, transformation logic, controls, platform usage, and delivery processes.

• Translating business and technology needs into clear, pragmatic solution designs that can be understood by engineers, product owners, data specialists, and senior stakeholders.

• Partnering closely with engineering teams to shape solutions, validate assumptions, remove ambiguity, and ensure architectural decisions are implemented effectively.

• Working with product owners and business stakeholders to understand finance processes, reporting needs, control requirements, and data quality expectations.

• Designing scalable, resilient, and well-governed solutions for data ingestion, transformation, validation, lineage, and consumption.

• Assessing solution options and making clear recommendations based on business value, technical feasibility, maintainability, cost, risk, and delivery impact.

• Identifying dependencies, risks, and architectural trade-offs early, and communicating them clearly to the right stakeholders.

• Promoting modern engineering and architecture practices, including automation, observability, reusability, documentation, and evidence-based decision-making.

• Using real data points, process insight, and stakeholder feedback to validate that solutions are fit for purpose and deliver the intended outcome.

• Acting as a bridge between business, architecture, product, and engineering teams, ensuring that solution direction remains coherent from concept through delivery.
 About You
 You are a pragmatic, curious, and delivery-minded Solutions Architect who enjoys working at the intersection of business, data, technology, and engineering. You are comfortable with complexity, but you know how to create clarity for others.
 You bring:

• At least 6 years of relevant hands-on experience in architecture, solution design or engineering within financial services

• Hands-on experience across the software development lifecycle, with a track record of working closely with engineering teams to ensure solutions are feasible, well-designed, and fit for purpose

• Strong data skills, including the ability to understand data models, data flows, transformation logic, data quality issues, lineage, controls, and how data is consumed by business processes, reporting, analytics, and downstream applications

• The ability to understand complex business and technology landscapes, identify the important details, and turn ambiguity into clear direction.

• The confidence to use diagrams, structured thinking, probing questions, and concise documentation to explain problems, options, trade-offs, and recommendations.

• The ability to move between strategic architectural thinking and detailed solution design, including dropping down into data flows, transformation logic, interfaces, controls, and implementation details where needed.

• Experience applying AI tooling effectively, accurately, and appropriately to improve analysis, design, documentation, engineering collaboration, or delivery outcomes.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and effectively across technical and non-technical audiences

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Preferably experience with our core technology stack of Apache Spark, Python, SQL and Databricks. Experience working with Microsoft Azure and integrating to and from SAP financial systems would be an extra advantage
 For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between CHF 128,000 and CHF 192,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. About the Role
 Are you a law student with an interest in law and the reinsurance industry? Would you like to use and broaden your knowledge in one of the best reinsurance companies in the world? Does the interaction with clients and stakeholders excite you? If the answer is yes then please join Swiss Re as a Working Student and gain hands-on experience at the intersection of law and business .
 You will gain insight into how legal expertise enables commercial decision-making in a global reinsurance business. We are looking for a highly motivated, ambitious Intern who will assist the Contracts P&C Team in London covering all markets in EMEA. This is a great opportunity to learn more about all lines of business and the variety of contracts in reinsurance business in general and more specifically about Property and Casualty.
 We are a diverse and international team of lawyers in four locations with a very high level of entrepreneurial spirit, energy and expertise, that we seek to complement and strengthen together with your support. At the same time, we gather more experiences, develop ourselves and have fun.
 Key Responsibilities

• Apply your legal skills to the development of our reinsurance contracts

• Align Swiss Re's reinsurance contracts with applicable law, regulations and internal requirements

• Contribute to our technology transformation journey by supporting the enhancement of our contract management IT infrastructure

• Develop and maintain training material

• Conduct legal and business research to support ongoing projects and strategic initiatives.

• Engage with and support initiatives involving young talent in the insurance industry, including networking and outreach activities.
 About you

• Currently in your penultimate or ultimate year of your LLB or enrolled in an LLM (or equivalent law degree) .

• Based in London and able to work from the Swiss Re London office.

• Strong interest in law, contracts and the reinsurance industry.

• Curiosity about how legal advice supports business decisions and underwriting.

• Ambitious, hands on team mate, who is curious and learns quickly.

• Excellent analytical skills with a keen eye for detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. An additional European language is a plus.

• Proactive, organised and able to manage multiple tasks independently.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
 Time Commitment
 Duration: 6-12 months with possible extension
 Working time: 15-20 hours / week
 Preferred start date: asap
 This is a long-term Working Student position . While there is flexibility to accommodate university commitments, such as examination periods, the expectation is a consistent average commitment of approximately 15-20 hours per week on average throughout the year .
 What We Offer

• A unique opportunity to work at the intersection of law, underwriting and business in a leading global reinsurance company.

• Exposure to complex commercial contracts, reinsurance wordings and real business decisions.

• An opportunity to develop both legal and commercial judgement by working alongside experienced lawyers and underwriters.

• Close collaboration with experienced legal professionals and business stakeholders across Swiss Re.

• Flexible working arrangements that can be coordinated around your academic schedule.

• A supportive, inclusive environment with opportunities to build your professional network and gain valuable industry experience.

jobs.description:
Are you early in your insurance operations career and interested in working in a global, fast-paced environment? Join Swiss Re Corporate Solutions and support Trade Credit Insurance operations across the transaction lifecycle. As part of a newly established back-end TCI Operations team, you will contribute to accurate processing, reconciliation, and control activities supporting global integration and ongoing operations.
 About the Role

jobs.title: Underwriter Engineering & Construction
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of risk in the evolving engineering and construction sectors?
 Join our Engineering & Construction team in Paris and grow your expertise while working on fascinating projects for our clients out of France. Develop your career path toward an underwriting position while making an impact in sustainable energy and construction sectors.
 About the Role
 In this position, you'll be assessing risks and negotiating insurance conditions for diverse projects in power generation, manufacturing, infrastructure, construction and renewable energy.
 We are open to any level of experience, as we offer development and will evaluate the level of seniority during the recruitment process. This can be from graduate level with a technical background or if you have a few years of experience in Insurance, Industry or Construction sectors already.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Assess risks and negotiate insurance conditions for projects in power, manufacturing, infrastructure, renewable energy and construction sectors

• Build and develop relationships with clients, brokers, and partners, acting as a trusted point of contact for Engineering & Construction insurance solutions

• Lead underwriting processes when acting in a lead capacity, ensuring rigorous technical analysis and sound decision-making

• Contribute to business development by actively representing Corporate Solutions and identifying opportunities to grow our presence in the market
 About the Team
 You'll be joining a team of experienced Senior Underwriters based in Paris, with deep expertise across the construction and engineering insurance market. Our team serves clients primarily in France, insuring their projects and assets on a worldwide basis — meaning the work is as diverse as it is impactful. You'll benefit from the knowledge and mentorship of seasoned professionals while also having the space to bring your own ideas and perspective. Beyond Paris, you'll regularly interact with Swiss Re Corporate Solutions offices across the globe, giving you a truly international dimension to your day-to-day work.
 About You
 You're curious, motivated, and eager to grow in the world of corporate insurance. You take initiative, communicate with clarity and confidence, and you understand — or are excited to learn — the dynamics of the Engineering and Construction insurance environment. You bring a technical mindset and a collaborative spirit, and you're ready to make a meaningful contribution from day one.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• You have an Engineering degree, preferably in mechanical, electrical, civil, or process engineering

• First experience in the industry, (re)insurance sector, or construction — whether as an Underwriter, Loss Adjuster, or in a technical role

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility with clients, brokers, and colleagues at all levels

• Fluent in both French and English, enabling effective engagement with our clients, colleagues.
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in the Construction & Engineering and/or Power & Utility sectors

• Knowledge of additional languages, which could be a valuable asset in our international working environment

• Willingness to travel occasionally
 Compensation & Work Model
 The estimated base salary range in France for this position is from EUR 62,000 to EUR 94,000.
 The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget.
 At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days
 We provide feedback to all candidates please check your spam folder.

• Contribute to the ongoing development of Swiss Re's global Competition and compliance frameworks, including policies, guidance, legal standards and governance.

• Monitor relevant legal trends and developments impacting the group's operations; and

• Engage and manage external counsel relationships.

• Support group-wide, business unit and cross-functional initiatives by providing practical legal input on strategic projects and emerging legal and regulatory developments.

 We are seeking an outstanding communicator, able to provide high-quality, timely and pragmatic legal advice, balanced with a clear focus on protecting the interests and reputation of Swiss Re. You demonstrate sound judgement, strong commercial instincts and are comfortable managing multiple complex cross-border matters.
 You are a proactive and collaborative lawyer who enjoys taking ownership, works well independently and builds trusted relationships across the business and with Legal and Compliance colleagues. You are curious, adaptable and keen to broaden your expertise, while delivering practical solutions in a fast-paced, international environment. Experience delivering legal training or presenting complex legal topics to non-lawyers would be an advantage.
 A high level of ethics, integrity and professionalism is essential.
 Education and qualifications:

• University degree and qualified lawyer admitted to practice in England & Wales or another jurisdiction within EMEA.
 Experience:
 • Minimum of 3+ years' post qualification experience in a financial crime legal advisory role with a specific focus on sanctions and/or competition law gained in a law firm and/or working as in-house counsel in a multi-national organisation.
 It would also be nice for you to have:

• Proficiency in other languages in addition to English
 If you are a committed standout colleague, able to work constructively with others, and enjoy engaging with colleagues across a diverse range of backgrounds, functions, and regions, we will be happy to get to know you!

 For London, the base salary range for this position is between 94,000 GBP and 140,000 GBP for a full-time role.

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.

 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

jobs.description:
Locations:
Windsor, CT, US |
Philadelphia, PA, US

Location: Windsor, CT | Philadelphia, PA

Are you a driven, commercially minded underwriting professional with deep expertise in international property? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your market knowledge and technical skills genuinely shape outcomes for large, complex clients? If so, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact on a high-performing team at one of the world's leading insurers.

About the Role
 Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is seeking a talented International Property Underwriter to join our New England/Mid-Atlantic Commercial Property team. In this prominent role, you will leverage your expertise and market relationships to underwrite sophisticated global and domestic property programs for large, enterprise-sized corporations. This is a role where your technical acumen, negotiation skills, and broker relationships will be front and center — and where your contributions will directly influence our portfolio performance and market presence.
 Key Responsibilities

• Manage a portfolio of accounts , including fronted global property programs, ensuring quality, profitability, and alignment with underwriting strategy

• Analyze and underwrite complex exposures , including Natural Catastrophe (Nat Cat) hazards, manmade risks, and diverse occupancy classes

• Assess technical insurability of exposures and coverages on new business and renewal submissions with a rigorous, data-driven approach

• Prepare quotations, structure programs, and deliver proposals in line with Swiss Re Corporate Solutions guidelines and risk appetite

• Utilize Swiss Re tools and systems to develop competitive terms and conditions and maintain accurate risk information across information platforms

• Build and gr ow a book of business through proactive marketing, prospecting, and origination of new opportunities in the New England/Mid-Atlantic region

• Structure capacity deployment and negotiate key terms that align with our underwriting strategy across shared and layered, quota share, and single-carrier placements

• Represent Swiss Re in meetings with clients, brokers, and Swiss Re Group entities, strengthening our brand and market presence

• Mentor and coach less experienced underwriters, sharing knowledge and supporting team development

• Lead internal and external projects , including technical, organizational, and client/market development initiatives

• Collaborate with the alternative risk transfer group to structure innovative and tailored solutions for clients and brokers

About the Team
 Our New England/Mid-Atlantic Commercial Property team is a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative group that values independent thinking as much as teamwork. We partner with brokers across the New England and Mid-Atlantic regions to deliver risk transfer solutions that range from ground-up quota share and shared and layered structures to single-carrier placements. North American Retail Property is a foundational line of business for Swiss Re Corporate Solutions — it sits at the heart of our brand and our value proposition to clients.
 We also work closely with our alternative risk transfer group to design innovative, bespoke solutions that go beyond the conventional. Whether you are deep in technical analysis or building broker relationships, you will find a team that supports your growth, respects your expertise, and celebrates creative problem-solving.

About You
 You are a confident communicator who builds genuine, lasting partnerships with brokers, clients, and colleagues alike. You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment, and take ownership of your decisions and results. You are comfortable managing multiple complex deals simultaneously and are energized by the challenge of structuring solutions for sophisticated, multinational clients.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 3–7 years of underwriting experience with medium to large corporate accounts, demonstrating a strong track record in commercial property

• In-depth knowledge of commercial property underwriting in the New England/Mid-Atlantic region, including market dynamics, broker relationships, and regulatory landscape

• Technical expertise in Nat Cat and manmade risk management, loss prevention, and the ability to analyze complex property exposures across diverse occupancy classes

• Proficiency in underwriting tools, applications, and systems , with the ability to develop accurate terms, conditions, and pricing metrics

• Strong broker and client network in the local region, with demonstrated ability to originate and grow a book of business
 Additional preferred skills and qualifications:

• Experience in the structuring and fronting of global programs , including knowledge of multinational insurance frameworks

• Familiarity with Captive insurance structures and alternative risk transfer mechanisms

• Experience with complex shared and layered program structures as well as 100% single-carrier business

• Background working across diverse and heavy manufacturing occupancies

• Strong negotiation skills with a track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals

• Comfort with regional travel , including air travel, for client and broker meetings

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 The estimated base salary range for this position is $108,000 to $162,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

jobs.description:
Join a team of security and technology professionals and help Swiss Re to fulfil its mission in making the world more resilient.

We're looking for an experienced, forward-thinking cybersecurity leader who will manage the production of detection content and incident investigation and help us to improve our incident response techniques. As a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst, you will be monitoring current threats by analysing and handling major cyber incidents, implementing standards and mentoring less experienced analysts.

What's more, you'll be working in a hybrid setup (50:50) , balancing work from home and the office premises (office presence required 2–3 days per week).

About the team
 Group Security & Technology Platforms (GSTP) brings together security, technology platforms and operational resilience to provide secure, reliable and scalable foundations for Swiss Re's business. The function ensures that security, resilience and engineering quality are embedded by design into how technology is built, operated and evolved across the organisation.

You will be part of the Cyber Defence team – made of passionate individuals who keep the company safe by going above and beyond in terms of preciseness and diligence. We oversee the maintenance of security operations, focusing on delivering high-quality detection monitoring and response solutions. Our team values innovation, collaboration and continuous learning, providing you with a stimulating environment to grow your expertise and make a tangible impact on our cybersecurity practises.

In your role, you will…

Play a pivotal role in safeguarding our organisation's systems and data and lead the charge in:

• Security monitoring – Oversee security operations, use advanced tools to monitor and analyse alerts, proactively detect incidents in real time, investigate and coordinate responses

• Incident response – Investigate security incidents, contain breaches and implement remediation strategies

• Operational excellence – Implement and maintain high operational standards

• Threat intelligence – Stay updated on cybersecurity threats and trends

• Team leadership – Mentor and guide a team of cybersecurity analysts, provide technical expertise, foster their development, support their growth and empower them to succeed. Act as a deputy to the Head of Monitoring

• Security strategy – Develop and implement security policies, procedures and controls to enhance the overall security posture of the organisation

• Security compliance – Ensure regulatory compliance with industry standards

• On-call duty – Participate in on-call rotations to address urgent matters outside of regular working hours

What we need from you…

Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of our requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are curious about the world of threat analysis and detection, we'll be more than happy to meet you!

Must-have:

Qualification & background

• Min. 5 years of work experience in cybersecurity as a Security Analyst or Incident Responder (preferably in SOC/CSIRT setup)

• In-depth knowledge of current threat landscape, offensive tooling and OWASP and industry-standard security framework, such as MITRE ATT&CK® techniques and Cyber Kill Chain

• Experience in malware and exploit analysis (or reverse engineering)

• Excellent oral and written communication skills in English

• Additional experience should include:

• Developing hypothesis-driven threat hunts

• Analysing various events, including but not limited to web traffic, underlying network protocols, malware, lateral movement TTPs (techniques, tactics, and procedures) or Microsoft and Linux security events

• Logfile correlation and analysis

• System and memory analysis

• Chain of custody and forensic acquisitions

• Major incident response or breach investigation management

Personal competencies

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

• Effective communication and presentation abilities to articulate and present complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Stakeholder management experience

• Demonstrated leadership experience

• Ability to work well in a fast-paced environment

Nice-to-have:

• Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology or a related field

• Experience developing in Python, Kusto or any other scripting language

• Knowledge of cloud security best practices and experience in cloud environment Azure or Amazon AWS

• Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, such as NIST, ISO or CIS controls.

• Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, EDR, DLP solutions

• Understanding of threat intelligence

• Certifications: CEH, CISM, CCSP, CISSP

For Switzerland the base salary range for this position is between CHF 128,000 and CHF 192,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

• Create concise, decision-oriented analysis on complex credit exposures and transaction-related risk assessments

• Monitor credit developments and engage proactively with internal stakeholders on emergingrisks

Our team members are based across Zurich, New York, Alpharetta, andBangalore, working in close collaboration across time zones to deliver consistent, high-qualityrisk oversight on a global scale.

 You are a quantitatively-minded professional who finds energy in transforming complex data intoclear, actionable insights. You bring proven analytical capabilities alongside strongcommunication skills — able to translate technical findings into compelling businessrecommendations. Naturally curious and detail-oriented, you thrive in collaborative environmentswhere your work has real, visible impact. You approach challenges with intellectual rigor,embrace continuous learning, and are energized by the opportunity to contribute to a globallyrespected risk management function.

• Strong quantitative and analytical background with solid academic credentials in a relevantfield such as Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline

• Advanced programming skills in Python, R, or Power BI, with demonstrated ability to deliverscalable solutions

• 2–5 years of relevant experience in financial risk assessment, data analysis, or relatedfields

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex technical findings clearlyto both technical and non-technical audiences

• Experience in credit risk assessment, capital markets analysis, or financial institutionscoverage

• Knowledge of credit rating methodologies and risk assessment frameworks

• Familiarity with financial statement analysis and credit modeling techniques

• Experience working within a global or matrix organization
