jobs.title: Contract Surety Underwriter - CorSo
jobs.description:
Must have Credit & Surety Underwriting experience
 Position location: Woburn, MA or Windsor, CT
 We are considering candidates in the NorthEast region.

Are you a surety underwriting professional who thrives on building relationships, analyzing complex financials, and making smart, strategic risk decisions? Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is looking for a talented Contract Surety Underwriter to join our dynamic team in Woburn, Massachusetts — where your expertise will directly shape the growth and success of our surety portfolio.

About the Role
 As a Contract Surety Underwriter, you'll be at the heart of our surety operations — evaluating risk, approving bonds, and cultivating the agent relationships that drive our business forward. This is a role where analytical rigor meets relationship-building, and where your decisions genuinely matter. You'll have real authority, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
 Key Responsibilities

• Underwrite contract surety bonds in alignment with Swiss Re Corporate Solutions Surety Group underwriting guidelines, assessing risk acceptability and strategic fit

• Manage daily bid and final bond requests, ensuring timely and accurate processing across your assigned territory

• Review new contract bond submissions for completeness and compliance with Swiss Re Corporate Solutions Surety Group policies

• Approve surety bonds within your assigned authority level, exercising sound judgment and underwriting discipline

• Oversee the fiscal status of accounts, including in-depth analysis of annual accounting audits and internal financial statements

• Maintain accurate documentation and credit information files in accordance with the Swiss Re Corporate Solutions Surety Group Procedure Manual

• Build and enhance agency relationships — schedule regular meetings with established agents, visit bond accounts, and actively identify and secure new agent partnerships

• Drive premium production growth by leveraging strong market knowledge and a proactive, client-focused approach

• Provide quarterly marketing updates to the VP/Branch Manager and contribute to special projects as delegated

• Attend regional meetings and represent the team with professionalism and expertise
 About the Team
 The Contract Surety team at Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is a dedicated group of underwriting professionals responsible for evaluating and approving contract bonds in accordance with our rigorous Surety Group policies. The team analyzes new account submissions across assigned territories, oversees the fiscal health of accounts, and maintains meticulous credit documentation — all while delivering exceptional service to our agent and contractor network. We are a collaborative, high-performing team that combines financial discipline with a strong market presence to deliver outstanding results.

About You
 You are a confident, detail-oriented underwriting professional with a passion for surety and a talent for building lasting relationships. You bring strong financial acumen, excellent communication skills, and the ability to balance analytical thinking with a commercially savvy mindset. You're comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and representing Swiss Re Corporate Solutions in the marketplace with energy and professionalism.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Minimum 3–5 years of contract surety underwriting experience , with demonstrated ability to assess and approve bonds within an assigned authority framework

• Strong quantitative and financial analysis skills, including the ability to review and interpret financial statements, accounting audits, and credit information

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word, with the ability to manage documentation, reporting, and data analysis effectively
 Additional preferred skills and qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree with an emphasis in business, finance, or accounting — or equivalent professional experience

• Proven track record in agency relationship management, including securing new agents and growing a book of business

• Strong marketing and business development skills, with the ability to engage contractor clients and identify new opportunities

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting updates and reports to senior leadership

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% to meet with agents and visit bond accounts

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 The estimated base salary range for this position in Woburn MA is $156,000 to $234,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

jobs.description:
Locations:
Schaumburg, IL, US |
Windsor, CT, US

Location: Open to Windsor, CT - or - Schaumburg, IL
 Accident & Health Underwriting Experience required.
 About the Team:
 As part of the Corporate Solutions (CorSo), North America, Accident & Health Team, you will join a team of experienced underwriters, focused on profit-oriented underwriting for Employer Stop loss coverage of self-funded employer health plans. Our Underwriters analyze claims experience, loss ratio, and other group-specific data to evaluate risk and develop optimal coverage solutions for our clients. We collaborate with the sales team, assigned client groups, and underwriting management to generate proposals, resolve account management issues, and service customers.
 About the Role:
 Underwriting:

• Production underwriter responsible for handling review of policies and procedures for both new and existing risks for self-funded employer health plans Accounts vary from Middle/Upper Middle Market, as well as Fortune 500 businesses.

• Understand and apply commercial insurance principles to complex situations

• Understand and apply data analytics to ensure we are adequately pricing for the risk under consideration

• Consistently demonstrate adherence to authority limits and underwriting controls to effectively manage exposure

• Able to demonstrate an in-depth understanding of both standard and non-standard policy wordings, extensions and limitations. Able to identify when to alter policy terms and the resulting impact

• Understand the drivers of performance within the portfolio and provide recommended steering actions that positively influence outcomes
 Customer Focus:

• Manage the definition, development and delivery of Accident & Health insurance products to ensure alignment with customer needs

• Accurately spot trends in early stages and collaborate to improve product offerings and financial results

• Review and challenge market/customer strategies, applying in-depth market understanding and innovative views

• Inspire a sense of urgency from the customer/ broker and CorSo decision makers to design win-win situations

• Consistently demonstrate effective influencing and negotiation skills to deliver the best outcomes for CorSo
 Team/Relationship Focus:

• Develop and maintain successful relationships with external clients and brokers

• Focus on building relationships across the team and wider organization. Actively work to support the end to end journey

• Coach and mentor less experienced Underwriters

• Inspire colleagues to embrace the mandate of their business areas in achieving Corporate Solutions’ strategy

• Lead internal (technical/organizational) and/or provide technical expertise for external (market/client development) projects and marketing efforts

• Support the business in developing appropriate analytical processes and outputs

• Prioritize new ways of working. Effectively deliver change, considering the full implementation impacts on end-to-end processes and learning from past projects. Recommend measures to reduce the impact of the market/underwriting cycle

About You:
 Educational/Professional:

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Finance, Actuarial Science) preferred or equivalent experience

• Minimum 5 years underwriting experience in Accident & Health

• In depth knowledge of insurance, with a focus on commercial Accident & Health underwriting

• Strong connection within the Employer Stop Loss insurance market

• Experience in producing a profitable portfolio of business within your underwriting authority

• Strong analytical skills to assess exposures, coverages, terms and conditions to appropriately assign underwriting decision on risks

• Knowledge and proficiency in the use of underwriting tools, applications, guidelines, and data analytics

• Keeps abreast of market environment and trends
 Values, Abilities, and Skills:

• Strong oral/written communications skills that focus on building relationships across the team, wider organization, and with clients

• Encourage collaboration in support of the end-to-end journey

• Strong negotiation, analytical skills, ability to multi-task with attention to details

• Prioritize new ways of working. Effectively deliver change, considering the full implementation impacts on end-to-end processes and learning from past projects

• Role-models continuous self-learning. Adept at learning and highly motivated to new skills to novel situations, gaining knowledge and expertise

• Constantly looking for the best option, identifying positives and negatives, to make effective decisions in complex and novel situations. Take accountability and support the team to ensure decision making happens at the right level

• Consistently demonstrate personal accountability for decisions, success and failures, challenges the status quo.

• Ideal candidates will distinguish themselves across multiple elements of Swiss Re's Leadership Model (thinks strategically, innovates, responds actively, collaborates, promotes excellence, stays accessible, fosters constructive debate, demonstrates an enterprise mindset, values diversity).
 Miscellaneous:

• Demonstrated proficiency of the English language. Spanish/French a plus

• Travel will be approximately 5% within the US

• Preferred locations are Windsor, CT or Schaumburg, IL. but open for the right candidate

• No relocation assistance will be offered
 For roles located within our Swiss Re offices, our company has a hybrid work model where the expectations is that you will be in the office three days per week on average.

titleByLocale.it: Join the Payments team as Cash & Bank Accounts Analista! (Hybrid)
titleByLocale.en: Join the Payments team as Cash & Bank Accounts Analyst! (Hybrid)
titleByLocale.de: Treten Sie dem Payments-Team als Cash & Bank Accounts Analyst bei! (Hybrid)
titleByLocale.fr: Join the Payments team as Cash & Bank Accounts Analyste! (Hybrid)

jobs.description:
Have you ever dreamed of handling piles of money? Then this is the right career opportunity for you. Why do we believe so? Well, we are the payments and receipts team, responsible for all incoming and outgoing payments of Swiss Re. We ensure that we pay out that hundred million dollar claim on time, but also that we don't miss a ten euro invoice for apples brought to our offices.

About the Role

If you join us, you will perform various tasks. Among others, you will process payments, perform account reconciliations, divide and accurate previously received installments. You will also actively communicate with banks investigating and resolving discrepancies in account movements. You will become a part of an outstanding team with team members that support each other and help new-joiners assimilate quickly. Team spirit is not just a phrase here.

Key responsibilities:
 • You will get your own portfolio of bank accounts, which will allow you to build professional relationships with your business partners.
 • Your main everyday tasks will be: control all entries on the bank account posted into the system, as well as reconcile bank statement balances with system balances to ensure they equal.
 • During first months in the team, experienced colleagues will train you to perform additional tasks, such as setup of partner´s banking details into internal master data system, splitting of received incomings from clients, or evaluating compliance risk for outgoing payments.
 • You will liaise with banks to make sure all payment details are clear and precise. We are positive that you will find exploring the way how banks communicate in their banking environment amazing.
 • At the end of every single day, month and quarter we will expect you to check if everything you processed was accurately posted and that all balances are on target.
 • The best part of our job is helping internal staff and external parties (suppliers, banks) resolve their queries. We make sure that you feel energized by rotating your daily agenda.

About the Team
 The Payments & Receipt team consists of 23 members of different ages and nationalities. The scope of our team covers Europe, and South Africa. Another aspect of our work is involvement in both global and team projects and initiatives. This gives everyone a chance to take part in sculpting the future way of doing things, it will inspire you to come up with and develop new ideas and creative solutions. We value team work, but also individuality and self-realization. So, do you go for it now?

About You
 Essentials:
 • Graduate of Secondary Economic School or Secondary Grammar school or University degree preferably in the area of finance, banking, accounting, economics.
 • Able to communicate in English fluently and see no challenge in writing emails or having phone conversations.
 • Familiar with MS Office (e.g. Excel, Word, Power Point) and have good verbal and written business social skills.

Nice to Haves:
 • Experience within finance/accounting/payments department.
 • Previous Experience with SAP system
 • Fluent in any other European language is an advantage for you.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1300 and EUR 2200 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.

 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. jobs.title: TA & CL Operations Analyst II
jobs.description:
We are looking for an agile, motivated, and dedicated individual who is ready to join our APAC Property and Casualty Operations Team in Bangalore as Reinsurance Operations Associate. APAC Operations is part of the P&C Re Operations Division, which handles the in-force reinsurance business from end to end.
 About the role:
 In this role, you will be responsible for handling end to end reinsurance accounts and claims, ensuring business deliverables are met (quality output within the turnaround times defined) through adequate understanding of Reinsurance contractual conditions. You will be working within a set framework of policies, processes and having potential opportunities to improve the same. You will own responsibility for an assigned portfolio of APAC clients and collaborate with business partners internally and externally. You will work in a dynamic environment by being capable of navigating through periods of change and ambiguity. You will also be encouraged to pro-actively pursue your career advancement by developing current and new areas of competence on own initiative.
 The role comprises, but not limited to, the following elements: -
 End-to-end processing of client Reinsurance accounts (premiums, claims, brokerage, etc.) ensuring deliverables and quality standards are met as defined

• Handling Reinsurance claims (simple to mid complex cases) through adequate understanding of Reinsurance Claims principles

• Capture accurate claim information by referring to claim advice reported by clients/ brokers and contract documents/conditions

• Maintain accuracy and quality parameters as defined by the process

• Rigorous follow up on outstanding queries/topics as per the defined process using the escalation matrix

• Problem solving/analysis for own portfolio, to determine underlying trends and following up on the same to deliver closure of issues

• Ensure financial transactions/payments are in adherence to processes and guidelines, quality management framework and key controls

• Timely collection of funds (Accounts Receivable), keeping track of financials within the assigned portfolio

• Ensure timely and accurate reporting and compliance with internal/external/regulatory requirements and/or commitments

• Manage own workload effectively to achieve agreed service/business standards

• Contact internal business partners and external clients directly (either written or verbal) to resolve any long pending operational issues like missing accounting information, incorrect data, payment delays, etc.

• You will work collaboratively across teams, functions and regions and support the requirements of internal clients

• Usage of PowerBI and data tools to assess and steer the portfolio
 About the team:
 You will join a very experienced and highly motivated Reinsurance operations team handling portfolios for diverse APAC regions. Our responsibilities require regular interactions with peers and experts from other locations, deliver best service and most value to our clients. With our continuous improvement mindset our aim is to provide our external clients and internal partners with fast, easy, and effective ways of conducting business within an environment where the risks are understood.
 About you:
 Minimum bachelor's in finance, Accounting, Insurance, or related fields, with min 3 years of work experience
 Flair for figures and proficiency in Excel
 Good verbal and written business interpersonal skills
 Being an agile team player with the ability to manage own workload and demonstrate a sense of Accountability, Responsibility and Commitment
 Ability to work together collaboratively, flexibly, and constructively in a team/group environment including in virtual set-ups
 Ability to challenge the status quo and manage multiple business partners (multi-cultural and cross functional teams in a virtual set-up)
 Insurance/Finance related certifications will be an added advantage
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

jobs.title: Actuarial Analyst- Regulatory Operations
jobs.description:
Are you an analytically driven actuarial professional who thrives on solving complex regulatory puzzles while leading and mentoring talented teams? If you're passionate about rate filings, compliance, and making a real business impact across a dynamic insurance portfolio, this could be the perfect next step in your career. Join Swiss Re Corporate Solutions and be part of a team that shapes the future of regulatory actuarial operations across Market Unit U.S.

About the Role
 As an Actuarial Analyst in Regulatory Operations, you will play a central role in managing and overseeing actuarial rate and rating rule regulatory compliance filings for Corporate Solutions U.S. Market Unit. This is a high-visibility role where your analytical expertise, communication skills, and collaborative spirit will directly influence business outcomes, regulatory relationships, and strategic initiatives. You will work at the intersection of pricing, compliance, and technology — making every day both challenging and rewarding.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead and manage rate and rating rule filings, rating factor adjustments, and rate implementation processes across multiple states, systems and lines of business

• Mentor and support the globally located Actuarial Services Unit (ASU) staff in Bangalore, India, providing guidance, solutions, and oversight on all ASU projects and deliverables

• Oversee and drive database creation and the ongoing update of generic filing templates to ensure accuracy and efficiency

• Negotiate with Departments of Insurance (DOIs) and coordinate with pricing actuaries to develop and deliver effective rate objection responses

• Lead rate filing planning discussions and proactively communicate updates to key stakeholders including IT, Underwriting, and Products teams

• Develop and apply in-depth knowledge of internal and external data sources, analytical tools, and actuarial methods to continuously enhance rate filing tools and processes

• Implement and manage the compliance rate audit process for all business units in the CorSo North America region, including new products and platforms

• Analyze, interpret, and communicate annual by-state, by-line-of-business rate indication analyses, rate implementations, and impact calculations

• Drive special projects in collaboration with the Pricing Actuarial Department, providing actuarial support around rate adequacy factors such as LCMs and trends

• Contribute to strategic initiatives and new product development within Corporate Solutions

About the Team
 The Regulatory Operations Actuarial Services Unit is a dynamic and collaborative team within Operations Corporate Solutions at Swiss Re. The team is responsible for overseeing actuarial rate and rating rule regulatory compliance filings across Corporate Solutions U.S. Market Unit, ensuring that all rate actions meet regulatory requirements across states and lines of business. Working closely with pricing actuaries, IT, underwriting, and a globally distributed team including offshore resources in Bangalore, the team plays a critical role in maintaining compliance integrity, driving regulatory audit processes, and supporting strategic pricing initiatives across the CorSo U.S. portfolio.

About You
 You are a motivated, detail-oriented professional with a strong analytical mindset and a collaborative approach to work. You bring a proactive attitude to problem-solving, are comfortable navigating complex regulatory environments, and have a proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, can manage multiple priorities under deadlines, and are energized by the opportunity to lead and develop globally distributed teams.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Minimum three years of work experience in actuarial activities, with demonstrated expertise in rate filings, regulatory compliance, or related mathematics areas

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Access, Visual Basic, and Power BI , with strong overall computer skills including Word, SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Outlook

• Ability to work both independently and in a team environment

• Strong knowledge of actuarial or mathematical methods and analytical tools , including the ability to develop and enhance rate filing tools using internal and external data sources

• Proven written and oral communication skills , with the ability to negotiate skillfully with regulatory bodies (DOIs) and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders

• Experience managing or mentoring teams , including the ability to work with globally located or offshore team members and manage distributed workloads
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Progress toward or completion of Casualty Actuarial Society (CAS) exams or other relevant insurance industry designations (e.g., CPCU)

• College degree in Mathematics, Actuarial Science , or a related quantitative field

• Familiarity with insurance regulatory environments across multiple U.S. states and territories

• Experience working with outsourced or offshore resources in a structured delivery model

• Ability to represent an organization at industry meetings and contribute to external forums

• Experience contributing to new product development or strategic product initiatives within a commercial insurance environment

The role will be located in our Kansas City, MO office. Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework, relocation assistance or visa sponsorship.

The estimated base salary range for this position is $76,000 to $114,000 . The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short- and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.description:
Have you ever dreamed of handling piles of money? Then this is the right career opportunity for you. Why do we believe so? Well, we are the payments and receipts team, responsible for all incoming and outgoing payments of Swiss Re. We ensure that we pay out that hundred million dollar claim on time, but also that we don't miss a ten euro invoice for apples brought to our offices.

About the Role

If you join us, you will perform various tasks. Among others, you will process payments, perform account reconciliations, divide and accurate previously received installments. You will also actively communicate with banks investigating and resolving discrepancies in account movements. You will become a part of an outstanding team with team members that support each other and help new-joiners assimilate quickly. Team spirit is not just a phrase here.

Key responsibilities:
 • You will get your own portfolio of bank accounts, which will allow you to build professional relationships with your business partners.
 • Your main everyday tasks will be: control all entries on the bank account posted into the system, as well as reconcile bank statement balances with system balances to ensure they equal.
 • During first months in the team, experienced colleagues will train you to perform additional tasks, such as setup of partner´s banking details into internal master data system, splitting of received incomings from clients, or evaluating compliance risk for outgoing payments.
 • You will liaise with banks to make sure all payment details are clear and precise. We are positive that you will find exploring the way how banks communicate in their banking environment amazing.
 • At the end of every single day, month and quarter we will expect you to check if everything you processed was accurately posted and that all balances are on target.
 • The best part of our job is helping internal staff and external parties (suppliers, banks) resolve their queries. We make sure that you feel energized by rotating your daily agenda.

About the Team
 The Payments & Receipt team consists of 23 members of different ages and nationalities. The scope of our team covers Europe, and South Africa. Another aspect of our work is involvement in both global and team projects and initiatives. This gives everyone a chance to take part in sculpting the future way of doing things, it will inspire you to come up with and develop new ideas and creative solutions. We value team work, but also individuality and self-realization. So, do you go for it now?

About You

Essentials:
 • Graduate of Secondary Economic School or Secondary Grammar school or University degree preferably in the area of finance, banking, accounting, economics.
 • Able to communicate in English fluently and see no challenge in writing emails or having phone conversations.
 • Familiar with MS Office (e.g. Excel, Word, Power Point) and have good verbal and written business social skills.

Nice to Haves:
 • Fluent in any other European language is an advantage for you.
 • Experience within finance/accounting/payments department.

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1300 and EUR 2200 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.

jobs.description:
Must have Credit & Surety Underwriting experience
 Position location: Midlothian VA
 We are considering candidates in the Mid-Atlantic region.

Are you a surety underwriting professional who thrives on building relationships, analyzing complex financials, and making smart, strategic risk decisions? Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is looking for a talented Contract Surety Underwriter to join our dynamic team in Woburn, Massachusetts — where your expertise will directly shape the growth and success of our surety portfolio.

About the Role
 As a Contract Surety Underwriter, you'll be at the heart of our surety operations — evaluating risk, approving bonds, and cultivating the agent relationships that drive our business forward. This is a role where analytical rigor meets relationship-building, and where your decisions genuinely matter. You'll have real authority, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
 Key Responsibilities

• Underwrite contract surety bonds in alignment with Swiss Re Corporate Solutions Surety Group underwriting guidelines, assessing risk acceptability and strategic fit

• Manage daily bid and final bond requests, ensuring timely and accurate processing across your assigned territory

• Review new contract bond submissions for completeness and compliance with Swiss Re Corporate Solutions Surety Group policies

• Approve surety bonds within your assigned authority level, exercising sound judgment and underwriting discipline

• Oversee the fiscal status of accounts, including in-depth analysis of annual accounting audits and internal financial statements

• Maintain accurate documentation and credit information files in accordance with the Swiss Re Corporate Solutions Surety Group Procedure Manual

• Build and enhance agency relationships — schedule regular meetings with established agents, visit bond accounts, and actively identify and secure new agent partnerships

• Drive premium production growth by leveraging strong market knowledge and a proactive, client-focused approach

• Provide quarterly marketing updates to the VP/Branch Manager and contribute to special projects as delegated

• Attend regional meetings and represent the team with professionalism and expertise
 About the Team
 The Contract Surety team at Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is a dedicated group of underwriting professionals responsible for evaluating and approving contract bonds in accordance with our rigorous Surety Group policies. The team analyzes new account submissions across assigned territories, oversees the fiscal health of accounts, and maintains meticulous credit documentation — all while delivering exceptional service to our agent and contractor network. We are a collaborative, high-performing team that combines financial discipline with a strong market presence to deliver outstanding results.

About You
 You are a confident, detail-oriented underwriting professional with a passion for surety and a talent for building lasting relationships. You bring strong financial acumen, excellent communication skills, and the ability to balance analytical thinking with a commercially savvy mindset. You're comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and representing Swiss Re Corporate Solutions in the marketplace with energy and professionalism.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Minimum 3–5 years of contract surety underwriting experience , with demonstrated ability to assess and approve bonds within an assigned authority framework

• Strong quantitative and financial analysis skills, including the ability to review and interpret financial statements, accounting audits, and credit information

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word, with the ability to manage documentation, reporting, and data analysis effectively
 Additional preferred skills and qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree with an emphasis in business, finance, or accounting — or equivalent professional experience

• Proven track record in agency relationship management, including securing new agents and growing a book of business

• Strong marketing and business development skills, with the ability to engage contractor clients and identify new opportunities

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting updates and reports to senior leadership

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% to meet with agents and visit bond accounts

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 The estimated base salary range for this position in Midlothian VA is $156,000 to $234,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.description:
Are you a master of organization, a champion of efficiency, and someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment? If you are the kind of professional who anticipates needs before they arise, keeps multiple plates spinning with ease, and brings calm confidence to even the busiest of days — we want to hear from you. Join Swiss Re's Asset Management division in New York City and play a pivotal role in supporting some of the most dynamic leaders in the industry.
 About the Role
 As an Executive Assistant within Swiss Re's Asset Management division, you will be the operational backbone for several Managing Directors and their teams across three distinct investment areas. This is far more than a traditional support role — you will be a trusted partner, a strategic coordinator, and a key connector across teams and leadership levels. Your ability to manage complexity, maintain confidentiality, and deliver with precision will directly enable the success of the leaders and teams you support.
 Key responsibilities include :

• Screen and prioritize incoming emails, visitor requests, and inquiries, evaluating relevance and importance, and directing them to the appropriate team members with sound judgment

• Compose, edit, and format correspondence, reports, and confidential documents from brief instructions or notes, ensuring accuracy and professionalism at all times

• Prepare agendas and meeting materials , take and transcribe minutes, and distribute final meeting notes with timely follow-up on action items

• Manage complex calendars for multiple senior leaders, arranging travel, meetings, conference calls, visitor registrations, conference room bookings, and catering logistics

• Coordinate intricate travel arrangements , including international itineraries, ensuring all logistics are seamlessly executed and process related expenses

• Produce high-quality reports and presentations using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel to support leadership communications and business needs

• Contribute to special projects across Asset Management functional areas and in support of senior leadership initiatives

• Provide backup support to fellow Executive Assistants, fostering a collaborative and resilient team environment

• Assist with event planning in a corporate setting, coordinating logistics and ensuring smooth execution of internal and external events
 About the Team

This role sits within Swiss Re's Asset Management division — a globally connected, intellectually driven organization responsible for managing Swiss Re's significant investment portfolio. You will provide dedicated administrative support to the Managing Directors of three distinct teams, each with its own focus and global reach:
 Corporate Development & Alternative Capital Partners
 This global team, overseen by the Group Head of Corporate Development & Strategic Investments, encompasses Corporate Development and Alternative Capital Partners. You will provide administrative support to the Head of this division, based in New York City, across a wide range of strategic investment and corporate development activities.
 Investment Strategy & Public Fixed Income
 This global team operates across a broad and diversified range of activities, organized around Investment Strategy, Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA), Derivative Structuring and Execution, and Public Fixed Income. You will support the Head of Investment Strategy & Public Fixed Income, based in New York City, as this team navigates complex and dynamic market environments.
 Private Debt
 This global team is responsible for infrastructure investment, commercial mortgage lending, and middle-market loans. You will provide administrative support to the Head of Private Debt, based in New York City, as the team manages a sophisticated and diversified private debt portfolio.

You bring a high level of energy, discretion, and intellectual curiosity to everything you do. You are equally comfortable working independently and collaborating across teams, and you have a natural ability to build trusted relationships at all levels of an organization. You thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and bring a solutions-oriented mindset to every situation.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements :

• 8–10 years of direct experience supporting senior executives in a corporate environment, with a demonstrated track record of managing complex, high-volume administrative responsibilities

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite — including Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint — with the ability to produce polished reports, presentations, and correspondence independently

• Exceptional calendar and travel management skills , including experience coordinating complex, multi-leg international travel arrangements and managing the schedules of multiple senior leaders simultaneously

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills , with the ability to compose and edit correspondence, meeting materials, and reports with accuracy, clarity, and professionalism

• Strong organizational and time management abilities , with a proven capacity to prioritize, multi-task, and deliver results under tight deadlines and in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment

Additional nice to haves :

• Experience in event planning within a corporate environment, including coordinating logistics for internal and external meetings and events

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification, demonstrating a strong academic foundation

• Experience working within financial services , asset management, or a similarly complex and regulated industry

Join Swiss Re's Asset Management division in New York City and play a pivotal role in supporting some of the most dynamic leaders in the industry.
About the Role
As an Executive Assistant within Swiss Re's Asset Management division, you will be the operational backbone for several Managing Directors and their teams across three distinct investment areas. This is far more than a traditional support role — you will be a trusted partner, a strategic coordinator, and a key connector across teams and leadership levels. Your ability to manage complexity, maintain confidentiality, and deliver with precision will directly enable the success of the leaders and teams you support.
Key responsibilities include :

• Screen and prioritize incoming emails, visitor requests, and inquiries, evaluating relevance and importance, and directing them to the appropriate team members with sound judgment

• Compose, edit, and format correspondence, reports, and confidential documents from brief instructions or notes, ensuring accuracy and professionalism at all times

• Prepare agendas and meeting materials , take and transcribe minutes, and distribute final meeting notes with timely follow-up on action items

• Manage complex calendars for multiple senior leaders, arranging travel, meetings, conference calls, visitor registrations, conference room bookings, and catering logistics

• Coordinate intricate travel arrangements , including international itineraries, ensuring all logistics are seamlessly executed and process related expenses

• Produce high-quality reports and presentations using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel to support leadership communications and business needs

• Contribute to special projects across Asset Management functional areas and in support of senior leadership initiatives

• Provide backup support to fellow Executive Assistants, fostering a collaborative and resilient team environment

• Assist with event planning in a corporate setting, coordinating logistics and ensuring smooth execution of internal and external events
About the Team

This role sits within Swiss Re's Asset Management division — a globally connected, intellectually driven organization responsible for managing Swiss Re's significant investment portfolio. You will provide dedicated administrative support to the Managing Directors of three distinct teams, each with its own focus and global reach:
Corporate Development & Alternative Capital Partners
This global team, overseen by the Group Head of Corporate Development & Strategic Investments, encompasses Corporate Development and Alternative Capital Partners. You will provide administrative support to the Head of this division, based in New York City, across a wide range of strategic investment and corporate development activities.
Investment Strategy & Public Fixed Income
This global team operates across a broad and diversified range of activities, organized around Investment Strategy, Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA), Derivative Structuring and Execution, and Public Fixed Income. You will support the Head of Investment Strategy & Public Fixed Income, based in New York City, as this team navigates complex and dynamic market environments.
Private Debt
This global team is responsible for infrastructure investment, commercial mortgage lending, and middle-market loans. You will provide administrative support to the Head of Private Debt, based in New York City, as the team manages a sophisticated and diversified private debt portfolio.
About You

You are a seasoned, proactive, and highly adaptable professional who takes pride in delivering exceptional support to senior leaders. You bring a high level of energy, discretion, and intellectual curiosity to everything you do. You are equally comfortable working independently and collaborating across teams, and you have a natural ability to build trusted relationships at all levels of an organization. You thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and bring a solutions-oriented mindset to every situation.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements :

• 8–10 years of direct experience supporting senior executives in a corporate environment, with a demonstrated track record of managing complex, high-volume administrative responsibilities

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite — including Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint — with the ability to produce polished reports, presentations, and correspondence independently

• Exceptional calendar and travel management skills , including experience coordinating complex, multi-leg international travel arrangements and managing the schedules of multiple senior leaders simultaneously

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills , with the ability to compose and edit correspondence, meeting materials, and reports with accuracy, clarity, and professionalism

• Strong organizational and time management abilities , with a proven capacity to prioritize, multi-task, and deliver results under tight deadlines and in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment

Additional nice to haves :

• Experience in event planning within a corporate environment, including coordinating logistics for internal and external meetings and events

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification, demonstrating a strong academic foundation

• Experience working within financial services , asset management, or a similarly complex and regulated industry

• Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with the utmost discretion and professionalism

• Collaborative team spirit with a flexible, can-do attitude and the willingness to step in wherever needed to support team success
The estimated base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $150,000. titleByLocale.en: IT Service Manager with Project Management
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de services informatiques avec gestion de projet

jobs.description:
About the Role
 At Swiss Re, technology and service excellence enable our business to operate efficiently and deliver value globally. We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused IT Service Manager with Project Management to drive service quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across our Group Functions technology landscape.
 This role combines IT Service Management with Project Management responsibilities . You will act as a key connector between business stakeholders, IT teams, and external service providers, ensuring high-quality service delivery while also leading service improvement initiatives and projects of varying complexity and scale.
 Success in this role requires strong stakeholder management, structured problem-solving, and the ability to coordinate diverse teams to deliver sustainable outcomes. You will have the opportunity to influence service performance across the organization while driving projects thatimprove our application landscape, processes, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
 What You'll Do
 Drive Service Quality Excellence

• Ensure adherence to Incident and Problem Management and related IT Service Management processes across supported services.

• Monitor service quality and operational performance, proactively addres high-priority issues, recurring service challenges and overdue incidents.

• Facilitate effective resolution of service issues, with a strong focus on customer experience and sustainable outcomes.

• Analyze and communicate service performance trends, supporting data-driven decision making and continous improvement initatives.

• Promote consistent service governance and operational excellence.
 Manage Service Performance

• Monitor and evaluate service performance at organizational and squad level against agreed KPIs and SLAs, identifying continous improvement opportunities.

• Support regular service reviews and performance reporting with vendors and stakeholders.

• Identify service gaps and coordinate corrective actions with relevant stakeholders and service providers.

• Build productive relationships with internal and external IT service providers and act as a key coordination point between delivery teams and service providers.
 Manage Projects & Lead Service Improvements

• Lead and coordinate small to medium-sized projects and service improvement initiatives from planning through execution and implementation.

• Manage larger projects and coordinate stakeholders across multiple teams.

• Drive implementation of process and governance changes and operational excellence initatives across the organization.

• Support service change adoption and transition of project deliverables into operational support.

• Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and service enhancement to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
 What You Bring
 Required Qualifications

• Experience in IT Service Management, IT Operations, or a related area.

• Understanding of Incident and Problem Management processes.

• Experience working with ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow or similar tools.

• Experience supporting projects or service improvement initiatives.

• Customer-oriented mindset with a focus on service excellence.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and drive tasks to completion.
 Nice to Have

• Exposure to ITIL practices or certifications, as well as PRINCE2 or similar.

• Familiarity with reporting and data visualization tools such as Power BI.
 Why Swiss Re?

• Be part of a leading global reinsurer and technology-driven organization.

• Gain exposure to enterprise-scale service management and vendor governance.

• Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across multiple countries and cultures.

• Contribute to meaningful service improvements that impact the entire organization.

• Grow your career in an environment that values learning, innovation, and collaboration.

• Enjoy a flexible and inclusive workplace with hybrid working arrangements.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,200 and EUR 3,700 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of work through cutting-edge AI and digital workplace technologies? Do you thrive at the intersection of innovation, data, and people? If so, this is your opportunity to make a real impact at one of the world's leading reinsurance companies. Join us and help redefine how over 14,000 employees connect, collaborate, and create value — every single day
 About the Role
 Step into a pivotal role within Swiss Re's Digital Workplace team, where you'll be at the forefront of AI-powered workplace transformation. As a Senior Workplace Engineer with a focus on Workplace AI and Data, you'll co-lead the strategy, adoption, governance, and delivery of intelligent workplace capabilities — with a spotlight on Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, and next-generation agentic AI platforms.
 This is not just an engineering role — it's a senior technical leadership role focused on the safe, secure, compliant, and scalable implementation of Workplace AI capabilities. You will drive business value, influence cross-functional teams, define guardrails and controls, and ensure AI solutions are delivered in line with security, compliance, regulatory, and governance requirements.
 Key Responsibilities

• Drive platform evolution by identifying, evaluating, and deploying new Workplace AI and Microsoft 365 capabilities, processes and solutions aligned with business requirements

• Lead design and implementation of robust AI and M365 security, governance, and compliance controls, translating regulatory requirements such as the EU AI Act, GDPR, and internal risk policies into technical controls and operating procedures

• Co-lead the strategy and adoption of AI-powered workplace tools such as Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT Enterprise, translating technology into measurable business value

• Monitor and respond to fast-paced developments in the Workplace AI and agentic space, maintaining active engagement with vendors and internal stakeholders

• Leverage data platforms such as Palantir Foundry and MS Power Platform to drive data-informed workplace decisions and visualisations

• Hands-on agentic implementation with Copilot Studio, ChatGPT Enterprise and other platforms.

• Continuously upskill , improve controls and procedures, and actively share knowledge across teams to foster a culture of learning and innovation
 About the Team
 We in Digital Workplace (DWP) set out to make it easy for more than 14,000 employees to seamlessly connect with people, ideas, and expertise — within and beyond Swiss Re.
 Our team is built around the Microsoft 365, Workplace AI solutions, and related services — spanning design, architecture, development, integration, and orchestration across teams and internal partners. We believe the key to success lies in deeply understanding the business needs of our internal clients, identifying where technology can add real value, and focusing on how people will adopt and embrace change.
 To support this, we are continuously redefining the way we work. DWP is an early adopter of agile methodologies and agile leadership within Swiss Re — and we're proud of it. We are a diverse, passionate team of experts who genuinely welcome professionals who bring curiosity, drive, and experience to help us deliver world-class solutions. Come join us on our journey!
 About You
 We are looking for a self-starter with a can-do, hands-on, and end-to-end mentality — someone who is adaptable, curious, and ready to challenge colleagues and the status quo in the best possible way. You thrive in an environment where no two days are alike, engaging regularly with new requirements and topics alongside a diverse team of experts. You bring a track record of successful delivery in complex, fast-paced environments and are energised by the opportunity to create real impact.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Expert knowledge of Workplace AI and agentic architecture and solutions (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise), including the ability to translate these tools into tangible business value and measurable impact

• Advanced knowledge of data management and visualisation , including hands-on experience with tools such as MS Power Platform and Palantir Foundry

• Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft 365 platform and services , including related security, governance, and compliance capabilities such as Microsoft Purview

• Advanced automation and scripting capabilities using PowerShell and Power Automate, including experience with modern DevOps technologies and CI/CD methodologies

• Good working knowledge of Azure Cloud, Networking, Identity and Access Management, as well as provisioning, authorisation, and authentication concepts

• Strong understanding of regulatory requirements impacting AI solutions , including GDPR, EU AI Act, and enterprise governance practices
 Hands on experience with advanced agentic platforms such as ChatGPT Enterprise and Copilot Studio

• Development experience using a modern programming language (e.g., C#, JavaScript, Python)

• Fluent English with excellent communication skills at all levels of the organisation and beyond
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience working in a global enterprise environment , preferably within the insurance or financial services sector

• Familiarity with eDiscovery, Compliance Capture, and Risk Management methodologies

• Experience working in agile SCRUM methodology
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 60,000 and EUR 100,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

• Drive platform evolution by identifying, evaluating, and deploying new Workplace AI and Microsoft 365 capabilities, processes and solutions aligned with business requirements

jobs.title: Application Support Engineer II
jobs.description:
About the Team

This team is responsible for second level user support in a global landscape. The Application Support Engineer will take a lead in providing primary support to Swiss Re's Corporate Solutions business users, covering primarily ( North America and Latin America or EMEA ) as part of a team that supports a Global community. This position is to provide great service to our internal customers, by monitoring and managing applications globally, to maximize availability, to alert internal customers to outages, escalating service affecting issues as appropriate and to restore service as quickly as possible through own efforts, or through appropriate referral.

You will have the opportunity to become a functional expert in the end-to-end process and system landscape of a commercial insurance company building a strong base of knowledge. The application landscape is dynamic and the support this team will provide will evolve over time.

You will work collaboratively in a globally distributed team environment. The role will report to the Regional Lead responsible.

About the Role

• Provide support through Incident Management. Incident Management includes identifying, analyzing and correcting the incident from recurring in the future. Either technical or functional issues cause incidents. Incidents disrupt the business and your goal is to restore normal service operations as quickly as possible. You will be the users advocate so you will need to listen, understand their incident and see it to resolution. Through your learnings, you will become an expert of the functional applications as well as the business processes used.

• Provide technical analysis. Our application landscape is broad and consists of multiple applications which are integrated. You will need to understand the technical dependencies of these applications in order to support the user community with their issues.

• Prepare to take support over from the Development Teams. For each application onboarded, there is a significant amount of time planned for knowledge transfer from the current support teams. You will need to listen, understand and document what you learn. You will need to apply these learnings throughout the job.

• Monitor the health of the applications. If there is a degradation in performance, you will need to take the steps to rectify it. This includes coordination with other parties such as the Major Incident Management team and Application Development Team. You may need to restart servers or flush messaging queues. This will require experience with technical issue troubleshooting and a solid understanding of the end-to-end application and infrastructure landscape. Requires the ability to interact intelligently with technical teams (i.e. application development, network, database, cloud operations etc.) and guide them to issue resolution. In cases of application outages, you will need to manage unplanned user communications.

• Problem Management Oversight. This includes analysis and coordination with other teams until the problem is fully resolved. A problem could be a cluster of similar incidents given to the dedicated application team to resolve. Users could have been given a workaround, but you will be the advocate for the customer to make sure their incident is fully resolved even after a work around is provided.

• Interact with users and members from other teams. During Incident & Problem Management, the users will depend on you to see their incidents are resolved. This could depend on you reaching out to other teams or users to obtain the information to "fix" the problem. You will need to communicate with them via email, instant messaging and phone calls. Doing this successfully will build your network of resources.

• Propose System Improvement Candidates. You will look for opportunities and propose application changes with a goal to reduce the volume of tickets raised by users and increase the customer experience within the applications

• As an Application Support Engineer, you will be a role model and mentor to the other members of the team. The team will look to you to take on the more complex incidents and lead the support of the more complex applications. In addition, you will be responsible for occasional project work assigned by the Regional Lead.

About You

• Ability to speak and write English fluently

• Obtained a four-year college degree or equivalent is highly preferred

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in an equivalent position

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Customer and people relationship skills

• Knowledge of Commercial Insurance is a plus

• Business acumen and mindset – Foundational understanding of business and how IT supports the delivery of business goals. Seeks to understand the end-to-end process, needs of business teams, and utilizes that knowledge to advocate for them through the issue resolution process.

• Highly motivated individual who can think analytically and is enthusiastic to learn new things quickly

• Ability to complete work independently or in cooperation with others

• Organized and able to work effectively under tight deadlines

• Technical aptitude and mindset - Understands fundamentals of software development (i.e. programming, database, network, etc) though no programming will be required in the role. Must be willing to learn specific technical skills (i.e. server restarts, clearing queues) that will allow for resolution of major issues. Ability to identify root cause of issues in a cloud-based environment is a plus.

• Ability and willingness to transfer knowledge and experience to colleagues

• Actively offer assistance to others, seeks opportunities to “pitch in” and help colleagues

• Demonstrates willingness and initiative to seek new knowledge and tasks, question current processes, and suggest improvements

**Please send the resumes in English

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in an equivalent position

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Customer and people relationship skills

• Knowledge of Commercial Insurance is a plus

• Business acumen and mindset – Foundational understanding of business and how IT supports the delivery of business goals. Seeks to understand the end-to-end process, needs of business teams, and utilizes that knowledge to advocate for them through the issue resolution process.

• Highly motivated individual who can think analytically and is enthusiastic to learn new things quickly

• Ability to complete work independently or in cooperation with others

• Organized and able to work effectively under tight deadlines

• Technical aptitude and mindset - Understands fundamentals of software development (i.e. programming, database, network, etc) though no programming will be required in the role. Must be willing to learn specific technical skills (i.e. server restarts, clearing queues) that will allow for resolution of major issues. Ability to identify root cause of issues in a cloud-based environment is a plus.

• Ability and willingness to transfer knowledge and experience to colleagues

• Actively offer assistance to others, seeks opportunities to “pitch in” and help colleagues

• Demonstrates willingness and initiative to seek new knowledge and tasks, question current processes, and suggest improvements

jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on IT professional who thrives on solving real-world technical challenges, building strong relationships, and keeping the wheels of a global organisation turning smoothly? At Swiss Re, we're looking for a Field Services Engineer who brings both technical expertise and a natural ability to lead — someone who can be the go-to person for IT support in Munich while also stepping up as a local team leader. If you love variety, ownership, and making a tangible difference every day, this could be your next great move.
 About the Role
 As a Field Services Engineer based in Munich, you'll be at the heart of Swiss Re's local IT operations — delivering expert on-site and remote support, managing assets, coordinating with vendors and contractors, and ensuring our colleagues can work seamlessly every day. Beyond your technical responsibilities, you'll take on a local team leadership role, acting as the key point of contact for contractors and overseeing local vendor contracts. You'll be a trusted partner to the business, a knowledge champion within the team, and a driving force behind service excellence.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead locally: Act as the local team leader for the Munich site, providing guidance and coordination to on-site contractors and ensuring consistent service delivery standards.

• Manage vendor relationships: Oversee local vendor contracts, coordinate service agreements, and act as the primary liaison for local IT suppliers and third-party providers.

• Resolve incidents and requests: Address and create incident tickets from the area queue, document resolutions, assign tickets to the appropriate transfer groups, and apply workarounds and solutions in a timely manner.

• Fulfil service requests: Validate and approve hardware and software requests, ensuring alignment with policy guidelines; educate and advise requestors where needed.

• Asset and inventory management: Maintain accurate records in the asset management tool, handle device repairs with vendors, manage hardware replacements, donations of old hardware, and disposal of electronic waste.

• Workplace provisioning: Execute the procurement and staging of Swiss Re workplace hardware and software, including decommissioning of devices when required.

• Provide remote and on-site support: Deliver timely, effective support adhering to departmental standards, policies, and OLAs, minimising the impact of incidents and service failures on business operations.

• Support meetings and events: Provide meeting room support, lend and administer loaned equipment, and instruct travelling users on IT setups.

• Knowledge management: Ensure knowledge articles published in the database meet technical and communication requirements; share expertise with the team and with customers.

• Communicate effectively: Manage customer expectations with conflicting priorities, communicating clearly and in a timely manner with both internal and external IT units and business customers.
 About the Team
 The Field Services UK and Central EMEA team is a dynamic group of IT professionals dedicated to keeping Swiss Re's workforce connected and productive. Based in Munich, the local team delivers expert on-site IT support for Swiss Re employees, covering laptops, printers, mobile devices, multimedia systems, and local IT projects — ensuring seamless operations for meetings, events, and day-to-day business. The team works collaboratively across locations, partnering with global IT functions to uphold the highest standards of service delivery.
 About You
 You are a proactive, customer-focused IT professional with a passion for solving problems and a natural ability to lead. You bring a calm, organised approach to a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities with ease, and communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels. You take ownership, inspire trust, and are committed to delivering exceptional service — every time.
 Required Qualifications

• Solid technical knowledge of Windows 10/11, MS Office, Outlook, and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, Ethernet).

• Hands-on experience managing hardware and mobile assets, including procurement, staging, repair coordination, and disposal processes.

• Proven experience in a technical IT support environment, including working with users across different cultural backgrounds and locations.

• Experience with incident, request, and problem management tools, with a strong understanding of ITIL-aligned processes and SLA management.

• Demonstrated ability to coordinate contractors and/or manage local vendor relationships, including contract oversight and service delivery accountability.
 Nice-to-Have Qualifications

• Experience in a local team leadership or coordination role, with the ability to guide and support colleagues or contractors on-site.

• Project management skills, with experience contributing to or leading local IT projects.

• Familiarity with SMARTHANDS processes and large-scale event or meeting room IT support.

• Knowledge of ordering systems and configuration management databases (CMDB).

• A relevant technical degree, diploma, or IT certification (e.g., CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation).

• Multilingual ability — excellent English is essential; German language skills are a strong advantage given the Munich location.

• Strong analytical and organisational skills, with the ability to assess work processes and overcome obstacles to meet goals.
 Due to the nature of the Field Services IT position, this role requires a full-time on-site presence (five days per week in the office). Please ensure this working arrangement aligns with your expectations before applying.

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role.

 In situations where a candidate does not meet all requirements or significantly exceeds them, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.
