jobs.title: Risk Management Intern (12 months internship)
jobs.description:
Are you a curious, analytically minded graduate ready to launch your career at the intersection of risk, reinsurance, and global finance? This is your chance to gain hands-on, meaningful experience within a world-leading reinsurance group — working across multiple legal entities and collaborating with an international team spanning continents. If you thrive on complexity, love learning, and want your work to matter from day one, read on.
 About the Role
 This 12-month internship offers a rare opportunity to immerse yourself in all facets of reinsurance risk management. You'll be an active contributor — not just an observer — supporting the Risk Management Function for Swiss Re Europe (SRE), its UK Branch (SRE UK), and Swiss Re Africa (SRAf). From regulatory reporting to risk frameworks and board-level presentations, you'll be involved in work that shapes how a global reinsurer understands and manages its risk landscape.
 Key Responsibilities

• Contribute to managing and monitoring the operational risk framework of SRAf (including Risk Control Self-Assessment process, analysis and resolution of operational events and issues and mitigation actions), and document material changes to any aspects of the risk profile.

• Contribute to SRAf's Own Risk and Solvency Assessment ("ORSA") process. This includes being involved both in the quantitative and qualitative aspects feeding into the process.

• Support in completing regulatory requests such as questionnaires/surveys across SRE, SRE UK and SRAf as required.

• Contribute to the quarterly risk reports presented to the SRE, SRE UK and SRAf Management Committee and Board of Directors.

• Support with maintaining the Risk Radar for SRE UK and SRAf.

• Provide support to thematic reviews performed by the EMEA RM team.

• Provide support on project management for specific initiatives.

• Champion a culture of risk awareness among staff by questioning and engaging with them in their daily work.
 About the Team
 Join a highly motivated, dynamic, and international Risk Management team with colleagues based across London, Zurich, Luxembourg, Munich, Bratislava, and Cape Town. This is a team that brings together diverse backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets to deliver a broad range of capabilities to our business partners.
 We value a good sense of humour, genuine inclusion, care for one another, and a collaborative spirit. We give honest feedback with integrity, support each other's growth, and bring energy and purpose to everything we do.
 About You
 You bring intellectual curiosity, a collaborative and fast-learning mindset, and the drive to make a real contribution. You're comfortable navigating complexity and ambiguity, and you communicate with clarity and confidence. You take ownership of your work, ask smart questions, and approach challenges with creativity and resilience.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Risk Management, Insurance, or a related quantitative discipline.

• Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret and present complex data clearly and concisely.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to summarise complex issues for a range of audiences including senior stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Are you a curious and analytical thinker looking to apply your skills in a global business environment?
 Join us as a Portfolio Monitoring & Insights Intern and gain hands-on experience in data-driven portfolio management while working alongside regional and global teams across the Life & Health (L&H) business.
 About the Role
 As part of the Portfolio Monitoring & Insights (PM&I) team, you’ll contribute to shaping strategic decisions through data analysis, collaboration, and performance insights.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Support the monitoring strategy for the Continental Europe PM&I team.

• Take ownership for the accurate ingestion of client data into the PM&I monitoring tool.

• Help to identify gaps in the current data and suggest remediation actions to be discussed with our clients.

• Proactively reach out to colleagues across the globe to gather product and data knowledge for the treaties you will look after.

• Support with deep dive investigations to understand the drivers of performance that will lead to execution of relevant actions.

• Use data analytics and visualisations to communicate portfolio performance, highlighting areas of concern and insights that steer business decisions.
 The internship is scheduled for 3-5 months starting in September 2026.
 About the Team
 The Portfolio Monitoring & Insights EMEA (PM&I EMEA) team works in close collaboration with various functions in Life & Health (L&H) and in partnership with Market Units in Continental Europe, UK & Ireland and Middle East & Africa. Our purpose is to generate insights and connect our business to proactively steer the business in delivering sustainable profits. We achieve this by strengthening feedback loops across L&H and by delivering portfolio monitoring capabilities.
 Now you can become a part of this international and dynamic team! We are an engaged and agile group of individuals with a distinct financial foresight and a flair for creativity and problem solving. By effectively applying our skills and collaborating across functions, we make a difference to our partners and generate value in our portfolio both for our clients and partners.
 About You
 We are looking for a brilliant critical thinker who thrives in a dynamic environment and isn’t afraid to constructively challenge the status quo.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements :

• Actuarial or Mathematics student, ideally on master's level (at least 6 semesters of studies completed).

• Understanding of various insurance lines of business.

• Naturally curious mindset.

• Ability to take ownership of tasks and work independently.

• Strong analytical skills with a passion for leveraging data and technology to steer business decisions.

• Experience with coding and data analytics tools (e.g. R, Power BI) is an advantage.

• Previous experience in the insurance/(re)insurance industry is a plus.

• Excellent oral and written English; Fluency in an additional European language is beneficial.
 We look forward to receiving your application!

We also coordinate and oversee the company wide ESG Risk Framework and selectively represent our sustainability risk efforts externally.

As an intern in Sustainability Risk Management, you:

• Contribute to key sustainability projects on nature and climate risk, with a focus on project work and documenting processes.

• Work on core tasks of the team, including managing data on sustainability risks.

• Will gain experience working on or managing multi-disciplinary projects that touch upon very diverse areas of the Group

About the Team

Sustainability Risk Management has a team of 10 people based in Zurich, from diverse range of countries and backgrounds, including environmental science, engineering, legal, human geography and more. We collaborate daily with colleagues across Swiss Re, creating a vibrant, interdisciplinary environment where your voice matters.

About You

Are you someone who others would describe as a strong team player, always contributing positively and working well with others? Your approach to challenges is pragmatic, solution-oriented, and you communicate your ideas clearly and effectively. Your can-do attitude helps you stay motivated and adaptable, even in dynamic situations.

Ideal candidates will have:

• A Master's level education in an area of sustainability (e.g. natural sciences, environmental economics, social sciences etc.)

• Experience in a diverse and global environment

• Fluency in English (written and spoken)

• Relevant previous internship or volunteering experience (e.g. on corporate responsibility, in an NGO, public sector etc.)

• Demonstrates strong data, AI and quantitative fluency, leveraging modern analytical approaches beyond traditional Excel-based workflows.

• Project management experience

• Proficiency in further languages is a plus

jobs.description:
Are you ready to join a global leader in reinsurance where you'll be at the heart of dynamic business operations? We're seeking a detail-oriented Business Coordinator to join our vibrant team and make a meaningful impact in a collaborative, international environment!
 About the Role

As a Business Coordinator, you'll serve as a crucial link between our client managers and various operational functions, ensuring smooth business processes while gaining valuable insights into the reinsurance industry.
 Key Responsibilities

• Act as a key partner for Client Underwriters and Key Account Managers, providing essential support for client-facing activities

• Manage your own portfolio including contract management, data gathering, analysis, and reporting

• Coordinate cross-functionally with Technical Accounting, Claims, Underwriting, and Contracts teams to ensure seamless operations

• Create professional presentations for client visits, events, and conferences

• Participate in strategic projects and initiatives to drive business improvements
 About the Team

We are a multinational, dynamic and engaged team of more than 60 Business Coordinators, divided into smaller teams according to EMEA markets. Our team is the backbone for our client managers, who originate and renew the business with clients. We are also the only reinsurance department that oversees the end-to-end process.
 About You

You're a reliable, self-driven professional who approaches challenges with a constructive and open mindset. Your attention to detail, prioritization skills, and effective communication make you an excellent team player. You thrive on delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong customer relationships.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Proficiency in English (fluency required), with another European language being an advantage

• Strong MS Office skills , particularly in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

• Data literacy with the ability to read and interpret data effectively
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Previous experience in administration or Insurance/Reinsurance (though the position is suitable for graduates)

• Project management experience

• Analytical mindset with problem-solving abilities

• Experience working in multicultural environments
 We are looking forward to your application!
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1400 and EUR 2300 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about making a real-world impact on advancing sustainability in re/insurance? Join us in driving innovative initiatives that strengthen Swiss Re's competitive advantage! This internship offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of sustainability and business strategy, collaborating with global experts to shape the future of sustainable re/insurance practices in a dynamic environment.

About the Role

As a Group Sustainability Intern, you'll be at the forefront of Swiss Re's sustainability strategy, gaining experience in how a global re/insurance leader addresses environmental and social challenges while creating business value.

Key responsibilities:

• Contribute to advancing the Group Sustainability Strategy and to implementing strategic ambitions for supporting the net-zero transition and building societal resilience, including co-developing concepts, methodologies and metrics

• Drive capability-building and communication by supporting the development of sustainability trainings and resources across the organization

• Collaborate cross-functionally with diverse internal stakeholders to advance sustainability initiatives

• Research and analyze emerging sustainability trends and their implications for the re/insurance industry

The internship is scheduled for 4-6 months starting in October 2026.

About the Team

At Group Sustainability, we advance Swiss Re's Group Sustainability Strategy as part of the organization's overall Group Strategy. We partner with Business Units and Group Functions to embed sustainability in all aspects of our business and to drive sustainability-related initiatives.

Swiss Re engages with a wide range of stakeholders on sustainability – including clients, investors, rating agencies and regulators – to identify, assess and steer sustainability topics.

About You

You thrive in dynamic environments where priorities evolve, demonstrating a passion for collaboration and a true team-player spirit. Bringing a can-do attitude, you embrace a solution-oriented mindset rooted in critical and analytical thinking, enabling you to break down complex problems and approach challenges methodically. Your willingness to step outside your comfort zone, combined with versatility and learning agility, empowers you to explore new topics and contribute effectively to multiple projects, even under tight deadlines. You are adept at working with teams that bring diverse stakeholder perspectives to the table. With confidence in engaging across various levels of seniority, you are always ready to go the extra mile to ensure success.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Ongoing or completed master's level education in sustainability and/or business (e.g., natural sciences, environmental economics, social sciences, economics/business administration)

• Relevant previous work experience, internship, or volunteering experience in sustainability (private sector, public sector, or civil society organization) or the re/insurance industry

• Agility, curiosity and adaptability to navigate changing priorities, quickly learn new topics and contribute across diverse projects in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly, tailor messages to different audiences and create engaging presentations and materials

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support research, analysis and content creation

Additional nice to haves:

• Initial understanding of the re/insurance industry, including sustainability-related challenges and opportunities

• Experience with sustainability reporting frameworks or ESG metrics

• Data analysis skills and experience with visualization tools

• Experience in stakeholder engagement or change management

We are looking forward to your application, including your CV!

Due to immigration regulations non-EU/EFTA and UK citizens must provide a certificate from a Swiss university confirming that an internship is integral to their course of study. Kindly submit the mandatory letter from your university with your application documents.

The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process.

Are you passionate about making a real-world impact on advancing sustainability in re/insurance? Join us in driving innovative initiatives that strengthen Swiss Re's competitive advantage! This internship offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of sustainability and business strategy, collaborating with global experts to shape the future of sustainable re/insurance practices in a dynamic environment.

About the Role

As a Group Sustainability Intern, you'll be at the forefront of Swiss Re's sustainability strategy, gaining experience in how a global re/insurance leader addresses environmental and social challenges while creating business value.

Key responsibilities:

• Contribute to advancing the Group Sustainability Strategy and to implementing strategic ambitions for supporting the net-zero transition and building societal resilience, including co-developing concepts, methodologies and metrics

• Drive capability-building and communication by supporting the development of sustainability trainings and resources across the organization

• Collaborate cross-functionally with diverse internal stakeholders to advance sustainability initiatives

• Research and analyze emerging sustainability trends and their implications for the re/insurance industry

The internship is scheduled for 4-6 months starting in October 2026.

About the Team

At Group Sustainability, we advance Swiss Re's Group Sustainability Strategy as part of the organization's overall Group Strategy. We partner with Business Units and Group Functions to embed sustainability in all aspects of our business and to drive sustainability-related initiatives.

Swiss Re engages with a wide range of stakeholders on sustainability – including clients, investors, rating agencies and regulators – to identify, assess and steer sustainability topics.

About You

You thrive in dynamic environments where priorities evolve, demonstrating a passion for collaboration and a true team-player spirit. Bringing a can-do attitude, you embrace a solution-oriented mindset rooted in critical and analytical thinking, enabling you to break down complex problems and approach challenges methodically. Your willingness to step outside your comfort zone, combined with versatility and learning agility, empowers you to explore new topics and contribute effectively to multiple projects, even under tight deadlines. You are adept at working with teams that bring diverse stakeholder perspectives to the table. With confidence in engaging across various levels of seniority, you are always ready to go the extra mile to ensure success.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Ongoing or completed master's level education in sustainability and/or business (e.g., natural sciences, environmental economics, social sciences, economics/business administration)

• Relevant previous work experience, internship, or volunteering experience in sustainability (private sector, public sector, or civil society organization) or the re/insurance industry

• Agility, curiosity and adaptability to navigate changing priorities, quickly learn new topics and contribute across diverse projects in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly, tailor messages to different audiences and create engaging presentations and materials

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support research, analysis and content creation

Additional nice to haves:

• Initial understanding of the re/insurance industry, including sustainability-related challenges and opportunities

• Experience with sustainability reporting frameworks or ESG metrics

• Data analysis skills and experience with visualization tools

• Experience in stakeholder engagement or change management

We are looking forward to your application, including your CV!

jobs.description:
To advance the development of an open industry platform for the placement and administration of International Programs, Swiss Re Corporate Solutions established an incubator to develop and bring to market tech solutions for brokers and carriers. This incubator has developed the "PULSE & Network" proposition, a combined offering of a state-of-the-art SaaS application (PULSE), fronting network access and risk pooling as a comprehensive service, aiming to reduce the barriers to entry to the International Program market.
 The International Programs Operations team is seeking a dynamic, proactive and client-focused person to deliver solutions and services meeting our corporate customers' needs, while fostering long-lasting partnerships, as well as driving excellence in service with internal stakeholders.
 About the Role
 As a PULSE & Network Customer Manager you will focus on ensuring our partners have the appropriate level of support, you will familiarize with policy implementation across the network of Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, contract renewal and customer management by working closely with many internal departments and external partners.
 This role offers the opportunity to leverage your insurance experience in a new and exciting way, to bring something different to the market and support us in our mission to reduce the inherent friction in the delivery of
 International Programs.
 In this role you will:

• Establish meaningful relationships with existing and prospect customers.

• Develop a deep understanding of customers' needs and translate them into executable opportunities to provide relevant solutions and services.

• Leverage data & analytics to ensure first-class service delivery in the provision of International Programs fronted for our customers.

• Monitor and report on operational program performance and address issues to ensure agreed service levels are kept within agreed tolerances.

• Drive and inspire cross-functional teams to deliver best value propositions.

• Liaise with International Financial Management and Technical Accounting teams to understand cash position across program portfolio and support provision of information and updates to the client.

• Engage in preparing and reviewing legal documents and contracts preparation/renewals.

• Support in the creation and maintenance of guidelines and standard operating procedures.

• Develop and maintain communication and training materials for customers.

About the Team
 Join this engaged, dynamic, curious and multicultural team, focused into bringing the best service to their customers!
 The PULSE & Network team is highly regarded for their professionalism, excellence in client service and continuous improvement mindset. Our role is to support our external stakeholders into navigating the complexities of International Programs.
 About You
 We are looking for a forward-thinking teammate with strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills who can constructively and respectfully engage in challenging conversations with both internal and external stakeholders. Are you able to form outstanding relationships to translate innovation into execution? Do you consider yourself to be a "self-starter", able and willing to take initiative and implement measures in a goal-oriented manner? This is the place for you!
 We are looking for a candidate with the following attributes:

• Minimum 5 years of insurance industry experience preferably in client management, consulting, or project management, with strong client/stakeholder interaction skills.

• Knowledgeable in the administration of global insurance programs and commercial insurance policies.

• Demonstrated ability of managing stakeholders at every level of the organization, internationally, internally and externally.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills, both verbally and in writing.

• Fluency in English is a must; German is highly appreciated; other languages are an asset.

• Highly detail- and solution-oriented with a focus on quality and customer experience.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to simplify the complicated.

• Highly organized and capable of handling multiple priorities at the same time.

• Goal-orientation and commitment to continuous learning. Taking ownership of tasks and completing them independently.

• Excellent computer skills including proficiency in MS Office applications and data analysis software (e.g., Stargate and Power BI).

For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 42,000 and EUR 70,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions

jobs.description:
It's all about keeping it safe in the digital world these days – and you can be a part of how that plays out in a multi-national company like Swiss Re! As the Cyber Security Analyst, you will support and resolve identity and access-related issues, bring your contributions to interesting projects to streamline our daily conduct of business, and more.
 We are a modern company, and your time is valuable to us! That is why we are offering you the option to work from home as well as the office premises in a perfectly balanced way.
 About the team
 The Security Team is the focal point for all security activities across Swiss Re. We are responsible for cybersecurity engineering and operations, corporate security, governance, operational resilience, risk and compliance. We define and advance the company's security strategy. You will work directly in Cyber SecOps – a team of security experts focus on providing the best possible Identity & Access Management services to our employees and customers.
 Got a knack for IT and cybersecurity? Are you not a seasoned expert but still eager to grow and learn? We are looking for a new colleague who will help to support our team in timely issue resolutions, bring in innovative ideas to improve our processes, and be a valuable addition to a cheerful, professional team of experts!
 In your role, you will…

• Support and resolve all identity and access-related issues

• Conduct regular access rights reviews

• Maintain a positive communication level towards customers

• Be a part of interesting projects to streamline the established services and processes

• Deal with tasks and tickets in a timely and high-quality-meeting manner

• Bless our team with enthusiasm and passion

• Foster a learning and development-centred culture and support team-based collaboration
 Your qualifications
 Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of our requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are curious about the world of great customer service inside IT and cybersecurity, we will be more than happy to meet you!
 What we need from you

• Basic experience working with Identity & Access Management and end-user support

• Ability to explain IT stuff to non-technical crowds

• Basic understanding - Active Directory / Azure AD (now Entra ID), SSO and MFA

• IAM knowledge - Authentication, authorization

• A people-loving personality and fondness of collaborating with colleagues, partners, and customers

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English

• Experience dealing with customers and clients

• Tech-savviness
 Nice-to-have

• VBA or SQL knowledge
 The minimum gross base salary for this role is 10 EUR/ per hour. Our final offer to you will be set up fairly, considering the skills and experience that you bring to the Swiss Re Group.

 About the Role
 Be ready to support our Underwriters in Trade Finance, Commodity Finance, Project Infrastructure and Portfolio Solutions as an Operations Specialist in our Credit line of business. This includes the timely and accurate handling of client/broker requests, inquiries and accurate policy issuance.
 In particular your responsibilities will include the following:

• Closely interact and coordinate with internal stakeholders in Operations and Underwriting located in various regions and markets globally, as well as with external stakeholders such as clients, brokers, service provider

• Process and administer correct reflection of client inquiries in our systems and handle contract/policy documents administration throughout their entire lifecycle (issuance, amendments, cancellation, invoicing)

• Support the underwriting and renewal processes in analysis, development, and evaluation of documents, such as underwriting files, master risk agreements and preparing policies or cover notes as draft

• Collaborate globally with other team members and our service provider to ensure best client service to our credit clients and brokers

Our team is acting across many locations in Europe, Asia Pacific, as well as North and Latin America and represents an network of operational experts.
 Our team is continuously improving and evolving the Operating model and is striving to standardize and improve the processes to offer best market services.
 About You

• You are aware of the importance of clients, understand their needs and are passionate to work with them in order to meet or exceed their expectations.

• You like to take personal ownership for your day-to-day responsibilities, do not need close supervision and are able to set the right priorities in the context of the business.

• You are a true team player, are passionate in sharing your expertise and help others to grow.

• You are building and maintaining effective working relationships with peers, both internally and externally.

• You appreciate working with global intercultural teams.

• You perceive change as an opportunity rather than a threat and enjoy shaping the future.

• You always look for opportunities for improvement and develop practical solutions. Obstacles cannot stop you, but let you find ways to overcome them.
 Essentials

• You have obtained first experience in area with financial intuitions or corporates credit products, preferably in an international bank, broker and or insurance company

• Previous experience in client facing servicing role, preferably in finance environment

• Completed commercial education preferably banking specialist or bachelor studies in economics or associates degree or job experience equivalent

• Basic knowledge and understanding of Trade Finance and/or intl. Guarantee business

• Familiar with KYC, AML procedures and sanctions, commercial and company law

• Proficiency in English language, reading, written and verbal, is a must (B2 or higher)

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about turning complexity into clarity? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, security, and collaboration? Join our cybersecurity team in one of Europe's most vibrant tech hubs and play a pivotal role in shaping how Swiss Re secures its digital future. As a Business Analyst in our Applications Identity and Access Management team, you'll be the bridge between stakeholders, delivery teams, and cutting-edge security solutions — making sure the right things get built, the right way.

About the Role

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our cybersecurity delivery engine. You'll work closely with engineers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate complex security objectives into clear, actionable requirements. From driving adoption of security services and remediating security risks, your work will directly contribute to making Swiss Re's global IT ecosystem more secure and resilient.

Key Responsibilities

• Elicit, clarify, document, and maintain requirements from users, consuming applications, and stakeholders — translating cybersecurity objectives into user stories, acceptance criteria, process descriptions, and delivery-ready artefacts, consolidating inputs from backlogs, workshops, and discussions into a coherent, up-to-date requirements landscape.

• Analyse changes in the IT and security landscape and assess their impact on the team's systems, consumers, and processes — capturing dependencies, risks, and assumptions, and proactively flagging opportunities for improvement.

• Drive rollout and adoption by co-creating communication material for our stakeholders, supporting consuming teams in understanding integration requirements and adoption steps, and tracking residual risks for management reporting.

About the Team

The Applications IAM team is part of Product & Engineering Cyber Security — Swiss Re's build-and-run organisation for cyber security capabilities. This unit envisions, engineers, owns, and operates a portfolio of cyber security products and platforms that protect Swiss Re globally, spanning application identity and access management, PAM, customer IAM, cyber defence platforms, detection engineering, vulnerability management, and more.

Within this organisation, the Applications IAM team focuses specifically on securing access and secrets management for technical identities across Swiss Re's global IT ecosystems, including public cloud environments. We define and build solutions at the cutting edge of application security — and as an active contributor to the group's cyber security strategy and roadmap, our work has a tangible impact on Swiss Re's resilience worldwide.

About You

You are a structured, curious, and collaborative professional who brings order to complexity. You have a talent for listening carefully, asking the right questions, and turning ambiguous inputs into clear, actionable deliverables. You communicate with confidence across technical and non-technical audiences, and you bring a proactive mindset that keeps delivery moving forward. A genuine interest in cybersecurity makes you excited — not intimidated — by the domain you'll be working in.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Solid experience as a Business Analyst in IT delivery teams, with a strong track record in agile environments and a confident command of BA practices — including requirements elicitation, documentation, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and the ability to structure complex topics into user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable deliverables.

• Genuine interest in and affinity for cybersecurity, with hands-on exposure to authentication protocols (e.g. OIDC, OAuth) and secrets management, to IAM, and the ability to engage meaningfully with engineers on technical integration topics.

• Practical experience building applications on Azure, combined with scripting skills in PowerShell or Python and a working knowledge of SQL.

• Academic background in IT, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or an equivalent field.

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with security audits, penetration testing, vulnerability management, or Identity and Access Management (IAM), providing additional depth when assessing security risks and requirements.

• Strong facilitation skills, with experience running workshops and discovery sessions, and a proven ability to present risks, requirements, and adoption timelines or progress clearly and convincingly to both senior technical and management audiences.

Salary & Benefits

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,100 and EUR 3,400 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

Are you passionate about turning complexity into clarity? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, security, and collaboration? Join our cybersecurity team in one of Europe's most vibrant tech hubs and play a pivotal role in shaping how Swiss Re secures its digital future. As a Business Analyst in our Applications Identity and Access Management team, you'll be the bridge between stakeholders, delivery teams, and cutting-edge security solutions — making sure the right things get built, the right way.

About the Role

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our cybersecurity delivery engine. You'll work closely with engineers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate complex security objectives into clear, actionable requirements. From driving adoption of security services and remediating security risks, your work will directly contribute to making Swiss Re's global IT ecosystem more secure and resilient.

Key Responsibilities

• Elicit, clarify, document, and maintain requirements from users, consuming applications, and stakeholders — translating cybersecurity objectives into user stories, acceptance criteria, process descriptions, and delivery-ready artefacts, consolidating inputs from backlogs, workshops, and discussions into a coherent, up-to-date requirements landscape.

• Analyse changes in the IT and security landscape and assess their impact on the team's systems, consumers, and processes — capturing dependencies, risks, and assumptions, and proactively flagging opportunities for improvement.

• Drive rollout and adoption by co-creating communication material for our stakeholders, supporting consuming teams in understanding integration requirements and adoption steps, and tracking residual risks for management reporting.

About the Team

The Applications IAM team is part of Product & Engineering Cyber Security — Swiss Re's build-and-run organisation for cyber security capabilities. This unit envisions, engineers, owns, and operates a portfolio of cyber security products and platforms that protect Swiss Re globally, spanning application identity and access management, PAM, customer IAM, cyber defence platforms, detection engineering, vulnerability management, and more.

Within this organisation, the Applications IAM team focuses specifically on securing access and secrets management for technical identities across Swiss Re's global IT ecosystems, including public cloud environments. We define and build solutions at the cutting edge of application security — and as an active contributor to the group's cyber security strategy and roadmap, our work has a tangible impact on Swiss Re's resilience worldwide.

About You

You are a structured, curious, and collaborative professional who brings order to complexity. You have a talent for listening carefully, asking the right questions, and turning ambiguous inputs into clear, actionable deliverables. You communicate with confidence across technical and non-technical audiences, and you bring a proactive mindset that keeps delivery moving forward. A genuine interest in cybersecurity makes you excited — not intimidated — by the domain you'll be working in.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Solid experience as a Business Analyst in IT delivery teams, with a strong track record in agile environments and a confident command of BA practices — including requirements elicitation, documentation, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and the ability to structure complex topics into user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable deliverables.

• Genuine interest in and affinity for cybersecurity, with hands-on exposure to authentication protocols (e.g. OIDC, OAuth) and secrets management, to IAM, and the ability to engage meaningfully with engineers on technical integration topics.

• Practical experience building applications on Azure, combined with scripting skills in PowerShell or Python and a working knowledge of SQL.

• Academic background in IT, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or an equivalent field.

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with security audits, penetration testing, vulnerability management, or Identity and Access Management (IAM), providing additional depth when assessing security risks and requirements.

• Strong facilitation skills, with experience running workshops and discovery sessions, and a proven ability to present risks, requirements, and adoption timelines or progress clearly and convincingly to both senior technical and management audiences.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Are you passionate about re-/insurance supervisory and regulatory topics? Do you want to be at the forefront of the relationship with our group-wide supervisor FINMA and cover the supervisory angle of everything that moves Swiss Re? We are looking for a Senior Regulatory Affairs Manager who takes a leading role in the team managing key supervisory processes and projects in collaboration with the relevant internal stakeholders, incl. senior management. In your role you will also analyze regulatory developments affecting Swiss Re's business and represent Swiss Re's interests towards regulatory expert groups and industry associations.

Your main tasks and responsibilities will include:

• Manage the relationship with FINMA together with the team and assume responsibility for supervisory requests, filings and regulatory reports.

• Lead or contribute to ad-hoc interdisciplinary teams related to projects, transactions and situations with a supervisory dimension.

• Lead the preparation of regulatory interactions such as the FINMA Supervisory College meetings, FINMA on-site inspections, regular senior level meetings, and ad-hoc exchanges.

• Contribute to and coordinate data calls, field testing exercises, or consultations.

• Identify, assess and monitor key regulatory developments and risks. Facilitate internal understanding of the impacts and subsequent preparation for upcoming regulatory requirements.

• Maintain close contact and cooperation with key internal stakeholders across Business Units, Finance, Legal & Compliance, Risk Management and other relevant internal functions.

• Support the preparation of briefing materials and presentations for members of Swiss Re's Executive Committee and/or Board of Directors.

• Contribute to and coordinate internal reports and presentation.

• Participate in specific industry events and meetings (e.g. Swiss Insurance Association) and represent Swiss Re's views as relevant.

About the Team

The Regulatory Affairs Switzerland team is responsible for managing the relationship with our group-wide supervisor FINMA and key authorities in Switzerland, ensuring constructive relationships while supporting the organization's business objectives. The team also manages risks arising from changes to existing or new regulatory and supervisory requirements that could materially affect Swiss Re.

About You

• Solid understanding of the re-/insurance regulatory framework and supervisory practice in Switzerland and/or another relevant jurisdiction.

• Proven track record in the (re)insurance industry or relevant authorities with touch points in Supervision, Regulatory, Risk Management, Finance, Legal, Compliance, or Treasury/Capital Management.

• A master's degree in either Law, Actuarial Sciences, Natural Science, Mathematics, Economics, Business Administration, Political Science or another relevant field.

• Excellent analytical skills, as well as a proven understanding of the foundations of (re)insurance and the pre-requisites required for it to be able to fulfil its role in society.

• Ability to summarise complex issues into concise memos/presentations.

• Ability to present and communicate well orally and in writing in both German and English.

• Strong interpersonal skills with experience in dealing with external stakeholders and top management.

• Strong team player, willing to share knowledge and information and who naturally brings individuals together as needed, from across countries and functions.

• Strong organisational and project management skills.

For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between CHF 128,000 and CHF 192,000 for a full-time role.

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.

jobs.description:
Are you a curious, driven, and creative individual looking to kick-start your career at the intersection of marketing, events, and sales? This is your opportunity to gain hands-on experience within a dynamic, fast-paced environment at Swiss Re Corporate Solutions Africa — where your ideas and energy will make a real difference from day one.
 About the Role
 As a Marketing and Events Coordination Intern within the Sales & Distribution team, you will play an active and meaningful role in supporting the team's commercial and communication activities. From coordinating engaging broker events to helping manage key customer systems and crafting compelling content, you will gain broad exposure to the world of insurance, sales, and marketing — all while contributing to real business outcomes.
 Key Responsibilities

• Content creation & thought leadership: Support the Leadership Team with the development of internal and external content, including thought leadership pieces and communication materials.

• Internal communications management: Help manage and monitor primary internal communication channels including SharePoint, Yammer, and online platforms to drive employee engagement.

• Event planning & execution: Support the Head of Sales & Distribution in planning, coordinating, and executing events — both virtual and in-person — as well as broker engagement sessions.

• CRM & pipeline management: Assist in managing and maintaining CRM systems and the customer pipeline tool to support sales activities and ensure data accuracy.

• Data extraction & reporting: Extract, analyse, and prepare reports and dashboards based on tool data to support business decisions and track sales performance against targets.

• Customer engagement documentation: Capture engagement notes and update relevant customer systems with accurate and timely information.

• Operational coordination: Take responsibility for a range of coordination activities within the Sales & Distribution department, supporting smooth day-to-day operations.

• Monthly reporting: Assist in generating monthly management reports to track commercial performance and support strategic decision-making.
 About the Team
 The Sales & Distribution team at Swiss Re Corporate Solutions Africa (SRCSA) is at the heart of the business — driving new business growth, managing broker and partner relationships, and expanding market access for SRCSA's products and solutions. The team develops and executes sales, distribution, and marketing strategies, monitors commercial performance, and supports sustainable portfolio growth while maintaining compliance and strong client engagement. This is a collaborative, high-energy team where every contribution counts and there is real opportunity to learn and grow.
 About You
 We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented individual who is eager to learn and not afraid to roll up their sleeves. You bring a proactive attitude, strong organisational skills, and a genuine interest in marketing, events, and commercial operations. You communicate clearly, manage your time effectively, and thrive in a collaborative environment where no two days are the same.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Commerce, or a related field.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word) with the ability to compile reports and create professional presentations.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create clear, engaging content for internal and external audiences.

• Analytical ability to extract, interpret, and present data in a meaningful way to support business decisions.
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Prior exposure to or experience with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce or similar platforms).

• Familiarity with SharePoint, Yammer, or other internal communication tools.

• Experience in event coordination or project support, even in a voluntary or academic context.

• A keen interest in the insurance or financial services industry.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment.

• A collaborative spirit with the ability to build positive relationships across teams and with external stakeholders.

This role is offered on the basis of an 12-month temporary contract, with an expected start date on 1st of September 2026. The gross monthly salary for this role is 9 000 ZAR full time.

Our interns have a hybrid work model where the expectation is that they will be in the office at least four days per week.
 Preference will be given to Employment Equity candidates.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

 The Data Management & Insights [DMI] team is part of Business Excellence delivering on the promise of a stable end-to-end operating platform for Life & Health Reinsurance. jobs.description:
Are you ready to bring your risk and financial expertise to a dynamic, global environment? Join Swiss Re Corporate Solutions in Madrid and play a key role in supporting our Spanish, Portuguese and broader European clients with their surety and guarantee needs. This is your opportunity to combine analytical excellence with meaningful client relationships — all within a truly entrepreneurial and collaborative setting.
 About the Role
 As an Underwriter Surety based in Madrid, you will be an integral part of our growing European surety team, connecting analytical insight with hands-on client management. You will work closely with corporates and brokers across the Spain, Portugal and internationally, balancing risk underwriting with client-facing responsibilities. This role offers a fantastic platform to develop your surety career within one of the world's leading surety groups.
 Key responsibilities:
 • Conduct risk assessments for new and existing clients, ensuring alignment with Swiss Re's risk appetite while maintaining highest standards of client satisfaction
 • Develop and manage your own client portfolio and transactions, identifying and driving new business opportunities across Iberia and broader Europe
 • Analyse and evaluate credit and transactional risks in close collaboration with internal stakeholders, applying rigorous financial and legal due diligence
 • Approve transactions within your own authority levels and prepare structured submissions for relevant committees
 • Build and maintain strong client and broker relationships through regular, proactive engagement and direct interactions
 • Support Senior Underwriters with the execution and monitoring of complex bespoke transactions and management of key accounts
 • Conduct market analysis to identify changes in the underwriting, market and legal landscape, assessing their risk implications and adapting strategies accordingly
 • Collaborate with and support colleagues across the wider European Surety team, contributing to a culture of shared knowledge and continuous improvement
 About the Team
 Backed by more than 150 years of experience, significant capacity and the financial strength of the Swiss Re Group, Swiss Re Corporate Solutions solves the risk management and financing needs of corporations around the globe. We pursue the goal of results-oriented underwriting. The positive relationship with our customers and brokers across Europe, combined with our strong brand, is the foundation of our success. If you share the passion for surety and financial products, we encourage you to apply for this position. As part of a global team offering tailor-made solutions across a broad range of surety products, you will have the opportunity to join our highly motivated team that shares the same passion for this business.
 About You
 You thrive in an international, team-oriented environment and enjoy combining analytical thinking with client engagement. You are a proactive communicator who builds trust with clients and business partners naturally, and you bring a solutions-focused mindset to every challenge. You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, and you are eager to contribute to the continued growth of a market-leading surety business.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:
 • Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience, preferably within a bank, surety insurer or financial institution with exposure to credit and guarantee products
 • Strong understanding of credit risks, particularly in relation to surety/guarantee structures
 • Proven analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to assess complex credit and transactional risks and translate findings into clear, structured recommendations
 • Confident communication and interpersonal skills, with experience engaging with clients, brokers and internal stakeholders
 • Spanish native speaker with proficiency in English (written and verbal) is essential;
 These are additional nice to haves:
 • Experience working with multinational corporations or in a cross-border European surety/credit context
 • Familiarity with legal due diligence processes related to surety or guarantee transactions
 • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong focus on identifying and originating new business opportunities
 • Experience using data and market intelligence tools to monitor portfolio performance and market trends
 • A university degree or equivalent qualification in finance, economics, law or a related discipline
 • The role may require some travel
 For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 47,000 and EUR 78,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In situations where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.

jobs.description:
Location: Armonk, NY
 Are you an experienced HR Partner who brings strong business judgment, practical HR leadership, and the ability to help senior leaders navigate change, organizational evolution, and complex people decisions?
 Swiss Re is seeking a collaborative, business-oriented HR leader to support U.S.-based populations while partnering with leaders and HR colleagues across global regions. This role combines strategic advisory with hands-on execution across the employee lifecycle, change, organizational effectiveness, and priority HR initiatives.
 About the Role
 Reporting to the SVP, Head of People US, you will partner with senior business and functional leaders to shape and deliver the people agenda in support of business priorities. You will advise on organizational effectiveness, talent, performance, culture, and change, helping leaders translate business needs into practical people actions.
 Key Responsibilities

• Business advisory and change leadership
•
• Partner with senior leaders to understand business priorities and translate them into practical people strategies and actions

• Advise on organizational design, workforce planning, talent, performance, culture, and leadership effectiveness

• Provide change management counsel and practical execution support to help leaders communicate, engage teams, manage resistance, and sustain effectiveness through change

• Advise on transformation, restructuring, and workforce transitions as needed

• Employee lifecycle and HR partnership
•
• Support key employee lifecycle moments by partnering with Center of Excellence teams across HR to deliver integrated solutions

• Advise on employee relations and employment risk matters, including performance, conduct, and sensitive employee situations, partnering closely with Legal and other stakeholders as needed

• Partner with HR colleagues across regions to support leaders managing multi-jurisdictional teams

• Projects, insights, and tools
•
• Lead or contribute to priority HR and people initiatives, bringing structure, stakeholder alignment, and disciplined execution

• Use workforce data, employee insights, and business context to identify themes, risks, and opportunities and translate them into practical recommendations

• Apply AI-enabled tools and emerging HR technologies responsibly to improve productivity and the quality of HR delivery

About the Team
 The US HR Partner team is a lean, seasoned, and highly collaborative group of HR Partners supporting approximately 2,200 employees across the US business. In our model, HR Partners serve as senior business advisors across a broad range of people and organizational topics while working closely with specialist partners.
 Swiss Re's global business structure means many teams span different countries. This role requires strong partnership across jurisdictions and confidence navigating a matrixed environment. HR Partners provide integrated support across the employee lifecycle, partnering closely with Talent Acquisition, Talent & Culture, Inclusion, Reward, Legal, and other specialist colleagues as needed.
 Within the same reporting line, the team works closely with HR Operations and a Data Analytics colleague, enabling a connected approach to delivery, insight, and problem-solving. The team’s footprint spans the US, with major hubs in Armonk (our US headquarters), New York City, and Kansas City. You would join at an important moment for the function, with new leadership under our Chief People Officer and continued evolution across the People organization.
 About You
 You are a credible, pragmatic HR Partner who builds trust quickly with senior leaders and balances support with constructive challenge. You are comfortable operating in a global matrix, navigating complexity across teams and jurisdictions, and moving between strategic advisory and practical execution.

Key requirements

• 10+ years of relevant HR experience, including significant HR Business Partner experience supporting senior leaders in a complex, matrixed organization

• Strong senior business advisory capability, including experience advising on organizational design, workforce planning, talent, performance, culture, and leadership effectiveness

• Broad employee lifecycle experience and the ability to partner effectively across HR Centers of Expertise and HR Operations

• Demonstrated experience supporting change management and organizational evolution

• Strong project leadership skills, with the ability to drive alignment and execution across HR initiatives

• Experience working effectively in a global matrix and across multi-jurisdictional teams

• Practical engagement with AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies, with sound judgment around responsible use

• Experience handling employee relations and employment risk matters with sound judgment and appropriate engagement of Legal and other stakeholders on sensitive issues

• Experience supporting transformation, restructuring, or workforce transitions is preferred

• Experience in reinsurance, insurance, asset management, financial services, or another regulated environment is preferred; adjacent experience will also be considered
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 The estimated base salary range for this position is $144,000 to $216,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short- and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.description:
Are you someone who can spot the right information in a document, process it with precision, and bring people together to get things done? Then buckle up - this one's for you!
 About the Role
 We have an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated and analytically minded professional to join our Credit Control team! This is a role where attention to detail meets international collaboration — you'll be managing a real portfolio of partners, diving into financial data, and playing a key part in keeping our insurance operations running smoothly across the EMEA region.
 You'll grow your technical and interpersonal skills, connect with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the globe, and gain meaningful insight into how a leading global reinsurance company operates from the inside.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain partnerships with external clients through regular, professional communication and proactive relationship management

• Monitor account balances across your assigned portfolio, ensuring timely collection and accurate processing of premium payments

• Prepare monthly and quarterly statements and reports for your portfolio, delivering clear and reliable financial insights

• Collaborate cross-functionally with colleagues from various Swiss Re departments around the world to resolve queries and drive outcomes

• Analyse and report on data using tools such as MS Excel and Power BI to support decision-making and identify trends

• Handle daily business correspondence , including the investigation, analysis, and interpretation of processed accounting information
 About the Team
 You'll be joining a dynamic department of 50 Credit Control professionals, organised into four specialised teams. Together, we are responsible for managing all financial transactions within the insurance portfolio, with a primary focus on premium collection for direct insurance contracts covering large risks. Our work spans the entire EMEA region, meaning we process, send, and analyse payments from brokers and clients across a wide range of markets and time zones. We're a team that values curiosity, precision, and a collaborative spirit — and we're excited to welcome someone who shares those values.
 About You
 You are detail-oriented, curious about numbers, and comfortable navigating a fast-paced, international environment. Whether working independently or as part of a team, you bring a proactive mindset and a genuine enthusiasm for getting things right. You're not afraid to ask questions, take ownership of your portfolio, and continuously develop your skills.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• English language proficiency – strong written and verbal communication skills are essential for managing international client relationships and correspondence

• Digital literacy and data skills – proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or a strong motivation and aptitude to learn it quickly), with the ability to work with financial data accurately and efficiently

• Analytical and numerical aptitude – a sharp eye for detail, comfort working with numbers, and the ability to interpret and draw conclusions from financial and accounting information

• Strong organisational skills – ability to prioritise, multitask, and manage competing deadlines in a constantly evolving environment

These are additional nice to haves:

• Additional European language skills – French, German, Spanish, or Italian would be a great asset given our EMEA-wide scope

• Previous working experience in business administration, accounting, finance, or a related field

• Experience with Power BI or other data visualisation tools
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between 1300 EUR and 2200 EUR per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements.
 Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

jobs.title: Pricing Actuary
jobs.description:
About the Role:
 Reporting to the Head L&H Pricing Japan, the candidate will be responsible to price business written by the Japan office in accordance with relevant technical guidelines and the Terms of Trade. The candidate will also be responsible for developing new business opportunities in close cooperation with client managers, underwriters and other units, by developing new product offerings; by identifying joint product development opportunities; and by structuring solutions mainly from a traditional reinsurance perspective.
 Major responsibilities:

• Manage actuarial matters to execute quotations for traditional and non-traditional reinsurance structures.

• Maintain actuarial Terms of Trade, i.e. the detailed terms on which business can be written, for all major lines of business, and initiation of regular experience studies in support of these terms

• Identify/develop products to meet client needs through analysis of market trend, geographical changes, social welfare system changes and offshore market trend, utilising regional input as needed

• Develop new business opportunities through tailoring of reinsurance structures, delivery of new product ideas and/or product development support

• Maintain strong relationships with key clients including liaising on product development projects and delivery of presentations.
 About the Team
 The team consists of 5 members currently located in Japan. This team will also work closely with the Pricing and Experience support team located in Bangalore.
 About You

• You are a qualified actuary or close to qualified actuary with at least 2-3 year' experience in actuarial product design and pricing in Japan.

• You are knowledgeable about products, product development and product trends in the market. You have experience of using and applying actuarial pricing tools.

• You have a fundamental understanding about the Japanese (re)insurance industry and the local insurance regulations.

• You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills (in Japanese and in English).

• You are well organised, good time-manager and able to manage projects effectively both independently or as a team player
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview
 At iptiQ by Swiss Re, we are building the next generation of digital life and health insurance. Our engineering teams are driving innovation across large-scale, cloud-native platforms that power millions of customer interactions. We blend modern software engineering with deep industry expertise to create solutions that are accessible, reliable, and user-centric. Our technology extends well beyond traditional insurance and encompasses data-intensive systems, modern architectures, digital health solutions, advanced analytics, and secure, high-performance services.
 About the role
 As a Lead Software Engineer , you will take ownership of significant cross-domain initiatives, influence architectural direction, and guide engineering teams through complex technical challenges. You will partner closely with Senior Engineering Managers (SEMs), architects, and cross-functional leads to plan and deliver large, strategic programs.
 You will also serve as a technical role model—driving high-quality engineering practices, ensuring robust delivery forecasting, and elevating the technical maturity of your domain.
 Our Technology Stack
 Our cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS platform runs on AWS. We use Kotlin, Java, SpringBoot, Docker, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL on the backend, and ReactJS and TypeScript on the frontend. Our continuous delivery pipeline leverages GitLab. We are using Prometheus, ElasticSearch, Kibana and Grafana as our logging and monitoring stack.
 Our mission
 iptiQ is not just an insurance company; we are at the forefront of integrating technology into the life and health insurance space. We employ people with diverse technical backgrounds who are eager to solve some of the industry's most complex problems and make a lasting impact on our customers globally. At iptiQ, you'll not only be a part of transforming the insurance industry but also work on large-scale applications and new platforms that redefine how insurance products are developed and delivered. From revolutionizing underwriting processes to creating user-centric digital health tools, our engineers are at the heart of iptiQ's mission to transform the world of insurance.
