jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Ready to build and run data driven digital services that power our Alternative Capital Partners organisation?
 About the Role & Team
 The Asset Management Digital and Tech Transformation unit has the mission to enable AM to become an AI powered, data centric organization . We foster a data-centric culture and ensure a state-of-the-art tech and data landscape, smartly using public cloud and SaaS solutions to provide innovative, secure and cost aware technology services.
 If you join us, as a member of the ACP (Alternative Capital Partners) IT team, you will be able to participate in a variety of interesting initiatives . For example, you will:

• Further develop internal and client facing data solutions

• Provide a resilient and secure tech operating platform through continuous improvement and operational support

• Co-create advanced tech and data enabled services in global, cross functional teams

• Support many other exciting projects in a collaborative environment with colleagues from Swiss Re Asset Management's international offices
 Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain end-to-end data solutions, from ETL processing to reports and visualisation

• Maintain and further enhance a reliable, governed and high-quality data foundation across various technologies, from PostgreSQL to Palantir Foundry

• Maintain code quality and automated testing using CI/CD pipelines

• Provide operational support and troubleshooting of the production issues

• Ensure timely delivery of business reporting deliverables aligned to closing cycles and financial markets needs
 About You
 You are a hands-on data engineer with a strong track record of delivering sustainable, data driven solutions. Your passion is engineering and Data practices and fully recognize the benefits of ETL processes that ensure data is accurate, reliable, and accessible. You take ownership for reliable operations, approach new challenges with a solution-oriented mindset, and enjoy partnering with business SMEs in cross-functional teams. You care about security, quality, user experience, documentation, testing, and the bigger picture.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:
 • Degree in Computer Science (Master's preferred) or a comparable engineering discipline
 • 5+ years' experience building and operating data solutions
 • Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL processes and data warehousing concepts
 • Strong knowledge of SQL and databases, preferably Postgres SQL
 • Strong programming skills in Python
 • E xperience with Data frameworks (Pandas, Polars, PySpark)
 • Experience with Palantir Foundry, Databricks or similar
 • Strong analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving skills
 • Good knowledge and work experience on automated testing (e.g. pytest) or test driven-development approach
 • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across global teams
 • Proficiency in English (written & verbal)
 These are additional nice to haves:
 • Experience on TypeScript / JavaScript
 • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools using Azure DevOps or equivalent platforms
 • Familiarity with batch processing and application operations, monitoring, and orchestration, preferably UC4
 • AI and ML engineering
 • Comfortable working in agile delivery environments (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira)
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between [EUR 2,400] and [EUR 4,100] per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.​
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

jobs.description:
About the Team
 In this position, you are part of a team supporting the North American technology landscape to facilitate Swiss Re Corporate Solution insurance products. The team's primary focus is to consistently provide superior customer service to our underwriting business partners. We focus on enabling strategic business changes to the North American region while also responding to issues and continuing to find ways to deliver operational efficiencies. To ensure consistent customer focus, strong relationships have been built with our business partners and vendors. The Requirements Engineer serves as the principal conduit between the business and the software development team throughout the lifecycle of an issue or change request.
 Role Purpose
 The Requirement Engineer is responsible for designing and validating business systems end-to-end, combining strong hands-on business analysis and engineering capabilities with emerging system-level thinking.
 They deliver production-grade business impactful systems through thorough developing solid understandings of business needs, grooming them into solution options, and translating them into robust quality technical designs for execution. The role is expected to also evolve towards a future state where system specification, AI-assisted engineering and agentic delivery models become more present.
 This role is explicitly part of an evolving capability model: candidates are expected to be strong requirement engineers today, with the ability to grow into end-to-end system design, specification and validation roles over time.
 Key Responsibilities
 End-to-End System Delivery
 • Work with Global Digital & Tech tech service teams to support strategic capability design / integration with NA landscape while ensuring quality implementation (design, testing, rollout).
 • Become E2E landscape expert as the basis to support production system issue root cause analysis and solution options to address.
 Translation of Intent & System Design
 • Develop stakeholder relationships across the business and Global Digital and Tech service landscape
• Gather and translate business requirements into scalable system design and working implementations
• Collaborate closely with Technical Product Owners to refine requirements and resolve ambiguity
• Define system components, interfaces and data flows, breaking down complex problems into composable technical solutions
 Integration, Quality & Operations
 • Design and implement integrations across APIs, messaging systems and platforms, applying both synchronous and asynchronous patterns
• Own production stability focused on deployment quality (design/testing adequacy) and addressing NA system production issues in an efficient manner
 AI-Assisted Engineering (Emerging)
 • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate system delivery where appropriate with a focus on translation of requirements into actionable development work packages
• Validate generated outputs for correctness, performance and adherence to standards
• Apply emerging AI capabilities pragmatically and begin structuring systems to support future agentic development
 Required Experience & Capabilities

• 5–10+ years in technology requirements engineering, system design or related roles
• Proven ability to design and deliver production systems end-to-end
• Solid understanding of APIs, data models, integration patterns and distributed systems
• Experience working across full development lifecycle (design → build → deploy → operate)
 Growth Potential Signals
 • Ability to think in end-to-end systems, not just components
• Strong problem decomposition and abstraction capability
• Experience developing, reviewing and validating complex implementation requirements
• Exposure to AI-assisted development tools or active interest in emerging engineering paradigms
• Strong technical communication and structured thinking

jobs.description:
Senior Distribution Manager
 Are you ready to shape the future of commercial insurance in Japan? Join our dynamic team as a Senior Distribution Manager and leverage your expertise to build strategic partnerships, drive profitable growth, and make a significant impact in one of the world's most sophisticated insurance markets.
 About the Role
 As Senior Distribution Manager, you'll be at the forefront of our distribution strategy in Japan, working directly with the Head of Customer and Distribution to transform strategic vision into market success. This influential leadership position offers the opportunity to build lasting relationships with key agencies and brokers while driving sustainable business growth.
 Key Responsibilities

• Execute and enhance distribution strategies for the Japan market aligned with our strategic direction

• Drive new business generation and portfolio growth through agencies and brokers across relevant lines of business

• Develop and manage senior-level relationships with key agencies and brokers to build long-term strategic partnerships

• Bridge communication between the Japanese market and underwriting teams to ensure effective business flows

• Lead and develop the Distribution team, fostering a high-performance and collaborative culture

• Oversee activation, development and performance management of assigned agencies and brokers

• Monitor and analyze market trends, broker dynamics and competitive developments to inform strategic decisions

• Influence across functions to improve operational effectiveness, service quality and market competitiveness

• Negotiate effectively with senior internal and external stakeholders to achieve strategic business objectives

• Drive innovation in distribution through digital platforms, new approaches and differentiated value propositions

• Manage distribution pipeline, forecasting and performance tracking with transparency to senior management

• Collaborate with underwriting, operations and other functions to ensure alignment and seamless execution

• Provide guidance for insurance solicitation materials and key marketing initiatives

• Ensure accurate oversight of sales activities and reporting within Customer 360 and other relevant systems

• Support strategic initiatives led by the Head Customer and Distribution

• Maintain compliance with all applicable internal policies and external laws and regulations

• Represent our company in senior-level meetings with clients, agencies, brokers and other stakeholders

About the Team
 You'll join Swiss Re Corporate Solutions (Swiss Re International SE), Tokyo Office. As part of our dynamic and growing Customer and Distribution team reporting directly to the Head of Customer and Distribution, you'll help deliver innovative solutions to customers, agencies and brokers in the Japanese market.
 About You
 You're a seasoned commercial insurance professional with a proven track record in distribution management in the Japanese market. You thrive in collaborative environments and can effectively navigate complex stakeholder relationships while maintaining a strong focus on results.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 10+ years' experience in commercial insurance, with significant exposure to agency and broker distribution

• Proven experience managing senior broker relationships and leading teams or functional initiatives

• Deep understanding of the Japanese corporate insurance market, distribution landscape and regulatory environment

• Strong execution capability with the ability to translate strategy into measurable results

• Native-level Japanese proficiency and business-level English reading and writing skills

• Excellent communication and influencing skills at senior internal and external levels

• Commercially minded with strong discipline in pipeline, performance and stakeholder management

• Self-motivated, resilient and able to operate effectively in a matrix organization

• Spoken English proficiency

• Experience with digital distribution channels and innovative insurance solutions

jobs.description:
As an Audit Manager with a focus on Reinsurance and Insurance in Group Internal Audit (GIA), you will leverage your experience across the end-to-end value chain while contributing to a broad range of audit activities. You will regularly engage with senior stakeholders and functional leaders across multiple business units.
 This role offers the opportunity to address themes with enterprise-wide impact and to help shape and strengthen the risk culture at Swiss Re.
 Key Responsibilities

• Work closely with the Audit Director for Re/Insurance audits to engage relevant stakeholders, continuously update risk assessments, and help shape the bi-annual audit plan.

• Lead and execute a portfolio of audits, taking ownership of select engagements from planning through reporting, while contributing as a key team member on others. Drive high-quality, risk-focused audit delivery by effectively managing timelines, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring audits are completed on schedule and within budget.

• Leverage your expertise to contribute to audit planning, enhance re/insurance subject matter knowledge within the team, and strengthen the quality of audit observations and insights.

• Act as a role model by challenging and coaching audit team members to deliver at a high standard and continuously improve.
 About the Team
 GIA provides independent and objective assurance to support the Board of Directors and Group Executive Committee in protecting Swiss Re’s assets, reputation, and sustainability. GIA’s vision is to advance Swiss Re’s resilience by delivering risk-responsive assurance and providing innovative insights that strengthen the control environment and support the achievement of business objectives.
 About You
 We are looking for an inspiring and curious professional who is a critical thinker, delivery-oriented, and a strong team player. You communicate effectively in English and are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments. You bring a passion for innovation and transformation.
 Additional Requirements

• 10+ years of experience in external and/or internal audit or related roles within the financial services industry

• Strong knowledge of property & casualty business, including treaty and facultative reinsurance, as well as specialty lines

• Degree in accounting, actuarial science, business, or another finance-related field

• Deep understanding of the (re)insurance industry

• Strong knowledge of risk, governance, and controls, as well as internal audit methodologies, audit project management, and continuous risk assessment frameworks

• Proven experience managing stakeholders and audit teams in a global, matrixed organization
 CPA, CA, CIA, or other relevant professional certification is a plus
 Our company operates under a hybrid work model, with the expectation that employees work from the office three days per week . Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship/visa transfers/visa extension or relocation support.
 The base salary hiring range for this new position located in Toronto is CAD $160,000 to $185,000. The specific base salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

jobs.description:
About the Team
 Global Engineering is a dynamic team that creates business opportunities by leveraging our technical capability, client services and tailor-made solutions. Our China team is recognized as one of the reputable leading reinsurers in China engineering market. We are now looking for experienced engineering underwriter to support our China growth strategy in China market.
 About the Role
 We're looking for a highly self-motivated and result-oriented Engineering Underwriter with strong commercial mindset to join Global Engineering China team, based in Beijing.
 Key focuses of this role are:

• To assist China Engineering team in developing and managing engineering reinsurance portfolio (combined treaty and facultative)

• To support Company strategy in strengthening our value proposition in China market

• To provide underwriting and technical support across Asia markets on an ad-hoc basis.
 Major Responsibilities

• Work with team to build up a sustainable and profitable engineering business portfolio (both treaty and facultative), including infrastructure, IDI, renewable energy, while delivering high‑quality underwriting in line with company philosophy and guidelines

• With support from senior underwriters, timely deliver tailor-made technical service to specific client(s) including underwriting training, site survey for infrastructure, managing MWS for offshore windfarm and TIS for IDI

• Strengthen SR Engineering market leader position by publishing technical articles or papers on selected technical topics, providing tailored reinsurance solution and exploring innovative new product

• Actively support SR China overall business strategy and collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams to deepen client partnerships and deliver sustainable, win‑win solutions.

• Properly maintain underwriting documentation, ensure good data quality in underwriting system and follow up post-bound activities such as premium payment, claim settlement, filing.

• Conduct research on selected technology development initiatives, actively contribute to the Swiss Re Global Engineering community.

• Regularly monitor portfolio performance and closely cooperate with actuary for ensuring proper costing loss reserve
 About You
 Qualifications & Requirements

• University degree in engineering discipline

• Minimum 3 years of experience in engineering underwriting or claims handling.

• Experience in construction projects or knowledge of building design standards and regulations is an advantage.

• Quick knowledge learner, passionate to learn new technical topics.

• Strong analytical skills and proactive problem-solving approach with ability to translate technical expertise into practical business solutions tailored to client needs.

• Proven team player with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with both internal and external.

• Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, multicultural environment, able to cope with pressure, with the flexibility to adapt to change.

• Good verbal and written communication skills in both Chinese and English.

About the Role
 In this pivotal role, you'll bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation, ensuring our insurance products deliver exceptional value. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate complex requirements into clear specifications that guide our development process.
 Key Responsibilities

• Analyze and clarify business requirements and translate them into functional and technical specifications including business architecture, process maps, wireframes and data models

• Ensure comprehensive specification of User Stories with all required data and background analysis available to the entire team

• Design and define related test cases and support the Product Owner in creating effective acceptance criteria

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Platform Product Owners, Technology Leads, Business Process Managers, Business Architecture and the Data Office to maintain end-to-end consistency of system, process and information architecture

• Anticipate and analyze customer needs to develop effective problem-solving solutions

• Organize and prioritize the Product Backlog based on Product Owner guidance

• Own production support for one or more business applications, addressing user requests directly or triaging more complex cases to the development team

• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation on the corporate Wiki

About the Team
 Our team is responsible for building products and solutions for the Corporate Solutions business unit. We work in a collaborative, innovative environment where your ideas will have real impact. We partner closely with colleagues around the globe, fostering a diverse and inclusive atmosphere where different perspectives help shape exceptional insurance products. As part of our team, you'll contribute to meaningful projects while developing your skills in a supportive, growth-oriented culture.
 What You Bring

• Experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role

• Practical knowledge of agile delivery

• Ability to work effectively with both business and technical teams

• Clear communication and stakeholder‑management skills

• General technical understanding of software or data‑enabled products
 Relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience

 You're a detail-oriented problem solver who thrives in collaborative environments. You have excellent analytical skills and can effectively translate between business and technical domains. You're proactive, customer-focused, and committed to delivering high-quality solutions that drive business value.
 We need you to bring in the following must haves:

• 5+ years of experience as a Requirements Engineer or in similar roles

• Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and experience working in cross-functional product teams

• Proficiency in tools like Jira or similar Agile management platforms like Azure DevOps

• Proficient in Visio, Figma or other process mapping tools, with good knowledge of BPMN

• Design and build end ‑ to ‑ end analytics solutions in Palantir Foundry

• Scalable PySpark data pipelines

• User ‑ facing web apps using Workshop and TypeScript

• Act as technical lead on initiatives, translating business needs into robust designs

• Improve architecture, performance, data quality, and developer experience

• Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing

• Collaborate in a global, cross ‑ functional environment

About the Team

The Specialty Analytics team delivers analytics for niche lines of business including Agriculture, Aviation, Credit & Surety, Cyber, Nuclear, and Political Violence. We are part of a global P&C data initiative and value ownership, collaboration, and leadership at all levels.

About You

You enjoy both building technical solutions and helping your team to continuously grow and improve through inspiring leadership.

• Senior level experience in data engineering or analytics

• Strong proficiency in Python and PySpark

• Solid understanding of data warehousing, ELT, and cloud data architecture

• Comfortable leading by example and mentoring others

• Strong problem ‑ solving and communication skills

These are additional nice to have:

• Experience building applications with JavaScript or TypeScript

• Palantir Foundry experience

• (Re)Insurance or financial domain knowledge

• Experience with Generative AI and/or Natural Language Processing

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Locations:
Kansas City, MO, US |
Chicago, IL, US

Help Shape the Future of Insurance—From a Legal and Regulatory Frontline
 We’re looking for a strategic, forward-thinking Legal Counsel to join our North America team and play a key role in supporting a complex, fast-moving (re)insurance business.
 This is a high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, governance, and business strategy—ideal for a lawyer who thrives in a dynamic environment and is energized by working closely with senior leaders, regulators, and cross-functional teams.
 You will help drive proactive regulatory reporting, strong governance practices, and business-enabling legal solutions across a diversified insurance platform. If you’re looking to combine technical excellence, regulatory insight, and real business impact, we’d love to hear from you.
 What You’ll Do
 Lead Regulatory & Governance Efforts

• Take a hands-on, proactive role in regulatory reporting and disclosures across U.S. insurance entities

• Partner with Compliance, Risk, Finance, and business leaders to deliver clear, accurate, and timely regulatory submissions

• Anticipate regulatory developments and translate them into practical guidance and action plans

• Support interactions with regulators, including preparing materials for examinations, inquiries, and meetings

• Help strengthen and streamline governance frameworks, reporting processes, and internal controls
 Be a Trusted Business Partner

• Serve as a go-to legal advisor for underwriting, claims, and operations teams, in particular for Swiss Re's Corporate Solutions Property & Specialty book across the United States

• Provide practical, solution-oriented guidance on insurance regulatory matters, in particular in relation to Property & Specialty

• Support innovative and complex insurance transactions, including bespoke and structured deals

• Collaborate on strategic initiatives, including in relation to Swiss Re's international programs and new business opportunities
 Work Across a Global, Collaborative Network

• Partner with colleagues across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, and Actuarial

• Contribute to cross-functional projects that shape how we operate and grow

• Engage with global teams on matters with broader business or regulatory impact

About the Team
 You will join the Corporate Solutions Legal North America team, a group of 10 experienced lawyers/legal professionals supporting a broad commercial insurance platform across the U.S. and Canada. The team works closely with the business as trusted advisors; balancing growth ambitions with regulatory discipline and reputational protection.
 We operate in a fast-paced, matrix environment and collaborate extensively with colleagues across regions and functions.

About You
 What You Bring
 Experience

• 6–10+ years of legal experience in a top law firm, insurance company, or financial services institution

• Strong background in U.S. insurance regulation and governance frameworks

• Experience with regulatory reporting, filings , or supervisory engagement preferred

• Familiarity with insurance transactions, policy wordings, or structured deals is a plus
 Skills & Mindset

• Commercially-minded and proactive—you anticipate issues before they arise

• Able to simplify complex legal and regulatory topics into clear, actionable advice

• Strong communicator with experience preparing senior-level or executive-facing materials

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment

• Collaborative, adaptable, and driven by delivering solutions, not just identifying risks
 Why Join Us

• Regulatory influence: Play a meaningful role in shaping how we engage with regulators across the U.S.

• Business exposure: Partner closely with underwriting and deal teams on complex transactions

• Collaborative culture: Join a high-performing, supportive legal team that values innovation and growth
 Additional Information

• Bar admission in at least one U.S. state required (IL, NY, or MO preferred)

• Travel: Limited (<10%)

• Other languages are a plus
 Our company operates under a hybrid work model, with the expectation that employees work from the office three days per week . Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship/visa transfers/visa extension or relocation support.
 The estimated base salary range for this position in Chicago, IL or Kansas City, MO, is $156,000 to $210,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. jobs.description:
About the Role
 We are looking for Procurement Specialist to join our team and help manage our organization’s procurement needs in area of Information Technology (IT).
 Responsibilities of Procurement Specialist IT include:

• Support a variety of initiatives to reduce costs and improve quality of goods and services provided by third parties for category areas such as Hardware, Software, Licenses, Cloud & Connectivity, IT Outsourcing

• Lead commercial negotiations for assigned business cases

• Prepare, review and negotiate contracts, initiate legal reviews and vendor due diligence process where needed

• Execute comprehensive RFx process followed by full contract life cycle management

• Review and approve purchase orders to ensure compliance with internal standards and guidelines

• Collaborate with Category Managers in developing and implementing procurement strategies across the organization

• Communicate with internal partners to ensure that purchased products and services meet the business needs and support strategic goals

• Cooperate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with digital governance
 About the Team
 You will be part of IT & Data Procurement, a unit within Group Procurement Team of Swiss Re. As a member of this unit you will work closely with Procurement Specialists and Category Managers based primarily in Bratislava, Zurich and London.
 About You

• You have a bachelor’s or master´s degree preferably in Economics / Business Administration or a Procurement, Supply chain degree.

• You have around 3-4 years of experience in purchasing of IT categories or similar in a global organization with multi-million spend.

• You have strong negotiations skills and can demonstrate focused delivery of significant cost savings/service improvements

• You are detailed and process oriented person.

• You have sophisticated verbal and written command of English (other language is desirable, German would be a plus).

• You are naturally proactive, a problem solver, able to navigate ambiguity and passionate about customer outcomes.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1,900 and EUR 3,200 per month (for a full-time role).
 The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits.

We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.

jobs.description:
About Role:
 This position is part of the Global Technical Accounting & Services organization, which has overall responsibility for the activities of Technical Accounting functions worldwide, including the Business Solution Centers. This position will report to the Manager Operations Southeast Asia & India.
 This team is expected to regularly meet the KPI, Quality targets pertaining to Technical Accounting Team & perform extensive data validations/analysis based on Reinsurance Contract wording for the respective Clients. One of the key activities is to ensure that payments received from clients (for example premiums) and payments made to clients (for example claims) reconcile against those payments expected. The client management expectation of this role would require you to correspond with internal and external stakeholders/clients to resolve issues related to Data quality aspect. Improvising while working within a set framework of policies and processes is key to the role.
 Principal Responsibilities towards:
 Operations:

• Consistently deliver on operational commitments.

• Develop & create data analysis summaries that aid decision making within and outside the Technical Accounting boundaries & can be consumed by multiple cross functional teams.

• Monitor the financial number's accounted into Technical Accounting Swiss Re system on regular basis & identify adverse Premium/Claim trends from the Client data.

• Deliver on the TA mandate including KPI'S to effectively manage/accelerate Cash in the books while demonstrating Swiss Re Values.

• Premium and Claims validation to be performed on the Client Seriatim data, make sure client reported data is complying with Contract wordings/agreement.

• Taking initiative at functional level to enhance the technical/Process knowledge of people across Technical Accounting team & act as Subject Matter Expert.
 People:

• Collaborate with team members and take ownership for team activities in specific markets

• Deliver results in consultation and as part of multiple-matrixed teams besides directly assigned work

• Build a network with both cross-functional and cross-geographical Swiss Re teams to discuss & Implement best Business Practices.
 Stakeholders (Cross Functional Team Coordination):

• Build and manage strong relationships with stakeholders and contribute to strengthening client relationship.

• Managing efficient and effective relevant business processes, portfolios in coordination with stakeholders.
 About the Team

This position is part of the Global Technical Accounting & Services organization for Life & Health Business, which has overall responsibility for Technical Accounting functions worldwide, including Business Solution Centers. The team ensures that payments received from clients (premiums) and payments made to clients (claims) reconcile against expected amounts. Working within established frameworks while finding innovative solutions is key to the team's success. The role reports to the Manager Operations Southeast Asia & India.
 About you:

• Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Accounting, Insurance or equivalent field.

• 7+ years of work experience in the banking /insurance or any other financial services industry.

jobs.title: UX/UI Designer
jobs.description:
About our team

We are a diverse and dynamic team of experienced and motivated individuals who are passionate about solving complex problems through simple, intuitive designs.

Our Design Team is organized around products – and you will be too. Instead of time-boxed projects, we are responsible for the experience design of a landscape of products at various stages of their lifecycle.

Our product portfolio consists of more than 150 web and mobile applications supporting reinsurance business functions such as Sales, Underwriting, and Claims Management.

Our guiding principles are collaboration, pragmatism, and agility. We strive to create experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and impactful, helping our users work more effectively while supporting Swiss Re's mission to address some of the world's most urgent challenges, including climate change and closing the protection gap.

We are looking for a UX/UI Designer with a proven track record of designing high-quality digital experiences. Given the complexity of our industry, we value creative problem solvers who enjoy tackling sophisticated business, asking questions, addressing technical, and analytical challenges and translating them into meaningful user experiences.

About the role

As a UX/UI Designer, you will help shape intuitive, scalable, and impactful digital experiences across a portfolio of products. You will work closely with Product Owners, Business Experts, Engineers, and fellow Designers to understand user needs, define solutions, and deliver experiences that balance user value, business objectives, and technical feasibility.

You will be expected to contribute both as a hands-on designer and as a strategic partner, helping teams make informed decisions about product direction, experience quality, and long-term usability.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive the end-to-end design process from discovery through delivery for one or more digital products

• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Experts, Engineers, and other Designers to create solutions that are desirable, feasible, and viable

• Conduct and apply user research, usability testing, journey mapping, and other user-centred design practices to inform product decisions

• Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma and our design system

• Apply established UX patterns, interaction design principles, and accessibility standards to create intuitive and consistent user experiences

• Contribute to product strategy by identifying user needs, opportunities, and experience improvements across the broader product ecosystem

• Bring a systems-thinking and service-design perspective to understand end-to-end workflows and identify opportunities beyond individual screens or features

• Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure design quality and successful implementation

• Use data, analytics, and user feedback to continuously evaluate and improve product experiences

• Contribute to the evolution, governance, and documentation of design systems, UX patterns, accessibility standards, reusable design assets, and design guidance that enable consistency and scalability across products and teams

• Explore and apply emerging technologies, including AI-assisted design and development workflows, where they create meaningful value for users and teams

• Help shape experiences that incorporate intelligent systems, ensuring they remain understandable, trustworthy, and human-centred

About you

• 3+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, Interaction Design, or a related field (experience in complex B2B environments is a plus)

• Strong proficiency in Figma and modern design workflows

• Demonstrated ability to apply UX patterns, interaction design principles, information architecture, and visual design best practices

• Experience working with design systems and component-based design approaches; contributing to a design system is a plus

• Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design principles (WCAG knowledge is a plus)

• Comfortable applying user-centred design methods, including research, usability testing, journey mapping, and iterative design

• Excellent communication, collaboration, facilitation, and storytelling skills

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and clearly document design decisions, patterns, standards, and processes for diverse audiences

• Systems thinker who can balance detailed design execution with broader product, service, and business goals

jobs.description:
Locations:
Alpharetta, GA, US |
Schaumburg, IL, US |
Windsor, CT, US

Swiss Re uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week.
 This position can be based near one of our Swiss Re offices, including (but not limited to) Alpharetta, GA -- Windsor, CT -- Schaumburg, IL.
 We have an excellent opportunity for an experienced Clinical Risk Manager to join our team in Swiss Re's Accident & Health division!
 About the Role:
 This position requires a strong clinical background in disease state management/case management experience. A background in a Clinical Risk Management position is encouraged but will consider qualified candidates especially those with an oncology or cardiology background. This position is ideal for applicants looking to enter the insurance sector in a nurse consultant role.
 In this position you have the responsibility to use your knowledge and experience to project expected treatment costs based on ICD 9 / ICD 10 codes, current treatment plan and other pertinent medical information.
 Principal responsibilities include :

• Review medical conditions and respond with a cost analysis coordinated to the Stop Loss case characteristics. Including the review and assessment of large claim reports, shock claim summary reports, trigger reports and large case management notes

• Identify high risk associated with individuals and communicate required stop loss cost analyzation of current clinical conditions and future cost projections

• Utilize provided clinical resoources such as Predict Dr., NCCN, NORD, and CDC

• Supply and manage documentation with clinical summary and estimated cost of services for each individual identified as at risk
 About the Team:
 The Clinical Risk team brings value to Swiss Re working in close collaboration with Underwriters to determine and evaluate potential risk and associated costs of projected treatments and care. We are a welcoming team of nurses who are passionate about what they do. Diversity and Inclusion are a part of our winning culture. We believe that our individual performances contribute to the success of the team. Come join us and be a part of something big!
 About You:
 You bring your strong analytical and problem-solving expertise! Your excellent interpersonal skills enable you to successfully navigate cross-functional collaboration. You have an ability to prioritize well and work independently with little direct supervision, while handling numerous projects at once.
 Additional requirements include :

• Minimum of Associate or Bachelor's degree in nursing with at least 1 year of Stop Loss Nursing experience

• Must have up to date registered nurse (RN) license

• Able to demonstrate a track record of producing work that is highly accurate, shows attention to detail, and reflects well on the organization

• Proven experience managing mulitple projects and working well while handling large volumes of work (with deadlines)

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Computer proficiency, specifically strong typing skills and Internet research skills, must have a clear understanding of Microsoft Word, Microsoft Office and Excel
 The estimated base salary range for this position is $84,000 to $140,000. The specific salary offered for any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Actuary
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for transforming complex data into actionable insights? Join our team where your actuarial expertise will directly impact business decisions across North America. This role offers you the opportunity to be at the intersection of traditional actuarial science and cutting-edge analytical techniques, helping shape the future of life insurance risk assessment.
 About the Role
 As a Senior Research & Development (R&D) Actuary, you'll be instrumental in developing and maintaining sophisticated mortality and lapse assumptions that drive our business decisions. You'll leverage your analytical prowess to translate experience data into valuable insights that inform product development, pricing strategies, and portfolio management across both Canadian and US markets.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead experience analysis initiatives to monitor population and insured life trends across direct insurance and reinsurance portfolios

• Develop key assumptions for mortality and lapse rates used in new business costing, in-force management opportunities, and business valuation

• Analyze complex data sets to identify underlying drivers of mortality and lapse, including policyholder behavior, product characteristics, and underwriting methods

• Create innovative tools and analytics to enhance monitoring methods and improve assumption accuracy

• Stay current with industry research and publications to continuously refine our methodologies

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Canadian and US market units, Risk Management, In-force Optimization, and Portfolio Steering & Monitoring teams

• Present findings internally to educate colleagues and externally to clients, potentially at industry events and special client meetings

• Document thoroughly all assumption development processes in compliance with corporate governance standards

• Ensure alignment between developed assumptions and their implementation in models to prevent unexpected errors

About the Team
 The Actuarial and Research Development team specializes in life insurance experience monitoring/analysis and assumption development support for both Canadian and US markets. Our team leads and ensures consistent application of sound actuarial principles, methods, and tools across the organization. We provide critical insights that drive product development, pricing strategies, and experience analysis.
 About You
 You're a detail-oriented professional who thrives on solving complex problems and communicating technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences. You have a curious mindset that drives you to continuously improve methodologies and challenge conventional thinking. You're comfortable working with ambiguity and can balance multiple perspectives when making recommendations.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Fellowship with the Society of Actuaries with 7+ years of relevant experience

• Bachelor's degree in mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, or related field with demonstrated mathematical and analytical abilities

• Experience in mortality and lapse assumption development for life insurance products

• Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations

• Strong communication skills with the ability to present effectively to various stakeholders
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with advanced analytical techniques (GLMs, machine learning, AI)

• Proficiency in technical tools such as Excel, Visual Basic, R, Python, SAS, or AXIS

• Knowledge of actuarial modeling platforms like ICE or Stargate

• Experience working in both Canadian and US insurance markets

• Demonstrated ability to influence without authority in cross-functional teams

• Creative problem-solving approach and resourcefulness in overcoming barriers

• Experience presenting at industry events or client meetings

Do you have a passion for transforming complex data into actionable insights? Join our team where your actuarial expertise will directly impact business decisions across North America. This role offers you the opportunity to be at the intersection of traditional actuarial science and cutting-edge analytical techniques, helping shape the future of life insurance risk assessment.
 About the Role
 As a Senior Research & Development (R&D) Actuary, you'll be instrumental in developing and maintaining sophisticated mortality and lapse assumptions that drive our business decisions. You'll leverage your analytical prowess to translate experience data into valuable insights that inform product development, pricing strategies, and portfolio management across both Canadian and US markets.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead experience analysis initiatives to monitor population and insured life trends across direct insurance and reinsurance portfolios

• Develop key assumptions for mortality and lapse rates used in new business costing, in-force management opportunities, and business valuation

• Analyze complex data sets to identify underlying drivers of mortality and lapse, including policyholder behavior, product characteristics, and underwriting methods

• Create innovative tools and analytics to enhance monitoring methods and improve assumption accuracy

• Stay current with industry research and publications to continuously refine our methodologies

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Canadian and US market units, Risk Management, In-force Optimization, and Portfolio Steering & Monitoring teams

• Present findings internally to educate colleagues and externally to clients, potentially at industry events and special client meetings

• Document thoroughly all assumption development processes in compliance with corporate governance standards

• Ensure alignment between developed assumptions and their implementation in models to prevent unexpected errors

About the Team
 The Actuarial and Research Development team specializes in life insurance experience monitoring/analysis and assumption development support for both Canadian and US markets. Our team leads and ensures consistent application of sound actuarial principles, methods, and tools across the organization. We provide critical insights that drive product development, pricing strategies, and experience analysis.
 About You
 You're a detail-oriented professional who thrives on solving complex problems and communicating technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences. You have a curious mindset that drives you to continuously improve methodologies and challenge conventional thinking. You're comfortable working with ambiguity and can balance multiple perspectives when making recommendations.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Fellowship with the Society of Actuaries with 7+ years of relevant experience

• Bachelor's degree in mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, or related field with demonstrated mathematical and analytical abilities

• Experience in mortality and lapse assumption development for life insurance products

• Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations

• Strong communication skills with the ability to present effectively to various stakeholders
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with advanced analytical techniques (GLMs, machine learning, AI)

• Proficiency in technical tools such as Excel, Visual Basic, R, Python, SAS, or AXIS

• Knowledge of actuarial modeling platforms like ICE or Stargate

• Experience working in both Canadian and US insurance markets

• Demonstrated ability to influence without authority in cross-functional teams

• Creative problem-solving approach and resourcefulness in overcoming barriers

• Experience presenting at industry events or client meetings

About the Role
 Do you want to be part of an international company that is making a difference in the world? Are you an accounting professional with experience working in the Life & Health reinsurance field?
 The successful candidate in this role will assume responsibility for the end-to-end Financial Accounting & Reporting for the L&H Re Canadian Branch, collaborating with Finance and Actuarial teams in Toronto, Zurich, Bratislava and Bangalore. You will report directly to the Head of Reporting, and will have direct interaction with the Canadian CFO, as well as with other business leads. Your duties will be performed in compliance with Local / Group requirements and the internal control framework.
 You will be accountable for producing accurate and timely technical and non-technical balances for regulatory reporting, including both inbound and ceded business. You will also be reviewing and analyzing actual results compared with expectations and prior periods. The role is expected to work closely with other functions and will also be involved in recurring and ad hoc capital planning. There will be opportunities to contribute to key projects within the Reinsurance environment, including new transactions, and migrations from legacy information systems to new platforms.
 Specific responsibilities will include:

• Developing and maintaining financial analysis and reporting processes and tools, covering gross inward business and any related intercompany or external reinsurance.

• Analyzing and providing explanations for the Branch's financial results for Canadian statutory/IFRS and Swiss statutory bases, including investigation of unusual variances and obtaining appropriate analytical support.

• Performing automation and streamlining of processes to improve efficiency and documentation quality. You will need to be creative, decisive and challenge processes, procedures, and controls to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Finance team.

• Submission of quarterly and/or annual filings with regulators (e.g. OSFI) and other external partners such as industry associations

• Provide necessary support in Capital projections and capital reporting

• Ensuring that all reporting requirements are met in accordance with evolving Group and regulatory requirements.

• Working with other functions (Actuarial Management, Claims, Technical Accounting, Operations) as well as with Finance colleagues in Canada, Zurich, Bratislava, and Bangalore to resolve accounting and administration issues.

• Reviewing the technical (cashflows/IFRS17 financials) and non-technical (investment/expenses/cash) reconciliations and analysis performed by Central teams.

• Perform & document internal control processes and respond to internal and external audit inquiries.
 About the Team
 The L&H Finance Reinsurance team, within the overall Canadian Finance team, are responsible for the accounting and reporting of Life and Health (L&H) reinsurance technical balances (premiums, claims, commissions, reserves, together with intra-group reinsurance – "IGR" - thereon), and non-technical balances (e.g., investments, general expenses) for Swiss Reinsurance Corporation, L&H Canadian Branch (the "Branch"). The team works with various business partners in support of relevant transactions. You will be joining a diverse and inclusive team of finance professionals that come from a variety of backgrounds and experience within the industry. The team works well in a collaborative environment while fostering and developing independent thought.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in an Accounting/Finance related discipline; or 3-5 years related experience, in a reinsurance/insurance environment (preferable) or other complex industry.

• CPA, or equivalent (current or in the near future)

• Strong learning skills, detail oriented, analytical skills, and decision-making skills.

• Knowledge of insurance products, preferably in the reinsurance space. Exposure to capital reporting, as well as knowledge of reinsurance contracts is an asset.

• Strong technical computer skills, including Word, Excel (Pivot Tables, knowledge of INDEX/MATCH/XLOOKUP and SUMIFS formulas is an asset), PowerPoint, and business objects.

• Proven organizational and time management skills; ability to handle multiple priorities.

• Proven interpersonal skills, including working internally across departments.

• Effective written and oral communication skills.

• Minimum 7–10 years relevant experience within the insurance and/or reinsurance industry, gained in underwriting, broking, or related market-facing roles. Experience leading placements, negotiations, and client relationships is highly desirable

• Strong background in building broker and client relationships.

• Proficiency in the use of underwriting tools and ability to interpret and judge the results

• Ability to handle multiple deals in parallel without losing oversight

• Strong Commercial mindset combined with technical expertise.

• Excellent Communication, negotiation and influencing skills.

• Good level of energy and pro-active behaviour

Our Global Specialty team consists of problem solvers driven by passion, powered by knowledge - and all of this with a good pinch of fun. jobs.description:
Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President
 Division: CCB-Group Security & Technology Platforms (51003024)
 Department: CCBN-Cyber Defence Operations (54000806)
 Join a team of cybersecurity professionals and help Swiss Re to fulfil its mission in making the world more resilient. As a Cybersecurity Analyst, you'll be monitoring current threats by analysing and handling major cyber incidents and implementing standards. What's more, you'll be working in a hybrid setup, perfectly balancing work from home and the office premises.
 About The Role
 Cyber Defence is the focal point for all security activities across Swiss Re. We are responsible for keeping the company safe – by going the extra mile in terms of preciseness and diligence. As part of the Security Team, Cyber Defence is responsible for maintaining security operations, focused on delivering high-quality detection monitoring and response solutions. We're looking for a cybersecurity professional who'll use their creative thinking to investigate alerts, and helping us to improve our incident response techniques.
 In your role, you will…

• Proactively identify and respond to cyber threats

• Implement and ensure appropriate standards

• Craft detection content

• Prioritize triage events

• Improve existing detection content and playbooks

• Ensure in-time incident response

• Perform on-duty/ on- call support

• Handle major security incidents

• Understand the environment and applications

• Analyse and document incidents
 About You

• Experience in cyber security as an analyst or incident responder (in a SOC/CSIRT setup, preferably)

• In-depth knowledge of current threat landscape, offensive tooling, and OWASP and MITRE ATT&CK® techniques

• Technical writing skills to present complex topics to non-technical audiences

• Excellent oral and written communication skills (English)

• Malware and exploit analysis (or reverse engineering)

• Developing hypothesis-driven threat hunts

• Analysing various events, including but not limited to web traffic, underlying network protocols, malware, lateral movement TTPs (techniques, tactics, and procedures), or Microsoft and Linux security events

• Logfile correlation and analysis

• System and memory analysis

• Chain of custody and forensic acquisitions

• Major incident response or breach investigation management
 Nice-to-Have

• Experience developing in Python, Kusto, or any other scripting language

• Experience with Azure or Amazon AWS

jobs.title: (Senior) Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about quantitative modelling, financial markets, and reinsurance? Join Swiss Re's Financial Market Portfolios team and work at the intersection of reinsurance, financial markets, and technology, supporting innovative Financial Solutions and capital management transactions across global markets.
 About the Role
 As a Portfolio Manager, you will help manage a diverse portfolio of Financial Solutions transactions exposed to financial market risks. You will work across transaction onboarding, valuation, risk management, portfolio analytics, and process automation, collaborating with experts across Swiss Re's global organization.
 Key Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and enhance quantitative models supporting pricing, valuation, risk management, and performance monitoring

• Manage transaction models and analytics throughout the transaction lifecycle, from onboarding through ongoing portfolio management

• Support the in-force management of Financial Market Transformation (FMT), Remote Risk Transactions (RRT), VA GMxB, Longevity, and other Financial Solutions transactions across Asia, EMEA, and the US, with a focus on Asia

• Automate modelling and reporting processes using modern programming, data analytics, and AI-assisted development tools

• Perform transaction performance analyses, investigations, and portfolio monitoring to identify key drivers and improvement opportunities

• Support the onboarding of new transactions and products (e.g., IUL, FIA, RILA), coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation

• Collaborate with stakeholders across L&H Structured Solutions, Trading & Structuring, Quantitative Analytics, Client Markets, Financial Risk Management, Financial Lines Valuation, Treasury, and Market Units
 About the Team
 The Financial Market Portfolios team manages a diverse portfolio of Financial Solutions transactions and plays a central role in supporting business growth through robust valuation, risk management, portfolio analytics, and performance monitoring.
 About You
 We are looking for candidates with:

• A degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline

• 6+ years of experience in quantitative modelling, actuarial modelling, financial analytics, or related fields

• Strong programming and debugging skills, preferably in Python, R, C/C++, or C#

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex quantitative concepts effectively

• Interest in financial markets, insurance, and reinsurance

• Curiosity, initiative, and a continuous learning mindset
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in structured reinsurance or financial markets transactions

• Understanding of financial market risk concepts, including interest rates, credit spreads, derivatives, hedging, and ALM

• Experience with actuarial modelling platforms such as Prophet, AXIS, or RAFM

• Experience with modern software development tools (e.g. Git, GitHub) and AI-assisted development tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude) to improve process efficiency

• Knowledge of IFRS 17, IFRS 9, EVM, and local statutory valuation frameworks

• Professional qualifications such as FSA, CERA, CFA, FRM, or equivalent
 We welcome applications from candidates with varying levels of experience. The final role level and title will be determined based on the successful candidate's skills, experience, and qualifications. Candidates with less experience may be considered for an appropriate role within the team.

jobs.title: Data & AI Enablement Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about driving digital transformation in legal & compliance? Join our innovative team where you'll leverage cutting-edge technology, AI and data analytics to revolutionize how legal and compliance functions operate across a global organization. This exciting opportunity allows you to shape the future of legal and compliance through innovative technology solutions while collaborating with diverse stakeholders in a dynamic environment.
 About the Role

As a Data & AI Enablement Analyst, you will support how Legal & Compliance uses data, analytics and AI to create practical business value across Swiss Re. You will work closely with Legal & Compliance experts, data analysts, project managers and technology partners to support data-driven solutions, dashboards and AI-enabled capabilities. This includes contributing to solutions on Swiss Re’s group-wide data platform, supporting Power BI dashboards where needed, assisting with data preparation and testing, and helping stakeholders shape practical AI use cases such as custom GPTs, Copilot agents or similar tools. This role is well suited for a curious early-career professional with solid data foundations, strong interest in data analytics, technology and AI, willingness to learn, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Key Responsibilities

• Support the development and maintenance of Legal & Compliance-specific data & analytics solutions using our advanced data analytics platform.

• Assist in data preparation, modelling and visualisation to support monitoring of key Compliance risks and business insights.

• Contribute to the enhancement, testing and continuous improvement of digital solutions and Power BI dashboards.

• AI Innovation : Help identify, explore and prototype AI use cases, including custom GPTs, Copilot agents or similar AI assistants, to improve information processing and enhance efficiency.

• Prompt Engineering & AI Enablement : Support stakeholders with prompt design, testing and refinement, helping them use AI tools in a structured and effective way.

• Business Analysis : Support requirements gathering and translate business needs into clear, actionable inputs for data analysts, developers and delivery partners.

• Solution Validation : Support testing coordination, UAT preparation, test cases, issue triage and rollout readiness.

• Governance & Compliance : Ensure delivered solutions consider applicable governance, data quality, data protection and compliance requirements.

• Cross-functional Collaboration : Work closely with Legal & Compliance experts, data analysts, IT partners, Risk & Control functions and group-wide AI initiatives.
 About the Team

This is an exciting opportunity to join our global Legal & Compliance Analytics & Innovation team, based in Zürich and Bratislava. The team is responsible for shaping the Legal & Compliance digital strategy and improving the use of data, analytics, AI, and technology for the benefit of Legal and Compliance across the Swiss Re Group, while driving insights for management and key stakeholders. Our services include business analysis, data analytics, data governance, and implementing innovative AI- and technology-enabled use cases. The development of analytics and innovation capabilities is a key strategic direction for Legal and Compliance.
 About You

You are curious, structured and proactive, with a strong interest in data, analytics and AI. You enjoy solving problems, working with data and exploring how new technologies can create practical business value. You are comfortable engaging with different stakeholders, asking good questions and helping turn ideas into clear, actionable solutions. You bring solid analytical and technical foundations, a willingness to learn and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues. You are interested in using AI responsibly and helping others apply it in a practical, structured and value-adding way.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Hands-on experience gained in a professional setting working with data, analytics or reporting tools, for example SQL, Python, Power BI, Excel or similar.

• Good understanding of core data concepts such as data quality, reporting logic, KPIs and basic analytical thinking.

• Strong interest in AI, prompt engineering and the practical use of tools such as custom GPTs, Copilot agents or similar AI assistants.

• Ability to understand requirements from non-technical stakeholders and explain data or AI topics in a clear and simple way.

• Curious, proactive and willing to learn new tools, platforms and ways of working.

• Comfortable with working in teams with both technical and non-technical colleagues in a dynamic international environment.

• Proficiency in English is required.
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with Power BI or similar visualisation tools.

• Familiarity with business analysis, testing, UAT or rollout support.

• Exposure to Legal, Compliance, Risk Management, Audit or other control functions.

• Experience in financial services or another regulated environment.
 For Slovakia, the base salary range for this position is between 2,400 EUR and 4,100 EUR for a full-time role. The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role
 • the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.

jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned SAP FI expert ready to make a real impact at the intersection of finance and cutting-edge technology? Join a globally distributed, collaborative team where your expertise will shape the future of SAP S/4 HANA solutions and drive meaningful change across a complex, fast-paced financial landscape. If you thrive on solving challenging problems and turning business requirements into elegant IT solutions, this role is for you!

About the Role
 As a Senior SAP FI Consultant, you'll be at the heart of our SAP S/4 HANA ecosystem — maintaining, designing and implementing innovative financial IT solutions. This is a fantastic opportunity to work with the latest SAP technology, collaborate with talented colleagues across the globe and take full end-to-end ownership of impactful initiatives from concept to production.
 Key Responsibilities

• SAP customizing and system parametrisation to ensure robust, scalable and efficient IT solutions

• Conduct IT business analysis across key financial domains including Lease Accounting (RE-FX) , Accounts Receivables (AR) , Accounts Payables (AP) , Bank Connectivity, Validations, Substitutions and IT interfaces with other systems

• Translate business requirements into functional designs and system specifications , covering all aspects of new solution implementations including testing and deployment to production

• Analyse, document and discuss requirements for new solutions and improvements in close collaboration with business experts, other SAP Business Analysts and Application Engineers

• Partner with ABAP developers during the realisation phase to ensure accurate understanding and implementation of business requirements through to production

• Support with incident handling, maintenance of productive IT solutions and provide quarter close support to ensure business continuity

About the Team
 You'll be joining a diverse and dynamic team of SAP IT business analysts, UC4, CPI, ABAP and HANA developers and application engineers. Our globally distributed team works closely with internal Finance colleagues, with a significant and vibrant hub based right here in Bratislava. Our mission is to run, maintain, and continuously improve existing SAP functionalities while also developing innovative new solutions. We own multiple interfaces to and from SAP FI and a variety of custom solutions in SAP designed to support both internal and external requirements.
 About You
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Finance or related Business field

• 7+ years of hands-on experience within SAP FI and SAP customizing

• Domain knowledge in Lease Accounting (RE-FX), Accounts Receivables (AR) and Accounts Payables (AP) would be an asset

• Basic knowledge of SQL and the ability to apply it in the context of SAP data analysis and troubleshooting

• Ability to analyse and tackle business and IT related issues

• Strong conceptual thinking and high level of abstraction — the ability to quickly grasp complex systems and processes

• Excellent communication skills with a ''Can do" behaviour and the ability to engage effectively with both technical and business stakeholders

• Great teammate , who works with dedication in the team, but also when working independently

• Resilience and adaptability — comfortable working under pressure and navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced environment

• Strong end-to-end ownership and proactive approach
 F or Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 3,200 and EUR 5,300 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

Join Swiss Re's Financial Market Portfolios team and work at the intersection of reinsurance, financial markets, and technology, supporting innovative Financial Solutions and capital management transactions across global markets.

 As a Portfolio Manager, you will help manage a diverse portfolio of Financial Solutions transactions exposed to financial market risks. You will work across transaction onboarding, valuation, risk management, portfolio analytics, and process automation, collaborating with experts across Swiss Re's global organization.
 Key Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and enhance quantitative models supporting pricing, valuation, risk management, and performance monitoring

• Manage transaction models and analytics throughout the transaction lifecycle, from onboarding through ongoing portfolio management

• Support the in-force management of Financial Market Transformation (FMT), Remote Risk Transactions (RRT), VA GMxB, Longevity, and other Financial Solutions transactions across Asia, EMEA, and the US, with a focus on Asia

• Automate modelling and reporting processes using modern programming, data analytics, and AI-assisted development tools

• Perform transaction performance analyses, investigations, and portfolio monitoring to identify key drivers and improvement opportunities

• Support the onboarding of new transactions and products (e.g., IUL, FIA, RILA), coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation

• Collaborate with stakeholders across L&H Structured Solutions, Trading & Structuring, Quantitative Analytics, Client Markets, Financial Risk Management, Financial Lines Valuation, Treasury, and Market Units
 About the Team
 The Financial Market Portfolios team manages a diverse portfolio of Financial Solutions transactions and plays a central role in supporting business growth through robust valuation, risk management, portfolio analytics, and performance monitoring.
 About You
 We are looking for candidates with:

• A degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline

• 6+ years of experience in quantitative modelling, actuarial modelling, financial analytics, or related fields

• Strong programming and debugging skills, preferably in Python, R, C/C++, or C#

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex quantitative concepts effectively

• Interest in financial markets, insurance, and reinsurance

• Curiosity, initiative, and a continuous learning mindset
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in structured reinsurance or financial markets transactions

• Understanding of financial market risk concepts, including interest rates, credit spreads, derivatives, hedging, and ALM

• Experience with actuarial modelling platforms such as Prophet, AXIS, or RAFM

• Experience with modern software development tools (e.g. Git, GitHub) and AI-assisted development tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude) to improve process efficiency

• Knowledge of IFRS 17, IFRS 9, EVM, and local statutory valuation frameworks

• Professional qualifications such as FSA, CERA, CFA, FRM, or equivalent
