jobs.title: Experience Studies Actuarial
jobs.description:
Our team forms part of L&H Pricing & Portfolio Performance (PPP) within the Chief Underwriting Office (CUO) . PPP combines pricing discipline with portfolio oversight to ensure consistent risk management, profitability, and performance across both new business and in‑force portfolios.
 The L&H Experience Studies (ES) Centre , within PPP, is responsible for the governance, methodologies, and tooling of Experience Studies across L&H Re globally. The ES Centre develops, maintains, and evolves the Experience Studies Platform (ESP) and associated tools, while providing guidance, standards, and expert support to regional teams that execute Experience Studies locally.
 This role sits within the Experience Studies Centre and does not run experience studies . Instead, it focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining tools , defining standards, and enabling Experience Studies teams worldwide to run high‑quality, consistent studies.
 The role is responsible for delivering and continuously improving state‑of‑the‑art analytical tools, platforms, and methodologies that support Experience Studies across L&H. Acting as both a developer and Experience Studies expert , the role provides technical leadership, programming expertise, and methodological guidance to ensure effective, scalable, and well‑governed Experience Studies.
 This role requires a strong combination of:

• Experience Studies domain expertise (life & health actuarial concepts, methodologies, and interpretation)

• Advanced programming skills , particularly in R , with a strong focus on analytical tooling and platform development

• Ability to work at the intersection of business, actuarial methodology, and technology

• Strong communication skills to guide, enable, and influence global teams without directly executing studies
 Key Responsibilities

Platform and Tool Development

jobs.description:
About the Team
 The Southeast Asia Legal team supports Swiss Re’s businesses and operations across Southeast Asia, partnering closely with internal stakeholders to manage legal and regulatory matters in a dynamic, cross‑border environment. The team provides practical, high‑quality, and commercially sound legal advice across a broad spectrum of areas, including corporate matters, regulatory issues, product development, and insurance and reinsurance contracts. Working as part of an international and collaborative team, the Southeast Asia Legal team members are trusted advisors who play a key role in enabling effective risk management while supporting business growth in line with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.
 About the Role

The Associate Legal Counsel will be expected to provide timely, commercially viable, practical and high-quality legal advice to enable effective oversight and management of legal risks in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, and industry standards. The legal advice and support provided would include general corporate issues, regulatory and compliance issues, product development and insurance contracts.
 This job is ideal for an individual who is looking for a challenge and is keen to work in a dynamic and energetic environment with an international team.
 Main responsibilities:

• Provide effective, commercially sound and practical legal advice on (re)insurance business and operations

• Advise on (re)insurance agreements

• Conduct legal and regulatory review of transactions (draft documents, negotiate the terms), instructing and managing outside counsel

• Manage legal and regulatory issues relating to products, business strategies and operating models

• Review and negotiate commercial agreements with business partners, agents or brokers

• Monitor and advise on legal and regulatory trends affecting relevant business areas

• Engage and collaborate with members of the Southeast Asia Legal team, business and functions across various jurisdictions within SEA in the provision of cross border legal support

• Support internal group projects and strategic initiatives

• Support governance activities such as participating in management committee meetings and handling internal and external approvals on appointments and other governance related matters
 About You

• 5 to 9 years PQE, qualified lawyer from a reputable university

• Good team player and able to work in a collaborative and agile environment

• Able to work independently and collaborate with teams and stakeholders across various jurisdictions

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Good communication and cross-cultural skills

• Prior experience in insurance or reinsurance matters required

• Prior experience in and good understanding of regulatory and licensing topics in cross-border scenarios preferred

• Possess excellent drafting, negotiation and influencing skills

jobs.title: Senior Actuarial Analyst
jobs.description:
About the role
 To support the ANZ Pricing & ES team, by providing technical expertise in respect of product pricing, experience studies and other initiatives.

Key Accountabilities

• Support the pricing actuaries in pricing treaties for ANZ market; responsibilities will focus on Open Treaty Reviews

• Support ES requirements for the region if any

• Provide Quote support/advisory recommendation for various Lines of Business and maintenance of pricing Terms of Trade.

• Provide support in inputs through analysis and maintenance of pricing Terms of Trade.

• Support the ANZ pricing actuaries in any local/regional projects as required.

• Work effectively with a cross-functional team of experts from client markets, underwriting, and claims towards assessing the risk associated with a treaty or opportunity.

• Provide technical, research and project management input for product development initiatives and pricing policy.

• Always ensuring the adherence to pricing guidelines and standard methodologies, and their consistent application.

• Mentoring the junior associates of the team.

Key Skills & Knowledge

• Excellent technical knowledge in all areas of pricing, experience studies and product development and fundamental knowledge of the products and services offered by insurers/reinsurers.

• Ability to apply actuarial judgement in a commercial environment.

• Good understanding of actuarial standard methodologies.

• Knowledge of actuarial L&H modelling and data analytical software's: SAS and R

• Organization, prioritization and planning skills.

• Knowledge of L&H actuarial modelling and data analytical software's.

About the Team

Part of pricing & underwriting services team with around 80+ members between Actuarial and Underwriting teams located in Bangalore. This role will be supporting Australia and New Zealand market (ANZ) for reinsurance pricing - actuarial and experience studies.
 About you

• Strong actuarial experience in insurance/reinsurance sector, ideally 2+ years of experience preferably pricing or ES.

• Experience in actuarial product design, pricing & ES, including use of any actuarial pricing tools will be an advantage.

• Good actuarial exam progress for actuarial institutes

• Excellent interpersonal, communication and influencing skills.

jobs.description:
Are you a curious, driven student ready to dive into the dynamic world of reinsurance? This is your chance to gain hands-on experience within a global leader in risk, working alongside a collaborative and multicultural team right in the heart of Latin America. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love keeping things organized, and are eager to make a real impact — we want to hear from you!
 About the Role
 As an L&H Sales Operations Intern, you will play a meaningful supporting role within Swiss Re's Life & Health Latin America Sales Operations team. From day-to-day administration to systems management and client support, you'll be at the center of the action — helping ensure that our regional operations run smoothly and efficiently. This is a fantastic opportunity to build a strong foundation in reinsurance operations while developing your professional skills in a truly international environment.
 Key Responsibilities

• Support Sales Operations with all relevant non-client-facing activities across the L&H Latin America portfolio, including day-to-day administration and general business support processes

• Manage client records including contracts, correspondence, and documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance

• Update and maintain systems with timely and precise data entry to support operational efficiency

• Assist with contract signatures and endorsements, ensuring processes are followed correctly and deadlines are met

• Prepare presentations and run reports as requested by the Sales Operations team to support decision-making and client management

• Collaborate across functions in a multi-disciplinary and multicultural environment, contributing positively to team goals
 About the Team
 The Sales Operations team is a service-oriented, client-focused group that processes treaty submissions for the Latin American Life & Health Treaty team. Acting as the first point of contact for our clients' administrative needs, the team plays a vital role in ensuring seamless operations across the region. You'll be joining a team that values collaboration, precision, and a strong service mindset — all within a vibrant, multicultural setting.
 About You
 We're looking for someone with an analytical mindset and strong interpersonal skills — someone who can build effective working relationships across disciplines and cultures. You're organized, adaptable, and comfortable working under tight deadlines without losing your attention to detail. You bring a positive, proactive attitude and a genuine curiosity about the world of (re)insurance.
 We Are Looking for Candidates Who Meet These Requirements:

• Currently enrolled in a degree program in Business Administration, Economics, International Relations, or a related field at a Brazilian higher education institution — with graduation expected in 2027 or later

• Advanced English proficiency — you'll be working within a regional Latin America team where English is essential for communication

• Excellent organizational skills — you are flexible, reliable, and able to manage multiple tasks effectively under tight deadlines

• Availability to work in a hybrid model — with a minimum of three days per week in our São Paulo office
 These Are Additional Nice to Haves:

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and Word

• Familiarity with (re)insurance concepts or the financial services industry

• Spanish language skills — a great asset given our Latin American focus

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and tasks with a positive, solution-oriented mindset

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in both formal and informal settings
 About Swiss Re

Are you a curious, driven student ready to dive into the dynamic world of reinsurance? This is your chance to gain hands-on experience within a global leader in risk, working alongside a collaborative and multicultural team right in the heart of Latin America. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love keeping things organized, and are eager to make a real impact — we want to hear from you!
 About the Role
 As an L&H Sales Operations Intern, you will play a meaningful supporting role within Swiss Re's Life & Health Latin America Sales Operations team. From day-to-day administration to systems management and client support, you'll be at the center of the action — helping ensure that our regional operations run smoothly and efficiently. This is a fantastic opportunity to build a strong foundation in reinsurance operations while developing your professional skills in a truly international environment.
 Key Responsibilities

• Support Sales Operations with all relevant non-client-facing activities across the L&H Latin America portfolio, including day-to-day administration and general business support processes

• Manage client records including contracts, correspondence, and documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance

• Update and maintain systems with timely and precise data entry to support operational efficiency

• Assist with contract signatures and endorsements, ensuring processes are followed correctly and deadlines are met

• Prepare presentations and run reports as requested by the Sales Operations team to support decision-making and client management

• Collaborate across functions in a multi-disciplinary and multicultural environment, contributing positively to team goals
 About the Team
 The Sales Operations team is a service-oriented, client-focused group that processes treaty submissions for the Latin American Life & Health Treaty team. Acting as the first point of contact for our clients' administrative needs, the team plays a vital role in ensuring seamless operations across the region. You'll be joining a team that values collaboration, precision, and a strong service mindset — all within a vibrant, multicultural setting.
 About You
 We're looking for someone with an analytical mindset and strong interpersonal skills — someone who can build effective working relationships across disciplines and cultures. You're organized, adaptable, and comfortable working under tight deadlines without losing your attention to detail. You bring a positive, proactive attitude and a genuine curiosity about the world of (re)insurance.
 We Are Looking for Candidates Who Meet These Requirements:

• Currently enrolled in a degree program in Business Administration, Economics, International Relations, or a related field at a Brazilian higher education institution — with graduation expected in 2027 or later

• Advanced English proficiency — you'll be working within a regional Latin America team where English is essential for communication

• Excellent organizational skills — you are flexible, reliable, and able to manage multiple tasks effectively under tight deadlines

• Availability to work in a hybrid model — with a minimum of three days per week in our São Paulo office
 These Are Additional Nice to Haves:

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and Word

• Familiarity with (re)insurance concepts or the financial services industry

• Spanish language skills — a great asset given our Latin American focus

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and tasks with a positive, solution-oriented mindset

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in both formal and informal settings
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

jobs.description:
We at Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, the insurance unit of the Swiss Re Group, offer structured and customized risk transfer solutions to corporate clients, seeking to meet the broad and complex needs of Brazilian companies. Backed by the expertise and financial strength of the Swiss Re Group, Swiss Re Corporate Solutions provides its clients with in-depth technical knowledge, innovative coverages and strong risk acceptance capabilities
 About the Role:
 Contributing to risk analysis for machinery, equipment and rural buildings, seeking to offer the right cover for the needs of clients and the appetite of the insurer.

• Statistical studies on portfolio performance

• Analysis of claims behavior and portfolio production, presenting proposals for improvements and solutions

• Support in the analysis of rural risks, property, machinery and installations

• Support in analyzing field inspection reports and interacting with the claims department

• Support in testing products, systems and operational activities related to the area
 About the Team:
 Underwriting Rural Insurance Products: area responsible for drawing up and defining the business plan, analyzing and accepting risks. Alignments internally and with marketing channels to identify product opportunities and business models related to agricultural activity. Portfolio growth strategy, always with a focus on operating results.
 About You:

• Studying Actuarial Sciences, Agricultural Engineering or Similar. Graduation expected in 2028 or after.

• Analytical profile with good communication skills

• Advanced office suite

• Initiative and organizational skills

• Availability to work in a hybrid work model (3x2)

• English is a nice to have;

• Good interpersonal skills
 PT:
 Nós, da Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, unidade de seguros do Grupo Swiss Re, oferecemos soluções estruturadas e customizadas de transferência de riscos a clientes corporativos, buscando atender às amplas e complexas necessidades das empresas brasileiras. Suportada pela expertise e solidez financeira do Grupo Swiss Re, a Swiss Re Corporate Solutions fornece a seus clientes profundo conhecimento técnico, coberturas inovadoras e grandes capacidades para aceitação de riscos.
 Sobre a posição:
 Contribuir com análises de riscos para as máquinas, equipamentos e construções rurais, buscando oferecer as coberturas adequadas as necessidades dos clientes e o apetite da seguradora.

• Estudos estatísticos sobre o desempenho do portifólio

• Análise de comportamento de sinistros e produção da carteira, com apresentação de propostas de melhorias e soluções

• Apoio na análise de riscos rurais, propriedade, maquinário e instalações

• Apoio em análise de laudos de inspeção de campo e interação com área de sinistros

• Apoio em testes de produtos, sistemas e atividades operacionais relacionadas à área
 Sobre a equipe:
 Subscrição de Produtos em Seguros Rurais: área responsável pela elaboração e definição do plano de negócios, análise e aceitação de riscos. Alinhamentos internos e com canais de marketing para identificar oportunidades de produtos e modelos de negócios relacionados à atividade agrícola. Estratégia de crescimento do portfólio, sempre com foco no resultado da operação.
 Sobre você:

• Cursando Ciências Atuariais, Engenharia Agrícola ou Similar – Formação prevista para 2028 ou depois.

• Perfil analítico, mas com boa desenvoltura e boa comunicação

• Pacote office avançado

• Iniciativa e capacidade organizacional

• Bom relacionamento interpessoal

• Disponibilidade para atuar em modelo híbrido (3x2);

• Inglês diferencial;
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 * To be eligible for an internship position in Brazil, candidates must be actively enrolled in a Brazilian higher education institution or participating in an exchange program with a local university, in accordance with local internship regulations.

jobs.description:
Are you a detail-oriented financial professional with a passion for international reporting standards? Join our dynamic team where you'll play a crucial role in ensuring accurate IFRS reporting across Latin America while driving process improvements and automation initiatives. This is an opportunity to leverage your analytical expertise in a collaborative environment that values innovation and excellence.

About the Role:

As an IFRS Controlling & Reporting Specialist, you'll be at the intersection of financial reporting, technical accounting, and system development, ensuring our reporting processes meet the highest standards of accuracy and efficiency. You'll work with diverse stakeholders to implement solutions that drive business value through enhanced financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support all specific closing IFRS requirements (technical & non-technical) that will ensure timely and accurate quarterly and annual closing processes for Latin American carriers and region

• Execute quarterly IFRS reporting processes and applications used for Group Level reporting and build efficiencies and automations

• Perform tasks with a high degree of autonomy , while leveraging and working closely with all relevant team members and Group support to deliver on clear objectives

• Support and ensure process and system changes within the IT landscape

• Ensure operational excellence through the execution of quarterly and annual internal controls supported by control evidence

• Operate in a fast-paced environment being agile and flexible while demonstrating eagerness to learn and build automation

About the Team:

As a Subject Matter Expert, you'll join our dynamic team of 8 professionals specializing in IFRS 17 reporting across the Americas region. Reporting directly to the Team Lead of Corporate Solutions IFRS Reporting & Controlling Americas, you'll be part of a collaborative group that plays a crucial role in ensuring financial reporting excellence. Our team works closely with key stakeholders including the Corporate Solutions Business Unit CFO, Group Accounting, IT departments, and various other internal partners to deliver strategic financial insights and reporting solutions. We pride ourselves on our technical expertise, collaborative approach, and commitment to maintaining the highest standards of financial reporting integrity.

About You:

You're a detail-oriented accounting professional who thrives in dynamic environments where no two days are the same. You combine strong technical knowledge with excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset. You're passionate about continuous improvement and have the analytical capabilities to translate complex financial data into actionable insights.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• College graduate with BA or BS in Accounting

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to deliver quality output on short deadlines

• Solid understanding of IFRS accounting

• Excellent command of English (spoken and written)

These are additional nice to haves:

• 5+ years insurance industry experience

• Agile and flexible, ability to operate within a changing environment and navigate ambiguity

• Ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects and prioritize effectively

jobs.title: Data Engineer III
jobs.description:
Locations:
Hyderabad, TG, IN |
Bangalore, KA, IN

Data Engineer III
 Are you passionate about transforming complex data into powerful insights that drive real business decisions? Do you thrive at the intersection of cutting-edge data platforms and enterprise risk management? If so, we want to hear from you! Join us as a Data Engineer and play a pivotal role in shaping the data backbone of one of the world's leading reinsurance companies.

About the Role
 We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer with expertise in Palantir Foundry and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) to join our Risk Management InfoTech department. In this role, you will design, build, and scale enterprise data and AI solutions that support risk analytics, operational workflows, and critical business decision-making.
 Working closely with risk management experts, business stakeholders, data scientists, and technology teams, you will develop robust data pipelines, operational applications, and AI-powered solutions that transform complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data models within Palantir Foundry, ensuring data quality, reliability, and integrity.

• Build and manage data transformations using Foundry Code Repositories , Pipeline Builder, and Ontology, supporting analytics, reporting, operational applications, and risk management use cases.

• Develop Python-based data processing solutions and integrate data from enterprise systems, databases, APIs, cloud platforms, and third-party applications.

• Design, implement, and support AI-enabled solutions using Palantir AIP, including AI-assisted workflows, AIP Logic, AIP Assist, and LLM-powered decision-support capabilities.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, risk management teams, data scientists, and engineers to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions.

• Ensure data governance, lineage, security, access controls, and compliance standards across data and AI assets.

• Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines, AI workflows, and performance to improve scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.

• Document data assets, processes, and architectures, while contributing to engineering practices, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Stay current with emerging capabilities in Palantir Foundry, AIP, and data engineering to drive innovation and enhance business outcomes.

About the Team
 The Group Functions & ORM Delivery team is part of the Risk Management InfoTech department at Swiss Re — a global leader in reinsurance, insurance, and risk transfer, helping make the world more resilient. We are a dynamic and collaborative team dedicated to delivering innovative technology solutions that support Operational Risk Management (ORM) across the enterprise. jobs.title: Underwriting Analyst
jobs.description:
About the role
 The role supports our SEA General Property Underwriting teams in Singapore in the handling of insurance business for our corporate customers and their brokers in addition to support branch operations from a governance and projects standpoint. Duties and responsibilities directly impact productivity, process efficiency, timeliness, profitability and accuracy of the underwriting process as well as the service delivery to customers and brokers. This position may require occasional travel for business meetings or training.
 Your main tasks will include the following:

• To support operations activities to accurately reflect the terms and conditions of business written in our systems

• To mainly manage property/casualty deals in close collaboration with the Underwriter

• To support the Underwriting team with renewal preparation (deal analysis of renewal accounts) and endorsement triaging and preparation

• To prepare and issue documents (binders, policies, endorsements and certificates) to our customers

• To issue invoices where required, including Insurance Premium Tax calculations, and work with our centralized Technical Accounting team to follow-up on outstanding premium positions

• To be in contact with our customers and brokers on a regular basis and attend customer and broker meetings
 Additionally you will:

• Manage and monitor the workflow, plan workforce management and capacity planning

• Act as key contact for business lines supported with regards to quality of work provided, standards of service, and Service Level Agreements

• Functions as Business Expert and liaison on the development and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures, complaints resolution, drive improvement initiatives.

• Contribute to local governance activities such as KPI monitoring, Business continuity planning, management meeting.

• Compile, sort, review and verify data accuracy using source documents, detect errors, and initiate correction while following-up with customer or process owner regarding any inconsistencies found

• Follow-up on outstanding information or items as per internal guidelines following standard operating procedures.
 About the team
 In APAC Operations we provide support to the Corporate Solutions (CorSo) Underwriting Teams in handling insurance and reinsurance business for corporations and/or their captives.
 This role is based in Singapore and would require you to attend the Operations and Underwriting team meetings, which needs you to be proficient in both, skills and experience, all committed to bring success to Corporate Solutions. In this role you will work closely with the APAC Operations teams in onshore and offshore locations.
 About You
 You are:

• Passionate about delivering excellent service to our customers and brokers

• Actively contributing to the team spirit and ability to build and maintain effective working relations with people in a multicultural environment

• A highly motivated individual with ability to work independently and proactively, always keeping our customers' needs in mind

• Accountable to deliver timely and accurate business processing also during peak times

• Enjoying an agile and fast paced work environment
 You have:

• A University Degree

• Minimum of 4-5 years of meaningful job experience and understanding of Re/Insurance business in the insurance industry

• Property and Casualty Insurance Knowledge - any additional other line of business experience is very welcome

• Any additional people management experience will be an added advantage

• Excellent communication skills - reading, written and verbal

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

• The ability to prioritize, plan, coordinate and manage personal work

• Strong user skills in Microsoft Office Package (special focus on Excel and PowerPoint)
 We are looking forward to your application!
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on any aspects. Your role will contribute to Customer Centricity, which is one of our core values in Swiss Re.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. jobs.title: Client Manager
jobs.description:
Ready to lead client relationships that shape the future of Life & Health reinsurance across Southeast Asia? This role places you at the heart of dynamic markets, where your strategic thinking and client insight will drive impactful solutions. You’ll collaborate with senior client manager and stakeholders, navigate diverse cultural landscapes, and influence outcomes that matter—from product innovation to portfolio growth. If you're looking for a role that blends autonomy, purpose, and regional leadership, this is your opportunity to make a difference
 About the Role
 The Client Manager supports the Senior Client Manager in delivering Swiss Re’s client engagement and portfolio management objectives across Southeast Asia. Your role plays a key part in ensuring the smooth execution of account strategies, operational processes, and internal coordination. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to maintain high service standards, support business origination efforts, and ensure timely follow-through on client and internal deliverables.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Support the Senior Client Manager in managing Life & Health (L&H) and Medical business for the focused market, including the development of go-to-market strategies, business planning, and performance tracking.

• Assist in the development and maintenance of client relationships by coordinating meeting preparation, follow-ups, and internal alignment across teams.

• Develop and own client relationships below C-suites level (for example and not limited to Head of Product, Pricing, Reinsurance Admin, UW and Claims) to ensure broad engagement across client functions. This facilitates deeper insights, cultivates internal champions, and ensures clear points of contact when needed.

• Contribute to the origination of business opportunities by preparing proposals, conducting market research, client pitches and supporting internal approval processes.

• Monitor in-force portfolio performance by tracking key metrics, compiling experience reviews, and supporting treaty actions as needed.

• Ensure operational excellence by coordinating treaty onboarding, payment tracking, data submissions, and audit logistics in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

• Prepare internal reports, dashboards, and updates to support planning, budgeting, and forecasting activities.

• Contribute to internal initiatives, including product innovation, process improvements, knowledge sharing, and thought leadership efforts.

• Provide administrative and project management support to ensure timely execution of account-related activities including supporting the senior client manager in prioritising treaties for experience studies (ES) and open treaty reviews (OTR).
 About You

• 5–8 years of experience in life and health (re)insurance or related financial services.

• Strong organizational and analytical skills with attention to detail.

• Effective communicator with the ability to engage internal and external stakeholders.

• Proactive, resourceful, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Actuarial qualification or background would be advantageous.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Willingness to travel as required (up to 25%).
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

jobs.description:
Are you energised by transforming complexity into clarity? Do you thrive on building high-performing teams, driving accountability, and delivering outcomes that genuinely move the needle? If you are ready to shape the future of Life & Health Operations at a global scale, this is the role for you.

About the Role

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity at the heart of Swiss Re's L&H Operations. As Head Business Architecture L&H Operations, you will set the standard for how we execute across the full treaty life cycle — from onboarding through to claims payments. You will drive operational excellence with pace and discipline, strengthen governance and quality, and build the capabilities, mindset, and execution muscle that enable our global Operations teams to consistently deliver for clients, stakeholders, and the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Set the bar for operational rigor and accountability — create a sustainable, trusted, and resilient Operations function that is built to perform at the highest level

• Drive process alignment, simplification, and continuous improvement — maintain a relentless focus on execution, measurable outcomes, and delivery against Operations KPIs

• Identify, prioritise, and execute operational excellence opportunities — remove friction, accelerate delivery, and make it easier for teams to do their best work

• Define standard Operations processes — lead the design, testing, execution, and rollout of end-to-end process and system enhancements

• Own the Operations governance and quality assurance framework — embed consistent risk appetite, strong controls, and a proactive risk culture across global Operations teams

• Build frameworks and operational discipline — ensure portfolio data is trusted, usable, and actionable for analytics and decision-making

• Turn standardisation and automation opportunities into delivered improvements — enable scalable growth and stronger business performance

• Build and energise a global community of Operations experts — establish clear roles, responsibilities, deliverables, and shared standards of excellence

• Create compelling expert career paths — attract, develop, and retain outstanding Operations talent across the globe

• Lead and deliver strategic projects and initiatives — drive clear ownership, strong stakeholder engagement, and close collaboration with regional teams, Market Units, COO, CUO, and other key partners

About the Team

You will lead a global team of 20+ talented colleagues across key Swiss Re locations, working at the very heart of L&H Operations. This team operates in close partnership with Market Units, Operational Excellence, Risk Management, COO, CUO, and wider Operations teams worldwide. Far from being a support function, this team is expected to be a genuine catalyst — driving sharper execution, stronger standards, and practical transformation that turns strategy into progress and progress into measurable business impact. If you are looking for a team where your leadership truly matters and your work leaves a visible mark on the business, this is it.

About You

You are an inspirational, hands-on leader who combines strategic thinking with a bias for action. You bring the courage to challenge constructively, the judgement to make pragmatic trade-offs, and the resilience to push important work through to completion. You communicate with impact, build credibility through delivery, and motivate diverse global teams to move with purpose, confidence, and urgency.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Proven track record of leading large, diverse global teams — with a demonstrated ability to create clarity, energy, and accountability that drives consistently strong outcomes

• Strong project and change management expertise — with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans, decisive action, and delivering results that land with impact

• Demonstrated success in operational excellence and process improvement — a consistent record of simplifying complexity, raising operational standards, and delivering tangible, measurable improvements at pace

• Deep experience in governance and quality assurance frameworks — including risk management, controls design, and embedding a proactive risk culture across large, distributed teams

• Excellent communication and senior stakeholder influencing skills — with the ability to build followership through transparency, credibility, and delivery across complex, matrixed organisations

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in Life & Health reinsurance or insurance operations, with familiarity of the treaty life cycle from onboarding through to claims

• Exposure to data strategy, portfolio data management, or analytics enablement within an operations context

• Experience designing and executing automation or digitalisation initiatives within an operations environment

• Familiarity with COO/CUO operating models and working across Market Units in a global reinsurance or financial services setting

• A college degree or equivalent professional qualification in a relevant discipline

• Multilingual capabilities — excellent spoken and written English is essential; additional languages are a plus

• A track record of building expert communities and creating career development frameworks that attract and retain top talent

The role will be located in our Fort Wayne, IN office. Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred.
 The estimated base salary range for this position is $188,000 to $313,000. The specific salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget.
 At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

Join our dynamic team where your analytical skills and attention to detail will drive critical business decisions! As a Costing Support Associate, you'll play a vital role in managing and analyzing data that shapes our insurance offerings and supports our growth strategy in evolving markets.

In this pivotal position, you'll be at the intersection of data management and business strategy, supporting the development and maintenance of costing models that drive our insurance products. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy and provide valuable insights that inform business decisions.

• Data Management – Take ownership of data integrity, validation, and maintenance for costing models

• Reporting – Prepare reports to support decision-making processes of underwriters

• Process Improvement – Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and accuracy by leveraging Gen AI capabilities

• Project Support – Assist in implementing new projects and approaches as business needs evolve

• Documentation – Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of processes and methodologies

• Quality Control – Ensure adherence to data quality standards and protocols
 About the Team

You'll be joining the Costing Data Services team in Corporate Solutions, where we take ownership of Data Management while working with colleagues across various functions and locations. Corporate Solutions is in a dynamic phase of growth, and we are continuously updating our costing models in support of new products and growing markets.

You're a detail-oriented professional with strong analytical capabilities and excellent communication skills. You thrive in collaborative environments and are passionate about data integrity and Gen AI. Your ability to organize information methodically and translate complex data into actionable insights makes you an ideal candidate for this role.

• University Degree (position is suitable for fresh graduates)

• Advanced English proficiency ( spoken, written, and reading )

• Experience with Microsoft Office Package, particularly Excel

• Logical thinking with the ability to review and validate documents, manipulate data and maintain a high level of attention to detail

• Experience with Gen AI tools and general technology awareness

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
 You'll be at the heart of developing and maintaining our sophisticated in-house insurance products built primarily with Java, Spring Boot and Angular. You will have the opportunity to join one of our product teams and contribute to the development of functionality which generates real business impact.
 About the team
 We are a team that believes in engineering excellence and that our leaders should also be engineers themselves. We build applications that are carefully designed, thoughtfully implemented, and surpass the expectations of our users by working together with product owners. Quality and stability are first-class deliverables in everything we do, and we lead by example by embedding high standards into our processes.
 Your responsibilities include

• Develop and review code that meets our high standards for quality and maintainability.

• Collaborate effectively within a cross-functional team including requirements engineers, QA specialists, and other application engineers.

• Shape architecture by contributing to key decisions and documentation that guide our technical direction.

• Integrate services and shared platforms including messaging systems, BPMN workflows, logging frameworks, and telemetry solutions.

• Stay current with emerging technologies and Generative AI developments to continuously improve our solutions.
 About you
 You're a naturally curious and thoughtful professional who thrives in a high-performance engineering environment. Your passion for coding is matched by your commitment to delivering business value. You believe in continuous learning through self-improvement or by absorbing knowledge from those around you and you're excited to contribute to a team that values technical excellence.
 You should bring the following skills and experiences

• 4 years of experience in software development across the entire software delivery lifecycle, with strong Java, Spring Boot and Angular expertise

• Must have previous public cloud experience, particularly with Microsoft Azure

• Experience in modern software architecture using synchronous, asynchronous integration technologies using RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or Kafka, and other technologies

• Experience with Maven, Git, and CI/CD pipelines

• Proficient in relational and/or document-based database technologies covering conceptual domain model design and its physical implementation

• Must be comfortable spending most of your time in the IDE and working with large and established codebases

• Excellent communication & presentation skills with proficiency in English

• At ease with leaving your comfort zone dealing with ambiguity

• Understanding of insurance/reinsurance business is a plus

jobs.title: Requirements Engineer II
jobs.description:
About the Role
 In this pivotal role, you'll bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation, ensuring our insurance products deliver exceptional value. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate complex requirements into clear specifications that guide our development process.
 Key Responsibilities

• Analyze and clarify business requirements and translate them into functional and technical specifications including business architecture, process maps, wireframes and data models

• Ensure comprehensive specification of User Stories with all required data and background analysis available to the entire team

• Design and define related test cases and support the Product Owner in creating effective acceptance criteria

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Platform Product Owners, Technology Leads, Business Process Managers, Business Architecture and the Data Office to maintain end-to-end consistency of system, process and information architecture

• Anticipate and analyze customer needs to develop effective problem-solving solutions

• Organize and prioritize the Product Backlog based on Product Owner guidance

• Own production support for one or more business applications, addressing user requests directly or triaging more complex cases to the development team

• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation on the corporate Wiki
 About the Team
 Our team is responsible for building products and solutions for the Corporate Solutions business unit. We work in a collaborative, innovative environment where your ideas will have real impact. We partner closely with colleagues around the globe, fostering a diverse and inclusive atmosphere where different perspectives help shape exceptional insurance products. As part of our team, you'll contribute to meaningful projects while developing your skills in a supportive, growth-oriented culture.
 About You
 You're a detail-oriented problem solver who thrives in collaborative environments. You have excellent analytical skills and can effectively translate between business and technical domains. You're proactive, customer-focused, and committed to delivering high-quality solutions that drive business value.
 We need you to bring in the following must haves:

• 5+ years of experience as a Requirements Engineer or in similar roles

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills

• Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and experience working in cross-functional product teams

• Proficiency in tools like Jira or similar Agile management platforms like Azure DevOps

• Proficient in Visio or other process mapping tools, with good knowledge of BPMN
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with Commercial Insurance products and processes

• Knowledge of insurance industry standards and regulations

• Experience with data modeling and database concepts

• Familiarity with API design principles

• Background in software development or technical implementation

jobs.title: Finance Manager, US Globals
jobs.description:
Locations:
Kansas City, MO, US |
Armonk, NY, US

Are you a finance professional who thrives on turning complex data into strategic insight? Do you want to play a meaningful role in shaping the financial performance of one of the world's leading reinsurers? If you're energized by impact, collaboration, and working at the intersection of finance and business strategy — this could be your next move.

About the Role
 This role offers a genuine opportunity to influence Swiss Re's US Property & Casualty business at a senior level. As Finance Manager US Globals, you will serve as a trusted finance partner to US Market Unit leadership — providing the insight, challenge, and strategic guidance that drives both day-to-day decisions and longer-term business objectives.
 This role offers exceptional exposure to senior market leadership and provides a strong platform for broader Finance and business leadership opportunities across Swiss Re.
 You will own the planning, projections, financial analysis, and performance measurement for the US P&C portfolio, translating complex financial information into clear, decision-relevant narratives for senior stakeholders. Beyond the core FP&A remit, you will assess and support large or complex transactions within the US market, contribute to renewal analysis and external financial storytelling, and take an active role in cross-market and cross-functional initiatives across the broader P&C Finance team.
 Key Responsibilities

• Act as a strategic finance partner to senior US Market Unit executives, delivering insight, constructive challenge, and recommendations that directly support business decisions

• Track and analyze US renewal performance and key transactions, contributing to both internal and external financial storytelling

• Lead the development of financial plans, projections, and performance reporting for the US P&C business, ensuring high-quality outputs and compelling, clear narratives

• Deliver actionable financial insight that shapes executive decisions across the US P&C portfolio.

• Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives and ad hoc projects at US Market Unit and P&C segment level, bringing a solutions-oriented mindset

• Build trusted partnerships across a global Finance network to deliver consistent insight and influence enterprise outcomes

• Drive the evolution of Finance by improving how insight, planning, and performance management support business decisions
 About the Team
 The FP&A team sits at the heart of Swiss Re's P&C business, playing a pivotal role in driving financial performance and enabling strategic decision-making at the highest levels of the organization. We partner closely with US Market Unit heads and senior stakeholders, delivering transparency, accountability, and insight across performance, planning, and key business decisions.
 We are a globally connected team that thrives on collaboration across regions, and we benefit from dedicated analytical support from our Bangalore hub. Our culture is defined by intellectual curiosity, high standards, and a genuine willingness to challenge constructively — because we believe that's how Finance creates real value.
 We are committed to continuous improvement, both in how we work and in how we support the business. Joining this team means becoming part of a diverse, driven group of professionals who are passionate about delivering impact, growing their expertise, and actively shaping the future of the US P&C business at Swiss Re.

About You
 You are a commercially minded finance professional who combines strong technical capability with the confidence to engage and influence at a senior level. You bring clarity to complexity, hold yourself to high standards, and are motivated by the impact your work has on real business outcomes. You are equally comfortable working independently and collaborating across a global team, and you bring a proactive, improvement-focused mindset to everything you do.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline

• Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A): Significant hands-on experience in FP&A or a closely related finance role, with a strong track record of leading planning cycles, projections, and performance reporting

• Financial Modelling & Performance Reporting: Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and communicate financial models and reporting frameworks that drive decision-making at a senior level

• P&C Reinsurance / Insurance Business Knowledge: A solid understanding of the US Property & Casualty reinsurance or insurance business, including its key performance drivers, metrics, and commercial dynamics

• Commercial Judgement: Strong analytical capability paired with sound commercial instinct — the ability to move beyond the numbers and connect financial insight to business strategy

• Communication & Synthesis: Proven ability to distil complex financial information into clear, concise, and compelling narratives tailored to senior stakeholders

• Prioritization & Delivery: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple competing priorities and consistently deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

• Adaptable Collaboration Style: Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, knowing when to drive forward autonomously and when to bring others along — across functions, geographies, and seniority levels

The role will be located in either our Armonk, NY or Kansas City, MO offices. Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework.

For Armonk, NY, the estimated base salary range for this position is $122,000 to $184,000. For Kansas City, MO, the estimated base salary range for this position is $112,000 to $168,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

As Finance Manager US Globals, you will serve as a trusted finance partner to US Market Unit leadership — providing the insight, challenge, and strategic guidance that drives both day-to-day decisions and longer-term business objectives.
 This role offers exceptional exposure to senior market leadership and provides a strong platform for broader Finance and business leadership opportunities across Swiss Re.
 You will own the planning, projections, financial analysis, and performance measurement for the US P&C portfolio, translating complex financial information into clear, decision-relevant narratives for senior stakeholders. Beyond the core FP&A remit, you will assess and support large or complex transactions within the US market, contribute to renewal analysis and external financial storytelling, and take an active role in cross-market and cross-functional initiatives across the broader P&C Finance team.
 Key Responsibilities

• Act as a strategic finance partner to senior US Market Unit executives, delivering insight, constructive challenge, and recommendations that directly support business decisions

• Track and analyze US renewal performance and key transactions, contributing to both internal and external financial storytelling

• Lead the development of financial plans, projections, and performance reporting for the US P&C business, ensuring high-quality outputs and compelling, clear narratives

• Deliver actionable financial insight that shapes executive decisions across the US P&C portfolio.

• Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives and ad hoc projects at US Market Unit and P&C segment level, bringing a solutions-oriented mindset

• Build trusted partnerships across a global Finance network to deliver consistent insight and influence enterprise outcomes

• Drive the evolution of Finance by improving how insight, planning, and performance management support business decisions
 About the Team
 The FP&A team sits at the heart of Swiss Re's P&C business, playing a pivotal role in driving financial performance and enabling strategic decision-making at the highest levels of the organization. We partner closely with US Market Unit heads and senior stakeholders, delivering transparency, accountability, and insight across performance, planning, and key business decisions.
 We are a globally connected team that thrives on collaboration across regions, and we benefit from dedicated analytical support from our Bangalore hub. Our culture is defined by intellectual curiosity, high standards, and a genuine willingness to challenge constructively — because we believe that's how Finance creates real value.
 We are committed to continuous improvement, both in how we work and in how we support the business. Joining this team means becoming part of a diverse, driven group of professionals who are passionate about delivering impact, growing their expertise, and actively shaping the future of the US P&C business at Swiss Re.

About You
 You are a commercially minded finance professional who combines strong technical capability with the confidence to engage and influence at a senior level. You bring clarity to complexity, hold yourself to high standards, and are motivated by the impact your work has on real business outcomes. You are equally comfortable working independently and collaborating across a global team, and you bring a proactive, improvement-focused mindset to everything you do.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline

• Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A): Significant hands-on experience in FP&A or a closely related finance role, with a strong track record of leading planning cycles, projections, and performance reporting

• Financial Modelling & Performance Reporting: Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and communicate financial models and reporting frameworks that drive decision-making at a senior level

• P&C Reinsurance / Insurance Business Knowledge: A solid understanding of the US Property & Casualty reinsurance or insurance business, including its key performance drivers, metrics, and commercial dynamics

• Commercial Judgement: Strong analytical capability paired with sound commercial instinct — the ability to move beyond the numbers and connect financial insight to business strategy

• Communication & Synthesis: Proven ability to distil complex financial information into clear, concise, and compelling narratives tailored to senior stakeholders

• Prioritization & Delivery: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple competing priorities and consistently deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

• Adaptable Collaboration Style: Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, knowing when to drive forward autonomously and when to bring others along — across functions, geographies, and seniority levels

The role will be located in either our Armonk, NY or Kansas City, MO offices. Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework.

jobs.description:
About the role
 You'll be at the heart of developing and maintaining our sophisticated in-house insurance products built primarily with Java, Spring Boot and Angular. You will have the opportunity to join one of our product teams and contribute to the development of functionality which generates real business impact.
 About the team
 We are a team that believes in engineering excellence and that our leaders should also be engineers themselves. We build applications that are carefully designed, thoughtfully implemented, and surpass the expectations of our users by working together with product owners. Quality and stability are first-class deliverables in everything we do, and we lead by example by embedding high standards into our processes.
 Your responsibilities include

• Translate business requirements into system production solution design and patterns that enable quality, re-usability, scalability, availability and maintainability in accordance with the overall Business Strategy and IT standards.

• Present and communicate ideas and design to various teams for review and brainstorming.

• Develop and review code that meets our high standards for quality and maintainability.

• Collaborate effectively within a cross-functional team including requirements engineers, QA specialists, and other application engineers.

• Shape architecture by contributing to key decisions and documentation that guide our technical direction.

• Integrate services and shared platforms including messaging systems, BPMN workflows, logging frameworks, and telemetry solutions.

• Stay current with emerging technologies and Generative AI developments to continuously improve our solutions.
 About you
 You're a naturally curious and thoughtful professional who thrives in a high-performance engineering environment. Your passion for coding is matched by your commitment to delivering business value. You believe in continuous learning through self-improvement or by absorbing knowledge from those around you and you're excited to contribute to a team that values technical excellence.
 You should bring the following skills and experiences

• At least 10+ years of experience in software engineering and Java programming with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and architecture patterns

• Experience in designing solutions for high performance and addressing performance issues in complex systems.

• Extensive hands-on experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot and microservices

• Experience in enterprise systems and REST API /service design

• 2-3 years of Angular Experience is preferred.

• Substantial Technology background with experience in delivering IT projects including cloud-native applications like Azure, operations and knowledge of state-of-the-art technology.

• Experience with Maven, Git, and CI/CD pipelines

• Experience on ORM and RDBMS is a plus

• Being hands-on Engineer is key to be successful in this role.

• Have experience working in cross-functional teams and enterprise-wide programs, operating effectively across the organization and within complex contexts.

• Strong analytical skills, and seek problems in a structured way, joining your own creative ideas by contributing to technical research and feasibility studies.

• Combining agile practices with collaborative skills across cultures, geographies and organizational levels.

• Committed to continuous learning and self-improvement.

• Excellent communication & presentation skills with proficiency in English

• Focus on the outcome and getting things accomplished with a strong commitment to quality and timely customer service.

• At ease with leaving your comfort zone dealing with ambiguity

• Understanding of insurance/reinsurance business is a plus.

jobs.description:
About the team
 The APAX Portfolio Management team sits within the Life & Health APAX Market Unit and plays a critical role in optimizing the value of the in-force portfolio across Asia Pacific (excl. China). The team focuses on driving sustainable profitability through a combination of technical actuarial expertise, commercial insight, and close collaboration with client-facing, pricing, valuation, and finance teams. By delivering executing management actions, and supporting strategic initiatives such as treaty reviews, product enhancements, and in-force transactions, the team actively protects and optimizes the value of in-force treaties. Operating in a highly collaborative and dynamic environment, the team works closely with regional stakeholders and global partners to generate value for both clients and the organization.
 About the role
 We are seeking an experienced and client focused professional to join our Portfolio Management team. The successful candidate will solve a variety of commercial problems to optimise and improve value generation on the in-force portfolio. This role is based in Kuala Lumpur to support initiatives across the Asia Pacific (excl. China) regions (APAX).
 Core responsibilities:

• Portfolio Management – Actively support the Portfolio Management team to execute on management actions focusing on in-force portfolios. Activities include but are not limited to preparing technical analyses, documentation, presentations, leading internal and external client discussions, managing internal stakeholders and managing junior resources from the Bangalore support teams (e.g. experience studies and modelling).

• Driving initiatives on the in-force portfolio to increase value and manage risk. Examples include (but are not limited to the following):
• Performing closed treaty reviews on several treaties annually to review profitability and propose actions.

• Technical analyses including projections, embedded value, profitability and experience analysis for pricing, recapture and other in-force transaction purposes.

• Supporting product or policyholder engagement initiatives to maintain or improve value generation for both the cedant and Swiss Re.

• Product upgrades and other treaty changes on the in-force:
• Supporting internal cross functional teams on requests to review product changes on in-force products.

• Responding to commercial triggers to consider changes to in-force treaties. Examples include (but are not limited to) considerations of substitute business, pricing changes, terms and conditions for pricing changes, requirements on portfolio management in terms of claims, retention, operations and data provision / quality.

• Experience and performance monitoring:
• Prepare and collate information to support portfolio steering and in-force management of the APAX portfolio.

• Support the SMART Circles framework by preparing monitoring analysis and where required, create new monitoring processes depending upon current and emerging risks.

• Act as linkage between front line / client facing functional teams and actuarial valuations and reserving to ensure that feedback loops are operating effectively.

• Transactions and governance:
• Support the team leader's role in preparing referral reviews and approvals on client recapture and / or re-pricing activities which require Portfolio Steering sign-off.

• Support for transactions both pre-deal as key Portfolio Steering representatives, post deal implementation and performance monitoring.

• Provide ad-hoc technical support to the broader Portfolio Management team.

• Support group wide and local projects as required / support other priorities within Portfolio Steering as required.
 About you:

• Fellowship-qualified actuary (or nearly qualified) with a recognised Actuarial professional body.

• Minimum 5 years of L&H valuation and pricing experience in reinsurance, primary insurance or actuarial consulting.

• Experience at a reinsurer or with a direct life office dealing with reinsurance relationships would be highly regarded.

• Excellent ability to independently solve a range of complex commercial problems.

• Strong end-to-end and execution mindset, with the ability to "join the dots" across the full L&H value chain.

• Excellent technical knowledge in all areas of liability portfolio management (e.g. experience studies, product pricing and valuations, business planning, financial performance analysis, embedded value).

• Working knowledge of IFRS17 financial reporting regimes, as well as traditional and market consistent embedded value methods.

• Knowledge of and experience APAX L&H market (Australia / New Zealand preferred but not mandatory).

• Analytical and technical skills, with a strong foundation in data, systems, actuarial models and financial reporting systems.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to lead meetings and drive outcomes (for both internal and external stakeholders of ranging seniority).

• Strong desire to learn, adaptable, flexible in thinking.

• Fluent in verbal and written English.

• Possess valid authorization and the legal right to work in Malaysia at the time of application and throughout the employment.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
