jobs.title: R&C Control & Oversight Lead
jobs.description:
Are you a controls-driven professional who thrives at the intersection of governance, risk, and real-world business delivery? Do you believe that great controls aren't just audit-ready — they're embedded, effective, and built to last? If you're someone who proactively hunts for gaps rather than waiting to be told where they are, this role was made for you. Join our Operations Risk & Compliance team in Bangalore and help shape the future of operational resilience at a global scale.

About the Role

As a Control and Oversight Lead , you will report to the Head of R&C Control & Oversight and operate at the heart of governance, controls, and delivery. This is a first-line role that demands a sharp control mindset paired with genuine business pragmatism. You won't just be checking boxes — you'll be proactively identifying control weaknesses, designing and executing risk-based testing, structuring complex problem statements, and driving tangible, sustainable improvements across operational processes. You'll be a trusted control partner to the business, making governance work in practice — not just on paper.
 Key Responsibilities

• Proactively assess control effectiveness and execution discipline across operational processes through risk-based monitoring, quality testing, thematic reviews, and ongoing engagement with business stakeholders

• Design and execute meaningful, risk-based samples , applying sound judgement on sample size, coverage, and representativeness to draw credible conclusions on control performance and execution quality

• Identify control gaps and emerging risk themes early , translating testing insights into structured, pragmatic remediation plans that address root causes — not just symptoms

• Own end-to-end remediation and control enhancement initiatives , ensuring clear accountability, milestone tracking, cross-functional coordination, and sustainable closure

• Act as first-line coordination lead for internal and external audits , ensuring precise, timely, and high-quality responses — while proactively surfacing control weaknesses well before audit activity does

• Ensure strong linkage between controls, processes, data, and execution realities , challenging misalignment and driving governance maturity across the process landscape

• Deliver concise, senior-ready reporting and insights , including clear conclusions drawn from testing and sampling outcomes, enabling leadership to understand risk exposure, remediation progress, and areas requiring attention or escalation

About the Team

The Operations Risk & Compliance (R&C) team is a global first-line function focused on enabling resilient operations through strong governance, control discipline, and risk awareness. We are the engine for operational resilience and continuous improvement — proactively identifying execution gaps, strengthening control effectiveness, and ensuring governance standards are embedded in day-to-day operations.
 We work in close partnership with Operations, Risk Management, Compliance, Finance, and Technology — representing the business on emerging risks while ensuring practical, sustainable execution across the operational landscape. Our team is collaborative, intellectually curious, and deeply committed to making governance a business enabler rather than a bureaucratic hurdle.

About You

You are a proactive, analytical, and structured professional who brings both technical rigour and business savvy to everything you do. You don't wait for audits to tell you what's broken — you find it first. You communicate with confidence and clarity at all levels, challenge constructively, and follow through until problems are genuinely resolved. You thrive in complex, fast-moving environments and take pride in driving governance that actually works.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 6–10 years of experience in internal audit, in-house assurance, first-line risk & control, or similar governance roles within complex operational environments

• Hands-on expertise in quality testing or assurance activities , with a strong practical understanding of risk-based sampling, sample size determination, and coverage assessment

• Proven ability to design and execute control assessments , identify weaknesses, and translate findings into structured, actionable, and sustainable remediation plans

• Track record of owning governance or remediation initiatives end-to-end — from issue identification through to disciplined execution and verified closure

• Educational background in Risk, Finance, Accounting , or a related discipline

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience working within a global, matrixed organisation with exposure to cross-functional stakeholder management across Operations, Finance, and Technology

• Familiarity with operational risk frameworks, control self-assessment (CSA) methodologies, or enterprise risk management (ERM) practices

• Exposure to regulatory or compliance environments and the ability to translate regulatory expectations into practical control requirements

• Strong data literacy — comfortable working with data to support testing conclusions, identify trends, and build compelling risk narratives

• Experience preparing and presenting governance reporting to senior leadership or board-level audiences

• A collaborative, curious mindset with a genuine passion for continuous improvement and building a strong risk culture

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. If you're someone who proactively hunts for gaps rather than waiting to be told where they are, this role was made for you. Join our Operations Risk & Compliance team in Bangalore and help shape the future of operational resilience at a global scale.

About the Role

As a Control and Oversight Lead , you will report to the Head of R&C Control & Oversight and operate at the heart of governance, controls, and delivery. This is a first-line role that demands a sharp control mindset paired with genuine business pragmatism. You won't just be checking boxes — you'll be proactively identifying control weaknesses, designing and executing risk-based testing, structuring complex problem statements, and driving tangible, sustainable improvements across operational processes. You'll be a trusted control partner to the business, making governance work in practice — not just on paper.
 Key Responsibilities

• Proactively assess control effectiveness and execution discipline across operational processes through risk-based monitoring, quality testing, thematic reviews, and ongoing engagement with business stakeholders

• Design and execute meaningful, risk-based samples , applying sound judgement on sample size, coverage, and representativeness to draw credible conclusions on control performance and execution quality

• Identify control gaps and emerging risk themes early , translating testing insights into structured, pragmatic remediation plans that address root causes — not just symptoms

• Own end-to-end remediation and control enhancement initiatives , ensuring clear accountability, milestone tracking, cross-functional coordination, and sustainable closure

• Act as first-line coordination lead for internal and external audits , ensuring precise, timely, and high-quality responses — while proactively surfacing control weaknesses well before audit activity does

• Ensure strong linkage between controls, processes, data, and execution realities , challenging misalignment and driving governance maturity across the process landscape

• Deliver concise, senior-ready reporting and insights , including clear conclusions drawn from testing and sampling outcomes, enabling leadership to understand risk exposure, remediation progress, and areas requiring attention or escalation

About the Team

The Operations Risk & Compliance (R&C) team is a global first-line function focused on enabling resilient operations through strong governance, control discipline, and risk awareness. We are the engine for operational resilience and continuous improvement — proactively identifying execution gaps, strengthening control effectiveness, and ensuring governance standards are embedded in day-to-day operations.
 We work in close partnership with Operations, Risk Management, Compliance, Finance, and Technology — representing the business on emerging risks while ensuring practical, sustainable execution across the operational landscape. Our team is collaborative, intellectually curious, and deeply committed to making governance a business enabler rather than a bureaucratic hurdle.

About You

You are a proactive, analytical, and structured professional who brings both technical rigour and business savvy to everything you do. You don't wait for audits to tell you what's broken — you find it first. You communicate with confidence and clarity at all levels, challenge constructively, and follow through until problems are genuinely resolved. You thrive in complex, fast-moving environments and take pride in driving governance that actually works.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 6–10 years of experience in internal audit, in-house assurance, first-line risk & control, or similar governance roles within complex operational environments

• Hands-on expertise in quality testing or assurance activities , with a strong practical understanding of risk-based sampling, sample size determination, and coverage assessment

• Proven ability to design and execute control assessments , identify weaknesses, and translate findings into structured, actionable, and sustainable remediation plans

• Track record of owning governance or remediation initiatives end-to-end — from issue identification through to disciplined execution and verified closure

• Educational background in Risk, Finance, Accounting , or a related discipline

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience working within a global, matrixed organisation with exposure to cross-functional stakeholder management across Operations, Finance, and Technology

• Familiarity with operational risk frameworks, control self-assessment (CSA) methodologies, or enterprise risk management (ERM) practices

• Exposure to regulatory or compliance environments and the ability to translate regulatory expectations into practical control requirements

• Strong data literacy — comfortable working with data to support testing conclusions, identify trends, and build compelling risk narratives

• Experience preparing and presenting governance reporting to senior leadership or board-level audiences

• A collaborative, curious mindset with a genuine passion for continuous improvement and building a strong risk culture

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

• Create and maintain automated UI & API tests covering accuracy, performance, and load requirements Implement quality gates to ensure thorough testing before approving deployments for release

 As an Application Engineer (Backend), you'll be at the heart of developing and maintaining our sophisticated in-house insurance products. You'll join one of our product teams where your contributions will directly generate real business impact through thoughtfully implemented solutions that exceed user expectations
 Key Responsibilities

• Develop and review code that meets our high standards for quality and maintainability

• Collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams including requirements engineers, QA specialists, and other application engineers

• Shape architecture by contributing to key decisions and documentation that guide our technical direction Integrate services and shared platforms including messaging systems, BPMN workflows, logging frameworks, and telemetry solutions

• Public cloud experience, particularly with Microsoft Azure

• Experience in modern software architecture using synchronous and asynchronous integration technologies (RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or Kafka)

• Drive cloud-native development on platforms such as Azure, contributing to the evolution of modern, microservices-based architectures

• Engage across global, cross-functional teams — both internal and external — to align on solutions, share knowledge, and deliver outcomes collaboratively

• Challenge requirements constructively, listen to the broader vision, and implement realistic, well-reasoned designs that balance innovation with pragmatism

• Contribute to technical research and feasibility studies, bringing structured analytical thinking and creative problem-solving to complex challenges

About the Team
 We are the Global L&H Reinsurance Engineering team — a passionate group of technologists dedicated to building enterprise-grade IT solutions for Swiss Re's Reinsurance business unit. Our team brings together deep technical expertise and a genuine curiosity for the reinsurance domain, enabling us to engineer solutions that truly make a difference.
 We believe in the power of collaboration — working closely with colleagues and teams across the globe to share knowledge, co-create solutions, and continuously raise the bar. As you grow within the team, you'll gain a broad perspective on the Architecture & Engineering landscape of a global reinsurer, developing a comprehensive understanding of the people, systems, and business outcomes that define our industry. This foundation will open doors to exciting career opportunities across our global organization — whether in engineering leadership, architecture, or roles closer to the operational business.

About You
 You are a hands-on, outcome-driven engineer with a passion for solving hard problems and a genuine commitment to quality. You bring both the technical depth to architect complex systems and the interpersonal skills to inspire and collaborate across cultures and geographies. You're energized by change, resilient in the face of setbacks, and always looking for ways to grow — and to help those around you grow too.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 12+ years of experience in software engineering with strong fundamentals in Java, data structures, algorithms, and architectural patterns

• Extensive hands-on experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture in enterprise environments

• Proven expertise in REST API and service design, with a solid understanding of enterprise system integration

• Cloud-native application development experience, particularly with Azure, including deployment, operations, and modern DevOps practices

• Proficiency with CI/CD tooling including Maven, Git, and automated pipeline management

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with front-end technologies such as React JS, Angular, TypeScript, or JavaScript

• Familiarity with ORM frameworks and RDBMS technologies

• Experience working in agile, cross-functional, and globally distributed teams across complex organizational contexts

• Ability to leverage AI frontier models to enhance product development and SDLC workflows

• Understanding of insurance or reinsurance business concepts and domain knowledge

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with a track record of contributing to technical research and feasibility studies

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels

• A growth mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and self-improvement

• Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to navigate complexity with confidence and adaptability

jobs.title: Head P&C Claims SID
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned Claims leader with a passion for shaping strategy across dynamic and diverse markets? Do you thrive at the intersection of technical expertise, client engagement, and people leadership? If so, this is your opportunity to make a real impact at one of the world's leading reinsurers — right at the heart of one of the most exciting and fast-growing regions in the industry.
 The role will play a critical part in advancing Swiss Re’s P&C Claims strategy by elevating Claims as a strategic differentiator that strengthens client franchise, enhances underwriting insights and drives operational excellence. This includes embedding the “Swiss Re Way of Handling Claims”, advancing AI-enabled Claims capabilities, strengthening Claims insights and fostering a high-performance, future-ready Claims organisation across the SID region.
 About the Role
 As Head P&C Claims SID , you will be the driving force behind Property & Casualty Claims management across the South East Asia, India, Hong Kong, Taiwan and Korea (SID) region. This is a high-visibility leadership role where you will set the strategic direction for Claims, champion Swiss Re's value proposition with key clients and partners, and lead a talented team of Claims professionals across multiple markets. You will be a key member of the SID Leadership Team, contributing both functional expertise and broader business insight to support Swiss Re’s strategic objectives in the region. In this role, you will shape the regional Claims strategy, strengthen Swiss Re’s market presence and lead a high-performing team of Claims professionals across diverse geographies and cultures.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop the SID P&C Claims team : Manage, mentor and inspire a team of experienced Claims experts across South East Asia, India, Hong Kong, Taiwan and Korea, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and high performance.

• Oversee the P&C Claims portfolio across the SID region: drive strategy on large and complex Claims, ensure the right Claims are paid, maintain consistency and adequacy of case reserves, and deliver timely and accurate reporting at both individual and portfolio level.

• Shape and implement the P&C Claims strategy for the SID region in alignment with key stakeholders and Swiss Re's overall business strategy; stay ahead of market trends, regulatory developments and emerging risks across the region's diverse markets.

• Build and nurture a strong regional network : Represent Swiss Re with clients, brokers, cedants and industry bodies across the SID region, providing thought leadership on topics that shape the industry and Swiss Re's strategic positioning.

• Drive client-centric initiatives : Lead impactful Claims-related projects that reinforce Swiss Re's value proposition, supporting business development and deepening client relationships across all segments.

• Maintain a robust feedback loop between the SID Market Unit, Global Claims, the Centre of Excellence Claims, Underwriters, Risk Management, Finance and other key functions; ensure Claims strategies are fully embedded in business plans.

• Provide strong advocacy for P&C Claims matters at market forums, client interactions and relevant industry bodies across the SID region.

• Oversee Governance and Compliance : Review, coordinate and ensure adherence to governance and compliance requirements across the SID Claims function, in line with local regulatory frameworks.

• AI, Innovation & Operational Excellence : Drive the embedding of AI-enabled capabilities and MVP-based innovation initiatives within the Claims function to enhance efficiency, decision-making and client outcomes, while supporting the evolution of the P&C Re Claims Target Operating Model and workforce strategy in response to AI and digital transformation opportunities. The role will foster a strong culture of operational risk ownership through effective risk identification, controls management and continuous improvement, while ensuring consistent execution excellence, high-quality delivery and adherence to operational standards across the Claims value chain.
 About the Team
 Our SID Claims team is a dynamic group of highly knowledgeable and experienced Claims professionals, bringing together diverse backgrounds, expertise and perspectives from across South East Asia, India, Hong Kong, Taiwan and Korea. jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned IT operations leader who thrives at the intersection of vendor governance, operational discipline, and transformation? Do you get energised by turning complexity into clarity, and ambiguity into action? If you're ready to lead from the front in a fast-moving, high-impact environment — this role was built for you.
 About the Role

As our IT Service Management Lead, you will be the operational heartbeat of our FITOPS organisation — the go-to leader who keeps our IT operations running smoothly, our vendor accountable, and our transformation agenda moving forward. You will own the governance of our strategic IT service management vendor, champion an AI-powered and automated operations future, and play a pivotal role in supporting the financial close cycle. This is a high-visibility role that blends strategic thinking with hands-on operational leadership, making a tangible difference every single day.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead vendor governance end-to-end — establish and maintain rigorous governance routines including service reviews, performance discussions, risk reviews, improvement planning, escalation management, and executive-level reporting.

• Drive accountability and transparency with our key IT service management vendor, ensuring strong operational discipline and adherence to agreed processes, standards, and controls across incident, problem, change, request, and service management activities.

• Act as the primary escalation point for vendor performance, service quality, delivery issues, and operational risks — resolving issues decisively and constructively.

• Support our financial close process with partnership with our Finance Close Management tea m through proactive and timely interventions/escalations to ensure closing relevant incidents and problems are well managed.

• Create a close relationship with the major incident team and act as the primary escalation point for major operational issues affecting the divisions we support.

• Partner with the Service Delivery Management team in India to ensure consistent execution of governance practices, operational controls, and service management expectations across geographies.

• Lead and support financial negotiations with the vendor, ensuring commercial discussions are aligned with service expectations, value delivery, and budget objectives; act as a key guardian for financial closing processes related to incident management, problem management, and operational service delivery.

• Help shape and drive operating model transformation with a focus on AI-powered operations, automation, predictive service management, self-healing capabilities, and improved user experience.

• Identify simplification and automation opportunities in partnership with the vendor and internal teams to reduce manual effort, improve service resilience, and increase operational efficiency.

• Support adoption of AI, analytics, and modern ITSM tooling to drive recurring issue elimination, faster resolution, knowledge management, and operational insight.

• Represent the division as operations lead in internal, enterprise-wide, and cross-functional forums — ensuring divisional requirements and operational realities are well represented.

• Build and sustain strong stakeholder relationships with technology leaders, service owners, process owners, key finance and group functions leaders, procurement, vendor management, and delivery teams.

• Communicate operational performance, risks, and transformation progress clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.

• Support vendor team stability and engagement — monitor attrition trends, key-person dependencies, capability gaps, and resource risks, ensuring mitigation plans are in place.

• Promote a collaborative partnership culture with the vendor while maintaining clear accountability for performance and outcomes.

• Champion continuous improvement — drive simplification, standardisation, and measurable service improvements aligned with business priorities and enterprise technology direction.
 About the Team
 You will be joining the Finance Close Management & Operations team — a dynamic, cross-functional group that sits at the heart of how our organisation plans, executes, and governs its financial close and operational excellence agenda.
 Our team connects and bridges a broad stakeholder community to ensure closing plans are realistic, agreed, and well understood. During the close, we ensure stability, keep all stakeholders informed on status, and intervene and escalate issues where necessary to protect the integrity of the process.
 Beyond the close, we support and drive operational excellence across D&T Finance and D&T Group Functions — ensuring robust processes are in place to capture knowledge, operate efficiently, and deliver real value. We also play a key role in audit readiness and execution: driving improvements to the ICOFR control landscape, preparing stakeholders with high-quality documentation, and supporting both auditors and product areas throughout the audit process.
 This is a team that operates with purpose, precision, and a genuine commitment to making things better — and we're looking for someone who shares that mindset
 About You

• You are a confident, credible operational leader who knows how to get things done in complex, matrixed environments. You bring a strong sense of ownership and accountability, communicate with clarity and impact, and are equally comfortable in a boardroom conversation and a detailed vendor performance review. You balance commercial sharpness with a collaborative spirit, and you're energised by the challenge of transforming how IT operations work — not just maintaining the status quo.

• We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Strong, proven experience in IT service management, IT operations, or service delivery leadership — with a track record of managing strategic vendors or outsourced IT service providers.

• Good working knowledge of ITIL practices — particularly incident management, problem management, change management, service reporting, and continual service improvement.

• Solid financial and commercial acumen — including hands-on experience with vendor negotiations, cost management, invoice validation, budget tracking, or commercial governance in an IT context.

• Experience leading or participating in operational transformation initiatives — including process improvement, automation, or service management simplification.

• Demonstrated ability to manage and influence geographically distributed teams — including offshore or nearshore delivery models.
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with AI-powered operations, AIOps, predictive monitoring, or digital operations transformation.

• Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar enterprise ITSM platforms.

• Experience in large, complex, matrixed enterprise environments.

• Knowledge of managed services contracts, SLAs, operational performance metrics, and vendor scorecards.

• ITIL certification or equivalent formal service management qualification.

• Comfort navigating financial closing cycles and supporting finance-related operational governance.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into actionable operational insight.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 3,200 and EUR 5,300 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

jobs.description:
Join our dynamic team in Mexico City where you'll develop your analytical expertise, solve complex risk management challenges, and gain invaluable industry experience in a global reinsurance leader.
 About the Role
 As an entry-level Actuarial Analyst, you'll gain hands-on experience supporting our Life & Health Actuarial Reserving operations with meaningful work that contributes directly to our business outcomes while developing your professional skills.
 Key Responsibilities

• Learn and assist with model construction and validation for actuarial analysis and risk assessment

• Develop your analytic skills by participating in experience studies to analyze performance and identify trends

• Support financial reporting processes, including Swiss STAT and IFRS17 reporting
 About the Team
 Our results-oriented team focuses on actuarial reserving on Latin America's Life and Health businesses. We're passionate about actuarial data analysis and provide accurate financial reporting for our block of business. Working with us means joining a collaborative environment where you'll receive mentorship and your contributions will have meaningful impact across multiple business areas.
 About You
 You're a motivated, enthusiastic, and goal-driven actuarial student who thrives in a learning environment. Your passion for problem-solving and innovation enables you to think outside the box and develop creative solutions with tangible results.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, or related fields

• Exceptional academic performance (GPA of 3.0 and above)

• Excellent oral and written communication skills, especially competence in English

• Completion of 2 or more actuarial exams (preferred)
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Familiarity with AXIS, SQL, R and VBA

• Previous internship experience in insurance, sales, or business

• Quick learning ability with enthusiasm for developing new skills

• Strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects

• Collaborative approach with ability to work effectively in teams

• Innovative thinking and curiosity about the reinsurance industry

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Are you someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity, loves owning processes end-to-end, and takes pride in making things run smoothly behind the scenes? If you're energised by coordination, quality, and operational excellence — this could be the role for you.
 About the Role
 As an Operations Manager within the GIA Office, you will be at the heart of how Global Internal Audit (GIA) functions as a high-performing, well-coordinated operation. You'll own and drive critical processes — from governance routines to regulatory frameworks and training initiatives — ensuring that GIA operates with consistency, clarity, and impact across the globe. This is a role where your attention to detail and organisational skills will directly shape the effectiveness of the entire audit function.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Own and manage GIA-wide operational processes , including management reporting, governance routines, professional development and documentation standards — ensuring timely, high-quality delivery at all times

• Drive coordination across audit units , subject matter experts, and leadership teams to ensure consistent application of processes and standards on a global scale

• Support the implementation and maintenance of regulatory monitoring processes and internal audit methodology frameworks, tracking progress and coordinating inputs across key stakeholders

• Organise and facilitate onboarding sessions for new joiners and manage the ongoing training and knowledge-sharing initiatives, supporting the rollout and adoption of new processes across GIA

• Prepare and distribute operational reports, dashboards, and internal communications , maintaining high standards of data accuracy and keeping stakeholders informed and aligned

• Contribute to planning and reporting cycles , supporting process execution and ensuring operational consistency across the GIA function
 About the Team
 The GIA Office sits within the Chief Operating Office GIA and is the operational backbone of Swiss Re's Group Internal Audit function. The team exists to ensure GIA runs effectively, consistently, and in line with the highest regulatory and internal audit standards. From providing strategic support to senior leadership, to owning governance processes and reporting, to driving cross-functional coordination, the GIA Office plays a pivotal role in driving the overall effectiveness and performance of GIA worldwide.
 About You
 You are a highly organised, detail-oriented professional who takes ownership of processes and delivers with reliability and precision. You're comfortable working across multiple stakeholders and teams, navigating complexity with a calm and structured approach. You bring a continuous improvement mindset and a genuine commitment to quality, consistency, and operational excellence. Whether you're managing a reporting cycle or coordinating a cross-functional initiative, you bring energy, rigour, and a collaborative spirit to everything you do.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Process management expertise : Proven experience owning and executing end-to-end operational processes, including reporting cycles, governance routines, and documentation standards with a passion for driving efficiency

• Stakeholder coordination : Demonstrated ability to coordinate activities across multiple teams, business units, or geographies, ensuring consistency and alignment in process application

• Reporting & data management : Strong experience preparing operational reports, dashboards, and management communications with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail

• Regulatory & methodology support : Experience supporting the implementation or maintenance of regulatory monitoring processes or internal audit / compliance methodology frameworks

• Knowledge management & training coordination : Experience organising onboarding, developing and delivering training or knowledge-sharing programmes and supporting the adoption of new processes or tools
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Background in internal audit, governance frameworks, or risk and compliance environment

• Experience working in a global or matrix financial services organisation with cross-border coordination responsibilities

• Proficiency with reporting tools, dashboards, or project management platforms (e.g., PowerPoint, Excel, SharePoint, Power BI, or similar)

• Strong written communication skills with the ability to craft clear, concise internal communications, process documentation or training materials

• A proactive, self-starter attitude with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,900 and EUR 4,800 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

jobs.description:
About the Team and our Scope

At L&H Solutions, we build and commercialize cloud-native (Azure-based) SaaS/PaaS solutions for Swiss Re Life & Health insurance clients. We offer a portfolio of products, including award offerings claims solutions. We are a SW house within Swiss Re.

Our team consists of more than 150 technical professionals with multidisciplinary skills, located in multiple countries, working on these multi-regional, highly available solutions.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager on our cloud engineering team, you will be a pivotal technical leader driving the design, development, and delivery of cutting-edge, scalable solutions that power our business. You will lead a team of highly skilled engineers, providing mentorship and technical guidance.

This is not just a management role, rather it’s an opportunity to lead by doing. You will collaborate closely with product, architecture, and operations teams to define the technical roadmap and ensure high standards of quality, reliability, and security in everything we build.

You will be responsible for building an environment of innovation, continuous improvement, and technical excellence, empowering your team to deliver impactful features at speed while maintaining operational resilience in a cloud-native ecosystem.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership culture where you can both shape strategy and dive into the technical landscape, this role offers a unique opportunity to grow your leadership skills alongside your technical expertise.

Your responsibilities will be:

• Lead cross-functional delivery of scalable solutions, coordinating the full lifecycle from design to deployment while enforcing engineering best practices

• Lead, coach and coordinate your product team with multidisciplinary skills to deliver SW product against release plan which you define and own

• Collaborate with stakeholders to define project goals, lead planning processes, and create realistic timelines

• Drive efficient execution by coordinating resources, removing blockers, and delivering features aligned with business objectives

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers, fostering accountability and continuous learning while supporting talent acquisition and development

About You

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll own end-to-end delivery, drive architectural excellence, and empower your team to build innovative, high-quality products in an Agile environment. If most of the skills listed match your experience and strengths, and you have a passion for leading cloud-native engineering teams, we’d love to hear from you.

Must-Have Skills

• Strong technical foundation with software development experience that has evolved into technical project management

• Exceptional analytical thinking and proven project management expertise

• Experience building high-performance teams with focus on KPIs and continuous improvement

• Solid understanding of cloud solutions and ability to assess delivery risks effectively

• Proficiency with Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and collaboration tools

• Strong presentation and communication skills to adapt messages for different audience (senior managers, business stakeholder, tech team)

• Experience working with cloud-native applications, preferably using Azure

These are additional nice to haves:

• Scrum Master experience and relevant certifications (PMP, SAFe)

• Knowledge of Java or other OOP languages

• High emotional intelligence with strong influencing skills

• Values aligned with proactivity, ownership, and continuous improvement

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between [EUR 3,800] and [EUR 6,300] per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Team and our Scope
 Our team, a software house within Swiss Re, develops cloud-native (Azure-based) SaaS/PaaS solutions for external Life & Health insurance clients. Our portfolio includes globally established products and those in growth or incubation stages. We utilize the latest technology and prioritize innovation to stay competitive.
 Our technical team comprises professionals with multidisciplinary skills, located in various countries, delivering highly available, multi-regional solutions used worldwide.
 About the Role
 We are looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team. Unlike other teams, we design and build productive infrastructure, leaving operations to others. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in writing IaaC and automating deployments, with skills in PowerShell, Kubernetes, Terraform, Azure DevOps, Helm, and modern DevOps best practices. As a Senior, you will guide other DevOps engineers and collaborate with the Engineering Manager and Product Owner to ensure the infrastructure meets evolving requirements.
 Your responsibilities will be:

• Solutionalize how to automatically deploy cloud infrastructure including networking, storage, compute, policies, monitoring, security, identity, functions, etc.

• Collaborate with product developers to identify DevOps solutions for embedding software in a secure, high-performance cloud infrastructure that meets enterprise standards.

• Create and implement DevOps solutions for automatic deployment of SW infrastructure, including disaster recovery strategies, operational manuals, and instructions for handing over maintenance to a separate team.

• Continuously assess and identify how to increase infrastructure performance while keeping cloud costs under control.

• Assess security policies, infrastructure requirements and changing guidelines to ensure keeping the SW infrastructure always compliant, resilient and secure.

• Lead a team of DevOps engineers, offering technical guidance. Collaborate with architects, managers, tech leads, and product owners to deliver solutions within the roadmap and SDLC processes.
 About You
 Nobody is perfect and meets 100% requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are genuinely curious about the world of software development and IT Cloud, we will be happy to meet you.
 If you possess traits and experience that match most of the below, we’d love to hear from you:

• Must have excellent technical proficiency in…

• Usage and administrator of Azure services.

• Strong experience with PowerShell/Bash scripting.

• In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes and containerization.

• Strong skills with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.

• Knowledge of Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines and release management.

• Experience managing teams of DevOps engineers.

• Preferably knowledge also about…

• Programming background in any OOP language (preferred Java and/or Go).

• Knowledge of security scans, authorization protocols, CloudFlare.

• Understanding of data fundamentals.

• Familiarity with Okta for identity and access management.

• Knowledge of Cloudflare for web performance and security.

• General knowledge of Gitlab and/or Github DevOps practices
 For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 60,000 and EUR 100,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

jobs.title: Actuarial Analyst
jobs.description:
Actuarial Analyst – L&H India
 Position Actuarial Analyst
 Level Associate
 Location Mumbai, India
 Reporting to Senior Pricing Actuary
 Objective of Role
 The role will be part of the L&H India pricing team taking responsibility for product development and pricing of new Life & Health business to help the region achieve its growth plans. We aim to do this through better client experience; cutting-edge, better-informed pricing; and supporting development of innovative products for clients in the region.
 The role involves supporting development of new products and the pricing of the business written in accordance with our technical guidelines.
 Major Responsibilities

• New Business Quotes and Tenders

• Lead and support the pricing and modelling of new business; this includes the review on quotes prepared by other team members and authority to sign-off.

• Partner with client-facing teams to understand cedants’ objectives, structures, and risk profiles, and translate these into appropriate pricing solutions.

• Collaborate with a cross-functional team of experts from client markets, underwriting and claims towards assessing the risks associated with a particular opportunity.

• Costing Methodology and Guidelines

• Ensure consistent and robust application of pricing methodologies and governance standards across all transactions.

• Proactively challenge existing pricing approaches and drive simplification, automation, and improvement of tools and processes.

• Monitor market, regulatory, and competitive developments and assess their impact on pricing assumptions and reinsurance structures.

• Collaborate with Experience Studies teams to analyze claims, lapse, and portfolio experience, and incorporate insights into pricing and assumption setting.

• Maintain and enhance pricing guidelines, documentation, and governance frameworks based on research and emerging experience

• Strategy, Product Development and Brand Presence

• Contribute to technical, research and project management input for product development initiatives.

• Assist in assessing the impact of regulatory, market, and industry developments on pricing and product structures, particularly within India and the region.

• Collaboration
• Work closely with senior actuaries and cross-functional teams, contributing to regional and global projects as appropriate .

• Contribute to regional and cross-border projects, collaborating with global teams and sharing best practices

Qualifications & Requirements

jobs.title: AVP, HR Generalist, US
jobs.description:
Location: Armonk, NY

Looking to build your HR career in a role with real scope and impact? As an AVP, HR Generalist, at Swiss Re, you’ll work across the full employee lifecycle to contribute to key HR deliverables, gaining exposure to complex people topics in a global organization.
 About the Role
 Reporting directly to the SVP, Head of People US, you will support a broad range of HR activities across the employee lifecycle, combining hands-on execution with advisory support. You’ll work closely with HR Partners, managers, and employees to address day-to-day people matters, contribute to cross-functional projects and initiatives, and help deliver a consistent, high-quality HR experience.
 This is a fast-paced, collaborative role with the opportunity to engage with a wide variety of HR topics, including employee relations, performance management, development, and people-related aspects of organizational change. You’ll build relationships across the business while contributing to ongoing improvements in how HR supports the organization.
 Key Responsibilities

• Work closely with HR Partners to support the delivery of HR activities and initiatives across the business, and lead selected projects as appropriate

• Support the implementation and interpretation of HR policies and procedures, providing guidance to managers and employees

• Contribute to HR reporting and data analysis, supporting business insights and ongoing reporting requirements

• Assist in administering employee performance, leadership and development programs

• Identify opportunities to enhance HR processes and employee experience, contributing to continuous improvement in delivery, clarity, and consistency

• Ensure compliance with local and national regulations and applicable employment laws, supporting the ongoing maintenance of HR policies and procedures

• Provide HR advisory support to employees and managers on a range of topics, including absence, conduct, grievances, and organizational change

• Serve as primary backup for HR Partners, with opportunities to support or rotate across other HR areas (e.g. HR Operations, Onboarding)
 About the Team
 The US People team is a collaborative and tightly connected group supporting employees across the business. The team includes HR Partners, HR Operations, and Data Analytics, working together to deliver end-to-end HR support and a consistent employee experience.
 The team is closely aligned with Centers of Excellence such as Talent Acquisition, Reward, Benefits, and Payroll, enabling strong partnership across the broader HR function. You’ll be part of a small, high-impact team with direct exposure to senior HR leadership and the opportunity to contribute across a range of HR topics and priorities.
 About You
 You are a thoughtful and proactive HR professional who brings sound judgment and a data-driven, solutions-oriented approach to your work. You enjoy working with managers and employees on a range of people topics and are comfortable balancing day-to-day execution with broader project contributions.
 You are organized, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. You care about creating an inclusive employee experience and supporting teams in ways that are fair, thoughtful, and practical, enabling our people to do their best work. You are curious and eager to learn, with an interest in building your experience across different areas of HR and developing your skills over time.
 We are looking for candidates with the following experience and skills:

• 4+ years of broad HR experience, with exposure to core areas such as employee relations, performance management, or HR operations, ideally within a global or matrixed corporate environment

• Experience working directly with managers and employees to address day-to-day HR topics and provide practical guidance

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment

• Demonstrated experience contributing to HR projects or initiatives, with the ability to take ownership of defined workstreams

• Working knowledge of HR policies, procedures, and employment law, with the ability to apply them consistently and thoughtfully

• Experience working with HRIS data and reporting; ability to use data to support insights and decision-making

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across teams and functions

• A practical, resourceful approach, with sound judgment and a willingness to engage on a range of HR topics

• Exposure to insurance or reinsurance helpful but not required

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; SHRM, PHR, or GPHR certification helpful
 The estimated base salary range for this position is $90,000 to $134,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short- and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office two to three days per week on average.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Join our dynamic team as an Full Stack Engineer where you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and contribute to impactful projects that make a difference across our organization!

 As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of developing and maintaining high-quality applications that support business functions.  You're a problem-solver at heart with a passion for creating elegant, efficient code. You thrive in collaborative environments and are eager to learn and adapt to new technologies. • Minimum 5-year experience as a fullstack developer

• Strong experience with Angular framework and front-end development

• Proficiency in .NET or equivalent backend development experience

• Experience working with databases such as MSSQL or PostgreSQL

• Understanding of software development lifecycle and Scrum methodologies

• Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

• Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, etc.)

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

• Familiarity with AI solutions including development of custom agents and implementation of AI orchestration frameworks

• Knowledge of SharePoint development and web parts

• Previous experience in a similar role within a corporate environment

jobs.title: Requirements Engineer III
jobs.description:
About the Role
 In this pivotal role, you'll bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation, ensuring our Costing & Pricing solutions deliver measurable business value. You'll collaborate with underwriting, pricing, finance, and technology teams to translate complex requirements into clear specifications that support the development and enhancement of costing tools and related business capabilities.
 Key Responsibilities

• Analyze, clarify, and document business requirements, translating them into functional and technical specifications, including process maps, business architecture, wireframes, and data models.

• Ensure comprehensive specification of User Stories with the required business context, data requirements, and supporting analysis.

• Design and define test scenarios and support the Product Owner in creating effective acceptance criteria.

• Collaborate with Product Owners, Technology Leads, Business Process Managers, Business Architects, and Data teams to maintain end-to-end consistency across systems, processes, and information architecture.

• Work closely with underwriting, pricing, and finance stakeholders to understand costing methodologies, pricing rules, and business processes.

• Support the enhancement of costing and pricing tools by identifying opportunities for process optimization, automation, and improved user experience.

• Organize and prioritize the Product Backlog based on Product Owner guidance.

• Provide functional support for one or more business applications, resolving user requests or coordinating with development teams for complex issues.

• Create and maintain project documentation and business knowledge artifacts on the corporate Wiki.

jobs.description:
About the Role
 As Head Facultative Japan, you will be the underwriting, portfolio, and commercial leader for Swiss Re's Facultative business in Japan. You will hold full accountability for portfolio performance (P&L), cedant & broker engagement, and market positioning — all while ensuring seamless alignment with APAC and Global Facultative strategies. This is a high-impact, high-visibility leadership role where your decisions will directly influence Swiss Re's market relevance, profitability, and long-term growth trajectory in Japan.
 Key Responsibilities
 Portfolio Ownership & P&L Accountability

• Own and steer the Facultative Japan portfolio with full responsibility for profitability, growth, and volatility management

• Ensure underwriting discipline , including line size deployment, nat cat exposure management, and accumulation control

• Actively monitor portfolio performance and take swift, decisive corrective actions where needed
 Underwriting & Origination Leadership

• Lead origination and execution of complex facultative transactions, including large single risk and fac facility business

• Drive client-centric solutions by understanding cedants' needs and translating them into tailored risk transfer structures

• Maintain and deepen strong engagement with key cedants and brokers across the Japan market

• Strengthen Swiss Re's market positioning in Japan through thought leadership and commercial excellence
 Strategy & Market Development

• Define and implement a Japan-specific underwriting and go-to-market strategy, aligned with APAC and Global Facultative priorities

• Identify opportunities for profitable growth, including non-traditional solutions and fac facilities

• Drive innovation in product development to meet evolving market demands
 Governance & Operational Excellence

• Ensure adherence to underwriting guidelines, referral frameworks, and governance standards

• Maintain strong controls around peer review principles, referral processes, and contract wording quality and certainty

• Partner with Risk Management and Governance functions to uphold the highest standards of operational integrity
 Leadership & Team Development

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing underwriting team in Japan, fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous learning

• Inspire collaboration across APAC and global teams, driving technical excellence and knowledge sharing

• Ensure effective resource allocation and team structure aligned with evolving business needs
 Regional & Global Collaboration

• Act as a key contributor to the Facultative APAC leadership team, bringing the Japan market perspective to regional strategy discussions

• Collaborate actively with Global Product Centers, Facultative APAC and Global communities, and Treaty teams to deliver integrated solutions

About the Team
 The Facultative Japan team sits at the heart of Swiss Re's reinsurance operations in one of Asia's most dynamic and technically complex markets. The team is responsible for originating, underwriting, and managing a diverse portfolio of facultative reinsurance business across property, casualty, and specialty lines — working closely with leading Japanese cedants, brokers, and regional and global colleagues. With a strong culture of underwriting excellence, collaboration, and client focus, the team plays a pivotal role in delivering Swiss Re's value proposition to the Japan market and contributing to the broader APAC and Global Facultative strategy.
 About You
 You are a confident, credible, and commercially driven reinsurance professional who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments. You bring a rare combination of deep technical underwriting expertise, strong people leadership, and the ability to build lasting relationships with senior stakeholders. You are equally comfortable steering a portfolio through challenging market cycles as you are inspiring and developing a talented team. You lead with integrity, communicate with clarity, and bring a genuine passion for the Japan reinsurance market.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Extensive experience (10+ years) in re/insurance underwriting, with strong and demonstrable exposure to the Japan market

• Proven track record in originating and executing facultative deals, including large and complex risks across multiple lines of business

• Demonstrated experience in portfolio management and P&L ownership, with the ability to balance growth ambitions with underwriting discipline

• Proven people leadership capability , with a track record of developing talent, leading senior underwriters, and building high-performing teams

• Deep expertise in Japan re/insurance market dynamics, nat cat exposure and modelling considerations, and reinsurance structuring and pricing mechanics

• Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify and capitalise on market opportunities

• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, both internally and externally at senior levels

• Fluency in both Japanese and English (written and spoken)
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience working within a global reinsurance organisation with exposure to regional and global governance frameworks

• Familiarity with non-traditional risk transfer solutions

• Strong network within the Japan cedant and broker community

• Experience collaborating across cross-functional teams including Risk Management, Treaty, and Global Product Centers
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. jobs.title: Lease Contract Manager
jobs.description:
Do you combine strong real estate expertise with a passion for contract and data excellence?
 Join Swiss Re's newly established central Lease Management team within Corporate Real Estate & Services (CRES) and play a key role in managing Swiss Re’s global lease portfolio across multiple regions and locations, ensuring accurate contract interpretation, end-to-end lifecycle ownership, and alignment with commercial, legal, and financial requirements.
 About the Role
 This role sits at the intersection of real estate, contract management, data governance, and financial reporting. It offers the opportunity to shape a globally consistent lease data environment, work closely with senior stakeholders across regions and functions, and contribute directly to audit-ready reporting, portfolio transparency, and informed decision-making throughout the entire lease lifecycle.
 Key responsibilities:
 As Lease Contract & Data Manager, you will oversee lease and sublease contracts after signature, ensuring contractual terms are accurately interpreted, converted into structured lease data, and maintained throughout the lease lifecycle to support operations, accounting, and reporting. Your task portfolio will include:
 Contract interpretation & data abstraction:

• Review lease contracts, amendments, annexes, side arrangements, and other related supporting documentation

• Interpret contractual terms and obligations

• Translate contract information into structured, system-ready Real Estate and IFRS 16-relevant lease data, including key terms, dates, payment obligations, and option clauses
 Lease data management:

• Own, monitor, and maintain lease data throughout the entire contract lifecycle

• Initiate and reflect updates resulting from renewals, amendments, terminations, rent reviews, and/or indexation adjustments

• Ensure completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness

• Enable IFRS 16 reporting through high-quality data submission to Finance
 Data quality and controls:

• Execute and document risk controls, including performing independent four-eyes reviews, in line with governance and reporting requirements

• Resolve identified discrepancies and data quality issues

• Ensure compliance with data standards and audit readiness
 Stakeholder collaboration:

• Liaise with contract owners, regional stakeholders, Finance, Legal, and Data Administrators to ensure aligned interpretation and high-quality data outcomes

• Clarify contract ambiguities and support interpretation decisions

• Act as a key partner to Global Portfolio Managers, CRES Regional Heads and regional/local teams, providing transparency on lease data and supporting fact-based decision-making (e.g. portfolio insights, contractual implications, risks, etc.)
 Documentation and auditability:

• Maintain complete contract documentation

• Ensure traceability between contract, extracted data and reporting outputs

• Support internal and external audits as well as control reviews by providing complete, traceable, and well-documented evidence
 Process improvement & governance:

• Contribute to continuously improve the end-to-end lease data management process

• Strong focus on capability building, governance, and process excellence
 About the Team
 You will be part of a newly created central Lease Management team responsible for end-to-end lease management after contract signature.
 We work closely with central, regional, and local teams, who lead business case development, negotiation, and contract setup. Once the contract is signed, we assume responsibility for lease data, ensuring consistency, timely updates, effective controls, and high data quality throughout the lease lifecycle.
 As a central competence center, we align local delivery with global standards, Finance requirements, and governance.
 About You
 You are an experienced lease professional who thrives in complex, global environments. You bring strong expertise in cross-regional lease contracts, execute with confidence, and build trust across a wide range of stakeholders. Pragmatic and hands-on, you help Swiss Re elevate lease management to the next level.
 Experience:

• At least 10+ years of experience in real estate and lease contract management

• Proven track record in international real estate environments

• Strong practical expertise in interpreting contracts, abstracting lease information, and managing structured lease data

• High familiarity with global or matrix-based organizations

• Solid understanding of IFRS 16 is required
 Skills:

• Academic degree in Business Administration, Finance, Real Estate Management or a related field

• Deep expertise in lease contracts and commercial terms

• Strong data governance and quality mindset

• Experience with lease systems (e.g., Planon) and a strong command of structured system data

• Robust understanding of risk management and controls, as well as audit requirements

• High attention to detail and structured working style
 Personal competencies:

• Strong ownership and accountability

• Analytical, precise, and solution-oriented

• Strong communicator able to engage and advise senior stakeholders across functions/regions

• Interest in applying AI-enabled tools to improve data quality, process efficiency, and analytical insight
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 3,200 and EUR 5,300 per month (for a fulltime role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.
 We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder. #LI-Hybrid

jobs.description:
Kick-start your AI career with real projects, global impact, and a team that helps you grow.
 About the Role
 This isn't about building AI for the sake of it - you'll create solutions that actually matter. From leveraging AI to read complex documents to building AI assistants that make everyone's job easier, your work will directly impact how one of the world's leading reinsurance companies operates.
 What You Will Work On
 Here's a taste of what you could be building:

• Smart document processing engines that automatically extract key information pieces in seconds – work that would take humans hours to complete manually

• AI assistants and agents that summarize complex texts, check if they follow company guidelines, and speed up workflows across the business

• Next-gen evaluation tools that help us understand how well our AI products are performing and ensure they're reliable enough for real-world use

• Powerful data pipelines that can process large amounts of messy, real-world information
 The best part? You won't just be coding in isolation. You'll work alongside experienced team members and business partners to understand the problems we're solving and why they matter.
 About the Team
 We're Swiss Re's biggest data science team – a friendly, ambitious group building AI solutions used across the entire company. Think of us as an internal AI startup: we work with teams all over the world to design and deliver tools that make their everyday work smarter and faster.
 Our products are created right here in Bratislava but used globally. We care about solid data science skills, but we equally value engineering excellence, scalable infrastructure, and delivering reliable, production ready AI.
 About You
 You're curious about AI and excited to apply it to solve meaningful problems. You enjoy both building technical solutions and understanding the human needs behind them. Most importantly, you're eager to learn and grow in a team that supports your development.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• A degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Software Engineering, or equivalent work experience

• Proficiency in Python (or similar languages) and experience with modern AI/ML frameworks

• Experience with Generative AI and/or Natural Language Processing
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience deploying AI solutions, including model monitoring and maintenance

• Experience working with large-scale data pipelines and distributed computing

• Solid Understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and MLOps methodologies

• Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audience

• Enthusiasm for continuous learning and trying new approaches
 If you don't have some of those but are eager to learn them, get in contact with us.
 Why Join Us?
 You'll build impactful AI solutions used globally, work in an environment that supports continuous learning, and grow your career by specializing in the areas that excite you most.

jobs.description:
About the Role
 You are a Quality Engineer with strong experience in modern software delivery environments and a passion for building fully automated, AI-enhanced quality engineering practices.
 You believe quality is engineered into systems from the beginning — not validated at the end — and you actively promote shift-left testing, automation-first thinking, and continuous validation throughout the software lifecycle.
 You work closely with software engineers, product owners, DevSecOps engineers, and architects to ensure applications are scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready. You are comfortable working across frontend, backend, APIs, cloud-native platforms, and CI/CD pipelines.
 You are excited by emerging AI-assisted engineering capabilities and understand how AI can improve test generation, validation, diagnostics, coverage analysis, and operational quality insights.
 Responsibilities
 Shift-Left Quality Engineering

• Embed quality engineering practices early in the software development lifecycle

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners during requirements and design phases

• Define test strategies and acceptance criteria before implementation begins

• Drive quality-focused engineering practices across frontend, backend, APIs, and integrations
 Test Automation Engineering

• Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and pipelines

• Develop automated unit, integration, API, UI, regression, and end-to-end tests

• Implement scalable test automation for Angular frontend and Node.js backend applications

• Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows

• Improve test reliability, coverage, execution speed, and maintainability
 AI-Enhanced QA & Validation

• Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate test creation, validation, and diagnostics

• Validate AI-generated test cases, automation scripts, and quality artifacts

• Apply AI capabilities for intelligent test selection, defect analysis, and coverage optimization

• Support emerging engineering approaches focused on specification-driven and validation-first delivery

• Contribute to deterministic, machine-readable testing and validation strategies
 Cloud, Platform & Operational Quality

• Support quality validation across Azure cloud environments and Kubernetes platforms

• Participate in performance, resilience, security, and operational testing activities

• Contribute to observability, monitoring validation, and production quality initiatives

• Help validate deployment automation and infrastructure reliability
 Security & Quality Governance

• Validate authentication and authorization implementations using OAuth2 and JWT-based security models

• Support secure development lifecycle practices and automated security validation

• Participate in code reviews, defect analysis, and root cause investigations

• Promote engineering standards, testing best practices, and continuous improvement
 Required Experience & Capabilities

• 3–6 years of software quality engineering or test automation experience

• Strong experience with automated testing frameworks and tooling

• Experience testing Angular frontend and API/backend services

• Familiarity with Node.js applications and distributed systems

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows

• Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes environments

• Experience working in Azure cloud environments preferred Understanding of OAuth2, JWT tokens, and application security concepts

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills

• Experience writing technical documentation and test strategies
 Growth Potential Signals

• Strong automation-first mindset

• Passion for improving engineering quality and developer productivity

• Interest in AI-assisted engineering and autonomous quality validation

• Ability to think in end-to-end systems and workflows

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Continuous learner who stays current with emerging quality engineering practices
