jobs.description:
About the Team:
 At Swiss Re, our mission is to make the world more resilient. The P&C Re Architecture team helps advance that mission by shaping the data, technology and architectural foundations that enable better risk understanding, stronger decisions and trusted analytics across the reinsurance business.

Together with colleagues across business and IT, we shape the foundations that enable trusted data, advanced analytics and AI-driven insights to support better decisions, strengthen resilience and create value for our clients
 About the Role:

As a Lead Data Architect, you will shape end-to-end data architecture across a broad business and application landscape. You will work with stakeholders across business and IT to translate complex requirements into logical data models, data flows and architecture designs that support operational processes, integrations, analytics and AI-driven use cases.

You will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and application engineering teams on all data architecture-related topics. In doing so, you will help ensure that data is structured, governed and managed in a consistent way across systems, enabling trusted, reusable and well-controlled data assets across the organisation.

Key responsibilities:

• Collaborate across boundaries – partner with P&C Reinsurance business and IT teams, as well as the broader Swiss Re organisation, to translate business requirements into clear, actionable data architecture designs.

• Design with purpose – create logical data models and end-to-end data flows that are scalable, reliable, and aligned with business needs across operational and analytical environments.

• Lead and enable – guide engineers and delivery teams in implementing physical data models, data flows, and data access controls, fostering a culture of architectural excellence.

• Empower through clarity – own and evolve key data architecture artefacts, including data models, shared definitions, lineage-related documentation, and other design assets that enable consistent use of data across systems and domains.

• Embrace innovation – leverage AI tools and techniques within the data architecture function to drive efficiency and unlock new possibilities.

• Ensure compliance and trust – uphold alignment with Swiss Re's data governance standards and security requirements, ensuring data is managed as a trusted, high-quality asset.

About You:

You understand that data is a strategic asset and take pride in designing structures and practices that make it trustworthy, accessible and fit for purpose across a complex application landscape. You are comfortable translating business needs into data models, data flows and data management practices that support operational, integration and analytical use cases.

You bring a collaborative spirit, a curious mind, and the ability to communicate complex data architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You are comfortable leading others, navigating ambiguity, and working across cultures and time zones to deliver meaningful outcomes.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Strong data modelling expertise – proven experience with both 3NF and dimensional modelling approaches, with the ability to design models that support operational, integration and analytical use cases.

• Data architecture experience – working knowledge of data architecture patterns that support operational systems, application integration and data analytics solutions in complex enterprise environments.

• Data management proficiency – practical experience applying data management practices such as data sourcing, data profiling, data transformation, data quality management, master/reference data management, data cataloguing, lifecycle management and access management across a range of business and technology use cases.

• Architectural leadership – demonstrated experience providing architectural guidance to engineering and delivery teams, translating strategy into implementable data architecture outcomes.

• Communication and stakeholder management – strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage effectively with multicultural, globally distributed teams and translate business needs into well-structured data-centric solutions.

• Industry knowledge – considered a nice-to-have, ideally in Property & Casualty domain, with an understanding of how data supports risk assessment and decision-making across the end-to-end value chain.

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between [EUR 3,400] and [EUR 5,700] per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers: ​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience. ​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. ​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

Together with colleagues across business and IT, we shape the foundations that enable trusted data, advanced analytics and AI-driven insights to support better decisions, strengthen resilience and create value for our clients
 About the Role:

As a Lead Data Architect, you will shape end-to-end data architecture across a broad business and application landscape. You will work with stakeholders across business and IT to translate complex requirements into logical data models, data flows and architecture designs that support operational processes, integrations, analytics and AI-driven use cases.

You will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and application engineering teams on all data architecture-related topics. In doing so, you will help ensure that data is structured, governed and managed in a consistent way across systems, enabling trusted, reusable and well-controlled data assets across the organisation.

Key responsibilities:

• Collaborate across boundaries – partner with P&C Reinsurance business and IT teams, as well as the broader Swiss Re organisation, to translate business requirements into clear, actionable data architecture designs.

• Design with purpose – create logical data models and end-to-end data flows that are scalable, reliable, and aligned with business needs across operational and analytical environments.

• Lead and enable – guide engineers and delivery teams in implementing physical data models, data flows, and data access controls, fostering a culture of architectural excellence.

• Empower through clarity – own and evolve key data architecture artefacts, including data models, shared definitions, lineage-related documentation, and other design assets that enable consistent use of data across systems and domains.

• Embrace innovation – leverage AI tools and techniques within the data architecture function to drive efficiency and unlock new possibilities.

• Ensure compliance and trust – uphold alignment with Swiss Re's data governance standards and security requirements, ensuring data is managed as a trusted, high-quality asset.

About You:

You understand that data is a strategic asset and take pride in designing structures and practices that make it trustworthy, accessible and fit for purpose across a complex application landscape. You are comfortable translating business needs into data models, data flows and data management practices that support operational, integration and analytical use cases.

You bring a collaborative spirit, a curious mind, and the ability to communicate complex data architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You are comfortable leading others, navigating ambiguity, and working across cultures and time zones to deliver meaningful outcomes.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Strong data modelling expertise – proven experience with both 3NF and dimensional modelling approaches, with the ability to design models that support operational, integration and analytical use cases.

• Data architecture experience – working knowledge of data architecture patterns that support operational systems, application integration and data analytics solutions in complex enterprise environments.

• Data management proficiency – practical experience applying data management practices such as data sourcing, data profiling, data transformation, data quality management, master/reference data management, data cataloguing, lifecycle management and access management across a range of business and technology use cases.

• Architectural leadership – demonstrated experience providing architectural guidance to engineering and delivery teams, translating strategy into implementable data architecture outcomes.

• Communication and stakeholder management – strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage effectively with multicultural, globally distributed teams and translate business needs into well-structured data-centric solutions.

• Industry knowledge – considered a nice-to-have, ideally in Property & Casualty domain, with an understanding of how data supports risk assessment and decision-making across the end-to-end value chain.

jobs.title: Distribution Manager
jobs.description:
Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President
 Division: CSA-MU Asia (50008866)
 Department: CSAJ-Japan (50005685)
 Recruiter: Devi Sangeetha R
 Hiring Manager: Makoto Iwasaki
 Copy the below link to share this job posting with your coworkers:
 https://performancemanager.successfactors.eu/sf/jobreq?jobId=135584&company=SwissRe

An opportunity to join a fast-growing, dynamic, foreign insurance company. You will be generating new business and conducting insurance solicitation activities, origination and development with agencies and brokers. Specific responsibility to help lead the distribution management of the Japan branch in the large and middle corporate market through innovative and differentiated insurance products, solutions and digital platforms in coordination with Senior Distribution Manager.

About the role

Position objectives and position summary

Generating new business and conducting insurance solicitation activities, origination and development with agencies and brokers. Maintaining and expanding the relationships with target clients, understanding the full product suite, in order to identify business opportunities.

Main tasks/activities

• Develop and implement strategies for distribution management in Japan

• Understand the business strategy and underwriting appetite of each business line to generate profitable business

• Function as a hub for the Japanese market and underwriting teams to explore localized and effective business flows

• Implement the PDCA cycle to activate the assigned agencies and brokers

• Proactively acquire market trends and communicate them to internal stakeholders

• Influence across teams to further improve branch operations in Japan

• Negotiate tenaciously with internal and external stakeholders

• Generate new revenue streams by deploying products with targeted agencies through digital platforms

• Act as the primary contact for the assigned agencies and brokers

• Collaborate with underwriting and operations to ensure alignment

• Prepare and/or support colleagues to work out insurance solicitation material and various marketing material

• Enter and maintain sales activities (e.g.: initiatives, discussion notes, quotations) in Customer 360 and necessary database

• Contribute to other project work and accept special assignments as and when necessary

• Adhere to all laws and regulations both external and internal

• Representation activities and interaction with other parties

• Represents SRIJ in meetings with clients, agencies, brokers and other intermediaries and organizations

About the team

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions (Swiss Re International SE), Tokyo Office.

Working as part of a dynamic and growing Customer and Distribution team that reports directly to the Head of Japan, helping to deliver innovative solutions to customers, agencies and brokers.

About You

You will ideally have worked in a commercial insurance company or agency in Japan and have the following attributes.

• Minimum 5 years-experience in Japanese agency business handling corporate business

• Good knowledge about the Japanese corporate insurance business as well as agency management and pipeline development.

• Open mindset with good communication skills

• Ability to drive innovation

• Ability to communicate clearly and persuasively internally and externally

• Self-motivated, organized and persistent in achieving goals

• Native Japanese language skills

• English reding/writing capability. Spoken English is an advantage

jobs.title: Junior Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role
 We are seeking a Junior Automation Engineer to join our global Solutions team in Mexico . In this role, you will contribute to the evolution and support of Magnum , Swiss Re’s market-leading automated underwriting solution, currently deployed with more than 70 clients worldwide .
 You will play a key role across the full solution lifecycle — from design and development through testing, validation, and continuous improvement. Working closely with product, underwriting, and technology stakeholders, you will help ensure Magnum continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and best-in-class automated underwriting capabilities that support our clients’ digital transformation journeys.
 Magnum is a strategic Swiss Re product, combining advanced risk knowledge with modern automation technologies to enable efficient, consistent, and high-quality underwriting decisions across Life and Health markets.
 Key Responsibilities

• Participate in the design, development, and delivery of automation solutions aligned with product strategy and client requirements

• Produce clear and well-structured functional and technical specifications

• Develop and maintain underwriting rules, automation logic, and supporting components

• Contribute to ongoing Magnum product enhancements and innovation initiatives

• Apply automation and RPA technologies to streamline and optimize business processes

• Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans, including regression test packs

• Validate development outcomes against defined business and client requirements

• Identify, track, and resolve defects throughout the full development lifecycle

• Actively participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles and release validation activities

• Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks and test suites

• Continuously improve test automation approaches to enhance coverage, reliability, and efficiency

• Collaborate effectively with global stakeholders across multiple time zones
 About You
 Nobody is perfect, and we don’t expect you to meet every requirement. If you meet most of the criteria below and are motivated to learn and grow, we would be happy to meet you.
 Required Experience & Skills

• 2-3 + years of experience in software development, automation engineering, or quality engineering

• Experience working in Insurance, Banking, or Financial Services IT environments

• Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms

• Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

• Programming experience in Java, JavaScript, C#, or similar languages

• Experience in test design, execution, and defect management

• Familiarity with web technologies, API testing, and SQL databases

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

• Ability to collaborate effectively in a global, multicultural environment
 Nice to Have

• Experience with automation and RPA tools (UiPath preferred)

• Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools (e.g. BDD, Selenium, Postman, Visual Studio)

• An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ownership and step beyond defined role boundaries

What We Offer
 At Swiss Re, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and continuous learning. Based in Mexico, you will work in a global environment while benefiting from a strong local community and support structure.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and diverse workplace where different perspectives are valued

• The opportunity to work on a strategic, market-leading product with global client impact

• Hybrid working model, combining office collaboration in Mexico with flexible remote working

• Flexible working arrangements supporting work–life balance

• Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with the Mexico market
 Our Culture
 Swiss Re’s culture is built on trust, accountability, and respect. We empower our people to take ownership, challenge ideas constructively, and continuously improve how we work.

• An environment where people feel safe to speak up, experiment, and learn from mistakes

• Strong emphasis on teamwork, integrity, and delivery excellence

• Collaboration across global teams and functions in a multicultural setting

• A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion at all levels of the organization
 Learning, Growth & Wellbeing
 We believe that sustainable performance comes from continuous development and personal wellbeing.

• Access to Swiss Re learning platforms, including digital learning libraries, technical training, and professional development programs

• Opportunities for on-the-job learning, knowledge sharing, and internal mobility across Swiss Re

• Support for personal and professional growth through feedback, coaching, and development conversations

• A strong focus on employee wellbeing, including wellbeing initiatives, mental health support, and a supportive working environment

• Modern office facilities in Mexico, designed to support collaboration, focus, and flexibility
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Working closely with product, underwriting, and technology stakeholders, you will help ensure Magnum continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and best-in-class automated underwriting capabilities that support our clients’ digital transformation journeys.
 Magnum is a strategic Swiss Re product, combining advanced risk knowledge with modern automation technologies to enable efficient, consistent, and high-quality underwriting decisions across Life and Health markets.
 Key Responsibilities

• Participate in the design, development, and delivery of automation solutions aligned with product strategy and client requirements

• Produce clear and well-structured functional and technical specifications

• Develop and maintain underwriting rules, automation logic, and supporting components

• Contribute to ongoing Magnum product enhancements and innovation initiatives

• Apply automation and RPA technologies to streamline and optimize business processes

• Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans, including regression test packs

• Validate development outcomes against defined business and client requirements

• Identify, track, and resolve defects throughout the full development lifecycle

• Actively participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles and release validation activities

• Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks and test suites

• Continuously improve test automation approaches to enhance coverage, reliability, and efficiency

• Collaborate effectively with global stakeholders across multiple time zones
 About You
 Nobody is perfect, and we don’t expect you to meet every requirement. If you meet most of the criteria below and are motivated to learn and grow, we would be happy to meet you.
 Required Experience & Skills

• 2-3 + years of experience in software development, automation engineering, or quality engineering

• Experience working in Insurance, Banking, or Financial Services IT environments

• Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms

• Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

• Programming experience in Java, JavaScript, C#, or similar languages

• Experience in test design, execution, and defect management

• Familiarity with web technologies, API testing, and SQL databases

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

• Ability to collaborate effectively in a global, multicultural environment
 Nice to Have

• Experience with automation and RPA tools (UiPath preferred)

• Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools (e.g. BDD, Selenium, Postman, Visual Studio)

• An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ownership and step beyond defined role boundaries

What We Offer
 At Swiss Re, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and continuous learning. Based in Mexico, you will work in a global environment while benefiting from a strong local community and support structure.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and diverse workplace where different perspectives are valued

• The opportunity to work on a strategic, market-leading product with global client impact

• Hybrid working model, combining office collaboration in Mexico with flexible remote working

• Flexible working arrangements supporting work–life balance

• Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with the Mexico market
 Our Culture
 Swiss Re’s culture is built on trust, accountability, and respect. We empower our people to take ownership, challenge ideas constructively, and continuously improve how we work.

• An environment where people feel safe to speak up, experiment, and learn from mistakes

• Strong emphasis on teamwork, integrity, and delivery excellence

• Collaboration across global teams and functions in a multicultural setting

• A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion at all levels of the organization
 Learning, Growth & Wellbeing
 We believe that sustainable performance comes from continuous development and personal wellbeing.

• Access to Swiss Re learning platforms, including digital learning libraries, technical training, and professional development programs

• Opportunities for on-the-job learning, knowledge sharing, and internal mobility across Swiss Re

• Support for personal and professional growth through feedback, coaching, and development conversations

• A strong focus on employee wellbeing, including wellbeing initiatives, mental health support, and a supportive working environment

• Modern office facilities in Mexico, designed to support collaboration, focus, and flexibility
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. jobs.title: Engineering Underwriter
jobs.description:
Are you a technically sharp, commercially minded engineering professional who loves turning complex risks into smart reinsurance solutions? Do you want to play a pivotal role in shaping engineering reinsurance across one of the world's most dynamic and fast-growing markets? If so, this is your chance to make a meaningful impact at Swiss Re — one of the world's leading reinsurers — and be part of a team that is setting the standard in engineering reinsurance across Asia-Pacific.
 About the Role
 We are looking for a driven and results-oriented Engineering Underwriter to join our Engineering North Asia team in Hong Kong. In this role, you will be at the heart of developing and growing engineering facultative and treaty reinsurance business across the Hong Kong and Taiwan markets, while also providing underwriting and technical expertise to other markets across Asia. You will work with a diverse portfolio of clients, delivering tailored reinsurance solutions that are both technically sound and commercially compelling.
 Key Responsibilities

• Profitably grow the engineering facultative and treaty reinsurance portfolio by delivering high-quality underwriting services and bespoke reinsurance solutions to clients across Hong Kong and Taiwan

• Perform post-underwriting activities including risk surveys, portfolio reserve assessments, treaty and facultative account servicing, and claims support

• Strengthen Swiss Re's market position in the North Asia engineering reinsurance space through proactive client marketing, underwriting training, and technical risk surveys

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deepen client partnerships and deliver sustainable, mutually beneficial solutions

• Contribute actively to the Swiss Re Global Engineering community through knowledge sharing, participation in special initiatives, and research projects

• Maintain underwriting excellence by ensuring accurate and complete documentation, upholding high data quality in underwriting systems, and following up on post-binding activities including premium collection, claims data, and regulatory filings
 About the Team
 The Engineering APAC team is part of Swiss Re's Global Engineering division — a world-leading center of expertise in engineering reinsurance handling both Treaty and Single Risks businesses. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Team and our Scope
 Our team, a software house within Swiss Re, develops cloud-native (Azure-based) SaaS/PaaS solutions for external Life & Health insurance clients. Our portfolio includes globally established products and those in growth or incubation stages. We utilize the latest technology and prioritize innovation to stay competitive.
 Our technical team comprises professionals with multidisciplinary skills, located in various countries, delivering highly available, multi-regional solutions used worldwide.
 About the Role
 We are looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team. Unlike other teams, we design and build productive infrastructure, leaving operations to others. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in writing IaaC and automating deployments, with skills in PowerShell, Kubernetes, Terraform, Azure DevOps, Helm, and modern DevOps best practices. As a Senior, you will guide other DevOps engineers and collaborate with the Engineering Manager and Product Owner to ensure the infrastructure meets evolving requirements.
 Your responsibilities will be:

• Solutionalize how to automatically deploy cloud infrastructure including networking, storage, compute, policies, monitoring, security, identity, functions, etc.

• Collaborate with product developers to identify DevOps solutions for embedding software in a secure, high-performance cloud infrastructure that meets enterprise standards.

• Create and implement DevOps solutions for automatic deployment of SW infrastructure, including disaster recovery strategies, operational manuals, and instructions for handing over maintenance to a separate team.

• Continuously assess and identify how to increase infrastructure performance while keeping cloud costs under control.

• Assess security policies, infrastructure requirements and changing guidelines to ensure keeping the SW infrastructure always compliant, resilient and secure.

• Lead a team of DevOps engineers, offering technical guidance. Collaborate with architects, managers, tech leads, and product owners to deliver solutions within the roadmap and SDLC processes.
 About You
 Nobody is perfect and meets 100% requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are genuinely curious about the world of software development and IT Cloud, we will be happy to meet you.
 If you possess traits and experience that match most of the below, we’d love to hear from you:

• Must have excellent technical proficiency in…

• Usage and administrator of Azure services.

• Strong experience with PowerShell/Bash scripting.

• In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes and containerization.

• Strong skills with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.

• Knowledge of Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines and release management.

• Experience managing teams of DevOps engineers.

• Preferably knowledge also about…

• Programming background in any OOP language (preferred Java and/or Go).

• Knowledge of security scans, authorization protocols, CloudFlare.

• Understanding of data fundamentals.

• Familiarity with Okta for identity and access management.

• Knowledge of Cloudflare for web performance and security.

• General knowledge of Gitlab and/or Github DevOps practices
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 3,800 and EUR 6,300 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

About the Team and our Scope
 Our team, a software house within Swiss Re, develops cloud-native (Azure-based) SaaS/PaaS solutions for external Life & Health insurance clients. Our portfolio includes globally established products and those in growth or incubation stages. We utilize the latest technology and prioritize innovation to stay competitive.
 Our technical team comprises professionals with multidisciplinary skills, located in various countries, delivering highly available, multi-regional solutions used worldwide.
 About the Role
 We are looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team. Unlike other teams, we design and build productive infrastructure, leaving operations to others. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in writing IaaC and automating deployments, with skills in PowerShell, Kubernetes, Terraform, Azure DevOps, Helm, and modern DevOps best practices. As a Senior, you will guide other DevOps engineers and collaborate with the Engineering Manager and Product Owner to ensure the infrastructure meets evolving requirements.
 Your responsibilities will be:

• Solutionalize how to automatically deploy cloud infrastructure including networking, storage, compute, policies, monitoring, security, identity, functions, etc.

• Collaborate with product developers to identify DevOps solutions for embedding software in a secure, high-performance cloud infrastructure that meets enterprise standards.

• Create and implement DevOps solutions for automatic deployment of SW infrastructure, including disaster recovery strategies, operational manuals, and instructions for handing over maintenance to a separate team.

• Continuously assess and identify how to increase infrastructure performance while keeping cloud costs under control.

• Assess security policies, infrastructure requirements and changing guidelines to ensure keeping the SW infrastructure always compliant, resilient and secure.

• Lead a team of DevOps engineers, offering technical guidance. Collaborate with architects, managers, tech leads, and product owners to deliver solutions within the roadmap and SDLC processes.
 About You
 Nobody is perfect and meets 100% requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are genuinely curious about the world of software development and IT Cloud, we will be happy to meet you.
 If you possess traits and experience that match most of the below, we’d love to hear from you:

• Must have excellent technical proficiency in…

• Usage and administrator of Azure services.

• Strong experience with PowerShell/Bash scripting.

• In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes and containerization.

• Strong skills with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.

• Knowledge of Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines and release management.

• Experience managing teams of DevOps engineers.

• Preferably knowledge also about…

• Programming background in any OOP language (preferred Java and/or Go).

• Knowledge of security scans, authorization protocols, CloudFlare.

• Understanding of data fundamentals.

• Familiarity with Okta for identity and access management.

• Knowledge of Cloudflare for web performance and security.

• General knowledge of Gitlab and/or Github DevOps practices

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about turning complex data into powerful business insights? Do you thrive at the intersection of advanced analytics, machine learning, and real-world commercial impact? If you love solving challenging problems and collaborating with diverse teams to drive meaningful growth, this could be your next exciting career move!
 About the Role
 As a Senior Analytics Analyst, you will be at the heart of transforming how we use data to drive smarter, faster, and more impactful business decisions. You will play a pivotal role in shaping our sales analytics capabilities, working closely with stakeholders across the organization to unlock the full potential of data — from building cutting-edge machine learning models to delivering compelling insights that fuel growth. This is a high-visibility role where your work will directly influence strategic decisions and commercial outcomes.
 Key Responsibilities

• Partner with stakeholders throughout the GDM organization to identify and prioritize opportunities for leveraging data to develop innovative business solutions

• Mine and analyze large-scale data from Sales Analytics databases to drive efficiency improvements and support the achievement of growth objectives

• Evaluate and assess the effectiveness and accuracy of new data sources and data gathering techniques to continuously improve data quality

• Design and develop custom data models and algorithms, applying them to complex datasets to generate actionable insights

• Build and automate reports and dashboards iteratively, providing scalable insights that address key business priorities

• Develop robust processes and tools to monitor and analyze model performance, ensuring ongoing data accuracy and reliability

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and identify opportunities for applying Generative AI (GenAI) technologies to enhance outcomes

• Stay at the forefront of the latest advancements in GenAI technologies and proactively recommend innovative solutions to enhance data science processes

• Deliver compelling presentations of findings and recommendations to stakeholders at multiple levels, creating clear and impactful visual displays of quantitative information

• Manage stakeholder relationships effectively — soliciting ideas, prioritizing requests, and managing expectations with clarity and professionalism

• Coordinate efforts and actions with nine market units, maintaining a strong client and broker focus with emphasis on growth initiatives and sales campaigns
 About the Team
 You will be joining the GDM Analytics team, a dynamic and collaborative group dedicated to enhancing sales data analytics capabilities across the organization. The team plays a central role in coordinating analytics efforts across nine market units, ensuring alignment and consistency in how data drives decision-making. With a sharp focus on client and broker relationships, the team is at the forefront of powering growth initiatives and sales campaigns through the intelligent use of data.
 About You
 You are a curious, driven, and collaborative analytics professional who combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills. You have a natural ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and enjoy working across teams to solve real-world business challenges. You bring a growth mindset, a passion for emerging technologies, and the confidence to present findings to senior stakeholders. You are proactive in staying current with the latest developments in data science and GenAI, and you are energized by the opportunity to make a tangible impact.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Educational background: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field

• Hands-on experience: At least 5 years of experience with analysis applications (e.g., extracting insights, performing statistical analysis, or solving business problems) and coding languages such as Python, R, and SQL to manipulate data and draw insights from large datasets

• Machine learning expertise: Proficiency in machine learning libraries and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PySpark, and scikit-learn, with knowledge of a variety of techniques including clustering, ensembles, and artificial neural networks

• Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and data wrangling techniques

• Statistical foundations: Solid understanding of probability concepts, statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and experimental design

• AI and NLP experience: Demonstrated experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and other Machine Learning models to analyze structured and unstructured data, including Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across diverse, cross-functional teams

• Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on pragmatic, solution-oriented thinking
 These are additional nice to have:

• Familiarity with latest GenAI technologies and their practical application in a business context

• Commercial Insurance experience — an understanding of the insurance industry and its data landscape is a valuable plus

• A genuine drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques, staying ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving field
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Application Engineer III

Ready to engineer the future of reinsurance? Let's build it together.

At Swiss Re, we don't just write code — we build solutions that help the world become more resilient. As an Application Engineer III based in Hyderabad, India, you'll be at the heart of a global technology team, crafting high-quality applications and services that power one of the world's leading reinsurance businesses. If you thrive at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and meaningful business impact, this is your opportunity.

About the Role

This is a hands-on, high-impact engineering role where design thinking meets cloud-native development. You'll bring together software engineering expertise, DevOps know-how, and a sharp understanding of business domains to design, build, and roll out applications and APIs that matter. Working in an agile environment, you'll collaborate with global teams and outsourcing partners across all phases of the software development lifecycle — from concept to production.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and deliver high-quality applications, components, and APIs with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability

• Drive the cloud journey by acquiring and maintaining deep knowledge of our application landscape, software architectures, and cloud-native patterns

• Shape application architecture in collaboration with cloud solution architects across all lines of business — designing systems that are robust, extensible, and future-ready

• Leverage modern cloud environments by identifying and exploiting the advantages of platforms such as Azure, Swisscom, or Ali Cloud

• Stay ahead of the curve by tracking technology trends and evaluating promising solutions that align with business and technical requirements

• Communicate and champion ideas — present architectural concepts and engineering solutions to wider teams with clarity, compelling storytelling, and well-reasoned arguments

• Prototype and validate new technologies and approaches, then share insights and learnings across teams to foster a culture of continuous improvement

• Contribute to technical research and feasibility studies for proposed tooling, software upgrades, and architectural decisions

• Collaborate across borders — partner effectively with global teams and outsourcing partners throughout all phases of delivery

About the Team

We are the global Reinsurance Technology team — a passionate group of technologists responsible for the technical architecture and engineering of IT shared services and components for Swiss Re's Reinsurance business unit. Our team members bring a rare combination of deep technical expertise and genuine curiosity about the reinsurance business. We believe great technology is built through collaboration, and we work closely with application teams and colleagues across the globe to share knowledge, challenge assumptions, and engineer solutions that make a real difference.

About You

You are a curious, driven, and collaborative technologist who loves solving complex problems with elegant solutions. You bring strong engineering fundamentals and a cloud-native mindset, and you're equally comfortable diving into the details as you are thinking at an architectural level. You communicate ideas with confidence, embrace agile ways of working, and bring creative thinking to every challenge. Whether you're mentoring peers, prototyping a new solution, or presenting to stakeholders, you make an impact.

We Are Looking for Candidates Who Meet These Requirements:

• 10+ years of experience in software engineering with strong fundamentals in design patterns, data structures, and software architecture

• Full-stack development proficiency with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, and JavaScript/TypeScript with Angular or React frameworks (minimum 3 years in Angular or React)

• Cloud platform expertise in Azure with a solid understanding of cloud-native architectures and software patterns

• REST API design and implementation skills, including proficiency with OpenAPI, Swagger, and microservices architecture

• DevOps and SDLC proficiency across a modern DevOps platform — Azure DevOps preferred, with Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent experience also welcomed

• Knowledge of modern AuthN/AuthZ practices and standards, particularly OAuth and OpenID Connect

• Experience with security-by-design principles and their application in cloud environments

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills — able to operate at both abstract and detailed levels, ensuring solutions are pragmatic and realistic

• Ability to evaluate and communicate technology choices through prototyping, feasibility studies, and clear documentation

These Are Additional Nice to Haves:

• An understanding of insurance or reinsurance business concepts — a genuine plus that will help you connect technology decisions to business outcomes

• Experience working with globally distributed teams and outsourcing partners across different time zones and cultures

jobs.title: Senior IT Business Analyst for Finance Reporting & Analytics

titleByLocale.en: Senior IT Business Analyst for Finance Reporting & Analytics
titleByLocale.it: Senior IT Business Analista for Finanza Reporting & Analytics
titleByLocale.de: Senior IT Business Analyst for Finanzen Reporting & Analytics
titleByLocale.fr: Senior IT Business Analyste for Finance Reporting & Analytics

jobs.description:
About the role
 We are looking for a Senior IT Business Analyst to join our team, supporting business-critical data-driven solutions.
 This role requires a well-balanced profile combining technical capabilities with solid business analysis expertise. The ideal candidate brings a hands-on technical background (e.g., software development or similar) and is motivated to connect systems, data, and business processes to drive practical and scalable Reporting & Analytics solutions.
 You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as a trusted execution partner and taking full end-to-end ownership of initiatives while working within the strategic direction defined.
 Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong willingness to learn are key success factors in this role.
 Key Responsibilities

• Take end-to-end ownership of system and process implementation and improvement initiatives, from requirements definition through implementation and validation.

• Partner with business stakeholders to understand needs, refine requirements, and propose scalable and pragmatic solutions.

• Translate business requirements into clear and structured technical specifications, and ensure transparent delivery with visibility on progress, risks and dependencies.

• Conduct delivery planning and support Product Owners in product backlog management, ensuring alignment between business priorities and technical readiness.

• Drive the implementation of new products and features and provide ongoing support for existing Reporting & Analytics applications and data products in a BAU environment.

• Perform in-depth data analysis to validate business logic, transform data, and ensure consistency and reliability.

• Collaborate closely with engineers, developers and architects to design robust and maintainable solutions aligned with enterprise standards.

• Independently manage the workstream, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, and timelines.

• Ensure proper documentation, traceability, and adherence to governance and control standards.

• Identify opportunities for process optimization and continuous improvement.

About the Team

You will join the Palantir Foundry Reporting & Analytics Solutions team, a high‑impact product team working at the intersection of Finance, data, and technology. The team delivers and runs modern, scalable, reliable, and data-driven solutions that enable better decision-making and operational efficiency.
 Collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement are at the core of how we work. You will join a supportive and dynamic environment where initiative, accountability, professional growth are valued and you’ll find a supportive environment that encourages idea-sharing and mutual respect.

About You

You're a passionate professional who thrives in collaborative environments and gets energized by solving complex problems. You have a talent for translating business needs into technical requirements and can effectively communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You're data-driven, customer-focused, and committed to continuous improvement.

We are looking for a candidate who meets these requirements:

• 5 – 8+ years of relevant experience in IT Business Analysis or hybrid technical/business roles, ideally in Finance (e.g., accounting), Sustainability, and/or Reporting & Analytics.

• Ability to operate independently and drive initiatives with minimal supervision.

• Experience with database concepts, data structures and software development (e.g., Python, PySpark, SQL).

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge business and technology and influence at multiple seniority levels.

• Ability to translate business requirements into implementable technical solutions, balancing feasibility, scalability, and delivery constraints.

• Proven experience with Palantir Foundry or comparable modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake), combined with a background in Finance / Sustainability / FP&A and the (Re-)Insurance industry is a strong advantage.

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving mindset, including familiarity with product delivery and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.

• Strong command of Agile ways of working and environments (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira).

• Experience applying AI technologies and techniques to support product development and business analysis processes.

• Knowledge of data governance, data quality principles and/or experience with audit processes is an advantage.

• Learning mindset and adaptability to new business domains.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 3,200 and EUR 5,300 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

jobs.description:
Are you a highly motivated professional looking for an exciting opportunity to make your mark in the world of Marine reinsurance?
 Do you have a passion for underwriting and a desire to work in a prominent role where you can demonstrate your expertise and market knowledge? If so, we'd love to hear from you!
 About the Role
 We are looking for a Marine Underwriter to join our Marine & Energy Treaty team in London.
 In this role, you'll take an active part in underwriting Marine treaty reinsurance business, working alongside experienced colleagues to deliver sound underwriting decisions and provide outstanding service to our clients and brokers.
 You'll have real ownership of your work, the opportunity to strengthen key relationships, and a platform to contribute meaningfully to the continued growth and success of the portfolio.
 Key Responsibilities

• Analyse and assess treaty reinsurance submissions, evaluating exposures, coverage, and pricing to identify and negotiate the best underwriting position for Swiss Re.

• Underwrite Marine treaty reinsurance business across Cargo, Hull, Liability, Energy, and PVT, including preparing quotations, proposals, wordings, and clauses.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and brokers, identifying opportunities to deepen existing partnerships and support cross-selling across other lines of business.

• Contribute to portfolio strategy by supporting Marine portfolio initiatives, market analysis, and underwriting projects.

• Share technical knowledge and market insights with colleagues, contributing to knowledge-sharing initiatives and supporting the continuous development of the underwriting team
 About the Team
 Our Marine & Energy Treaty team is a dynamic and collaborative group of specialists based in London, operating at the heart of one of the world's leading reinsurance markets.
 We underwrite a diverse and high-quality portfolio spanning Cargo, Hull, Liability, Energy, and PVT, working closely with brokers and clients across the globe.
 As part of Swiss Re's broader P&C Reinsurance division, we combine deep technical expertise with a commercial mindset to deliver innovative reinsurance solutions. We're also proud of the inclusive and supportive culture we've built along the way.
 About You
 We are looking for an open-minded, collaborative, and proactive individual who thrives in a dynamic environment.
 You'll engage confidently with colleagues, clients, and brokers, bringing strong communication and negotiation skills to every interaction. You take genuine ownership of your work, approach challenges with a proactive mindset, and are committed to continuously developing your technical expertise.
 You'll bring a strong blend of analytical capability and commercial thinking that enables you to make sound, well-reasoned underwriting decisions.
 We are looking for candidates who have:

• Around 5–6 years of relevant experience within the insurance and/or reinsurance industry, gained in underwriting, broking, or another market-facing role.

• Strong analytical skills , with the ability to assess risk, interpret data, and exercise sound commercial judgement.

• Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with brokers, clients, and internal stakeholders.

• Experience in Marine, Energy, or PVT insurance or reinsurance is an advantage.

• A strong commercial mindset , with the ability to identify and capitalise on market opportunities.

• The ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining close attention to detail
 Compensation
 For the United Kingdom, the base salary range for this position is £106,000–£158,000 for a full-time role.
 The specific salary offered will take into consideration:

• The requirements, scope, complexity, and responsibilities of the role.

• The applicant's profile, including education, qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills, and experience
 Working Model
 Our company operates a hybrid working model, with the expectation that you will work from the office at least three days per week .

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you a highly motivated professional looking for an exciting opportunity to make your mark in the world of Marine reinsurance?
 Do you have a passion for underwriting and a desire to work in a prominent role where you can demonstrate your expertise and market knowledge? If so, we'd love to hear from you!
 About the Role
 We are looking for a Marine Underwriter to join our Marine & Energy Treaty team in London.
 In this role, you'll take an active part in underwriting Marine treaty reinsurance business, working alongside experienced colleagues to deliver sound underwriting decisions and provide outstanding service to our clients and brokers.
 You'll have real ownership of your work, the opportunity to strengthen key relationships, and a platform to contribute meaningfully to the continued growth and success of the portfolio.
 Key Responsibilities

• Analyse and assess treaty reinsurance submissions, evaluating exposures, coverage, and pricing to identify and negotiate the best underwriting position for Swiss Re.

• Underwrite Marine treaty reinsurance business across Cargo, Hull, Liability, Energy, and PVT, including preparing quotations, proposals, wordings, and clauses.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and brokers, identifying opportunities to deepen existing partnerships and support cross-selling across other lines of business.

• Contribute to portfolio strategy by supporting Marine portfolio initiatives, market analysis, and underwriting projects.

• Share technical knowledge and market insights with colleagues, contributing to knowledge-sharing initiatives and supporting the continuous development of the underwriting team
 About the Team
 Our Marine & Energy Treaty team is a dynamic and collaborative group of specialists based in London, operating at the heart of one of the world's leading reinsurance markets.
 We underwrite a diverse and high-quality portfolio spanning Cargo, Hull, Liability, Energy, and PVT, working closely with brokers and clients across the globe.
 As part of Swiss Re's broader P&C Reinsurance division, we combine deep technical expertise with a commercial mindset to deliver innovative reinsurance solutions. We're also proud of the inclusive and supportive culture we've built along the way.
 About You
 We are looking for an open-minded, collaborative, and proactive individual who thrives in a dynamic environment.
 You'll engage confidently with colleagues, clients, and brokers, bringing strong communication and negotiation skills to every interaction. You take genuine ownership of your work, approach challenges with a proactive mindset, and are committed to continuously developing your technical expertise.
 You'll bring a strong blend of analytical capability and commercial thinking that enables you to make sound, well-reasoned underwriting decisions.
 We are looking for candidates who have:

• Around 5–6 years of relevant experience within the insurance and/or reinsurance industry, gained in underwriting, broking, or another market-facing role.

• Strong analytical skills , with the ability to assess risk, interpret data, and exercise sound commercial judgement.

• Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with brokers, clients, and internal stakeholders.

• Experience in Marine, Energy, or PVT insurance or reinsurance is an advantage.

• A strong commercial mindset , with the ability to identify and capitalise on market opportunities.

• The ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining close attention to detail
 Compensation
 For the United Kingdom, the base salary range for this position is £106,000–£158,000 for a full-time role.
 The specific salary offered will take into consideration:

• The requirements, scope, complexity, and responsibilities of the role.

• The applicant's profile, including education, qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills, and experience
 Working Model
 Our company operates a hybrid working model, with the expectation that you will work from the office at least three days per week .

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

jobs.title: Technical Accounting Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about accounting and ready to make an impact at one of the world's leadingreinsurance companies? Join our Operations team in São Paulo and help us deliver exceptionalservice to our clients.
 About the Role
 As a Technical Accounting Analyst, you'll be at the core of our reinsurance operations — ensuring financial accuracy, managing complex transactions, and keeping our operational engine running smoothly.
 Key Responsibilities

• Book and process accounting transactions accurately and in a timely manner across complex reinsurance portfolios

• Manage billing and collection cycles, ensuring invoices are issued correctly and payments are tracked and followed up

• Identify and resolve account and payment discrepancies, working closely with clients and internal teams to reach swift resolutions

• Interpret complex reinsurance agreements to ensure transactions are processed in line with contractual terms

• Participate in projects and special tasks, provide training and assistance to team members, and conduct root cause and failure analysis of workflows

About the Team
 You'll join a motivated Operations team managing Reinsurance portfolios for Brazil & South Cone. We collaborate daily with global peers to deliver fast, effective, and high-quality service. Our continuous improvement mindset keeps us at the forefront of reinsurance operations.
 About You
 You are a dynamic professional who brings energy and clarity to every challenge. You communicate with confidence, listen actively, and know how to turn complex problems into practical solutions. You thrive in fast-paced environments, adapt quickly to change, and bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to your work — making you a valued partner to both clients and colleagues alike.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 1–3 years of experience in insurance, reinsurance, or a related field, with end-to-end reinsurance operations knowledge

• Strong financial accounting knowledge applied to complex reinsurance transactions

• Advanced Excel skills and enthusiasm for data analysis; intermediate MS Office proficiency

• Degree in Accounting, Finance, Actuarial Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics, or Insurance

• Intermediate English proficiency

These are additional nice to haves :

• Experience with Power BI and R for data insights

• Spanish proficiency for South Cone client engagement

• Advanced reinsurance technical accounting expertise in Life & Health

• Strong ability to prioritize and manage competing deadlines

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 Please submit your CV in English

jobs.description:
Are you a law student eager to develop your career in a truly international environment? Join our Reinsurance Contracts team in Brazil and gain hands-on experience supporting complex reinsurance transactions across multiple lines of business, while collaborating with colleagues across Latin America and the global Contracts community. This is a unique opportunity to build legal, commercial and analytical skills while working alongside experienced professionals in one of the world's leading reinsurance companies.
 About the Role
 The intern will work under the guidance and supervision of the Senior Reinsurance Contracts Counsel in charge of P&C Reinsurance Contracts in Brazil, performing:

jobs.title: Actuarial Intern (Fall 2026)
jobs.description:
Launch your actuarial career with an exciting internship at our Canadian office in Toronto! This is your chance to gain hands-on experience in the Life & Health Reinsurance industry while working alongside professionals who are passionate about mentoring the next generation of actuarial talent. You'll develop valuable skills, build your professional network, and apply your academic knowledge to real-world challenges.
 About the Role
 As an Actuarial Intern in the Life & Health Valuation Americas team, you'll be immersed in meaningful work that contributes to Swiss Re's success while developing your technical and professional capabilities in a supportive environment.
 Responsibilities of the role may include:

• Assist with valuation model investigations and enhancements, gaining expertise in AXIS modelling tools.

• Contribute to experience studies and annual updates of assumptions by analyzing relevant data and identifying key trends.

• Support IFRS 17 and Swiss Statutory reserving and financial reporting, gaining valuable exposure to industry standards.

• Contribute to automation initiatives and process improvements, using technology to increase the team's operational efficiency.

• Work on other diverse projects and provide support to team members as needed.
 About the Team
 The L&H Valuation & Analysis Americas team is part of Finance and plays a critical role in the independent valuation of our Americas Life & Health reinsurance business. The team is responsible for the preparation, analysis, and reporting of quarterly and annual reserves and capital across a diverse portfolio, including mortality, critical illness, disability, medical and medical supplement.
 Beyond delivering robust and timely reserving guidance, the team partners closely with Market Units to translate actuarial insights into actionable strategies, enabling proactive business steering and supporting Swiss Re’s commitment to sound financial management and risk transparency.
 About You

You are a motivated student with a passion for numbers, problem-solving, and learning. You are eager to apply your academic knowledge in a professional setting, and you are excited about building a career in the actuarial field.

• Available to work for Fall 2026 for 4 to 8 months.

• Pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics or related field.

• Proficient with Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel.

• Demonstrated progress in actuarial exams.

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

• Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams.

• Experience with database applications and SQL, programming languages such as R and Python, Power BI, or AXIS modeling would be an asset.

• Previous internship experience in insurance, finance, or related fields.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. This is your chance to gain hands-on experience in the Life & Health Reinsurance industry while working alongside professionals who are passionate about mentoring the next generation of actuarial talent. You'll develop valuable skills, build your professional network, and apply your academic knowledge to real-world challenges.
 About the Role
 As an Actuarial Intern in the Life & Health Valuation Americas team, you'll be immersed in meaningful work that contributes to Swiss Re's success while developing your technical and professional capabilities in a supportive environment.
 Responsibilities of the role may include:

• Assist with valuation model investigations and enhancements, gaining expertise in AXIS modelling tools.

• Contribute to experience studies and annual updates of assumptions by analyzing relevant data and identifying key trends.

• Support IFRS 17 and Swiss Statutory reserving and financial reporting, gaining valuable exposure to industry standards.

• Contribute to automation initiatives and process improvements, using technology to increase the team's operational efficiency.

• Work on other diverse projects and provide support to team members as needed.
 About the Team
 The L&H Valuation & Analysis Americas team is part of Finance and plays a critical role in the independent valuation of our Americas Life & Health reinsurance business. The team is responsible for the preparation, analysis, and reporting of quarterly and annual reserves and capital across a diverse portfolio, including mortality, critical illness, disability, medical and medical supplement.

jobs.description:
Are you a financially sharp, analytically driven professional who thrives at the intersection of data, strategy, and storytelling? Do you want to play a pivotal role in shaping the financial direction of a global reinsurance leader? If so, this is your opportunity to make a real impact!

About the Role
 As a Finance Manager within our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function, you will be at the heart of empowering business leaders with the insights, analytics, and financial planning they need to make bold, informed decisions. You will develop a deep understanding of our business to identify and communicate the drivers of financial performance, while producing financial plans that reflect our strategic ambitions. This is a role for someone pragmatic, curious, and collaborative — someone who can extract meaning from complex data, connect the dots across the organization, and communicate answers with clarity and confidence.
 Key Responsibilities
 Performance & Analytics

• Build a detailed understanding of financial performance drivers each quarter by cultivating strong relationships across client markets, reporting and controlling, and actuarial/pricing functions

• Ensure timely and accurate analysis and submissions of financial performance to senior stakeholders, including pipeline information, dashboards, and quarterly performance reports

• Collaborate cross-functionally to respond to ad-hoc requests and present findings and recommendations to management
 New Business Close Process & Business Plan

• Work closely with the BU FP&A team to support and develop requirements for New Business projections and the business plan

• Facilitate change activities related to IFRS-17 performance reporting by maintaining a full end-to-end understanding of business and finance operations, ledger closing, and financial reporting (e.g., New Business and Business Plan)

• Analyze business results and system outputs , ensuring consistent valuation compared to the business plan and costing

• Drive business input into IFRS-17 KPI and business plan development , serving as the key connection point between Finance Americas and the BU L&H team
 Business Steering

• Act as a trusted finance partner in strategic discussions, supporting the business in commercial decision-making

• Provide clear, actionable insights into the financial impact of transactions and other business actions

About the Team
 The team falls within the broader mandate of FP&A Americas Life & Health (L&H) Re and proudly supports the Canadian portfolio — making it the go-to function for the region on all matters related to performance management, financial steering, reporting, and advisory on growth initiatives, transactions, and other business priorities. We work closely with client managers, other Finance teams, and the wider Swiss Re organization, bringing together a rich diversity of perspectives and expertise. Our vibrant, collaborative team is made up of members based across Armonk, Kansas City, Miami, and Toronto — and we are excited to welcome a new voice to the mix!

About You
 You are an analytically outstanding professional with a sharp commercial mindset and a talent for crafting compelling financial narratives. You bring curiosity, flexibility, and the ability to prioritize and deliver high-quality results under time pressure. Your excellent interpersonal skills allow you to engage confidently and constructively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization — and your collaborative, positive energy makes you a valued partner wherever you work.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Experience with L&H IFRS Financials is required, with a solid understanding of multi-valuation concepts, in particular IFRS 17/9

• 5–7 years of relevant work experience (5+ years in insurance), with strong knowledge of insurance/reinsurance business and performance drivers

• Academic background encompassing elements of Mathematics, Computer Science, financial modelling, actuarial sciences, and/or finance
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Strong computing and data management skills ; knowledge of multiple financial systems and programming languages is a significant advantage

• Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills — the ability to translate complex financial data into clear, engaging storylines for diverse audiences

• Experience working in a global, matrixed organization and navigating cross-functional collaboration across geographies

• Familiarity with FP&A processes including business planning, forecasting, and performance reporting in a reinsurance or insurance context

• A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver under tight deadlines
 This role will be located in our Toronto office. Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week.
 The base salary hiring range for this existing position located in Toronto is CAD $122,000 to $154,000. The specific base salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.range

jobs.description:
Location: Bangalore

Senior Digital Risk Advisor

Join a team of digital risk governance professionals and help drive the evolution of Swiss Re’s Digital Governance Framework (DGF), the central process governing the review and assessment of digital and technology initiatives across the organisation. In this role, you will work with cross-functional stakeholders to evolve framework processes and workflows while supporting strategic governance initiatives across Swiss Re.

About the team

The Digital Risk Governance & Control team is a cornerstone of Swiss Re's resilience strategy. We are dedicated to managing risks related to digital initiatives, ensuring they are properly identified, assessed, and controlled. As owners of the Digital Governance Framework (DGF), we are responsible for shaping and advancing the governance of digital and technology initiatives across Swiss Re. The DGF integrates multiple governance, risk, and control functions into a unified framework and workflow, enabling cross-functional collaboration, governance transparency, and risk-informed decision-making across digital initiatives.

In your role, you will…

• Drive the evolution of the Digital Governance Framework (DGF) by improving governance models, processes, and workflows.

• Design scalable and pragmatic governance solutions that support effective and risk-informed decision-making.

• Identify process inefficiencies, challenge existing approaches, and lead governance and workflow improvements.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to align governance requirements, priorities, and implementation approaches.

• Facilitate governance discussions and drive alignment across technology, risk, security, architecture, and business teams.

• Develop and maintain governance standards, procedures, and audit-ready documentation.

• Prepare executive-level reporting, presentations, and strategic governance materials for senior leadership.

• Translate complex governance and technology topics into clear and actionable communication for diverse audiences.

• Support organisational adoption and awareness of governance practices through stakeholder engagement and internal communications.

What we need from you

• 10+ years of work experience in digital governance, technology risk, governance transformation, process improvement, consulting, operating model design, or related areas.

• Demonstrated experience improving or redesigning governance frameworks, operating models, or cross-functional initiatives within complex technology environments.

• Strong conceptual and analytical thinking skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, connect ideas across domains, and challenge existing approaches.

• Experience driving cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholder groups with competing priorities and perspectives.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including experience preparing high-quality executive presentations and governance reporting for senior leadership forums.

• Strong facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence discussions, navigate ambiguity, and build alignment across functions.

• Experience preparing structured governance documentation, operating procedures, standards, or audit-ready process artefacts.

• Ability to translate abstract governance and risk concepts into practical, implementable processes and workflows.

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Business Technology, or a related IT field.

Nice-to-have

• Additional certifications in information security, governance, or risk management (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CRISC).

• Familiarity with cloud technologies, data governance, AI, or emerging technology risk topics.

• Experience working with workflow tools or process management platforms.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
